jobs.title: Account Director, Digital Natives - France
jobs.description:
About the team

OpenAI’s mission is to build safe artificial general intelligence (AGI) which benefits all of humanity. This long-term undertaking brings the world’s best scientists, engineers, and business professionals into one lab together to accomplish this.

In pursuit of this mission, our Go To Market (GTM) team is responsible for helping customers learn how to leverage and deploy our highly capable AI products across their business. The team is made of Sales, Solutions, Support, Marketing, and Partnership professionals that work together to create valuable solutions that will help bring AI to as many users as possible.

About the role

Our Sales team has a unique mission to help customers understand the deep impact that highly capable AI models can bring to their business and users. This role is a mixture of technical understanding, vision, partnership, and value-driven strategy.

You’ll be a key driver of opportunities through the entire sales cycle, from pipeline generation to closure. You’ll work with researchers, engineers, and solution strategists to help customers evolve their industry with AI.

This role is based in Paris. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week.

 

In this role, you'll:

  • Manage ~dozen key accounts, developing and executing strategies for a comprehensive account plan

  • Lead our enterprise prospects’ journeys from consideration to succesful deployment

  • Partner with solutions and research engineering to build and execute complex customer programs and projects

  • Own a consumption revenue target

  • Manage consumption revenue forecasts

  • Analyze key account metrics to create reports and provide insights to internal and external stakeholders

  • Closely monitor the industry landscape (people, competitors, partners, etc.) to contribute to product roadmap and other corporate strategies

  • Collaborate with solutions, marketing, communications, business operations, people operations, finance, product management, and engineering

  • Support the recruitment and onboarding of other teammates

  • Support the development of company culture

We're seeking someone with experience including:

  • 5-7+ years selling platform-as-a-service and/or software-as-a-service

  • Achieving revenue targets >$1M per year for more than 3 years

  • Designing and executing complex deal strategies

  • Supporting the growth of fast-growing, high-performance companies

  • Working directly with c-level executives

  • Communicating technical concepts to customers and internal stakeholders

  • Leading high-visibility customer events (CAB, conferences, product launches, etc.)

  • Gathering, distilling, and processing complex market (industry, competitor, customer, prospect) intelligence

 

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Are customer-centric. You are motivated to deeply understand your customer’s priorities and help them achieve their vision for using our models to improve their products and services. You build strong relationships with executives and professionals across functions and serve as a trusted advisor.

  • Have a passion or deep curiosity in artificial intelligence. You embrace the opportunity to help deploy our technology in a way that benefits humanity. You’re excited to educate our customers on AI and how to plan for the future.

  • Are a builder. You are excited to impact how our company operates and scales. Your passion is building strong systems and processes from the ground up and executing them with precision.

  • Are excited by new challenges. You don’t have the answers to every question up front, but the process of solving them invigorates you. Bespoke issues requiring multidimensional knowledge excite you. You’re willing to experiment with new solutions.

  • Are a strategist. You deeply understand go to market best practices and raise the bar for our organization. You think and plan forward on the order of years and bring internal and external stakeholders along with your strategy.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

jobs.title: Director, GTM Partnerships, SME & growth
jobs.description:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

 

Attributes We Value

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

 

About the role...

As Partnerships Director, France & Spain, you will lead and develop a team of four partnership managers:

  • Two Accounting Partnerships Managers

  • One Venture Capital Partnerships Manager

  • One Travel & E-commerce Partnerships Manager

You will own the partnerships strategy and commercial performance across both markets, building a channel-led growth engine that generates qualified introductions, partner-sourced pipeline and net-new business for Airwallex.

This is a strategic, hands-on player-coach role. You will set direction, develop the team and build the operating model, while personally sourcing, negotiating, activating and growing strategic partnerships.

The role is focused on commercial partnerships and lead generation—not technical integrations. The initial priority is to build the Accounting and Travel & E-commerce channels across France and Spain. The broader scope includes Payments and Venture Capital and may evolve with business priorities.

The role is based in either France or Spain, with a minimum of three days per week in the relevant Airwallex office.

What you’ll do...

  • Own the France and Spain partnerships strategy, aligned with the SME & Growth GTM.

  • Set partner ICPs, commercial priorities, account plans, pipeline expectations and operating standards across the team.

  • Lead, coach and develop the four partnership managers.

  • Personally source and progress a portfolio of strategic partnerships in at least one priority vertical.

  • Build repeatable referral, reseller, co-selling and partner-led outbound motions across Accounting, Travel, Payments, E-commerce and VC.

  • Ensure signed partnerships become active commercial channels, not passive logos.

  • Work with Sales on account mapping, lead routing, qualification, follow-up and conversion of partner-sourced opportunities.

  • Track active partners, referrals, opportunities, sourced and influenced pipeline, conversion, time to first referral and revenue contribution.

  • Test partner segments and commercial motions; scale what creates quality pipeline and stop what does not.

  • Work cross-functionally with Marketing, RevOps, Product, Solutions, Risk and Compliance to remove friction from the partner journey.

What you’ll bring...

  • 8+ years in partnerships, channel sales, indirect sales, partner sales, strategic business development or a comparable commercial role.

  • A successful 0-to-1 partnership motion or vertical launch in Accounting or Travel & E-commerce, with measurable commercial outcomes.

  • Strong channel-led execution and a personal track record of partner-sourced referrals, pipeline, opportunities or revenue.

  • Commercial experience across at least two of these verticals: Accounting, Travel, Payments, E-commerce or Venture Capital.

  • A deep, activatable network in at least one priority vertical, with access to senior decision-makers.

  • Strong strategic judgement and hands-on execution: you can define the strategy and personally open the first doors, lead key meetings and progress strategic partnerships.

  • Experience designing partner ICPs, activation motions, attribution and channel performance management.

  • Experience leading, coaching or developing partnership professionals is preferred. Formal people-management experience is valuable, but not the only indicator of leadership potential.

  • Experience in accounting, payments, fintech, ERP, financial software or another competitive B2B environment.

  • Professional English plus native or bilingual French or Spanish. Native or bilingual proficiency in the other local language is a strong advantage, but not required.

  • Comfortable with CRM, funnel metrics, partner economics and basic business cases.

Who you are...

  • Strategic and hands-on: you can set direction while staying close to partners, pipeline and commercial details.

  • Channel-led: you care about net-new business and revenue, not only signed agreements or ecosystem visibility.

  • A builder: you create structure from zero, test quickly and learn without waiting for a perfect playbook.

  • Commercially accountable: you use data to decide where to invest, coach or stop.

  • A player-coach: you develop people while continuing to win strategic partnerships yourself.

What success looks like...

  • The four partnership managers have clear mandates, partner ICPs, account priorities and measurable pipeline objectives.

  • Accounting and Travel & E-commerce have prioritised partner strategies and active channel motions in France and Spain.

  • Partner cohorts are recruited, activated and connected to repeatable referral, reseller or co-selling motions.

  • You personally own strategic partnerships that contribute materially to Airwallex’s growth.

  • Partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline is accurately tracked and converted with clear Sales ownership.

  • The team scales the highest-performing partner segments and quickly deprioritises inactive or low-potential relationships.

Why join Airwallex...

You will own a strategic growth engine across France and Spain and shape how Airwallex builds channel-led growth in the region.

  • Director-level ownership across two European markets

  • Strategic and hands-on player-coach role

  • Direct ownership of partner-sourced growth and strategic partnerships

  • Opportunity to build scalable channels across Accounting, Travel, E-commerce, Payments and VC

  • Hybrid role in France or Spain: minimum three days per week in the relevant office

  • Competitive salary, commission and equity

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

jobs.title: DPO & Compliance Officer
jobs.description:
🌀 The Company

Filigran, founded in October 2022, stands out in the cybertech ecosystem for its commitment to revolutionizing cyber threat management with a proactive approach. Its mission is to develop innovative open-source solutions designed to anticipate cyber threats, identify security gaps, and strengthen organizational security posture.

Filigran solutions are now trusted by over 6,000 public and private organizations worldwide.

🎯 The Role

We’re looking for a DPO & Compliance Officer to design and implement Filigran’s practical, scalable compliance program.

You will be Filigran’s formal Data Protection Officer, ensuring strong privacy governance across our products, operations and international footprint. You will also lead the day-to-day design and delivery of broader compliance workstreams, including AI governance, cybersecurity regulation, operational resilience, export controls and sanctions.

You will work closely with the General Counsel, CEO, CISO, People, Product, Engineering and Sales teams, helping Filigran meet regulatory expectations in a business-minded attitude.

💼 Your Responsibilities

  • Act as Filigran’s Data Protection Officer and primary point of contact for supervisory authorities, including the CNIL, and for data subjects.

  • Design and operate Filigran’s privacy program, including ROPAs, DPIAs, privacy by design, retention, data-subject rights, breach assessment and international data transfers.

  • Lead the design and operational implementation of compliance controls across AI governance, NIS2, operational resilience, export controls and economic sanctions, under the General Counsel’s leadership.

  • Maintain a proportionate compliance framework, including policies, risk mapping, monitoring plans, internal controls and clear reporting.

  • Partner with Security to translate regulatory requirements into practical, business-enabling policies and controls that work for a fast-growing cybersecurity company.

  • Partner with Security, Product and Engineering to embed privacy, AI and regulatory requirements into product development, vendor management and customer assurance.

  • Monitor regulatory developments across the EU, UK, US and other relevant markets, and provide clear recommendations to the General Counsel and executive team.

  • Support enterprise sales and procurement by responding to privacy, AI governance and compliance requirements.

  • Leverage AI tools and methodologies to boost productivity and impact

  • Contribute to building AI capabilities into internal workflows

🤝 Who You’ll Work With

You will have a split reporting line:

  • For your statutory DPO responsibilities, you will report directly to the CEO. You will have the independence and access to senior management required to carry out those responsibilities.

  • For all other compliance responsibilities, you will report to the General Counsel, who retains ultimate accountability for Filigran’s wider compliance programme and material compliance decisions.

You will work closely with the General Counsel, CISO, Security, Product, Engineering, Sales, People and Finance teams. You will lead delivery across the programme while knowing when to escalate decisions and draw on internal or external specialists.

🧬 Profile We’re Looking For

  • 7 to 10 years’ experience as a DPO, data privacy lead or compliance officer, ideally in a fast-growing technology or SaaS company.

  • Demonstrable expert knowledge of data protection law and practice. A recognized DPO certification or IAPP qualification, such as CIPP/E, is strongly preferred.

  • Experience with a company-wide implementation of the EU AI Act.

  • Deep, hands-on command of GDPR and UK GDPR, including ROPAs, DPIAs, breach management, data-subject rights and international transfers.

  • Demonstrable ownership of at least two adjacent regulatory programmes, such as AI governance, cybersecurity regulation, operational resilience, export controls or economic sanctions.

  • Able to lead unfamiliar workstreams with sound judgement and appropriate specialist internal or external support.

  • Comfortable translating complex legal and regulatory requirements into proportionate controls that work operationally.

  • Able to build strong relationships and credibility with technical, commercial and executive stakeholders.

  • Comfortable working in a remote, async-first environment.

  • Autonomy, ownership and team spirit.

  • Strong interest in AI and its applications in the privacy & compliance function

  • Comfortable working with and leveraging AI-powered tools (LLMs, automation, copilots, etc.) to improve workflows and productivity

  • Bonus: experience in cybersecurity, threat intelligence or a technical B2B SaaS environment; fluency in English and French.

🌱 Why Join Filigran? More than just a job.

We’re a fast-growing, global, and fully remote company building open-source cybersecurity solutions, increasingly powered by AI, to help defense teams anticipate threats and act faster.

⭐ What we believe

We believe we do work that matters, uniting defenders into a global community to make security more open, resilient & collaborative.

💻 How we work

We do work that matters by combining strong engineering standards with emerging technologies, including AI, to move faster and smarter.

🧭 What guides us

We make our work matter by building a culture grounded in our CORE values of Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility, and Equity. The principles that guide how we make decisions, treat people, and grow together, especially when no one’s watching.

💰 Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive pay + equity - everyone shares in our success

  • Remote-first, flexible, and balanced - work that fits your life

  • Your setup, your choice - pick the gear that works for you

  • Twice-a-year gatherings - we meet in person for regional and global offsites to connect, collaborate, and strengthen our culture beyond the screen

🌍 Equal Employment Opportunity

We enable cybersecurity through inclusion - from code to culture.

At Filigran, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe diversity of our people make our products and our team stronger. We welcome talent of every background, identity, and lived experience, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

What matters here is what you bring, not what you look like, where you’re from, or how you identify.

🚀 Ready to Join Us?

Apply now and help us build the future of the cybersecurity ecosystem, together.

Artificial Intelligence. Actual Impact.

At Docebo, we’re using AI to change how people learn at work—and we mean actually change it. We’re an AI-powered learning platform that helps organizations create, deliver, and manage training all in one place. But our real mission goes deeper: we help teams move faster, work smarter, and focus on the work that truly matters. Our platform is built with intelligent, time-saving tools that personalize learning, eliminate busywork, and turn training from a checkbox into a superpower. The result? Better experiences for learners and real results for businesses.

We’re shaping the future of learning with a team that isn’t afraid to challenge the status quo. If you're excited by the idea of using AI to make work-life better for real people–you’ll feel right at home here. And it’s not just what we build, it’s how we show up. At Docebo, our values aren’t just posters on the wall—they guide how we work every day. We call it the Docebo Heart: trust by default, assume positive intent, and create space for different perspectives to thrive.

So… what are you waiting for? Join 900+ Docebians around the world and help us reinvent the way people learn, because learning never stops.

🚀 The Adventure Ahead

As our Workplace Experience Manager in Paris, you will be the heartbeat of our office, transforming ordinary workdays into vibrant, hospitality-driven experiences. You’ll take full ownership of building a thriving local community, executing memorable events, and ensuring our facilities run like a well-oiled machine. By adapting global initiatives to fit our unique Parisian flair, you’ll directly shape our culture and create an energizing environment where top talent loves to gather, collaborate, and thrive.

🛠️ The Day-to-Day

  • Lead the Experience: Elevate daily office operations and spearhead a warm, polished, hospitality-driven environment for all employees, visitors, candidates, and customers.

  • Curate the Culture: Own the local engagement calendar from concept to execution, crafting memorable themed events, social activities, cultural celebrations, and wellness initiatives.

  • Master the Operations: Manage facilities, vendor relationships, repairs, supplies, cleaning, food and beverage, security, access, and floor plan management seamlessly.

  • Build Strong Alliances: Cultivate meaningful relationships with local employees, leadership, landlords, building management, and cross-functional global partners.

  • Drive Strategic Growth: Oversee the workplace budget, purchase orders, and spending forecasting while supporting office projects, space planning, tech rollouts, and branding installations.

  • Listen and Evolve: Gather employee feedback continuously to identify high-impact opportunities and adapt global workplace programs to reflect the true spirit of Paris.

⚡ Your Superpowers

  • Proven Track Record: Brings 5+ years of experience successfully managing workplace operations, facilities, hospitality, or employee experience independently.

  • Event Mastery: Possesses hands-on expertise in conceptualizing, budgeting, and hosting high-quality, creative, and engaging community events.

  • Operational Excellence: Demonstrates strong skills in vendor management, budget forecasting, space planning, and facilities logistics.

  • Bilingual Communication: Speaks and writes with professional fluency in both French and English to effortlessly bridge global and local teams.

  • Proactive Problem-Solver: Takes complete ownership with energy, adaptability, excellent organization, and a true passion for bringing people together.

🎯 Bonus Points

  • Fast-Paced Savvy: Prior experience working within a global tech or fast-moving organization.

  • Design & Space Vision: An eye for office branding, space layout optimization, and workplace aesthetics.

Our Hybrid Work Philosophy 🤝

Great work can happen anywhere but coming together helps us go further. Our team spends three days a week in the office (Tuesday-Thursday) to collaborate, solve problems, and learn from each other. With flexibility the rest of the week, it’s a balance designed to help everyone do their best work and keep growing.

Our Total Rewards Philosophy 🎉

Our Total Rewards Philosophy centers around three core areas to reward and care for our People:

  • Rewarding Impact: We lead with competitive pay to reward the impact, skills and traits that fuel our success.

  • Fostering Holistic Wellbeing: We care deeply about and invest in the whole person with programs that support our people’s physical, mental, and financial well-being.

  • Empowering Our Talent Culture: We build a culture of trust and empowerment by designing our rewards and benefits with transparency, equity, and flexibility, enabling our people to do their best work and stay for the long haul.

Our Promise to You 😍

  • Financial Wellness: Own a piece of Docebo through our Employee Share Purchase Plan (ESPP) at a 15% discount, plus a competitive compensation package.

  • Your Well-Being, Covered: You’ll get access to health benefits, so you can get the care you need when you need it.

  • Rest, Relax, Repeat: Rest and recharge with paid vacation days, two company-wide Docebo Days, floating holidays for cultural celebrations, and your birthday off!

  • Family First: We provide coverage offering you time with your little one(s) so you can soak up all those precious moments. Fun fact: we had 30 Docebian babies join the family in 2025!

  • Connections That Count: Connect with global communities through our Employee Resource Groups (including PRIDE, DWA, BIDOC, and Green Ambassadors) and company-wide events that keep the fun rolling all year long.

About Docebo 💙

At Docebo, we create seamless, AI-powered learning experiences for over 3,000 customers worldwide. We have successfully achieved two IPOs (TSX: DCBO & NASDAQ: DCBO), been recognized as a top SaaS e-learning solution, and are growing exponentially in the process. We're a global company, with office across North America, EMEA, APAC, and beyond. Our team is guided by five core values—Grow Together Win Together, Build with Our Customer, Clear is Kind, Own Outcomes, Progress Over Perfection—that shape everything we do. If this resonates with you, now is the perfect time to join one of the fastest-growing learning technology companies in the world.

Sidetrade (Euronext Growth: ALBFR.PA) is an AI-native company dedicated to Order-to-Cash (O2C). Its platform combines O2C applications, autonomous AI agents, and Aimie IQ, an intelligent natural-language interface that helps multinationals accelerate their cash generation, all built on SAFE, the Sidetrade Agentic Framework for Enterprise. Sidetrade operates the world's largest proprietary O2C Data Lake, built on $9 trillion in B2B transactions and millions of buying companies. We use this data to train specialized AI models that monitor, analyze, decide, and act autonomously throughout the O2C cycle. Sidetrade supports companies in 85 countries with 450 employees across Europe, North America, and Asia-Pacific.

We’re proud of our 38 nationalities, and these diverse perspectives drive our innovation, one-team culture, and customer-first mindset. Sidetrade has been positioned as a Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ Leader since 2022. We value passion over perfection. So, if you’re eager to learn and bring great energy, we want to hear from you. Be you. Grow with us. 

Curious about Sidetrade? Catch Aimie in motion: Aimie Video

Requirements

Today, we're looking for our Global VP of Talent Acquisition to build and lead our Ai-native shift and create the dream team for our next stage of growth. This is both a strategic and hands-on leadership challenge for designing a scalable, data-driven talent acquisition function across all regions in the world (North America, Europe, and APAC), all functions and levels -from AI expert to GTM and from Mid-level to Executives. You'll partner directly with the executive team and hiring managers to ensure we attract, hire, and onboard the talent needed to hit our growth targets, while building a TA function that's efficient, candidate-centric, and built for scale.

Because it’s instrumental to the strategy, this role will report directly to the CEO.

What you would do:

  • Strategy & Leadership: Define and own the global talent acquisition strategy, aligning hiring plans with headcount budgets, business goals, and workforce planning across all regions.
  • Team Management: Build, lead, and develop a high-performing global TA team, including regional leads, recruiters, sourcers, and coordinators; set goals, coach performance, and grow internal talent.
  • Executive & Leadership Hiring: Personally in charge of hiring senior C-level roles with the CEO.
  • Process & Scale: Design and continuously improve AI Agents for recruiting processes, workflows, and SLAs to ensure a consistent, efficient, and high-quality hiring experience.
  • Employer Brand: Own the company's employer brand and candidate value proposition globally; partner with Marketing and Comms to strengthen our reputation as an employer of choice.
  • Data & Metrics: Establish TA metrics and dashboards (time-to-fill, cost-per-hire, quality-of-hire, pipeline conversion, diversity metrics) and use data to drive decisions and report to the executive team and board.
  • Systems & Tools: Own the ATS and recruiting tech stack; evaluate and implement tools (sourcing, assessment, AI-enabled recruiting tools, CRM) to improve efficiency and candidate experience.
  • DEI: Champion diverse and inclusive hiring practices globally, ensuring equitable processes across all regions.
  • Global & Compliance: Ensure hiring practices comply with local labor laws and regulations across all operating countries; manage relationships with external agencies, RPOs, and immigration/visa partners as needed.
  • Budget Ownership: Own the TA budget, including headcount, tooling, agency spend, and employer branding investments.
  • Stakeholder Partnership: Act as a strategic advisor to hiring managers and executives on org design, market talent trends, compensation benchmarking, and hiring strategy.

 What we are looking for:

  • 10+ years in talent acquisition, with 5+ years in a senior TA leadership role (VP, Head of TA, or similar) at a SaaS or high-growth AI company.
  • Proven experience building and scaling global TA functions across multiple countries/regions (US, Europe)
  • Track record of personally hiring C-Levels
  • Experience operating in a mid-size, fast-growing company environment
  • Hands-on, roll-up-your-sleeves approach balanced with strategic, big-picture thinking.
  • Experience managing distributed, cross-cultural teams.
  • Natural ability to convince and motivate C-Level candidates to join our AI strategy.
  • Strong analytical mindset; comfortable building and presenting TA metrics and forecasts to executive leadership and the board.
  • Deep knowledge of modern sourcing strategies, employer branding, and recruiting technology (AI Recruiter Agents, ATS, CRM).
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills; able to influence and partner with senior executives.
  • Strong understanding of global employment law and compliance considerations related to hiring.

Because when you thrive, we all succeed!

jobs.title: supervisore dei cantieri edili
jobs.description: Per conto di LPM Prefabbricati (https://www.lpmpref.it/) storica azienda con presenza consolidata sul mercato italiano nella fabbricazione di prefabbricati di grandi dimensioni, ricerchiamo un* Geometra con circa 10 anni di esperienza per un ruolo di Responsabile di Commessa con forte presenza in cantiere. La figura seguirà la commessa e il cantiere quotidianamente: pianificazione montaggi, coordinamento risorse, relazione con il cliente e controllo di tempi/costi, garantendo l'esecuzione efficace dei lavori. Obiettivo del ruolo e responsabilità principali: Assicurare che ogni commessa venga gestita con rispetto di tempi, contratti e consegne, mantenendo un presidio operativo sul cantiere e guidando squadre e fornitori con metodo, disciplina e orientamento al risultato. In particolare: Pianificazione delle commesse: organizzare il susseguirsi dei cantieri sul lungo periodo, in base alle scadenze contrattuali, durata dei cantieri, ecc. Pianificazione montaggi prefabbricati: programmare le attività dall'avvio del cantiere al termine del montaggio. Programmare gli step operativi giornalieri/settimanali, e seguire l'avanzamento dei lavori. Coordinamento squadre di cantiere e subappaltatori: organizzazione, controllo operatività, gestione comportamenti e standard (es. riduzione inefficienze). Interfaccia con clienti: gestione richieste e criticità con approccio pratico (es. rimodulare l'ordine di montaggio per rispettare esigenze del cliente senza perdere controllo su tempi/costi). Controllo tempi / contratti / spedizioni: presidio consegne, vincoli contrattuali, varianti ed extra. Valutazione e controllo costi: stime, consuntivi, supporto alla marginalità e gestione economica della commessa. Topografia e rilievi di cantiere: tracciamenti, verifiche quote/dimensioni e controllo esecutivo (in coordinamento con ufficio tecnico/DL dove previsto). Collaborazione continua con ufficio tecnico, produzione e logistica per garantire continuità tra prefabbricazione e montaggio. Requisiti: Diploma di Geometra (o titolo tecnico equivalente). ~10 anni di esperienza in cantieri industriali con responsabilità di capocantiere, o responsabile operativo, o responsabile commessa. Preferibile esperienza in prefabbricati o provenienza da imprese di costruzioni Competenze di pianificazione, gestione priorità, avanzamento lavori e controllo economico. Disponibilità a trasferte su Nord-Ovest Italia e occasionalmente Sud Francia. Leadership concreta e capacità di gestione del team, capacità di far rispettare regole, sicurezza e metodi di lavoro. Ottima relazione con clienti e stakeholder: comunicazione chiara, negoziazione, problem solving. Approccio pratico, orientato a risultato e affidabilità su tempi/consegne. jobs.description:
Role: Product Owner – Communication Channels & AI

Location: Manchester

Hours: Monday-Friday 8:45am-5:15pm

Package: £80k OTE 

As Product Owner - Technical Products, your role is to own and continuously improve PHMG's Technical product portfolio, ensuring Cloud Telephony, AI Receptionist and CCE deliver measurable client value, operational quality and long-term commercial growth. 

You are accountable for translating client needs, technology capability, partner opportunities and commercial priorities into scalable products and service models that strengthen adoption, retention and PHMG's competitive position. 

Through H2 2026, you will lead the evolution of the technical product portfolio by bringing together product performance, platform capability, roadmap execution, client outcomes, commercial discipline, operational readiness and cross-functional alignment into one coherent product improvement agenda. 

Key Objectives 

Core Accountability 

  • Own the strategy, design and ongoing performance of Cloud Telephony, AI Receptionist and CCE.
  • Set a clear, prioritised roadmap that balances client value, technical feasibility, commercial return, operational capacity and partner dependency.
  • Ensure Technical products are positioned, sold, onboarded, serviced and renewed in a way that delivers measurable value for clients.
  • Define the product standards, service models and client journeys that CS and Technical Production can execute consistently.
  • Bring clarity to build, buy and partner decisions so product direction is deliberate, commercially disciplined and scalable.

 

Technical Product Strategy & Roadmap 

  • Define the long-term direction for Cloud Telephony, AI Receptionist and CCE, including the sequence of capability, integrations and service-model changes.
  • Prioritise AI Receptionist growth across both horizontal capability and the vertical use cases where PHMG has the strongest right to win.
  • Create a clear approach for CCE in the existing base, reducing under-utilisation and turning technical review, onboarding and value evidence into retention levers.
  • Partner with the Creative Product Owner so the full product set feels coherent to clients and to the teams selling and servicing it.

Client Experience, Adoption & Value Evidence 

  • Define the client experience for Technical products across onboarding, configuration, in-life usage, renewal and offboarding.
  • Clarify how clients access, configure and understand product value through the portal, including call flows, AI Receptionist behaviour, CCE setup and usage analytics.
  • Ensure CS has the standards, data and language needed to evidence value, drive adoption and manage client expectations confidently.
  • Identify where clients slow, stall or disengage, and build product or service-model interventions that protect retention.

Commercial Performance & Partner Discipline 

  • Own the commercial logic of the Technical portfolio, including pricing, CAC, cost-to-serve, gross margin, revenue performance and investment cases.
  • Operationalise the GoTo resell model with clear pricing, service, process and margin controls while protecting the partner relationship.
  • Use data to assess where Technical products create incremental value, where they cannibalise existing activity and where the model needs to change.
  • Make active trade-offs between speed, quality, margin, client experience and platform investment.

Operational Delivery & Launch Readiness 

  • Work with Technical Production and Tech to define standards, SLAs, runbooks and support models for each product and release.
  • Ensure new capabilities do not go live until operational readiness, client communications, CS briefings and support routes are clear.
  • Create tight governance for launch decisions, technical dependencies, client escalations, recurring provisioning issues and partner constraints.
  • Keep accountability clear between Product, Tech and Product Operations so issues are solved at the right level rather than absorbed by CS.

Insight, Reporting & Continuous Improvement 

  • Maintain a reliable view of product performance across adoption, usage, NPS, retention, revenue, margin, service issues and operational friction.
  • Build structured feedback loops with CS, Client Insights, Sales, Tech and Technical Production to identify product problems worth solving.
  • Turn recurring client or operational issues into permanent product, process, reporting or service-model improvements.
  • Use performance data to make early decisions before product issues become retention, margin or client-experience risks.

Established in 1998, PHMG has grown from a Manchester-founded creative business into the world's leading audio branding agency. Today, we partner with almost 40,000 clients across more than 50 countries, including global brands such as Coca-Cola, Samsung, Adidas and Audi, alongside ambitious SMEs in virtually every sector. Innovation fuels everything we do. From day one, we set out to redefine audio branding by harmonising creativity, technology and measurable results. That mindset continues to shape our evolution as we expand beyond sound into a broader suite of client communication services. In 2025, PHMG entered a defining new chapter as an employee-owned business. Ownership now sits with the people who power our creativity, performance and growth. We are proud recipients of the King's Award for Enterprise, recognised for innovation, growth and performance excellence. Today, more than 800 colleagues across six global offices collaborate to deliver work that blends artistry with commercial impact. Joining PHMG means becoming part of a people-powered, future-focused company that values creativity, champions diversity and invests in professional growth. Sound good?

jobs.description:
What is Flagstone?

Flagstone is many things. An online savings platform, reinventing how individuals, businesses, and charities manage, protect, and grow their cash. A diverse group of people, bound by a collaborative spirit, and shared purpose. And lastly, a thriving, profitable business – where smart people do their best work.

Each definition shares a common thread: our unique culture. It’s our pride and joy. And our competitive advantage.

A feel for our culture

To revolutionise the savings market, we need to be at our best. But high performance takes more than talent – it takes a culture of kindness, respect, and growth.

That’s why we’re building a diverse, inclusive community, where your voice is heard and valued. Where, with close support and room to develop, you can surpass even your own expectations. And be rewarded for it.

We may not change the world, but we can change the world of financial technology. And all it takes is a winning mix of drive, talent, and empathy. Our culture celebrates all three.

But enough about us. Let’s talk about you.

Does this sound like you?

Flagstone is the UK's leading cash platform with £19bn in AuA and a mandate to reach £50bn by 2028. The IFA and wealth manager channel is one of the most significant growth opportunities in front of the business with over 1,400 registered IFA firms on the platform, strong existing relationships to deepen, and a large addressable market of independent advisers who have yet to engage with us at all.

The ARM role combines proactive business development with ongoing relationship management. You will be identifying and engaging IFA firms in Scotland and Northern Ireland, introducing the Flagstone proposition, training advisers on how to use the platform, and building the trusted, consistent relationships that turn a registered firm into an active referral partner.

What You'll Be Doing

Proactive Partner Engagement & Development

  • Own your territory of IFA firms and wealth managers, taking personal responsibility for the breadth and depth of engagement and the referral activity it generates

  • Spend the substantial majority of your time in the field visiting adviser firms, attending regional industry events, and building face-to-face relationships that create consistent, long-term referral partners

  • Proactively identify and approach IFA firms not yet working with Flagstone, introducing the proposition and beginning the relationship development process from first meeting to active referral

  • Work to deepen engagement with registered firms that are not yet actively referring, understanding what is holding them back and taking targeted action to unlock their activity

  • Grow the volume and value of referrals from existing active partners by helping them identify more clients who could benefit from Flagstone

Proposition Training & Education

  • Deliver clear, confident, and compelling presentations of the Flagstone proposition to IFA firms individually and in group settings

  • Train advisers on the Flagstone referral portal and onboarding process, reducing friction and building confidence so that making a referral feels straightforward

  • Keep partner firms up to date with product developments and platform enhancements

  • Use insight from adviser conversations to feed back proposition gaps, platform friction points, or competitive pressures

Reactive Support & Partner Feedback

  • Act as a knowledgeable and responsive point of contact for your partner firms when they have questions about Flagstone, the referral process, or platform features

  • Resolve queries with pace and accuracy, always closing the loop with the adviser

  • Act as a structured source of intelligence from the IFA market back into Flagstone, capturing and communicating what advisers are telling you about the platform, proposition, and competitive landscape

  • Feed adviser feedback directly into the product development process, flagging friction points, missing features, and enhancements that would most meaningfully increase referral activity

Pipeline & Performance

  • Maintain a clear and current picture of your regional pipeline through tracking firm engagement levels, referral volumes, and conversion activity

  • Report regularly to the Relationships Team Lead on the health of your territory - what is working, where the opportunities are, and where support is needed

What You'll Bring

Field Sales & Relationship Management

  • Experience in a field based sales or relationship management role, with a proven track record of building trusted commercial relationships face to face

  • Genuine comfort being out in the field every day, covering a broad and geographically diverse territory - you need to be energised by travel, variety, and independence

  • The personal presence and communication skills to represent Flagstone confidently in front of independent financial advisers, wealth managers, and compliance officers

Financial Services Knowledge

  • A solid understanding of the IFA and wealth manager market - how independent advice firms are structured, how advisers make recommendations, and how cash management fits within a client's financial plan

  • Familiarity with the regulatory landscape: directly authorised firms, Appointed Representatives, and network members

  • Sufficient financial literacy to have credible conversations about cash, interest rates, FSCS protection, and multi-bank diversification

Commercial Drive & Self-Direction

  • A commercially motivated self-starter who takes personal ownership of regional performance and manages their own diary and territory plan

  • Organised and disciplined in how you manage a complex regional portfolio: you plan your visits, track your pipeline, and follow up consistently across a large number of relationships simultaneously

How we reward you:

At Flagstone, the benefits extend beyond false gifts like “fruit and snacks”. Instead, we invest in your health, wealth, and professional development. Here’s a selection of our benefits:

  • Competitive bonus scheme - designed to reward and recognise high performance

  • Flexible benefits budget - a pot to fund meaningful benefits for you, whether it's hormone or fertility testing, cancer screening, neuro-diversity coaching or something that matters for you.

  • A range of salary sacrifice options to help you make tax efficient savings on electric cars, nursery schemes, home and tech goods.

  • Learning and development - £1,000 personal development budget to help you grow in your role.

  • Private health care - Enjoy all the benefits AXA has to offer, including reduced gym memberships and medical history disregarded

  • Medical cash plan - To help you with the costs of dental and optical expenses

  • Matched pension contributions up to 5%

  • 25 days holiday - plus bank holidays, well-being days and volunteering days

  • Enhanced Parental Leave - enhanced maternity, paternity and adoption pay.  

All are welcome.

At Flagstone, we’re assembling a diverse team that defies our industry’s norms. Think this role could suit you? We encourage you to apply, no matter your background.

As you grow in the role, the ambition is for you to also take ownership of group consolidation and become the financial reporting engine of the business.

Specifically, you will be responsible for:

Reporting, Close and Consolidation

  • Own the month end and year end close against the group close calendar, preparing journals, accruals and prepayments, completing balance sheet reconciliations and delivering the reporting pack, with hands-on support while you build up to running it independently.

  • Support group consolidation across our entities, including intercompany reconciliations, eliminations and FX.

Technical Accounting

  • Support technical accounting assessments, ad hoc finance projects and the development of group accounting policies (for example leases and share based payments), helping prepare papers and notes on judgemental areas and complex transactions.

Statutory Reporting and Audit

  • Manage the PBC list and audit request tracker, and support the wider external audit process, maintaining auditor relationships and contributing to remediation of any audit findings.

Controls, Systems and Process

  • You communicate clearly and build trust easily with auditors, external advisors and internal stakeholders.

But we aren’t stopping there. With a strong operational footprint and 800+ employees, we have ambitious plans to continue scaling. We’re building a world where tech skills unlock people’s potential and output.

Join Multiverse and power our mission to equip the workforce to win in the AI era.

The Opportunity

It's an incredible time to join Multiverse as Director of Enterprise Technology, as we scale from Series E toward IPO. Every stage of that journey raises the bar on what "good" IT looks like: more employees, more auditors, more systems, more scrutiny — and zero tolerance for the operation falling over.

We're looking for a Director of Enterprise Technology to own IT end-to-end: two connected halves of the function, the day-to-day running of IT services across the business, and the delivery of the systems and platform changes that will carry us through IPO and beyond. This is not a "keep the lights on" role split from a "build the future" role — it's one leader accountable for both, because at this stage of growth they have to move in lockstep. You'll be the most senior IT voice in the business, setting the strategy as well as running the operation.

This role needs an AI-native leader. Not someone who bolts AI onto existing ways of working, but someone who sees automation and AI as the engine of the team — the thing that lets a lean function support a scaling business without just adding headcount, and that turns IT from a cost centre into a genuine driver of strategic business outcomes.

The Mission: Multiverse is reshaping the future of workforce development. As we scale headcount, geographies, and compliance obligations on the way to IPO, IT has to go from "good enough for a fast-growing startup" to "resilient, auditable, and scalable for a public company" — without ever compromising the experience our 1,000+ employees get day to day.

The Environment: You'll sit at the centre of a small, high-trust, fully in-house IT function, with full ownership of the IT budget, tooling strategy, and roadmap. You'll represent IT to the exec team and, increasingly, to auditors and the board as we approach IPO. You'll have the autonomy to decide how your team's time and the IT budget are split across your two remits, and the seniority to make the case for more of either when the business needs it.

Our Tech Stack: Google Workspace (we're a Google-first environment); identity via Okta, Entra ID and/or JumpCloud, including Okta Workflows; endpoint security/EDR tooling; FreshService (or similar) for service management; automation and integration via n8n, Zapier, Workato, and scripting (Python, Bash); and security practice aligned to frameworks like ISO 27001.

What You'll Own

1. BAU IT Operations (keeping the business running)

You'll manage the operational running of IT across Multiverse — ensuring our 1,000+ employees get excellent support, that people join, move within, and leave the business with seamless and secure experiences, and that incidents are handled swiftly and professionally. This is delivered by your in-house team, so you'll own resourcing, workload, and standards directly rather than through a third party.

2. IT Systems Implementation (building what gets us to IPO)

You'll lead the planning and delivery of the systems and platform changes IT needs to make as we scale — new tooling, integrations, identity and endpoint platform upgrades, automation of manual processes, and the technical controls (access management, audit trails, change management) that a business preparing for IPO is expected to have in place. You'll run these as real projects: scoped, resourced, tested, and rolled out with minimal disruption to BAU.

Leading the function

You'll lead the whole of IT — a small, fully in-house team spanning both remits — balancing workload and investment across BAU and project work, and making the call on trade-offs between "fix it now" and "fix it properly." You'll own the IT budget and roadmap, and be the one accountable when the exec team or board asks how IT is scaling with the business. A big part of the role is making things better across both sides of the house: spotting manual processes that should be automated, building workflows that save time, and continuously improving how IT operates as the business scales. You're not just keeping the lights on — you're making the whole operation more efficient, more auditable, and more scalable.

Your Impact (First 6–12 Months)

  • Stabilise and prove BAU: Quickly own service delivery end-to-end, with SLAs met and your in-house team's standards and workload clearly managed and visible. Once that’s done, you move on to implementing a culture of continuous improvement, which gives measurable improvements in all areas of our BAU work.

  • Ship your first systems project and define the roadmap: Take at least one meaningful systems implementation (identity, ITSM, automation platform, or major integration) from scope to live rollout, with documentation and controls a future auditor could follow. And at the same time develop a clear roadmap of future projects that allows IT Ops to enable and power the Business for the future rather than provide drag.

  • Build the team model: Establish how your team's time splits across BAU and project work, and how it's protected for continuous improvement work rather than constantly firefighting. Identify any skills gaps and hire or restructure as appropriate.

  • Lead with AI, not just tolerate it: Set a visible standard for using AI and automation as the default way of working across the team — identifying manual, repeatable processes across the IT Ops estate to eliminate, and freeing capacity for higher-value systems work. But you won’t stop there, as you’ll go on to use it where the thinking is hard, not just where the task is easy — diagnosing complex incidents, forecasting capacity and risk, and shaping how the estate evolves."

  • Raise the operating bar: Introduce (or tighten) the documentation, change management, and incident processes that scale with headcount and hold up under IPO-level scrutiny.

  • Build a customer focus: Build real relationships with the stakeholders IT Ops serves — understanding their goals well enough to anticipate needs, not just respond to requests. You'll be judged not on tickets closed but on whether other leaders see IT Ops as a team that makes their work easier."

What You'll Bring

Essential

  • 7+ years in IT operations or IT leadership, including 3+ years as the most senior IT person in a business or leading multiple IT teams/functions at once

  • Proven experience owning IT strategy and service delivery in a scaling organisation with a fully in-house team, including managing to SLAs and internal standards

  • Experience selecting, procuring, and managing software/tooling vendor relationships (contracts, budget, renewals) even without an MSP in the mix

  • Track record of leading systems or platform implementations end-to-end — scoping, stakeholder management, testing, rollout, and adoption — as well as running BAU in parallel

  • Strong automation mindset — you've built or directed workflows and automated processes that saved real, measurable time across a function, using scripting (Python/Bash) or platforms like n8n, Zapier, or Workato

  • Genuinely AI-native as a leader: you use AI tools daily, you can tell the difference between a real agentic workflow and a chatbot wrapper, and you set the tone for your team to work the same way

  • You see automation and AI as the engine that lets a lean team punch above its weight — not a side initiative, but core to how you plan headcount, prioritise work, and deliver strategic outcomes for the business

  • Solid technical foundation: identity management (Okta, Entra ID, or JumpCloud), endpoint management, SaaS administration (Google Workspace or equivalent), and how these connect to broader systems architecture and IT strategy

  • Comfortable owning trade-offs between "run the business" and "change the business" investment, and making that case to the exec team

  • Excellent communication — calm under pressure, credible with end-users, vendors, auditors, and senior leadership alike

  • Process-minded with a bias for documentation, change control, and continuous improvement

  • Full ownership experience: budget management, vendor/tooling negotiation, and direct people leadership

Legal AI is inventing its best practices in real time, and this role sits where that happens. You'll sit within the Legal Engineering team and work hand in hand with Product at one of the fastest-growing legal AI companies in the world, seeing new capabilities before almost anyone else, experimenting with them against real legal work, and turning what you learn into the standards a global function runs on. In a year here, you will see and vet more legal AI use cases than most people in the industry see in a career, working directly with some of the best legal engineers in the industry.

You'll be the person who vets the skills, workflows and use cases the function ships: testing them hands-on, separating the genuinely strong from the merely plausible, and quality-controlling practice-area workflows so that what carries the Legora name is consistently excellent. What you bring

You're a lawyer with real practice experience who has become genuinely technical: maybe you did a coding bootcamp, maybe you taught yourself, but either way you're the person colleagues ask how something actually works. You live in AI tools, and it shows: you can tell a strong use case from a plausible-sounding weak one, you know why a prompt underperforms before you've finished reading it, and you hold both halves of the judgement this role needs: what makes a prompt run well, and what makes a legal output substantively right rather than merely fluent. jobs.title: Creative Strategist (m/w/d) - Vollzeit, vor Ort in Lingen
jobs.description:
Du schaust auf einen Ad Account und siehst nach zwei Minuten, wo es hakt? Welcher Angle als Nächstes dran ist, welche Hook fehlt, warum der Winner gerade abbaut?

Dann lies weiter.

Wer wir sind

Commerce Ventures ist die führende Performance-Marketing-Agentur, im Food, Health und Beverage Bereich. Wir betreuen ausschließlich Brands, hinter denen wir stehen, von Gründern und Gründerinnen, die ambitioniert sind und wirklich coole Produkte entwickelt haben.

Monatlich laufen sechsstellige Meta-Budgets über unsere Accounts, und wir haben mehr als eine Brand von null auf achtstellig begleitet.

Der Hebel dahinter ist immer das Creative. Dafür haben wir ein Modell gebaut, das funktioniert: klare Prozesse, klare Zahlen, klare Verantwortung, und Leute, die liefern. Kein Agentur-Bullshit, keine 40-seitigen Decks.

Was du machst

Du übernimmst deine eigenen Brands, in kompletter Eigenverantwortung, drei bis vier Brands maximal, damit du dich voll und ganz auf die Ergebnisse unserer Kunden konzentrieren kannst.

Du übernimmst die komplette Creative Strategy, Media Buying, Kunden-Calls, Planung. Du briefst unsere Post-Production, du entscheidest, was live geht, du weißt jeden Morgen, was die Zahlen sagen und was heute zu tun ist.

Damit wir uns nicht falsch verstehen: Wir suchen keinen Strategen, der Konzepte präsentiert und andere machen lässt. Du setzt die Strategie und lieferst selbst: Angles, Hooks, Skripte, Briefings, Statics. Wer lieber Slides baut und mehr redet als macht, ist bei uns falsch.

Wie wir arbeiten

Wir sind ein kleines Team, remote aufgestellt, und trotzdem haben wir gerade unser Büro in Lingen vergrößert. Warum? Weil die Lernkurve neben Gründer und Team im Office steiler ist als in jedem Google-Meet. Wer die Rolle vor Ort macht, lernt es von denen, die es jeden Tag machen! Und bekommt JUUZ und Prepmymeal Meals im Kühlschrank obendrauf.

Heißt aber nicht, dass remote nicht geht. Wenn du gut bist und selbstständig arbeitest können wir reden. Lingen ist unser Wunsch, aber nicht die Bedingung.

Was bei uns gilt: Wir arbeiten hart, weil gemeinsam Ziele erreichen, Spaß macht!

Wir sagen uns direkt, was Sache ist. Und wir feiern, wenn ein Kunde den Umsatz verdoppelt.

Kurz, unser Motto: doing cool shit with cool people!

Aufgaben

  • Du verantwortest die Creative- und Funnel-Strategie für deine Accounts: von der Analyse über den Testplan bis zum fertigen Creative.
  • Du analysierst die Ad Accounts, findest die Lücken (fehlende Angles, , schwache Hooks, schwache Landingpages) und leitest daraus konkrete Testpläne ab.
  • Du entscheidest, was als Nächstes launcht, und priorisierst nach Wirkunk und nicht nach Bauchgefühl.
  • Du schreibst Hooks, Skripte und Ad Copy selbst und baust Statics und Animations, wenn der Account sie braucht.
  • Du briefst UGC-Creator, Editoren und unsere Post-Production und challengst sie so lange, bis die Creatives performen.
  • Du führst deine Kunden-Calls selbst, präsentierst Zahlen und hast den vollen Überblick über deine Accounts (maximal drei).
  • Du iterierst Winner weiter und leitest aus den Performance-Daten die nächste Version ab.
  • Du arbeitest täglich mit Claude und Co., baust dir eigene Prompts und Workflows und nutzt AI, um schneller und besser zu liefern als der Markt.

Qualifikation

  • Erfahrung als Creative Strategist, Media Buyer, Direct-Response-Marketer oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle, idealerweise im D2C- bzw. E-Commerce-Bereich.
  • Du denkst in Funnels, Awareness Stages (Schwartz), Angles und Hypothesen, nicht in Branding-Kampagnen.
  • Du hast Creatives, Hooks, Skripte oder Funnels nicht nur konzipiert, sondern selbst gebaut, und sie haben performt.
  • Du arbeitest datengetrieben und schaust auf die Zahlen: ROAS, CAC, CTR, Hook-Rate, Hold-Rate.
  • Du bist sicher im Umgang mit KI-Tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Magnific und Co.) oder brennst darauf, sie in deinen Workflow zu bauen.
  • Du ziehst Themen eigenständig durch, lieferst sauber und gibst Gas, auch wenn keiner zuschaut.
  • Hands-on-Mentalität: Du redest nicht über Ideen, du setzt sie um.
  • Du willst vor Ort arbeiten, in Lingen (Ems) oder Umgebung.
  • Lebenslauf, Studium oder Titel auf dem Papier sind uns egal. Deine Erfahrung und Expertise zählt, sowie dein Character.

Benefits

  • Eine Lernkurve, die es so kaum irgendwo gibt: 6-stellige Meta-Budgets, direkter Draht zum Gründer, Feedback in Tagen statt in Quartalen.
  • Ausschließlich Brands, hinter denen wir stehen: Food, Health und Supplements. Keine Kunden, für die du dich rechtfertigen musst.
  • Geiles Office in Lingen, ein Ort, an dem man wirklich gerne arbeitet.
  • Neueste Hardware (Apple-Universum) und der komplette AI-Stack, den du brauchst.
  • JUUZ & Prepmymeal-Vorrat im Kühlschrank
  • Attraktives Fixum plus Performance-Bonus
  • Ergebnisse vor Anwesenheit: flache Hierarchien, kurze Wege, keine Konzern-Bürokratie.
  • Neue Arbeitskultur, positive Vibes, Hands-on statt Meeting-Marathon.
  • Die Chance, den Creative-Bereich einer wachsenden Agentur mitzugestalten und später ein eigenes Team zu führen.

Bis hierhin durchgelesen? Dann sind wir vielleicht dein Match.

Schick uns ein kurzes, ungezwungenes Anschreiben per du: Was hast du bisher gebaut, welche Creatives, Hooks oder Funnels von dir haben am besten performt, ab wann könntest du starten? Portfolio, Ad-Beispiele, Loom: immer her damit.

Bitte kein 5-Seiten-Roman mit "teamfähig und belastbar", sondern kurz und knapp zeigen, wer du bist und was du drauf hast.

Wenn du magst, nimm ein kurzes Video auf und beantworte zwei Fragen: Wer bist du? Und warum sollte man dich unbedingt im Team haben?

Danach lernen wir uns 15 Minuten kennen und schauen, ob es passt.

Ich freue mich besonders auf Leute aus Lingen und Umgebung.

Liebe Grüße,

Marek
