jobs.title: Conducteur/trice de travaux - Ile-de-France (H/F)
jobs.description:
Vous cherchez un défi professionnel stimulant, où chaque jour est une nouvelle aventure ? Aucun risque de s'ennuyer sur ce poste

Vous pilotez des projets techniques d'installations de bâtiments complets. Vous pilotez, planifiez et coordonnez des installations de projets de travaux grues, transports, cordes, depuis la validation du devis et jusqu'à la fin de chantier.

Vos enjeux sur chaque projet : la sécurité, la qualité, le service, le coût, les délais et l'attention portée au client.

Concrètement, comment ça se passe ?  En amont, les dossiers sont négociés par un chargé d'affaires puis validé par la direction  Vous confrontez votre regard pour valider ou ajuster si nécessaire  La suite est entre vos mains :

1- Vous êtes le/la premier(e) représentant(e) de l'entreprise sur le chantier.

Vous effectuez la visite technique d'installation pour vérifier si les moyens prévisionnels prévus pour ce projet sont en adéquation avec les besoins. Vous rédigez le mode opératoire avec un rapport technique et vous vous assurez que les documents administratifs, d'accès et sécuritaire seront bien envoyés aux clients (PDP, PPSPS, Carte Pro, DPAE, etc..)

2- Vous êtes le/la chef/fe d'orchestre :

Vous gérez la planification et la coordination interne des installations de bâtiments. Vous assurez les réunions de vos chantiers et réalisez les comptes rendus ou répondez dans les délais à ceux rédigés par la MOE ou MOA.

Vous anticipez et optimisez les ressources pour veiller à la rentabilité des chantiers. Vous gérez l'aspect contractuel et l'application des procédures de chantiers. C'est vous qui gérez la relation client avec diplomatie sur toute la période, avant, et pendant les travaux. Et vous contribuez au quotidien à une bonne communication interne en favorisant le travail d'équipe. Que ce soit pour nos clients du BTP, tertiaires, industriels ou les collectivités.

Avec qui ?

Vous rejoignez 3 de vos pairs, Et vous avez le soutien du service HSE pour la partie sécurité ainsi que du Responsable Exploitation pour la partie technique.

Quel périmètre ?

Notre agence est basée à Saint-Michel-sur-Orge (91) et votre secteur est établi sur la région Ile-de-France

Une expérience d'au moins 3 ans en conduite de travaux ou gestion de projets spécifiques aux métiers de la construction et/ou rénovation est attendue (hors alternance).

Vous aimez apprendre et êtes positif/ve, toujours dans la recherche d'amélioration continue. Vous êtes naturellement déterminé(e) pour assurer vos responsabilités et suivre chaque projet au quotidien. Votre relationnel sera un atout pour favoriser, au quotidien, le travail d'équipe et l'intelligence collective dans le cadre de résolutions de problèmes.

Informations complémentaires :

* Mobilité régionale régulière avec retour au domicile
* Forfait 218 jours
* Rémunération brute annuelle globale comprise entre 30 000 et 55 000€
* Avantages d'un grand groupe (primes, comité d'entreprise, mobilité interne, formation interne...)

jobs.title: Commercial / Commerciale sédentaire (H/F)

jobs.title: Employé Principal - Saint Maurice l'Exil - CDI 31,5H (H/F)
jobs.description:
L'Employé Principal (EP) contribue à l'augmentation du chiffre d'affaires et à la réduction des coûts. Il contribue à la satisfaction et la fidélisation de la clientèle en veillant à la bonne tenue du magasin et à un encaissement correct. - Passer les commandes de produits.
- Remonter à sa hiérarchie les anomalies concernant les produits en rupture et/ou de mauvaise qualité.
- Assurer quotidiennement l'entretien et le nettoyage du magasin (labo pain, réserve, local social, parking, changement des poubelles, rayons, vitrines, meubles de présentation,.).
- Effectuer le tri des cartons et des plastiques.
- Respecter et assurer la santé et la sécurité du personnel et de la clientèle en respectant les procédures et règles en vigueur.

- Assurer la formation des nouveaux collaborateurs.

jobs.title: Technicien de maintenance outillages (H/F)

Notre organisation certifiée IATF et ISO9001 apporte ainsi à nos clients une gestion de projet efficace et des livraisons strictement conformes aux engagements pris.
Involve, c'est avant tout 160 collaborateurs présents sur 3 sites industriels, qui cultivent et animent la dynamique du groupe fondée sur 4 valeurs fortes, constitutives de son identité : l'engagement - l'exigence - la considération - l'esprit d'équipe, socle de leur développement et de leur management humain.

Nous vous proposons de partager notre projet, en tant que Technicien de maintenance outillages, au sein de notre site Involve Manufacturing Izernore (50 collaborateurs). Rejoignez-nous !

Description de poste:

Rattaché au responsable maintenance, vous assurez l'ensemble de la maintenance du parc outillages en appliquant la réglementation intérieure, les règles d'hygiène, de sécurité et les procédures.

Pour cela :
- Vous assurez l'entretien courant et la maintenance préventive des outillages de production (moules)
- Vous identifiez et diagnostiquez les défauts et dysfonctionnement des outillages
- Vous analysez les causes des problèmes sur les outillages
- Vous traitez les défauts et dysfonctionnements des outillages
- Vous réalisez les opérations d'usinage simples sur les machines-outils
- Vous analysez la qualité et la conformité des outillages
- Vous assemblez les outillages et vérifiez leur fonctionnement
- Vous veillez au conditionnement et au stockage des outillages
- Vous gérez les enregistrements et le suivi des actions de maintenance (utilisation du logiciel de GMAO Cegid)
- Vous organisez votre activité dans le respect des consignes sécurité et qualité du site

Votre profil:
De formation Bac+2 ou expérience équivalente, vous avez acquis des compétences solides en maintenance mécanique outillages dans le secteur de la plasturgie. Vous savez démonter et remonter un moule de façon autonome et utiliser les machines-outils traditionnelles (tour, fraiseuse, rectif.).
Vos savoir-être seront vos principaux atouts pour vous épanouir sur le poste proposé : réactivité, rigueur et esprit d'équipe sont des qualités qui vous animent !
En rejoignant Involve, vous intégrez un groupe industriel dynamique à taille humaine et vous vous engagez au sein d'une équipe et d'un environnement de travail motivant.

Poste à pourvoir rapidement sur des horaires en journée.

ET SI C'ÉTAIT VOUS ?

- Diplôme d'Infirmier.ère d'Etat exigé. Inscription au Conseil de l'ordre obligatoire
- Expérience ou connaissance en addictologie
- Connaissance en réduction des risques et des dommages (RDRD)

jobs.title: Collaborateur(trice) comptable - Révision (H/F)
jobs.description:
Envie de progresser vraiment en cabinet ?

Vous avez déjà une première expérience en cabinet et vous souhaitez maintenant gagner en autonomie, développer vos compétences et prendre davantage part à la relation client ?

Rejoignez CAC Réunion, un cabinet à taille humaine implanté depuis plus de 20 ans à La Réunion, avec deux bureaux dans le Nord-Est, à Sainte-Clotilde Technopole et Saint-André. Vous évoluerez au sein d'une équipe où proximité, échanges et transmission des savoirs font partie du quotidien.

Notre objectif : vous permettre de développer progressivement vos compétences et votre autonomie, au contact direct de dirigeants d'entreprise.

Votre quotidien chez nous :

Vous intervenez principalement en expertise comptable, sur des missions de révision, auprès d'un portefeuille diversifié de PME.
Le poste est principalement centré sur la révision : vous intervenez sur des travaux de contrôle, d'analyse et de préparation des comptes, et non sur des missions de tenue comptable au quotidien.
Selon votre niveau d'expérience, vous serez accompagné(e) pour monter en autonomie.
La relation client occupe une place importante dans le poste. Vous deviendrez un interlocuteur de confiance pour vos clients : vous échangerez avec eux et les accompagnerez sur leurs enjeux comptables et fiscaux.
Des déplacements ponctuels en clientèle sont à prévoir.

Et l'audit ?
Notre cabinet exerce également une activité de commissariat aux comptes. Selon les dossiers, vous pourrez participer à certaines missions d'audit aux côtés de l'équipe : une occasion d'élargir vos compétences et de découvrir une autre facette du métier.

Pourquoi rejoindre CAC Réunion ?
Pour développer une vraie relation client
Vous ne restez pas uniquement derrière vos dossiers : vous échangez avec les dirigeants et prenez progressivement votre place dans la relation client.  Pour évoluer dans une équipe à taille humaine, vous bénéficiez d'échanges simples et directs avec les responsables de mission et les associés.
Pour élargir votre vision du métier : Expertise comptable, fiscalité, juridique, social, audit : la diversité des compétences présentes au cabinet vous permet de mieux comprendre les problématiques de vos clients.
Pour continuer à progresser : Formation, transmission des savoirs et outils digitaux vous accompagnent dans votre montée en compétences et votre prise d'autonomie.

Le profil que nous recherchons :

Vous êtes titulaire d'une formation en comptabilité telle qu'un DCG, DSCG, Master CCA ou diplôme équivalent.
Vous disposez déjà d'une première expérience en cabinet d'expertise comptable, même courte, idéalement avec une première exposition à des travaux de révision, et vous souhaitez aujourd'hui franchir une nouvelle étape.
Nous recherchons une personne rigoureuse, curieuse et désireuse d'apprendre, qui apprécie le travail en équipe et souhaite gagner en autonomie. Vous avez déjà une première pratique de la révision et souhaitez désormais consolider vos acquis et développer vos compétences. Votre bon relationnel vous permettra également de prendre votre place dans les échanges avec les clients.
Vous ne maîtrisez pas encore tout ? C'est normal. Nous recherchons un collaborateur ou une collaboratrice ayant surtout l'envie d'apprendre et de s'investir dans la durée.

Envie de rejoindre l'aventure ?

Vous avez envie de progresser et de construire une vraie relation avec vos clients ? Alors, il est peut-être temps de faire connaissance !
Pas besoin d'être parfait(e) ni de cocher toutes les cases : ce qui compte pour nous, c'est votre motivation et votre envie de progresser.

Un doute ? Candidatez quand même. Le meilleur moyen de savoir si le courant passe, c'est encore d'échanger.
Envoyez-nous votre CV et quelques mots sur vous.

Un véritable chasseur, qui aime ouvrir des portes, décrocher des rendez-vous et transformer les opportunités en contrats ;
Votre appétence pour la conquête, démontrée par une expérience réussie dans ce domaine, n'est plus à prouver ;
À l'aise avec la prospection téléphonique et terrain ;
Animé(e) par le challenge et la recherche de résultats ;
Proactif(ve), énergique et doté(e) d'un excellent relationnel ;
À l'aise pour développer votre réseau et créer des relations de confiance ;

Votre manager vous accompagnera dans votre prise de poste et dans le développement de votre activité afin que vous puissiez rapidement gagner en autonomie et en performance.

Nous recherchons un chef de partie ou une cheffe de partie passionné(e) et talentueux(se) pour rejoindre notre équipe dynamique. Vous serez responsable de la préparation et de la cuisson des plats, en veillant à respecter les normes de qualité et de sécurité alimentaire. Ce poste est idéal pour une personne désireuse de contribuer à un environnement culinaire stimulant et créatif.

Responsabilités
- Préparer les ingrédients nécessaires à la réalisation des plats
- Cuisiner et dresser les plats selon les recettes établies
- Assurer la qualité et la présentation des plats avant le service
- Gérer l'approvisionnement en denrées alimentaires et contrôler les stocks
- Respecter les normes d'hygiène et de sécurité alimentaire en vigueur
- Collaborer avec l'équipe en cuisine pour garantir un service fluide
- Former et encadrer les commis de cuisine dans leurs tâches quotidiennes

Profil recherché, vous êtes fait(e) pour ce poste si vous possédez :
- Une expérience significative en cuisine, idéalement en tant que chef de partie ou dans un rôle similaire
- Des compétences avérées en préparation, cuisson, service et manipulation des aliments
- Une bonne connaissance des normes de sécurité alimentaire
- Un sens aigu du détail et une capacité à travailler sous pression
- Un esprit d'équipe et une bonne communication avec vos collègues

Si vous êtes motivé(e) par le travail bien fait et souhaitez évoluer au sein d'une équipe passionnée, nous serions ravis de vous accueillir parmi nous !

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer | Voice | Full-Stack
jobs.description:
Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What sets us apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

Meet the team behind this journey

DeepL is not just a translation tool; we are building the Operating System for Global Communication. We are the rare AI company that builds the entire stack in-house: from training next-gen LLMs on our own NVIDIA DGX SuperPODs to delivering real-time Language AI to over 300 million users and 200,000+ businesses globally.

You will join DeepL Voice, the team defining the art of the possible for real-time interpretation. While our Translation engine conquered text, Voice is conquering the physical world. We are building the "Universal Translator"; enabling fluid, real-time conversations for frontline workers, global meetings, and enterprise teams.

This is a 0-to-1 engineering environment. We successfully launched our first customer-facing features in late 2024, but we are just getting started. We are tackling the hardest problems in AI interaction: How do you eliminate the "flickering" effect of unstable transcripts? How do you chain chunked inference to achieve sub-millisecond latency? How do you deliver a seamless audio stream that feels natural, not robotic?.

You will work in a dynamic, cross-functional squad alongside Researchers, Product Managers, and Designers. We are not just wrapping an API; we are building the proprietary models, the streaming architecture, and the user interfaces that allow the world to speak without barriers.

Your responsibilities

  • A "0-to-1" Builder Mindset: You thrive in ambiguity. You don't need a roadmap to build; you need a problem. You are comfortable prototyping a new feature in the morning and refactoring it for scale in the afternoon.

  • Product Obsession: You care about the flow of the conversation. You understand that "99% accuracy" means nothing if the audio arrives 3 seconds late. You optimize for the human experience.

  • Ship End-to-End Features: Build and deploy impactful features across the entire stack, from high-performance frontend UIs to streaming audio services on the backend and AI inference integration.

  • Tackle Real-Time Complexity: Debug and resolve challenging edge cases unique to real-time communication, including sub-second latency spikes, transcript flicker, audio glitches, and unstable network environments.

  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner closely in a tight-knit, cross-functional squad alongside PMs, Product Designers, and AI Researchers to scope, shape, and solve hard product and technical challenges.


Qualities we look for

  • A "Product-First" Mindset: You care deeply about the customer journey. You ask, "How does this feature help us close the next Enterprise deal?" before writing code.

  • Full-Stack Fluency: You're comfortable across the stack — building polished, modern UI in React and TypeScript on the frontend, and shipping backend services in Node.js/TypeScript (or a strongly transferable language, with willingness to ramp) on the backend.

  • Real-time: WebRTC, WebSockets, streaming architectures, latency-sensitive systems.

  • High Agency: You don't wait for permission. If the billing reconciliation process is slow, you automate it. If the documentation for the API is unclear, you fix it.

  • AI-Native Velocity: You leverage AI-powered tools (like GitHub Copilot or Claude) to accelerate your velocity and eliminate repetitive toil. You use AI for boilerplate code, test generation, and debugging, allowing you to focus your cognitive energy on high-value architectural decisions and complex problem-solving.


A Note on Our Hiring Process: DeepL hires for the Company, not just a specific team. We operate a Unified Engineering Pipeline. If you pass our bar, we will match you to the highest-priority role that fits your skillset—whether that is in Core Product, Platform, Voice, or Enterprise. We prioritize "Missionaries" who want to solve the biggest problems, wherever they live in the stack .

What we offer

  • Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.

  • Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.

  • Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.

  • Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.

  • 30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.

  • Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

 

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

#LI-JL1

We are an equal opportunity employer

You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

jobs.title: Deputy Head of Financial Crime
jobs.description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

We’re looking for a Deputy Head of Financial Crime to join our financial Crime Operations team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help safeguard the firm against financial crime risks, lead critical remediation initiatives, and drive control enhancements as part of our Financial Crime Operations team as we scale our business spend management platform. If you're excited about building robust, future-proofed compliance frameworks and leading high-performing operational teams and are passionate about financial crime prevention and regulatory excellence, then this is the opportunity for you!

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You’ll report to the Associate Director of Financial Crime Operations and work closely with teams in Compliance, Risk, Legal, Operations, and Product. Our team is highly collaborative and dedicated to mitigating AML, CTF, Sanctions, ABC, and Fraud risks while supporting sustainable business growth. You’ll also have the chance to partner with teams across the wider organisation, external auditors, and regulatory bodies to ensure success.

What you’ll be doing

As a Deputy Head of Financial Crime, you will:

  • Drive Compliance oversight and quality assurance: Oversee day to day financial crime reports, disclosures, risk assessments sign-off, and regulatory outputs while monitoring metrics and KPIs to address emerging risks and operational bottlenecks.

  • Lead Complex Remediation & Projects : Act as the primary lead for financial crime remediation programs, regulatory look-backs, control enhancements, and tech integrations from scoping through to execution and root-cause analysis.

  • Provide Strategic Leadership Coverage: Deputise for the Associate Director of Financial Crime Operations during absences, representing the function at executive committees, board meetings, and in regulatory engagements.

  • Direct Team Leadership & Capability Building: Directly lead, coach, and empower the FinCrime Operations team, driving resource planning, talent development, and a high-performing, accountable culture.

  • Foster Cross-Functional & Regulatory Relationships: Work closely with internal Risk, Legal, and Business units, as well as external auditors and regulators, to embed effective financial crime controls across the business.

What you bring


You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • Deep Financial Crime Expertise: Comprehensive knowledge of AML, CTF, Sanctions, ABC, and Fraud frameworks within a 1LOD environment.

  • Strategic & Operational Leadership: Proven track record of direct team management, coaching, resource allocation, and providing trusted counsel to senior stakeholders and boards.

  • Remediation & Program Management: Hands-on experience leading multi-workstream remediation projects, regulatory look-backs, and complex control improvements.

  • Regulatory Acumen: Strong understanding of evolving regulatory landscapes and experience engaging directly with regulatory bodies and external auditors.

  • Data-Driven Problem Solving: Strong analytical mindset to identify root causes, track KPIs, and optimize operational processes.

  • A background in Financial Services, Fintech, or regulated payment institutions with at least 8+ years in financial crime/compliance, including 3+ years in a formal leadership role.

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You enjoy balancing high-level strategic influence with hands-on operational execution and team leadership.

  • You thrive in dynamic environments where you can lead complex remediation projects and shape evolving compliance frameworks.

  • You want high visibility, direct deputising experience, and ownership over key regulatory and board-level interactions.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You prefer a purely advisory role without direct team management or operational execution responsibilities.

  • You are uncomfortable working in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities or managing regulatory ambiguity.

  • You prefer maintaining existing processes rather than actively driving process optimization and control overhauls.

How you’ll develop in this role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you’ll:

  • Lead key control enhancement and remediation initiatives to drive impact in our overall risk mitigation and operational efficiency.

  • Collaborate with Operations, Risk, and Tech teams to improve fin-crime detection systems and workflow processes.

  • Grow your skills in executive stakeholder management and strategic governance, taking on new challenges as the company continues to scale.

We’re committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means taking on bigger projects, stepping into leadership, or acquiring new skills in fintech risk governance

The location


Please note: We can hire on a remote, hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

Show me the benefits!

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

  • Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

  • We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays

  • For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

  • We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

  • Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work


The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  2. Hiring Manager Interview: A 45-minute deep dive with the Associate Director of Financial Crime Operations focusing on operational experience, leadership, and technical expertise.

  3. Challenge and Panel interview: We will send you a take home assignment to present into a panel interview

  4. Final Interview: A final conversation senior leadership

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired for a similar role, we received a total a vast number of applications but only a few were selected for an intro call. With this in mind, we want to help you understand what we really care about when reviewing your application:

  • CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

  • Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

  • Lead key control enhancement and remediation initiatives to drive impact in our overall risk mitigation and operational efficiency.

  • Collaborate with Operations, Risk, and Tech teams to improve fin-crime detection systems and workflow processes.

  • Grow your skills in executive stakeholder management and strategic governance, taking on new challenges as the company continues to scale.

We’re committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means taking on bigger projects, stepping into leadership, or acquiring new skills in fintech risk governance

The location


Please note: We can hire on a remote, hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

 

Show me the benefits!

 

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

  • Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

  • We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays

  • For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

  • We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

  • Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work


The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  2. Hiring Manager Interview: A 45-minute deep dive with the Associate Director of Financial Crime Operations focusing on operational experience, leadership, and technical expertise.

  3. Challenge and Panel interview: We will send you a take home assignment to present into a panel interview

  4. Final Interview: A final conversation senior leadership

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired for a similar role, we received a total a vast number of applications but only a few were selected for an intro call. With this in mind, we want to help you understand what we really care about when reviewing your application:

  • CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

  • Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

jobs.title: Aide-soignant DE (H/F) en EHPAD de nuit
jobs.description:
Vitalis Médical Avignon, agence de recrutement spécialisée dans les métiers de la santé et du secteur médico-social, recrute un aide-soignant diplômé d'État (H/F) pour assurer des remplacements de nuit au sein d'un EHPAD situé à proximité du Pontet.
La résidence accueille des personnes âgées ayant des niveaux d'autonomie variés et leur propose un accompagnement quotidien adapté à leurs besoins. L'organisation de la structure repose sur une prise en charge individualisée, dans le respect des habitudes de vie, de la dignité et de la sécurité de chaque résident.
L'établissement accompagne également des personnes âgées présentant des troubles cognitifs ou une dépendance importante. Durant la nuit, les résidents doivent pouvoir bénéficier d'une présence rassurante, disponible et attentive afin de favoriser leur repos et de répondre rapidement à leurs besoins.
Votre rôle sera essentiel pour assurer la continuité de l'accompagnement entre les équipes de jour et de nuit. Vous veillerez à la sécurité des résidents, réaliserez les soins nécessaires et surveillerez leur état général tout au long de votre service.Vous devrez être capable d'intervenir avec discrétion afin de préserver le sommeil des personnes accueillies, tout en restant vigilant face aux risques de chute, aux épisodes d'agitation, aux douleurs ou aux changements de comportement.
Détails du posteType de contrat : intérim.Horaires : poste de nuit selon le roulement communiqué par l'établissement.Planning : missions proposées en fonction des besoins du service.Structure : EHPAD

            
Vos missionsLors de vos interventions, vous aurez pour missions de :- Prendre connaissance des transmissions réalisées par l'équipe de jour.- Effectuer les rondes de surveillance prévues durant la nuit.- Accompagner les résidents lors du coucher et assurer leur installation confortable.- Réaliser les changes, les soins d'hygiène et les soins de confort nécessaires.- Répondre aux sonnettes et rassurer les résidents en cas d'angoisse ou de désorientation.- Surveiller les personnes présentant des risques particuliers ou des troubles cognitifs.- Identifier les signes de douleur, d'inconfort ou d'altération de l'état général.- Prévenir les chutes et sécuriser les déplacements nocturnes.- Collaborer avec le professionnel présent afin d'assurer une prise en charge adaptée.

            
Pré-requis- Diplôme d'État d'aide-soignant obligatoire.


Les avantages de Vitalis Médical Avignon :- Une application dédiée.- Accès au comité d'entreprise dès votre première mission.- Astreinte téléphonique disponible.- FASTT : tarifs préférentiels sur la location de véhicules, la garde d'enfants- Accompagnement personnalisé tout au long de vos missions.- Accès à un réseau solide dans les secteurs médical, paramédical et social.- Souplesse du planning selon vos disponibilités.

            
Profil recherchéVous êtes titulaire du diplôme d'État d'aide-soignant et vous appréciez le travail auprès des personnes âgées. Vous êtes à l'aise avec les horaires de nuit et savez travailler de manière autonome tout en respectant les consignes de l'équipe soignante.Vous faites preuve de patience, de discrétion et de maîtrise de vous-même. Votre capacité à rassurer les résidents, à anticiper les risques et à réagir efficacement face aux situations urgentes constitue un véritable atout pour ce poste.Votre ponctualité, votre fiabilité et votre sens des responsabilités vous permettront de vous intégrer rapidement au fonctionnement de l'établissement.

jobs.title: Aide-soignant DE (H/F) en EHPAD
jobs.description:
Vitalis Médical Avignon, agence spécialisée dans le recrutement et l'intérim dans les secteurs médical, paramédical et social, recherche un aide-soignant diplômé d'État (H/F) pour effectuer des missions d'intérim de jour au sein d'un établissement d'hébergement pour personnes âgées dépendantes situé dans le secteur du Pontet.

Vous contribuerez activement à assurer la continuité des soins et à maintenir un environnement sécurisant, respectueux et chaleureux.

jobs.title: Dak- en gevelwerker
jobs.description:
We zoeken iemand die fier wil zijn.

Fier op een dak dat tot in de details klopt.
Fier op een gevel waarvan je achteraf denkt: “Ja. Dat hebben wij bij Bulotte gemaakt.”
Fier op de collega’s.
En fier om ’s morgens in werkkledij van Bulotte bij een klant aan te komen.

We zoeken we niet noodzakelijk een ervaren dakwerker; het mag maar is geen must!

Bij Bulotte geloven we dat mentaliteit, de juiste werkethiek, de fierheid om deel uit te maken van dit team belangrijker is dan eventuele ervaring.

We zoeken vooral “ de juiste collega“.

Welkom bij Bulotte

Vanuit Temse werkt Bulotte aan daken en gevels in de ruime regio (Waasland en Klein-Brabant).

Hellende daken, platte daken, renovaties en herstellingen, gevelisolatie, crepi, kalei, steenstrips… Ons werk is veelzijdig, maar de standaard is altijd dezelfde:

Wat we doen, doen we goed (en goed is uitstekend!).

We willen dat een woning na onze passage niet alleen technisch in orde is maar ook mooi en verzorgd afgewerkt. Daarom telt elk detail.

En dat harde werk en die ambitie blijven niet onopgemerkt.

In 2026 werd Bulotte bekroond met de Gouden Baksteen en verkozen tot ‘Belofte van het Jaar 2026’. Een erkenning waar we als team bijzonder fier op zijn – en tegelijk een extra motivatie om de lat elke dag opnieuw hoog te leggen.

Want groeien is mooi. Erkenning krijgen ook. Maar voor ons begint het nog altijd bij hetzelfde: goed werk afleveren met een ploeg die daar samen fier op is.

En die ploeg willen we nu versterken.

Vakmanschap kun je leren.

Heb je ervaring als dakwerker of gevelwerker? Fantastisch.

Heb je ervaring in de bouw? Ook goed.

Heb je nog nooit één voet op een dak gezet en kom je uit een compleet andere sector?

Dan willen we je nog altijd graag leren kennen.

Want technieken kunnen we aanleren.

Wat we zoeken moet vooral “in” je zitten.

Je komt op tijd. Je doet wat je belooft. Je steekt de handen uit de mouwen en wacht niet tot iemand je voor de derde keer vertelt wat er moet gebeuren.

Je draagt zorg voor materiaal. Je ruimt op. Je werkt veilig.

En als iets niet mooi afgewerkt is dan zie je dat zelf ook én doe je er iets aan.

Kortom: je bent een beetje een pietje – of mietje – precies.

Respect voor je vak én voor de klant

Je werkt vaak bij mensen thuis.

Daarom vinden we het vanzelfsprekend dat je beleefd en respectvol bent, dat je verzorgd voor de dag komt en dat je de woning en omgeving van de klant behandelt zoals je dat bij jezelf thuis zou willen.

Een werf laat je proper, ordelijk en veilig achter.

Daarnaast heb je een uitstekende kennis van het Nederlands. Veel van onze klanten zijn Nederlandstalig en we verwachten dat je vlot met hen kunt communiceren, vragen kunt beantwoorden en afspraken goed begrijpt.

Wat moet je wél kunnen afvinken?

  • je werkt graag buiten;
  • je bent fysiek in goede conditie;
  • je hebt twee handige handen en wil bijleren;
  • je bent nauwkeurig en hebt oog voor detail;
  • je hebt een sterke werkethiek;
  • collega’s kunnen op je rekenen;
  • je bent beleefd en respectvol tegenover klanten en collega’s;
  • je spreekt uitstekend Nederlands;
  • je neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor het werk dat je aflevert;
  • je wilt fier zijn op het resultaat én op de ploeg waarmee je het realiseert.

Een rijbewijs B zien we heel graag. Een rijbewijs BE of C is een extra troef.

Een diploma in de bouw?
Niet noodzakelijk.

Jaren ervaring?
Ook niet noodzakelijk.

Goesting en de juiste ingesteldheid? Absoluut noodzakelijk.

jobs.title: Ervaren plaatser ramen & deuren
jobs.description:
Wie is M-DP?

M-DP is een sterk groeiende KMO uit Bornem, gespecialiseerd in ramen, deuren en buitenschrijnwerk. Van opmeting tot plaatsing: M-DP houdt het volledige traject in eigen handen.

Vandaag bestaat het team uit een 12-tal medewerkers waarvan heel wat collega’s al jarenlang aan boord zijn. Door de sterke groei van M-DP zoeken we een extra ervaren plaatser om de ploeg te versterken.

Wat ga je doen?

Je staat samen met je collega’s in voor het plaatsen en afwerken van ramen, deuren en zonwering bij klanten.

In het begin nemen we de tijd om je vertrouwd te maken met de manier van werken bij M-DP. Heb je die eenmaal onder de knie dan ga je, samen met een collega, zelfstandig de baan op.

Je hoeft ons het vak dus niet meer van nul aan te leren. We zoeken iemand die al ervaring heeft binnen de wereld van ramen en deuren, schrijnwerkerij, houtbewerking, aluminium of een gelijkaardige sector.

Voor ons is je ervaring belangrijker dan het juiste diploma.

We zoeken iemand die:

  • relevante ervaring heeft binnen ramen en deuren, schrijnwerkerij, houtbewerking, aluminium of een vergelijkbare omgeving;
  • technisch en praktisch inzicht heeft;
  • een rijbewijs B heeft;
  • Nederlands begrijpt en zich voldoende kan uitdrukken om vlot samen te werken;
  • zelfstandig kan werken en verantwoordelijkheid neemt;
  • maturiteit en flexibiliteit toont;
  • vooral: een hart voor het vak heeft en fier is op goed afgewerkt werk.

jobs.title: Solutions Architect, Public Sector - East
Design Engineer (Web & Brand)
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

We're looking for a Design Engineer with strong visual taste to help drive our creative initiatives across web and brand. When it comes to design and code, we’re looking to work with experienced people who can pick up any problem and solve it. For us, it’s both how it works and how it looks. At its core, Linear is a developer tool where speed, interactions, and small details matter. We expect a broad set of design skills and the ability to create high-quality designs, interactions, and prototypes.

In this role, you will help communicate Linear's story—what we're building and why it matters—as part of our internal creative agency: the Magic Team.

What you'll do

 - You will be responsible for building complex and interactive UI web/app experiences

 - Build beautiful, responsive websites, landing pages, and internal tools

 - Implement creative animations and interactions in code

 - Explore visual design in Figma and translate it to web-native experiences

What we're looking for

 - Eye for good design

 - Strong frontend engineering skills

 - Experience building end-to-end websites and landing pages

 - Experience with React and TypeScript

 - Experience using agentic coding tools as part of the design process (from exploring ideas to building production-quality interactions)

 - A portfolio or Twitter profile showcasing a range of technical skills, a creative use of code, and prototyping skills

What we offer

 - Interesting and challenging work

 - Work life balance

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms (extended exercise)

 - Paid lunch and coffee during work days

 - Work remotely, no commuting to the office

 - Paid co-working space/desk at an office

 - Regular team events and offsites

 - 5 weeks paid vacation

 - 4 months paid parental leave

jobs.title: Junior/ Professional Controller (E-Commerce) (m/w/d)  Standort: Hamburg | Flexible Remote-Option
jobs.description:
Moin, wir sind Nordmut – die Outdoor Brand mit Herz und Vision.

Wir entwickeln hochwertiges Outdoor-Equipment für Abenteurer, Camper und Freiheitsliebende. Du hast Bock auf Zahlen, behältst auch bei Wachstum den Überblick und möchtest mit smartem Controlling echte unternehmerische Entscheidungen mitgestalten? Wir nämlich auch!

Unser Ziel: bis 2030 die führende deutsche Outdoor D2C-Marke zu werden – mit einem skalierbaren, internationalen Geschäftsmodell. Dafür brauchen wir nicht nur starke Produkte und eine klare Vision, sondern auch ein Finance-Team, das unsere Zahlen versteht, Transparenz schafft und unser Wachstum aktiv mitsteuert.

Wir sind ein junges, ambitioniertes Team aus dem Herzen Hamburgs, das seine Mission lebt: Wir inspirieren Menschen, durch die Natur zu sich selbst zu finden und mit hochwertiger Ausrüstung, starker Gemeinschaft und unvergesslichen Abenteuern über sich hinauszuwachsen.

Und dafür brauchen wir dich.

Aufgaben

Dein Verantwortungsbereich

· Controlling & Reporting: Du unterstützt beim Aufbau und der Weiterentwicklung unserer regelmäßigen Finance-Reports und sorgst dafür, dass wir unsere wichtigsten Kennzahlen jederzeit im Blick haben.

· Planung & Forecasting: Du wirkst bei Budgetplanung, Forecasts und Liquiditätsplanung mit und hilfst uns dabei, die finanzielle Entwicklung von Nordmut vorausschauend zu steuern.

· Performance-Analysen: Du analysierst Umsatz, Kosten, Margen und Profitabilität und identifizierst Chancen sowie Abweichungen frühzeitig.

· E-Commerce & Produkt-Controlling: Du behältst die Wirtschaftlichkeit unserer Produkte und Vertriebskanäle im Blick und unterstützt uns dabei, Sortiment, Preise und Margen datenbasiert weiterzuentwickeln.

· Prozessoptimierung: Du hilfst dabei, unsere Finance-Prozesse und Datenstrukturen kontinuierlich zu verbessern, zu automatisieren und für unser Wachstum skalierbar aufzustellen.

· Finance Operations: Du unterstützt bei laufenden Finance-Themen und arbeitest eng mit unserer Buchhaltung, Steuerberatung und weiteren externen Partnern zusammen.

· Accounting: Du übernimmst die operative Verantwortung für unsere Buchführung & arbeitest eng mit dem Steuerberater zusammen.

· Business Cases: Du erstellst Analysen und Entscheidungsgrundlagen für neue Produkte, Investitionen und strategische Projekte.

· Sparring: Du arbeitest eng mit uns Gründern zusammen, bereitest Zahlen verständlich auf und hilfst dabei, aus Daten konkrete unternehmerische Entscheidungen abzuleiten.

Qualifikation

**Dein Background
**· Ausbildung/Studium: BWL, Finance, vergleichbare Qualifikation.
· Erste Erfahrungen: Idealerweise im E-Commerce-Umfeld oder in einer dynamischen Finance-Umgebung.
· Prozessverständnis: Fundiertes Wissen in Controlling, Cashflow & Accounting.
· Analytisches Mindset: Datengetrieben, strukturiert und effizient.
· Sprachskills: Verhandlungssicheres Englisch, weitere Fremdsprachen sind ein Plus.

Dein Mindset · Struktur & Genauigkeit: Du arbeitest organisiert und verlierst nie den Überblick.
· Naturverbundenheit: Idealerweise selbst Outdoor-Fan oder Abenteurer.
· Kommunikationsstärke: Souverän im Umgang mit Partnern und Banken.
· Hands-on: Lösungsorientiert, belastbar und pragmatisch.
· Digital & nachhaltig: Interesse an Automatisierung, KI und nachhaltigen Finance-Lösungen.

Benefits

**Deine Benefits
**· Flexibilität: Arbeiten im Office in Hamburg-Mitte, remote oder sogar temporär aus dem Ausland.
· Work-Life-Balance: 30 Urlaubstage.
· Gründer-Sparring: Direkter Austausch mit den Gründern statt Konzernpolitik.
· Team-Spirit: Regelmäßige Team-Events & jährliche Workation im Ausland.
· Karriereperspektive: Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einem schnell wachsenden Start-up.
· Markenstolz: Teil einer emotionalen Outdoor Brand mit großer Vision.
· Modernes Setup: Apple-Hardware & effiziente Tools.
· Nach deinen Wünschen: Deutschlandticket, Urban Sports oder Firmenfahrrad.

👉 Bewirb dich noch heute und werde Teil von Nordmut – gemeinsam sorgen wir dafür, dass Menschen überall draußen Abenteuer erleben können.

Wir freuen uns auf dich!
Jonas & das ganze Nordmut-Team

  • Ivareta barnas omsorg, trivsel og sikkerhet.

jobs.title: Vi søker flere deltidsmedarbeidere til REMA 1000 SPILLUM!
jobs.description:
Ønsker du en variert og aktiv deltidsjobb hvor du får skape gode handleopplevelser? 🤩

Hos oss handler det om mer enn å fylle hyllene. Vi leter etter deg som ønsker å være en viktig del av hverdagen til kundene våre – noen som møter dem med et smil, hjelper når de trenger det, og sørger for at butikken vår alltid føles som et hyggelig sted å handle.

Hva får du jobbe med? ✨

Som butikkmedarbeider får du en aktiv arbeidsdag der du bidrar med alt fra å fylle på varer og sitte i kassa til å ta imot leveranser og sørge for at butikken ser innbydende ut. Men det stopper ikke der. Du er også den som hilser kunden velkommen, gir dem en god avskjed, og tar initiativ til å hjelpe – enten det er å finne en vare, bytte noe de ikke var fornøyd med, eller gi anbefalinger med et smil.

Hvem ser vi etter? 🔍

Vi ser etter deg som brenner for god service og trives i møte med mennesker. Du er den som får ting gjort, som liker et hektisk tempo, og som alltid har kunden i fokus. I tillegg:

  • Er du positiv og offensiv, og bidrar til engasjement og trivsel på jobb
  • Trives du med å jobbe både selvstendig og som en del av et team
  • Liker systemdrift og å følge rutiner, og har et øye for detaljer
  • Tar ansvar, er ærlig og til å stole på
  • Er god til å kommunisere i møte med kundene våre på en hyggelig og profesjonell måte
  • Har fylt 18 år

Hvorfor velge REMA 1000? 💙

I REMA 1000 er mulighetene mange for mennesker som tør å gi av seg selv, er positive og selvstendige. Hos oss er det plass til alle – mangfold gjør oss sterkere. Vi ser frem til å høre fra deg og gleder oss til å ønske deg velkommen som en del av teamet vårt.

Hos oss får du:

  • En trivelig arbeidsplass med hyggelige kollegaer
  • Muligheter for utvikling
  • Et miljø hvor du får støtten du trenger til å lykkes i rollen din
  • Variasjon og energi i hverdagen – ingen dager er helt like!

Les mer på oss på vår karriereside: https://www.rema.no/karriere/

Høres dette ut som jobben for deg? Da gleder vi oss til å høre fra deg 👋

Om rekrutteringsprosessen: 

I våre rekrutteringsprosesser benytter vi oss av testverktøy for å kunne bli bedre kjent med deg. Aktuelle kandidater vil motta e-post med link til testene kort tid etter innsendt søknad. 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

REMA 1000 er blant Norges største dagligvareaktør og en av landets sterkeste merkevarer. Siden 1979 har REMA 1000 jobbet for å kunne tilby kunder over hele landet et godt utvalg av dagligvarer til laveste pris, av høy kvalitet, produsert og solgt på en ansvarlig måte. Ved å ha hyggelige og dyktige mennesker med riktige holdninger og fokus på å jobbe med de rette tingene, har REMA 1000 lykkes med å skape en solid virksomhet som er lønnsom ikke bare for sine kjøpmenn og for bedriften - men også for kundene.
Ønsker du å lese mer om vårt arbeid med miljø og samfunnsansvar; https://www.rema.no/ansvar-i-rema-1000/

jobs.title: Julehjelp / sesonghjelp søkes til THE BODY SHOP - Kvadrat Kjøpesenter
jobs.description:
Til vår fantastiske butikk på Kvadrat ser vi etter en entusiastisk selger som vil styrke teamet vårt i julesesongen. Vi ser etter deg som elsker salg, har sterkt konkurranseinstinkt, er kreativ og har service i fokus. Videre er du glad i utfordringer, er fleksibel og ikke redd for å ta i et tak!

Hva vi ser etter

VI SØKER DEG SOM:

• Har stor interesse for hud og hudpleie, trender og nyheter

• Byr på seg selv og oppsøker dialog via sterk kommunikasjonsevne

• Elsker å gi det lille ekstra, og skape verdifulle kundemøter

• Kan jobbe både dag, kveld og helger, i henhold til senterets åpningstider.

• Har stor arbeidskapasitet særlig i desember, inkludert utvidede åpningstider, søndagsåpent og romjul

• Er fleksibel, ansvarlig og initiativrik

• Vil være en inspirerende ambassadør for vår merkevare og produkter, gjerne også foran kamera i forbindelse med innholdsproduksjon.

• Motiveres av en åpen og inkluderende arbeidsplass der vi jobber hardt mot felles mål, og feirer våre seiere langs veien.

• Tidligere salg- og serviceerfaring er en fordel, men ikke et krav

Stillingen er en sesongbasert stilling, og arbeidsmengden vil variere i henhold til butikkens behov. For rett kandidat kan også stillingen utvikle seg til en fast ansettelse, da vi er et firma i vekst.

Vi gjør oppmerksom på at stillingen kan bli besatt før søknadsfristen utløper, og oppfordrer derfor interesserte kandidater til å søke så snart som mulig. Ønsket oppstart er 15.oktober, eller etter avtale. Aldersgrensen for stillingen er 18 år.

Som selger er ditt hovedfokus å selge våre fantastiske produkter med service i verdensklasse, og være ansiktet utad for merkevaren vår. Gjennom historiefortelling, våre verdier og med stort engasjement hjelper du våre kunder med å finne de riktige produktene. Med sminke- og hudpleiekonsultasjoner gir du kunden en opplevelse utover det vanlige og legger grunnlaget for at de ønsker å komme tilbake til oss.

Vi tilbyr

Hos oss blir du en del av et team med fantastiske kollegaer som brenner for det vi gjør. Vi investerer i deg og dine ferdigheter gjennom regelmessig kursing og trening. Du har mulighet til månedlige premier og personalkjøp. Vi forholder oss til Virkes tariff for lønn.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Vi har alltid gjort ting litt annerledes - og i over 40 år har vi bevist at å selge kosmetikk kan bety mer enn å rense, skrubbe og smøre. Dyrevelferd, miljøvern, rettferdig handel og sosialt ansvar er områdene som former vår holdning til alt vi driver med. Hvis du deler våre verdier og lidenskap for å drive butikk på en litt annen måte, "Business as a force for good", kan The Body Shop være et sted for deg!

You will work closely with our Sales Operations team, the Salesforce Administrator and our Sales teams. In the beginning, the role will be quite hands-on and operational, with plenty of opportunities to learn and gradually take ownership of your own topics.

What you will do

  • Support our Sales teams with day-to-day operational questions and requests.

  • Support our Salesforce Administrator with user management, configuration, testing and documentation.

  • Connect ad spend to actual outcomes: get click and conversion data from our ad managers (LinkedIn, Google, Meta) flowing into HubSpot so campaign performance can be measured and fed back into targeting.

  • Own our tool stack: build and maintain a registry of every tool in use (technical owner, business owner), lead the retirement of Airtable, and run tool-selection decisions as a cross-functional process, not a unilateral ops call.

  • Stabilize ticketing and webinar operations ahead of high-volume periods, our two biggest scale risks right now.

  • Manage and grow the ops team: one person on revenue ops and one on tooling and custom software report to you from day one, and you will assess where further hiring is needed.

What you'll bring

Why join us?

This is a role to take an operations function that's already moving in the right direction and drive it the rest of the way, not a maintenance job, and not a blank-slate build either.   • Publish regularly under your own name, and take the analyst chair at our events and at the industry majors we attend.

  • Take vendor and enterprise briefings, and turn them into a structured view of the vendor landscape that feeds our reference architecture and our research.

  • Lead and develop the content team: a content PM, a narratives and QA lead, a video producer, and through them our brand designers.

  • Build relationships with other media houses, analyst firms and independent voices for co-published research, syndication and joint formats.

  • Work with our founders on their public positioning, so that the strongest ideas in the company reach the stage and the page.

What you'll bring

  • 6+ years in roles where your job was to understand a technology market and say something about it that held up: industry analyst, editor or lead writer at a technical publication, content or product marketing lead who shaped a category, or developer advocacy lead with a strategic remit.

  • Real depth in platform engineering, developer tooling, cloud infrastructure or the adoption of AI in software development. You can hold your own with a staff engineer and a CTO in the same conversation.

  • A body of published work under your own name, and a view on where the industry is going that you can defend with evidence.

  • Narrative judgment: you know the difference between a topic and a thesis, and between something that is true and something that is worth saying now.

  • Editorial rigor. You have run methodology, sourcing and fact-checking on work where being wrong had consequences.

  • Experience leading a small team of writers, researchers or producers, and making them better rather than louder.

  • Comfort in public: on stage, on camera, in a briefing room with a vendor's leadership team.

  • Operating discipline: calendars, standards and a cadence that ships.

  • Exceptional written and spoken English

  • Willingness to travel a few times per year for events and offsites.

Nice to have

  • Experience inside an analyst firm, or on the receiving end of one as a vendor.

  • A track record of building something recognized as a source: a report people cite, a newsletter people forward, a format people copy.

  • Familiarity with survey design and quantitative research methods.

  • Existing relationships across the cloud native and developer tooling ecosystem.

  • Hands-on engineering or platform background earlier in your career.

  • A practical view on where AI helps and hurts research and editorial work.

  • Experience working in a startup or scale-up, and with remote, globally distributed teams.

Why join us?

Most analyst jobs ask you to describe a market someone else built. This one asks you to shape one. Platform engineering is a discipline that our community defined, and the agentic enterprise is being defined right now. You'd be doing that work with direct access to the people building the world's most interesting internal developer platforms, a community of hundreds of thousands who already trust us, and a team that can turn an idea into a report, a course, a stage talk and a video in weeks.

There is no legacy research franchise to protect and no house style to inherit. If you want a role where your judgment about what matters becomes what the industry reads, this is that role.

jobs.title: Vil du lede et av Norges viktigste miljøer for IT-brukerstøtte?
jobs.description:
Vi i Domstoladministrasjonen bidrar til Norges domstolers oppdrag som samfunnets viktigste konfliktløser. Det gjør vi gjennom å utvikle fellesløsninger, slik at domstolene kan konsentrere seg som sine hovedoppgaver i dag og i fremtiden.

IT-avdelingen har et overordnet ansvar for forvaltning av informasjon og bruk av teknologi i Norges domstoler. Avdelingen skal sikre stabile, sikre og fremtidsrettede IT-løsninger som understøtter domstolenes virksomhet og ambisjonen om et digitalt rettsliv. Avdelingen består totalt av om lag 60 medarbeidere, fordelt på Seksjon for applikasjonsutvikling og test, Seksjon for digital arbeidsplass og Seksjon for sikkerhet, arkitektur og tjenesteplattform. 

Brukersenteret er nylig etablert som en egen gruppe i Seksjon for digital arbeidsplass. Brukersenteret er intern førstelinje for IT-støtte til Norges domstoler og har en sentral rolle i å sikre stabil drift, gode brukeropplevelser og effektiv innføring av nye IT-løsninger. Det er totalt ca. 2000 brukere. 

Vi har nå ledig stilling som gruppeleder. Gruppeleder vil rapportere til seksjonssjef for Digital Arbeidsplass. 


Arbeidsoppgaver

Dine viktigste oppgaver vil være å:

  • lede og videreutvikle Brukersenteret som nasjonal brukerstøttefunksjon
  • ha personalansvar for gruppens medarbeidere, herunder oppfølging, utviklingssamtaler, kompetanseutvikling og arbeidsmiljø
  • sørge for effektiv drift, bemanning og prioritering av oppgaver
  • følge opp mål, kvalitet, kapasitet og leveranser
  • videreutvikle arbeidsprosesser, rutiner og metoder for brukerstøtte
  • bidra til god samhandling mellom Brukersenteret, andre fagmiljøer i IT-avdelingen og våre leverandører
  • være en sentral samarbeidspartner for IT-rådgivere og IT-koordinatorer i domstolene, og lede utviklingen av disse rollene
  • bidra i planlegging og gjennomføring av større endringer, innføringer og forbedringstiltak på IT-området
  • sikre at brukernes behov og erfaringer blir fanget opp, systematisert og omsatt til forbedringer
Kvalifikasjoner

Vi ser etter deg som har:

  • relevant høyere utdanning, minimum bachelor innen IT, gjerne med ledelse i fagkretsen
  • erfaring med tjenesteleveranser, brukerstøtte eller IT-forvaltning
  • erfaring med personalledelse er en fordel, men kandidater med erfaring fra faglig ledelse oppfordres også til å søke
  • kjennskap til ITSM-rammeverk, prosessarbeid eller kontinuerlig forbedring er en fordel

Ansettelse til denne stillingen forutsetter godkjent bakgrunnssjekk.

Personlige egenskaper
  • Du trives med å kombinere operativ oppfølging med langsiktig utviklingsarbeid. 
  • Du har god relasjons- og mellommenneskelig kompetanse, og bygger tillit på tvers av fagmiljøer.
  • Du er strukturert, beslutningsdyktig og god til å prioritere. 
  • Du samarbeider godt og kommuniserer klart og tydelig på norsk, både muntlig og skriftlig. 
  • Du motiveres av å utvikle mennesker og fagmiljø. 
Vi tilbyr

I tillegg til en jobb som er viktig for både enkeltpersoner og samfunnet får du: 

  • muligheten til å utvikle både domstolene og deg selv 
  • et godt tverrfaglig miljø 
  • varierte og utfordrende arbeidsoppgaver 
  • ulike tilbud om relevant kompetanseheving
  • fleksibel arbeidshverdag med fleksitid, mulighet for hjemmekontor og trening i arbeidstid
  • moderne lokaler i sentrum med egen kantine og kort vei til offentlig transport  
  • gunstige vilkår i Statens pensjonskasse 

Stillingen lønnes som kontorsjef (kode 1054) etter Hovedtariffavtalen, avhengig av din kompetanse. 

KontaktinformasjonBjørn Olav Kvendset, Seksjonssjef, 908 91 615, bjørn.olav.kvendset@domstol.no
ArbeidsstedDronningens gate 2
7011 TRONDHEIM
Nøkkelinformasjon:Arbeidsgiver: Domstoladministrasjonen

Referansenr.: 5176733251
Stillingsprosent: 100%
Fast
Søknadsfrist: 05.10.2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Om oss

Domstolene er samfunnets viktigste konfliktløser. Norge har 55 domstoler med om lag 2000 medarbeidere. Domstolene er den tredje statsmakt. Som samfunnets viktigste konfliktløser, er domstolene avhengig av tillit. Det innebærer at virksomheten må innfri samfunnets krav og forventninger. Domstoladministrasjonen skal medvirke til at domstolene blir best mulig i stand til å løse oppgavene sine. Det betyr blant annet å legge til rette for en forsvarlig og effektiv gjennomføring av rettssaker.

Domstoladministrasjonen har en styrings- og støttefunksjon, en rettspolitisk og en utviklingsrolle overfor domstolene. Domstoladministrasjonen holder til i Trondheim, og arbeidsspråket vårt er norsk. Virksomheten er organisert i fem avdelinger. Se www.domstol.no for mer informasjon. 

Personvern

Personopplysninger i søknad og CV til stillingen blir håndtert i samsvar med lov om behandling av personopplysninger. Du kan lese mer om personvern på www.domstol.no. Vi utarbeider offentlig søkerliste og viser til offentlighetsloven § 25, andre ledd, for mulighet til å bli unntatt fra denne.

Mangfold i Norges domstoler

Det er viktig at de ansatte i norske domstoler representerer et godt mangfold med ulik bakgrunn og erfaring. Vi har i dag et rikt og flerkulturelt samfunn. Norges domstoler ønsker derfor å rekruttere flere dommere som har en flerkulturell bakgrunn og erfaring. Dette vil gi domstolene viktig kunnskap i utførelsen av samfunnsoppdraget. Mangfold er en styrke, og vi vil tilrettelegge for ansatte med ulike behov. Les mer om muligheten for positiv særbehandling på https://arbeidsgiver.dfo.no/positivsaerbehandling.

Bakgrunnssjekk

For utvalgte stillinger gjennomfører Domstoladministrasjonen bakgrunnssjekk som en del av rekrutteringsprosessen. Bakgrunnssjekken utføres av Semac etter samtykke fra kandidaten, og innebærer blant annet verifisering av CV og annen relevant søknadsdokumentasjon. For stillinger der bakgrunnssjekk er aktuelt, vil ansettelse forutsette godkjent bakgrunnssjekk. Aktuelle kandidater vil få nærmere informasjon om dette i rekrutteringsprosessen.

jobs.title: THE BODY SHOP - Byporten i Oslo søker julehjelp / sesonghjelp
jobs.description:
Til vår fantastiske butikk på Byporten søker vi to entusiastisk selgere som kan være med på å styrke teamet i julesesongen. Vi ser etter deg som elsker salg, har sterkt konkurranseinstinkt, er kreativ og har service i fokus. Videre er du glad i utfordringer, fleksibel og ikke redd for å ta i et tak!

Hva vi ser etter

VI SØKER DEG SOM:

• Har stor interesse for hud og hudpleie, trender og nyheter

• Byr på seg selv og oppsøker dialog via sterk kommunikasjonsevne

• Elsker å gi det lille ekstra, og skape verdifulle kundemøter

• Kan jobbe både dag, kveld og helger, i henhold til senterets åpningstider.

• Har stor arbeidskapasitet særlig i desember, inkludert utvidede åpningstider, søndagsåpent og romjul

• Er fleksibel, ansvarlig og initiativrik

• Vil være en inspirerende ambassadør for vår merkevare og produkter, gjerne også foran kamera i forbindelse med innholdsproduksjon.

• Motiveres av en åpen og inkluderende arbeidsplass der vi jobber hardt mot felles mål, og feirer våre seiere langs veien.

• Tidligere salg- og serviceerfaring er en fordel, men ikke et krav

Stillingen er en sesongbasert stilling, og arbeidsmengden vil variere i henhold til butikkens behov. For rett kandidat kan også stillingen utvikle seg til en fast ansettelse, da vi er et firma i vekst.

Vi gjør oppmerksom på at stillingen kan bli besatt før søknadsfristen utløper, og oppfordrer derfor interesserte kandidater til å søke så snart som mulig. Ønsket oppstart er 15.oktober, eller etter avtale. Aldersgrensen for stillingen er 18 år.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Som selger er ditt hovedfokus å selge våre fantastiske produkter med service i verdensklasse, og være ansiktet utad for merkevaren vår. Gjennom historiefortelling, våre verdier og med stort engasjement hjelper du våre kunder med å finne de riktige produktene. Med sminke- og hudpleiekonsultasjoner gir du kunden en opplevelse utover det vanlige og legger grunnlaget for at de ønsker å komme tilbake til oss.

Vi tilbyr

Hos oss blir du en del av et team med fantastiske kollegaer som brenner for det vi gjør. Vi investerer i deg og dine ferdigheter gjennom regelmessig kursing og trening. Du har mulighet til månedlige premier og personalkjøp. Vi forholder oss til Virkes tariff for lønn.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Vi har alltid gjort ting litt annerledes - og i over 40 år har vi bevist at å selge kosmetikk kan bety mer enn å rense, skrubbe og smøre. Dyrevelferd, miljøvern, rettferdig handel og sosialt ansvar er områdene som former vår holdning til alt vi driver med. Hvis du deler våre verdier og lidenskap for å drive butikk på en litt annen måte, "Business as a force for good", kan The Body Shop være et sted for deg!

jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.description:
Sama is a B2B platform that enables employers to provide hyper-tailored development through unlimited professional coaching—right from a user-friendly app (sama.io).

Come join our amazing team working to elevate the corporate environment by allowing employees to be their best productive selves.  We’re building the future of work! 

Ready to be a part of a team of highly motivated individuals who think like owners and are on a mission to consistently deliver amazing experiences? Read on.

Your mission, should you choose to accept it:

We’re looking for an experienced Product Designer to join our growing team on a part time/contract basis. In this role, you’ll be responsible for creating intuitive, engaging product experiences that delight our users — from concept to delivery. You will also collaborate with marketing and sales to ensure brand consistency across the full customer journey, contributing to assets such as landing pages, sales decks, and campaign visuals.

What you'll be doing:

Product Design (Primary Focus)

  • Own end-to-end design for key product areas, from discovery through delivery
  • Translate user needs, business goals, and technical constraints into elegant solutions
  • Create wireframes, user flows, high-fidelity mockups, and interactive prototypes
  • Collaborate closely with Product Managers and Engineers to bring ideas to life
  • Participate in user research and usability testing to inform design decisions
  • Contribute to and evolve our design system for consistency and scalability

Marketing & Sales Design (Secondary Focus)

  • Design marketing materials that align with the product brand, such as landing pages, ads, and campaign assets
  • Collaborate with the marketing team to refine and elevate our visual storytelling
  • Support the sales team with design for presentations, one-pagers, and other collateral
  • Ensure brand cohesion across digital product, web, and sales experiences

Requirements

Note: this job is remote, and we are open to candidates across Europe.

What you'll need to succeed: 

  • 3–5 years of professional experience in product design, ideally within SaaS
  • Experience with marketing design, branding, or motion graphics
  • Experience working in start-ups
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating user-centered product design and a solid visual design aesthetic
  • Experience designing responsive web and/or mobile applications
  • Proficiency in Figma (or equivalent design/prototyping tools)
  • Understanding of design systems and component-driven design
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams

What people would say about you:

  • You have an ​​entrepreneurial mindset and are autonomous
  • You’re able to work in an environment with limited structure and processes
  • You’re excited to tackle new challenges head-on
  • You’re extremely curious
  • New opportunities and potential challenges excite you
  • You’re extremely detail oriented and have a bias for action—you're a doer
  • You’re open, trustworthy, and committed
  • You’re a team player

Benefits

What you’ll get:

  • Compensation: $1,500/month retainer plus additional project-based compensation
  • Project fees vary based on scope, complexity and involvement
  • Remote work.
  • Plenty of room for growth as our ambitious team grows too.
  • Access to your professional coach via our app.
  • Regular training and development.
