jobs.title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer - Moonpay Enterprise
jobs.description:
MoonPay Enterprise is for builders with something to prove.

This isn't a "work on cool crypto stuff" company. It's a high-standards, high-velocity, high-accountability company building the operating system for value movement. If the internet moves information, we move value: crypto, stablecoins, tokenized assets, and whatever comes next. Four offerings make that real: fund, tokenize, trade, and spend.

MoonPay Enterprise is the fund layer built for businesses. We power how stablecoins move through real financial operations: enterprises, fintechs, PSPs, wallets, and marketplaces running their treasuries, their cross-border flows, and their stablecoin operations on us. The goal is to make moving real money at scale as predictable as any other piece of financial infrastructure, with the compliance and controls CFOs need to say yes.

AI is the default operating mode here. It's woven into every role, and we expect you to use it daily. It handles the manual work so you can deliver on what actually matters.

You'll thrive here if outcomes excite you more than process, if impact motivates you more than titles, and if you want hard problems, real ownership, and teammates who love winning, building, and doing it together.

The bar is high. The pace is real. We're building the rails that businesses run real money on, for humans and agents. MoonPay ranked #2 in Crypto Services on Fortune's inaugural Crypto 100, made Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers 2026 (Top 25 in Finance), and landed on The Sunday Times Best Places to Work two years running.


The role

We’re hiring backend engineers across several openings within MoonPay Enterprise. All roles share the same foundation of designing and operating reliable, secure, high-throughput backend services, but each opening has a distinct focus. When you apply, tell us which track (or tracks) excites you most.

Track 1: KYB / KYC & Compliance Platform

Build the systems that let enterprises onboard safely and stay compliant across dozens of jurisdictions. You’ll own services powering business (KYB) and individual (KYC) verification flows, risk scoring, sanctions and AML screening, case management, and integrations with identity and compliance vendors. The challenge is making rigorous compliance feel invisible: fast, automated, and globally scalable, without ever compromising on regulatory obligations.

Track 2: New Product Lines, starting with Custody

Join us at the ground floor of new enterprise products, beginning with Custody. You’ll design the backend for secure digital asset storage and management for institutional clients: key management workflows, policy engines, transaction authorization, ledger integrity, and audit trails. This track suits engineers who love ambiguity, greenfield architecture, and building products from zero to one with enterprise-grade security requirements.

Track 3: Blockchain, Stablecoin Issuance & On-Chain Infrastructure

Work directly with blockchain protocols to power our stablecoin issuance business and on-chain products. You’ll build and operate services for minting, burning, and managing fully reserved stablecoins across chains, develop smart contract integrations on EVM chains and Solana, and design the indexing, monitoring, and reconciliation systems that keep on-chain and off-chain state in sync. Prior Solana (Rust) or Solidity development experience is a strong plus here.

Across all tracks, experience with fiat rails, banking integrations, or payments systems is very welcome. Much of our hardest work happens where traditional finance and crypto overlap.

What you’ll do

  • Design, build, and operate backend services written in Rust that process high volumes of financial transactions with strong guarantees around correctness, idempotency, and auditability
  • Own features end to end, from shaping the product spec through technical design, implementation, testing, deployment, and production monitoring. You won’t just receive work from product: as a domain expert, you’ll help define what we build and propose the work you consider most useful
  • Integrate with external partners such as banks, payment processors, blockchains, and identity and compliance vendors, and build the abstractions that make those integrations reliable
  • Improve engineering quality across observability, incident response, security practices, and API design
  • Collaborate closely with product, compliance, and other engineering teams across MoonPay’s global network
  • (Staff level) Set technical direction for your area, mentor other engineers, and drive architectural decisions that span multiple teams

About you

  • 5+ years of backend engineering experience (8+ for Staff), with a track record of shipping and operating production systems at scale
  • Strong backend experience with a statically compiled language (e.g. Rust, Go, C#, C++) is a must. Deep fundamentals matter more to us than your specific language history
  • Prior professional Rust experience is not required, but interest in Rust and motivation to become an expert in it are very welcome, since our services are written in Rust
  • Solid fundamentals in distributed systems, API design, data modeling, and asynchronous processing
  • Comfort working in domains where precision matters, such as financial systems, double-entry ledgers, reconciliation, or similarly correctness-critical software
  • A pragmatic, autonomous, ownership-driven mindset. You care about outcomes, communicate clearly, and thrive on high throughput: on this team, features ship in hours to days and products in days to weeks
  • Strong critical thinking, including in how you use AI tools. You know how to drive AI-assisted development productively while staying firmly in control of correctness, security, and design quality
  • Interest in crypto, stablecoins, and the future of payments. Prior crypto experience is a plus rather than a requirement, except for Track 3, where hands-on blockchain development experience is expected

Bonus points

  • Professional or hobby experience writing Rust (open-source contributions count!)
  • Experience in fiat payments, banking integrations, card networks, or PSPs
  • Familiarity with KYC/KYB, AML, sanctions screening, or regulated financial products (Track 1)
  • Background in custody, key management (MPC/HSM), or institutional-grade security (Track 2)
  • Smart contract development in Solidity (EVM) or Rust (Solana), and experience with on-chain indexing or node infrastructure (Track 3)
  • Experience working in regulated, multi-jurisdiction environments

How we work

MoonPay Enterprise operates like a startup inside a scale-up: small, senior, high-throughput teams with real ownership, direct access to customers and decision-makers, and the backing of MoonPay’s global licenses, banking relationships, and distribution network. We move fast and expect engineers to act as product owners for their domain, not just implementers. This role is open fully remote, or hybrid from our Berlin, Germany hub if you prefer time with the team in person.

  • Du stärkst die Ownership für Pipeline, Umsatz und nachhaltiges Subskriptionswachstum.

Player-Coach – ca. 20 % eigene Sales-Aktivität

Du bleibst selbst nah am Markt und an unseren Kunden. Rund 20 % deiner Zeit investierst du in eigene operative Vertriebsaktivitäten.

Dabei übernimmst du bewusst eine begrenzte Anzahl eigener Accounts und Opportunities, betreibst selbst Neukundenakquisition und arbeitest bei ausgewählten strategischen oder komplexen Opportunities gemeinsam mit deinen KAMs.

  • Partner- und Ecosystem-Selling

Wichtig ist uns vor allem: Du kannst nicht nur selbst verkaufen – du kannst Vertriebskompetenz auf andere übertragen.

Du bist Coach und Führungskraft, ohne deinen Sales-Hintergrund zu verlieren.

Vormachen → gemeinsam machen → Verantwortung übergeben.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager (hands-on) - Alan Clinic
jobs.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

🤖 Who we are

Alan Clinic. A health companion and a digital clinic for everyone.

We're a small team within Alan, on a mission to redefine the future of care by democratizing access to medical expertise. The Clinic is two crews building one experience:

  • Mo. An intelligent, empathetic, multimodal LLM-based conversational AI assistant able to prescribe, triage, and proactively follow up on care. We kicked off in 2023 and launched Mo to all our French members (1M) in Q1 2026, making it the first safe AI health companion live at scale in Europe.

  • Clinic Platform. The medical services behind the conversation: chat with health practitioners, teleconsultation, and care programs across primary care, mental health, and physiotherapy.

Imagine giving every person in the world instant, 24/7 access to personalised medical expertise (through chat, voice, or video) with AI agents working in tandem with real doctors and the health system. That's what we are building 🤖🏥.

🚀 What you'll build and who you'll work with

We're building a medical experience that works reliably, safely, and at scale. An AI agent, and the clinic behind it. You'll lead the engineering team and you'll keep building alongside them.

The crews work at the intersection of product engineering, ML engineering, and medical expertise. As their engineering leader, you own:

  • 💬 The team behind the most memorable chatting experience. Hiring, onboarding, honest feedback, and the mix of skills Mo needs as it grows. Talent density is yours to own.

  • ➕ The architecture for Mo's next chapters. More context, new skills, new countries. You guide the calls on our architecture and agentic framework, and you stay close enough to the code to make them well.

  • 🏥 The platform that turns conversations into care. Chat with health practitioners, teleconsultation at national scale, and the tooling doctors and therapists use every day. You drive alignment with the crews and medical teams on the other side, so members get from words to actions.

  • 🛡️ Operational excellence. Mo and teleconsultation are real-time services that have to be live 24/7. Latency, error rates, incident response, and an on-call rotation that doesn't burn people out.

If you're excited by the idea of building the future of healthcare, this is the team for you. We're at the start of the journey. If you're curious, here is a paper we published recently.

⚡ Why this role is special

  • Dual impact: Shape both technical excellence and team growth - your engineers become better while building better products

  • Leadership growth: Influence engineering culture, mentor future leaders, and drive technical strategy that shapes the future of healthcare delivery

  • Startup speed, Alan's platform. Mo operates with the focus of a startup, on top of Alan's infrastructure, distribution, and health expertise. Small team, huge reach.

  • Stakes that make the work matter. In medical AI, reliability and safety are the product. Every call you make on quality, architecture, and evaluation is a call about our members' health.

🔍 What we're looking for

We're looking for an engineering leader who gets excited about building state-of-the-art AI systems and applying them to real-world, high-stakes problems in healthcare.

Leadership experience

  • 3+ years leading engineering teams, with a track record of building high performers.

  • You partner with other product functions as a true equal: you shape the roadmap, name trade-offs honestly, and help the team commit to what it can actually deliver.

Technical foundations

  • Experience establishing engineering excellence standards, with the ability to guide architectural decisions.

  • First-hand experience shipping AI or LLM products to production is a big plus.

  • You're excited and eager to keep writing code. You still review it, and you still ship some yourself.

  • Comfortable with modern development practices and AI-assisted development tools.

What we value

  • Curious, self-starting, humble, collaborative, and eager to grow.

  • You develop people as much as you develop products.

  • Ex-founders are typically a great fit in our team.

Mission alignment

  • Healthcare technology and innovation excite you

  • You understand that great engineering teams are built on psychological safety and continuous learning

But above all, we are looking for high potential and curiosity: make sure to show us this when you apply!

🎯 Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

  • Connect the dots with Prevention initiatives, including the relationship between Prévoyance coverage and absenteeism prevention.

Pricing

  • Define and improve methodologies for both theoretical and experience pricing.

  • Adapt analyses to the specific characteristics of each business segment, including small amounts, high-severity claims, and newly launched segments.

  • Contribute to the portfolio renewal strategies, in close collaboration with internal teams (Strategy, Product, Sales, etc.) and external stakeholders (insurer, reinsurers).

Underwriting & product launch

Team Growth

  • Support the identification and hiring of new talents for the Insurance team.

⭐️ The Business Segment Lead role ⭐️

At Alan, we split the French market in several business segments, each of them corresponding to a category of clients (whether by size, or industry).

The role of a Business Segment Lead is to reach market leadership in their given segment. To succeed, you will have to (1) articulate a vision for your segment, (2) define priorities and resources to deliver, and (3) make strategic decisions for your segment based on market insights.

The Business Segment Lead role is made for transversal influence as we operate based on distributed ownership. You will work closely with all teams involved in the success of your segment (Product, Insurance, Sales, Marketing). You will also collaborate with other segment leaders to build-up knowledge, share best practices, and create alignment around a long-term value plan.

Main missions include:

  • Market intelligence: You’ll build expertise on our market and competitive landscape. You’ll work both on the quantitative side (sizing) and the qualitative side (customers’ pain points and needs).

  • Value proposition and pricing: Our goal is to differentiate our offer from the market. You’ll relentlessly ask yourself: what is the best product offering to become leader in this segment?

  • Go-to-Market strategy: You’ll work both on renewal (account management) and expansion strategy (business development). This will require you to adapt and innovate when it comes to distribution channels, sub-segments, and partners management.

  • P&L ownership & Resources allocation: You’ll own the return on investment of your segment and are in charge of building the case for internal resources allocation based on your P&L.

  • Product trade-off: You’ll work together with product teams in order for us to build the best product based on market insights.

Alan operates at the intersection of health insurance, prevention, and regulated data. The person in this role owns the security governance and risk posture of a company that handles sensitive health data for 1M+ members, operates under DORA and HDS certification requirements, and is regulated by the ACPR. They work in close partnership with Legal, Internal Audit, and the broader Risk function. It's a highly collaborative role.

🛡️ Your mission: Governance, risk & compliance

Own and operate the ISO 27001 ISMS. You are the accountable owner of the Information Security Management System: scope definition, Statement of Applicability, internal audit programme, and management review. You've led at least one full certification or recertification cycle and know what breaks down in the months between audits.

Be the security expert on regulatory and privacy matters. Legal leads on DORA, HDS, RGPD, PGSSI-S, and regulatory relationships. Your role is to bring the technical and operational security substance: translating regulatory requirements into controls, flagging implementation gaps, and making sure the security programme is solid when the regulatory team negotiates with the ACPR or ANS.

Run risk as an ongoing programme, in partnership with the broader risk function. You lead security risk cartography using EBIOS RM and ensure it feeds into, and is informed by, the company-wide risk framework. You facilitate risk workshops, produce treatment plans, and bring the security lens to forums where non-security risks are also on the table. You know when a security risk is really a business risk.

Own the controls framework, but distribute ownership of controls themselves. You define the framework, set the standards, and track coverage, but the controls live with the teams who build and run the things they protect. You work closely with Infrastructure, Platform, and Engineering to ensure foundational building blocks (identity, network, secrets management, logging) are designed with security requirements built in from the start. You work alongside those teams as a partner.

Run audit cycles with rigour, in close partnership with Internal Audit. You manage the security audit programme and coordinate with certification bodies. You work with Internal Audit to align scopes, avoid duplication, and present a coherent picture of control effectiveness to the board. You've sat in joint audit planning sessions and know how to make that relationship work well.

Manage third-party risk. You run vendor security assessments and define contractual security requirements (security annexes, DPAs). You partner with our Risk team, which oversees third-party risk, and own the security dimension.

Bring the health sector context. You understand the ANS framework, CERT Santé requirements, and what it means to handle sensitive health data in day-to-day operations. You're a useful partner to Legal when the question is "what does this regulation actually require us to do technically?"

Own incident governance and support DORA reporting. You classify and escalate ICT incidents internally, own BCP and DRP governance, and provide the security substance for DORA incident reports.

🚀 What you'll build and who you'll work with

Compliance Framework: ISO 27001, DORA, HDS, NIS2. Multiple regulators, multiple countries, one coherent governance backbone. Build the system that lets Alan scale from 1M to many millions of members without rebuilding compliance every time.

Automated Audit & Evidence Engine: Replace manual evidence collection with scripted pipelines plugged directly into engineering systems. Turn audit cycles into a continuous capability instead of a quarterly rush.

Risk Cartography: Risk treated as an operational signal that feeds directly into business and engineering decisions, with EBIOS RM at the core.

You'll work closely with Legal, DPO, Internal Audit, and the broader Risk function, and partner day-to-day with Infrastructure, Platform, Engineering, Product, and Operations. You're the bridge between regulatory complexity and operational simplicity.

⚡ Why this role is special

Direct Impact: You own the trust foundation that lets Alan handle health data for 1M+ members and operate in highly regulated markets. Your work is the precondition for everything else Alan does.

Complex Problems: 4 regulators across 4 countries, sensitive health data, and a regulatory landscape that keeps shifting (DORA, NIS2, AI Act), all to be modeled into a single, coherent control system.

Ownership & Growth: Board and executive exposure, real influence on company-wide risk decisions, and the autonomy to shape Alan's security culture across 800+ people.

🤝 What you will also do: Technical enablement

Automate compliance work wherever possible. You script evidence collection, automate control testing, and connect GRC tooling to engineering pipelines. You've used Python or similar to reduce the manual work of an audit cycle, and you actively look for the next process to streamline.

Configure and own GRC tooling. You can administer platforms like CISO Assistant, ServiceNow GRC, or Archer, designing workflows, building dashboards, and making them genuinely useful for the teams that feed them data.

Speak cloud governance fluently. You understand shared responsibility in HDS-qualified environments, know what CSPM tools surface and what they miss, and can reason about policy-as-code (OPA, SCP) without needing an engineer to translate.

Read architecture well enough to challenge it. You can review a proposed architecture, identify control gaps in identity, network segmentation, encryption, or logging, and push back credibly with engineers even though you're not one.

Interpret vulnerability data and drive prioritisation. You read scan outputs, work with engineering teams to prioritise remediation by business impact over CVSS score alone, and track resolution KPIs over time.

⭐️ Qualifications, mindset and soft skills

You translate risk into business language. You can brief a board or an audit committee and leave them genuinely informed. You know the difference between a finding that requires an emergency board call and one that belongs in a quarterly report.

You influence without authority. You align Legal, DPO, Risk, Engineering, Product, and Operations on security requirements without creating blockers or adversarial dynamics. People come to you early because you make their work easier.

You manage programmes with audit-grade rigor. You run structured, traceable roadmaps. You know where every commitment is, who owns it, and when it's due. You escalate proactively and don't let dependencies surprise you.

You build a genuine security culture. Your awareness programmes land because they're relevant to the people who take them. You foster proportionate risk ownership across the company, so teams make better day-to-day decisions.

You think in principles when frameworks shift. DORA is live. NIS2 transposition pace varies. The AI Act is arriving. When the regulatory landscape moves, you reason from first principles and adapt without waiting to be told what to do.

Remote work: We offer remote work flexibility, but we value in-person collaboration

- Käytännön ongelmanratkaisukykyä ja huolellista työnjälkeä

- Itsenäistä, vastuullista ja luotettavaa työotetta

- Asiakaspalveluhenkisyyttä

- B-ajokorttia ja mahdollisuutta liikkua eri työkohteisiin

- Valmiutta työskennellä tarvittaessa myös Oulun ulkopuolella

- Halua oppia ja omaksua uusia työtehtäviä perehdytyksen avulla


Aiempi kokemus kaikista työvaiheista ei ole välttämätöntä. Arvostamme erityisesti oma-aloitteisuutta ja halua tehdä työ laadukkaasti.

Mitä tarjoamme?

- Vakituisen työsuhteen ja mahdollisuuden pitkäaikaiseen työskentelyyn

- Säännöllisen kuukausipalkan

- Kiinteistöpalvelualan työehtosopimuksen mukaiset työehdot

- Työehtosopimuksen mukaiset ylityökorvaukset ja lisät

- Vuosiloman kertymisen työehtosopimuksen mukaisesti

- Monipuoliset ja vaihtelevat työtehtävät

- Mahdollisuuden kehittyä ammatillisesti ja oppia uusia työvaiheita

- Perehdytyksen ja opastuksen tarpeen mukaan

- Työtehtävissä tarvittavat työvälineet ja ohjauksen

- Mukavan ja käytännönläheisen työyhteisön


Työsuhde ja palkkaus

**Työskentelyalue:** Oulu ja tarvittaessa muut paikkakunnat Pohjois-Suomessa **Työsuhde:** Vakituinen **Palkkaus:** Säännöllinen kuukausipalkka, joka määräytyy kiinteistöpalvelualan työehtosopimuksen 1.8.2026 alkaen voimassa olevan palkkaryhmän 6 vähimmäispalkan mukaisesti. **Lisät ja ylityökorvaukset:** Työehtosopimuksen mukaisesti **Vuosiloma:** Kertyy työehtosopimuksen mukaisesti.

Kiinnostuitko?

Lähetä hakemuksesi sähköpostitse osoitteeseen **info@pintakeskus.fi**. Kerro lyhyesti itsestäsi, aiemmasta kokemuksestasi ja siitä, miksi olisit sopiva tehtävään. Liitä mukaan yhteystietosi ja mahdollinen ansioluettelosi.

Tule mukaan tekemään laadukasta ja luotettavaa kylpyhuonehuoltoa osana ammattitaitoista työyhteisöämme!

Haemme vielä kahta asentajaa tiimiimme. Täytämme paikat heti sopivien tekijöiden löydyttyä, joten lähetä hakemuksesi jo tänään!

jobs.title: Fast stilling og vikariat som politibetjent 3/2/1, Etterforsker
jobs.description:
Om stillingen

Ved Tjenesteenhet Hamar, seksjon etterforskning, er det ledig faste stillinger og vikariat som PB 3/2/1.

  • Andre oppgaver etter behov

Kvalifikasjoner

Nødvendige:

  • Bestått bachelor fra Politi(høg)skolen
  • Interesse for etterforskningsfaget

  • God evne til kommunikasjon og relasjonsbygging.

    • PB 3 lønn fra kr. 575.000,- brutto per år + etterforskertillegg kr. 60.000,-

Opplysninger om deg kan bli offentliggjort selv om du har anmodet om ikke å bli ført opp på søkerlisten. Dersom anmodningen ikke blir tatt til følge, vil du bli varslet om dette.

Innlandet politidistrikt er landets største politidistrikt i geografisk utstrekning, med flere større hovedfartsårer og mange grenseoverganger til Sverige.

jobs.title: Solutions Architect - West
Verpleegkundige verpleegafdeling hematologie
jobs.description:
Wat ga je doen?

  • je bent verantwoordelijk voor de totaalzorg van patiënten met een bloedziekte, bv leukemie of hemofilie
  • je hebt aandacht voor de fysieke, psychische en sociale noden van patiënt en naaste omgeving, zowel in een acute als palliatieve setting
  • je bent nauw betrokken bij de transplantaties van stamcellen en andere bloedderivaten
  • je werkt samen met verschillende leden van een multidisciplinair team

Wie zoeken we?

  • je behaalde het diploma van verpleegkundige (bachelor, hbo-5 of gelijkgesteld)
  • indien je in het bezit bent van een beroepstitel oncologie is dit een meerwaarde
  • je werkt in een continudienst
  • je bent een dynamische verpleegkundige met verantwoordelijkheidszin
  • je kunt zelfstandig werken in een multidisciplinair team
  • je deelt onze visie van levenslang leren en permanent groeien

Wat mag je verwachten?

  • Je hebt een diploma verpleegkunde (basisverpleegkundige, HBO5 of bachelor/VVAZ)
  • Je job met impact gaat gepaard met een motiverend loonpakket:
    • Basisverpleegkundige: IFIC 13 (https://www.uza.be/sites/default/files/media/files/2025-03/IFIC%2013.pdf)
    • HBO5 verpleegkundige: IFIC 14B (https://www.uza.be/sites/default/files/media/files/2025-03/IFIC%2014B.pdf)
    • Bachelorverpleegkundige: IFIC 14 (https://www.uza.be/sites/default/files/media/files/2025-03/IFIC%2014.pdf)
  • Daarnaast bieden we tal van extralegale voordelen zoals maaltijdcheques, een hospitalisatieverzekering, een verzekering gewaarborgd inkomen en de mogelijkheid tot fietsleasing.
  • Work-lifebalance is voor ons van groot belang. Ga je voltijds bij ons aan de slag? Dan kan je genieten van 40 vakantiedagen.
  • Als universitair ziekenhuis bieden we talloze opleidingsmogelijkheden om je talenten verder te ontwikkelen
  • We ontzorgen jou en je gezin met verschillende kinderopvangmogelijkheden en een ruime, gratis personeelsparking.
  • We zijn een fiere Baanbrekende Werkgever: je komt terecht bij een mensgerichte en duurzame werkgever.
  • En wist je dat we uitgeroepen zijn tot Ziekenhuis van het Jaar?
  • En nog veel meer! Ontdek alle voordelen van werken bij het UZA hier. (https://uzajobs.be/wij#onze-voordelen)

Interesse om deel uit te maken van ons team?

Solliciteer online via www.uzajobs.be (http://www.uzatrektaan.be). 

Voor meer informatie over de functie inhoud kan je terecht bij Ellen Borghgraef (hoofdverpleegkundige), +32 3 821 53 51.

Voor meer informatie over de sollicitatieprocedure kan je contact opnemen met Winie Van den Brande (HR medewerker), +32 3 821 59 48.

jobs.title: Stabiliteitsingenieur
jobs.description:
Als stabiliteitsingenieur beoordeel je concrete stabiliteitsvragen op het terrein. Je analyseert de situatie in situ, formuleert deskundig advies en geeft, waar nodig, duidelijke instructies over de maatregelen die noodzakelijk zijn om gebouwen of panden veilig te stellen.

Je ondersteunt de aanbestedende overheid met deskundig advies bij stabiliteitsproblemen in publieke gebouwen en private panden, waarbij veiligheid, onderbouwde besluitvorming en duidelijke communicatie centraal staan.

Voornaamste taken

  • Je voert plaatsbezoeken uit naar gebouwen of panden waar stabiliteitsproblemen of gevaarlijke situaties worden vastgesteld.
  • Je beoordeelt de situatie ter plaatse en analyseert de problematiek op een deskundige manier.
  • Je formuleert concrete adviezen over de noodzakelijke maatregelen om de veiligheid te garanderen.
  • Je maakt duidelijke verslagen van plaatsbezoeken, ondersteund met relevant beeldmateriaal.
  • Je ondersteunt de aanbestedende overheid bij dossiers in het kader van openbare veiligheid.
  • Je stelt, indien van toepassing, een omstandig verslag op in het kader van artikel 135 van de Gemeentewet.
  • Je kan bij noodsituaties advies verlenen aan of op vraag van de brandweer.
  • Je bent stabiliteitsingenieur en beschikt over de nodige technische expertise om stabiliteitsproblemen correct te beoordelen.
  • Je hebt ervaring met plaatsbezoeken, technische analyses en het formuleren van praktisch uitvoerbare adviezen.
  • Je communiceert helder en professioneel met de overheid, hulpdiensten en andere betrokken partijen.
  • Je werkt zelfstandig, nauwkeurig en oplossingsgericht.
  • Je bent bereid om ter plaatse te gaan wanneer een concrete vraag of noodsituatie dit vereist.
  • Referenties: je kunt minimaal 1 referentie van gelijkaardige opdracht uitgevoerd in de voorbije 3 jaar voorleggen. Aan elke referentie wordt een attest van goede uitvoering toegevoegd evenals de tewerkstellingsperiode.

jobs.title: Projectleider bouw en renovatieprojecten
jobs.description:
Voor de ondersteuning van diverse bouw- en renovatieprojecten binnen gemeentes grenzend aan Oost-Vlaanderen en Antwerpen zoeken wij een ervaren projectleider. Je neemt projecten zelfstandig op of ondersteunt lopende dossiers, steeds in nauwe samenwerking met de opdrachtgever, ontwerpers, architecten, aannemers en interne diensten.

Als externe projectleider vertegenwoordig je de bouwheer bij bouw- en renovatiedossiers. Je bewaakt de voortgang, kwaliteit, timing en budgetten en zorgt ervoor dat projecten professioneel voorbereid, opgevolgd en afgerond worden. Je combineert bouwtechnische expertise met sterke organisatorische vaardigheden en een goed inzicht in overheidsopdrachten.

Voornaamste taken

  • Je analyseert de bestaande bouwkundige toestand en de planologische context van projecten.
  • Je stelt programma’s van eisen, ramingen, nota’s en technische voorschriften op.
  • Je begeleidt ontwerp- en uitvoeringsdossiers in samenwerking met ontwerpers, architecten en aannemers.
  • Je organiseert en neemt deel aan overlegmomenten en maakt duidelijke verslagen op.
  • Je ondersteunt de Dienst overheidsopdrachten bij lastenboeken, prijsonderzoeken, offertevraagstukken en gunningsverslagen.
  • Je volgt werken op als vertegenwoordiger van de bouwheer en adviseert over technische keuzes, wijzigingen, verrekeningen en opleveringen.
  • Je bewaakt budgetten, vorderingsstaten, technische fiches, proefverslagen en het dagboek der werken.
  • Je bereidt voorlopige en definitieve opleveringen voor en volgt openstaande punten tijdens de waarborgperiode op.
  • Je beschikt over een bachelor- of masterdiploma in een bouwkundige richting en/of relevante aantoonbare beroepservaring.
  • Je hebt ervaring met bouw- en renovatieprojecten, bij voorkeur binnen een publieke context.
  • Je bent vertrouwd met projectmanagement, werfopvolging, technische dossiers en budgetbewaking.
  • Je communiceert helder met opdrachtgevers, ontwerpers, aannemers en interne stakeholders.
  • Je werkt zelfstandig, nauwkeurig en oplossingsgericht.
  • Kennis van de wetgeving overheidsopdrachten is een sterke troef.
  • Referenties: je kunt minimaal 1 referentie van gelijkaardige opdracht uitgevoerd in de voorbije 3 jaar voorleggen. Aan elke referentie wordt een attest van goede uitvoering toegevoegd evenals de tewerkstellingsperiode.

jobs.title: Technisch adviseur / stabiliteitsingenieur
jobs.description:
Als Technisch adviseur of stabiliteitsingenieur bied je deskundige ondersteuning aan de medewerkers van de afdeling. Je analyseert technische problemen, formuleert haalbare oplossingen en geeft advies binnen bouwdossiers, overheidsopdrachten, procedures, geschillen of situaties met mogelijke impact op de openbare veiligheid.

Voornaamste taken

  • Je analyseert bouwtechnische problemen en werkt onderbouwde adviezen of oplossingen uit.
  • Je adviseert over technische installaties, civiele bouwkunde en bouwkundige uitvoeringsvragen.
  • Je ondersteunt medewerkers bij complexe dossiers, procedures of geschillen.
  • Je leest ontwerplastenboeken na en adviseert over de kwaliteit en uitvoerbaarheid ervan.
  • Je beoordeelt stabiliteitsproblemen in gebouwen of panden, zowel op publieke als private eigendom.
  • Je voert plaatsbezoeken uit en maakt duidelijke verslagen met analyse, beeldmateriaal en concrete maatregelen.
  • Je formuleert, indien nodig, advies in het kader van openbare veiligheid en artikel 135 van de Gemeentewet.
  • Je bent beschikbaar voor dringende oproepen bij noodsituaties, ook buiten de normale kantooruren.
  • Je beschikt over sterke technische kennis binnen civiele bouwkunde, bouwtechniek en/of technische installaties.
  • Voor stabiliteitsadviezen beschik je over het profiel van stabiliteitsingenieur.
  • Je kan je snel inwerken in technische vraagstukken en vertaalt je bevindingen naar helder, bruikbaar advies.
  • Je bent vertrouwd met bouwdossiers en bij voorkeur ook met de wetgeving overheidsopdrachten.
  • Je communiceert professioneel met interne medewerkers, de aanbestedende overheid, hulpdiensten en andere betrokken partijen.
  • Je werkt zelfstandig, nauwkeurig en oplossingsgericht.
  • Je bent bereid om, indien van toepassing, snel ter plaatse te gaan bij dringende situaties.
  • Referenties: je kunt minimaal 1 referentie van gelijkaardige opdracht uitgevoerd in de voorbije 3 jaar voorleggen. Aan elke referentie wordt een attest van goede uitvoering toegevoegd evenals de tewerkstellingsperiode.

jobs.title: Customer Service Medewerker
jobs.description:
Heb je een bachelor op zak en combineer je graag klantencontact met administratie en opvolging?

Dan is dit een mooie kans om jouw analytische en organisatorische skills in te zetten binnen een stabiele onderneming.
  • Bachelorfunctie met verantwoordelijkheid en afwisseling
  • Stabiele werkomgeving met een ervaren team
  • Sterke work-lifebalans met flexibele werkuren én extra verlofdagen

Wat ga je doen?
Als Customer Service Medewerker ben je een belangrijke schakel tussen klanten, sales, logistiek en interne diensten. Jouw verantwoordelijkheden:
  • Verwerken van binnenkomende orders voor België en Luxemburg
  • Registreren en controleren van bestellingen binnen het ERP-systeem
  • Stockniveaus controleren en opvolgen
  • Orders administratief verwerken van A tot Z
  • Levertermijnen opvolgen en communiceren naar klanten
  • Dagelijks contact onderhouden met klanten, vertegenwoordigers en magazijn
  • Klantvragen professioneel beantwoorden via mail en telefoon
  • Prioriteiten stellen en verschillende dossiers tegelijk opvolgen
  • Actief meedenken bij vragen of problemen van klanten

Waar ga je werken?
Je komt terecht in een financieel gezond en stabiel productiebedrijf met een sterke reputatie binnen zijn sector. De organisatie combineert professionaliteit met een warme, familiale sfeer.Collega's werken nauw samen, successen worden gevierd en medewerkers krijgen de ruimte om initiatief te nemen. De cultuur is no-nonsense, mensgericht en gericht op lange termijn.Hier krijg je de kans om deel uit te maken van een ervaren team waar jouw bijdrage telt en waar een gezonde werk-privébalans geen loze belofte is.
  • Ervaring binnen customer service, commerciële binnendienst of orderverwerking
  • Uitstekende kennis Nederlands én Frans
  • Goede kennis Engels
  • Administratief zeer sterk en nauwkeurig
  • Ervaring met ERP-systemen
  • Je kan zelfstandig prioriteiten stellen
  • Voltijdse beschikbaarheid

jobs.title: Afkoppelingsdeskundige private percelen
jobs.description:
Als afkoppelingsdeskundige sta je in voor de opmaak, opvolging en kwaliteitsvolle afhandeling van afkoppelingsdossiers op perceelsniveau. Je brengt bestaande afwateringssituaties in kaart, werkt technische oplossingen uit en begeleidt eigenaars of bewoners doorheen het proces van correcte scheiding van afvalwater en hemelwater. Daarbij hou je rekening met de geldende regelgeving, de interne richtlijnen, VLAREM II, Aquaflanders en/of VLARIO, en de principes van goed vakmanschap.

Voornaamste taken

jobs.title: Customer Support medewerker
jobs.description:
Als Customer Support Medewerker help je klanten verder met vragen over hun mobiliteits- en wagendossiers. Je combineert ticketafhandeling met telefonisch contact en zorgt ervoor dat elk dossier correct en professioneel wordt opgevolgd.
Omdat je te maken krijgt met complexe vragen, verschillende car policies en meerdere contactpersonen tegelijk, vraagt deze rol een goed analytisch inzicht.

Zo ziet je werkdag eruit:
  • Je werkt afwisselend met tickets en telefonie. Telefonische contacten verlopen in vaste tijdsblokken, waardoor je ook voldoende tijd hebt om je dossiers administratief netjes op te volgen. Concreet zijn er drie halve dagen in de voormiddag en twee halve dagen in de namiddag voorzien voor telefonie.
  • De ticketwerking vormt de kern van je job. Je bepaalt prioriteiten, houdt overzicht en volgt dossiers op tot ze volledig afgerond zijn.
  • Je behandelt vragen rond onder meer schadegevallen, herstellingen, leasingvoorwaarden en franchises. Dat zijn vaak geen standaardvragen: dossiers lopen over meerdere stappen, vragen afstemming met verschillende partijen en hebben een duidelijke opvolging nodig.
  • Daarnaast heb je regelmatig contact met leasemaatschappijen, hersteldiensten en makelaars, en stem je intern af met Finance en HR.
  • Je beheert meestal vier tot vijf klanten tegelijk, elk met een eigen car policy en specifieke afspraken. Dat vraagt structuur, flexibiliteit en een goed organisatorisch vermogen.
  • Niet elk gesprek is eenvoudig. Vooral bij schadegevallen of discussies kan het contact emotioneel of pittig zijn. Je blijft rustig, professioneel en duidelijk, ook wanneer klanten gefrustreerd of boos reageren. Je leert hoe je hier sterk in staat dankzij opleidingen rond assertiviteit en gesprekstechnieken.
Wie zoeken wij in deze functie als Customer support medewerker?
  • Pas afgestudeerd in een relevante Bachelor richting of eerste relevante werkervaring
  • Vlot in het aanleren van nieuwe IT-applicaties
  • Uitstekende kennis van Nederlands, zeer goede kennis van Frans en Engels
  • Zelfstandig, proactief en stressbestendig
  • Sociaal, communicatief en een echte teamplayer
  • Klantgericht en energiek

jobs.title: Grondwerker Nederland
jobs.description:
Werk je graag buiten en steek je graag de handen uit de mouwen?

Ben je een echte doener die graag in team werkt? Heb je geen schrik van fysiek werk en wil je meewerken aan uitdagende bouwprojecten? Dan is deze functie als grondwerker iets voor jou.

Jouw functie

Samen met je collega's zorg je ervoor dat bouwterreinen volledig bouwrijp worden gemaakt voor woning- en appartementsbouw. Je werkt in een vaste ploeg van gemiddeld twee tot drie personen en ondersteunt de kraanmachinist bij diverse grondwerken.

Je takenpakket bestaat onder andere uit:

  • Uitvoeren van graaf- en grondwerken.

  • Plaatsen van rioleringen en uitvoeren van funderingswerken.

  • Ondersteunen van de kraanmachinist tijdens de werkzaamheden.

  • Mee zorgen voor een veilige, kwalitatieve en nette uitvoering van de werken.

  • Samenwerken binnen een hecht en gemotiveerd team.

Je werkt voornamelijk op werven in Nederland. Daarom verblijf je van maandag tot vrijdag in een hotel dicht bij de werf. De accommodatie wordt voor jou geregeld.

Jouw profiel

  • Een diploma is niet vereist; motivatie en inzet zijn voor ons het belangrijkst.

  • Je werkt graag buiten en bent niet bang voor fysiek werk.

  • Je volgt werkinstructies nauwkeurig op.

  • Je bent stipt, betrouwbaar en werkt graag in team.

  • Je hebt oog voor veiligheid en kwaliteit.

  • Ervaring met een minigraver is een pluspunt.

  • Je bent bereid om tijdens de werkweek in Nederland te verblijven.

jobs.title: Lääkeluvallinen lähihoitaja, Hyvinvointikoti Tove - Ikifit, Tuusula
jobs.description:
Toimintamme laajentuessa tiimiimme mahtuu lisää hyviä tyyppejä

Meillä työskennellään ammattitaidolla ja suurella sydämellä. Tarjoamme työntekijöillemme avoimen ja joustavan työilmapiirin, jossa jokainen tiimin jäsen on aidosti tärkeä. Työkavereiksi haluamme hyviä tyyppejä, jotka arvostavat kollegoiden taitoja ja jakavat omaa osaamistaan muille.

Edellytämme lähihoitajan koulutusta ja kokemusta ikäihmisten hoidosta, lääkehoidon osaamista sekä hyvää suomen kielen taitoa. Lähihoitajan ammattioikeus on oltava todennettavissa Valviran rekisteristä. Tehtävään valittavan henkilön on esitettävä nähtäväksi rikosrekisterilain 6 §:n 2 momentissa tarkoitettu rikosrekisteriote.

Tehtäväsi on asukkaiden hyvän hoidon ja hyvinvoinnin edistäminen ja ylläpitäminen. Jos olet musikaalinen, liikunnallinen tai omaat käden taitoja, niin pääset hyödyntämään osaamistasi viriketoiminnassamme.

Tarjoamme lakisääteistä laajemmat työterveyspalvelut, ateriaedun sekä ePassin ylläpitämään työkykyäsi. Töitä on tarjolla vakituisesti, palkkaus on yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES G20C mukainen. Käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuajalla ja haku sulkeutuu, kun valinnat on tehty.

Hyvinvointikoti Tove on viihtyisä ja lämminhenkinen hoivakoti, jossa on 46 ympärivuorokautisen
palveluasumisen paikkaa ikäihmisille. Marraskuun alusta asukaspaikkamme kasvaa 23:lla. Tove tarjoaa asukkailleen yksilöllistä ja ihmisläheistä hoivaa ja huolenpitoa rauhallisessa, viihtyisässä ja kodikkaassa ympäristössä.

Olemme savuton työpaikka. Myös hyvinvointikeskusten ja -kotien pihapiirit kuuluvat savuttomaan alueeseen.

Ikifit on täysin kotimainen, ikäihmisten palvelujen ammattilainen. Päätehtävämme on tuottaa korkealaatuista, kokonaisvaltaista ja yksilöllistä palvelua asiakkaillemme. Monipuoliset palvelumme parantavat arkea ja elämänlaatua.

jobs.description:
YRITTÄJÄPARISKUNTAA PYÖRITTÄMÄÄN AMMATILLISTA PERHEKOTIA

Mahdollisuus ryhtyä itse yrittäjiksi – valmis kokonaisuus Pohjoisessa Keski-Suomessa

Etsimme **yrittäjähenkistä pariskuntaa**, joka haluaa **ryhtyä itse yrittäjiksi ja ottaa vastuulleen ammatillisen perhekodin pyörittämisen** Pohjoisessa Keski-Suomessa.

Kyseessä ei siis ole työsuhteinen tehtävä, vaan mahdollisuus lähteä **yrittäjäpariskuntana toteuttamaan ja kehittämään omaa ammatillista perhekotitoimintaa**.

VALMIS KOKONAISUUS

Pariskunnalle on tarjolla **uudehko, suuri ja viihtyisä kiinteistö**, jossa on aiemmin toiminut vastaavaa toimintaa.

Pariskunta tulee **asumaan kiinteistöön**, ja tilat vuokrataan/myydään yrittäjäpariskunnalle.

Lisäksi on mahdollista vuokrata **valmiit kalusteet sekä toiminnassa tarvittavat työvälineet ja tarvikkeet**, joten kaikkea ei tarvitse hankkia alusta lähtien.

MITÄ EDELLYTÄMME?

Toisen yrittäjistä tulee täyttää ammatillisen perhekodin **vastuuhenkilölle asetettavat vaatimukset**. Hänellä tulee olla **soveltuva AMK-tutkinto sekä riittävä kokemus lastensuojelutyöstä**, jotta hän voi toimia toiminnan vastuuhenkilönä. Toiselle vanhemmalle riittää sosiaali,-ja terveysalan perustutkinto.

Molemmilta yrittäjiltä edellytetään aitoa kiinnostusta lastensuojelutyöhön, sitoutumista toimintaan sekä halua rakentaa turvallista ja kodinomaista arkea perhekodin lapsille ja nuorille.

Aiempi yrittäjäkokemus on eduksi, mutta tärkeintä on **halu ryhtyä yrittäjäksi ja sitoutua yhteiseen toimintaan**.

MAHDOLLISUUS OMAAN YRITTÄJYYTEEN

Tämä on hyvä mahdollisuus pariskunnalle, joka haaveilee **omasta ammatillisesta perhekodista ja yrittäjyydestä**, mutta haluaa aloittaa valmiissa ympäristössä.

Tarjolla on valmis kiinteistö, asumismahdollisuus sekä mahdollisuus kalusteiden ja toiminnassa tarvittavien välineiden vuokraamiseen.

jobs.title: PhD Candidate in Empirical Software Engineering
jobs.description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position

As agile development scales to larger, more complex organizations, software engineering is being transformed by a set of intertwined changes. Continuous software engineering is converging development and operations to enable frequent releases, while AI is touching every stage of the software lifecycle, bringing agents that work alongside developers. Together, these changes are reshaping team composition and dynamics, as well as enabling shorter feedback loops, while introducing new roles and requiring new skillsets. 

The purpose of empirical software engineering research is to study these shifts as they unfold, examining real-world practice to generate knowledge that can guide how teams and organisations build quality software. As a PhD Candidate, you will carry out this work within the Software Engineering group at the Department of Computer Science, one of Norway's leading software engineering environments. The group works closely with industry and publishes at leading international venues.

Your immediate leader will be the head of unit.


Duties of the position
  • Develop research-based knowledge on continuous software development, grounded in empirical studies. 
  • Carry out empirical studies in Norwegian software companies, with the aim of publishing in recognised journals and conferences.
  • Responsible for conducting your own studies and for taking part in project teams together with master's students.
  • Contribute to teaching activities, including lab sessions and supervision
  • Other career-promoting work agreed with the department, such as work on smaller related research projects or collaboration with organisations in the public and private sectors. Applicants who hold a position outside the university may, by agreement, retain part of that position as career-promoting work.

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.


Required selection criteria
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty's Doctoral Programme, see Section 6-1 of the PhD regulations for more information.
  • You must have a relevant Master’s degree in computer science or equivalent. Your degree must include a major independent project (minimum 30 ECTS) equivalent to a master’s thesis.
  • You must have a strong and relevant academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker academic background, you may be considered if you can document that you are exceptionally suited for a PhD education, for example through relevant work experience and/or peer-reviewed academic works. 
  • You must master English as a professional language, both written and orally.
  • You must attach a project outline (1500 words) to your application. It should set out your theoretical and methodological approach to the research topic, together with proposed research questions.
     

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.


Preferred selection criteria

Academically relevant background within software engineering or information systems

  • Experience from the software industry
  • Experience with empirical studies and scientific publishing
  • Good oral and written presentation skills in Norwegian or another Scandinavian language 

Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to: 

  • A good team player
  • A good communicator
  • Eager to learn
  • Results-oriented
  • Work independently
     

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.


We offer

 

  • An exciting job with an important mission in society
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Working capital that can be used to implement the project
  • Mentor programme as a new employee at NTNU
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.


Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality.


Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,-per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 4 years for the doctoral work in addition to 1 year of career promotion work. (A minimum of three work years of the total term period must be dedicated to doctoral work.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Computer Science within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme throughout the period of employment.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to be in conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.


About the application

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in Norwegian/a Scandinavian language or English.

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include: 

  • Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degrees
  • CV 
  • Copy of Master's thesis. If you have recently submitted your Master's thesis, you can attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed Master's degree must be presented before taking up the position.
  • Project outline containing proposals for an overall description of research questions, theoretical perspectives, methodological design for the project and progress plan (maximum 1500 words/4 pages) 
  • Short letter of motivation (400 words/1 page)
  • Possibly publications etc. other relevant research work
  • Possibly certificates
  • Names and contact information of three relevant referees
     

If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.

Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.

NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).


General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Joakim Klemets (Associate Professor), phone +47 413 51 921, email: joakim.klemets@ntnu.no. 

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact HR at hr@idi.ntnu.no.

Application deadline: 08.10..2026

For practical information about working at NTNU, please visit this webpage. 

The city of Trondheim is a modern European city with a rich cultural scene. Trondheim is the tech capital of Norway with a population of 200,000. The Norwegian welfare state, including healthcare, schools, kindergartens and overall equality, is probably the best of its kind in the world. Professional subsidized day-care for children is easily available. Furthermore, Trondheim offers great opportunities for education (including international schools) and possibilities to enjoy nature, culture and family life and has low crime rates and clean air quality. 


Om arbeidsgiveren:

NTNU - knowledge for a better world

The Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU) creates knowledge for a better world and solutions that can change everyday life.

Department of Computer Science 

We are the leading academic IT environment in Norway, and offer a wide range of theoretical and applied IT programmes of study at all levels. Our subject areas include hardware, algorithms, visual computing, AI, databases, software engineering, information systems, learning technology, HCI, CSCW, IT operations and applied data processing. The Department has groups in both Trondheim and Gjøvik. The Department of Computer Science is one of seven departments in the Faculty of Information Technology and Electrical Engineering .

jobs.title: Vil du lære hvordan et vannkraftverk faktisk fungerer? Vi søker Energioperatørlærling!
jobs.description:
Lærling i energioperatørfaget - bli med og hold vannkraftverkene i gang!

Vil du lære et fag der du får jobbe med både elektro, mekanikk, automasjon og noen av de viktigste energianleggene vi har?
TrønderEnergi Kraft AS søker lærling i energioperatørfaget med oppstart høsten 2027.


Vi eier og opererer 17 vannkraftverk i Midt-Norge, som til sammen produserer rundt 2,6 TWh fornybar energi hvert år. Kraftverkene våre skal ikke bare driftes – de skal vedlikeholdes, forbedres og utvikles for å være en viktig del av kraftsystemet også i fremtiden.

Som lærling hos oss blir du en del av den daglige driften og vedlikeholdet av vannkraftanleggene våre. Du får jobbe sammen med erfarne fagfolk innen elektro og mekanikk og vi bidrar til at du får opplæringen og erfaringen du trenger for å nå kompetansemålene i læreplanen og være godt forberedt til fagprøven.

I TrønderEnergi sier vi at vi «lever av tillit». For oss er en felles tillitsbasert kultur avgjørende for at vi lykkes.
Vår tillitskultur bygger på to enkle verdier: Modig og pålitelig.
Modig fordi vi liker utfordringer, er ambisiøse på egne ​og våre eieres vegne og vi er åpne for nye muligheter og ideer.
Vi vet at vi kontinuerlig må forbedre og utvikle oss.​
Pålitelig fordi vi holder det vi lover, er forutsigbare, ​effektive og solide.

TrønderEnergi Kraft har vannkraftanlegg i flere deler av Trøndelag. Vår nye lærling vil ha hovedtyngden av arbeidstiden sin hos oss tilknyttet vårt oppmøtested på Berkåk, men vi søker deg som også gjerne vil jobbe ved våre anlegg på Fosen. Arbeidsgiver kan være behjelpelig med formidling av bolig.

 


Dette vil du få jobbe med:

Arbeidshverdagen i et kraftverk er variert. En dag kan du arbeide med elektriske anlegg og feilsøking, neste dag med mekanisk vedlikehold eller arbeid ute på et reguleringsanlegg.

Du vil blant annet få delta i:

  • Drift, kontroll og vedlikehold av vannkraftverk
  • Reparasjoner og monteringsarbeid
  • Vedlikehold på mekanisk utstyr
  • Arbeid på elektrotekniske anlegg fra lavspenning og opp til 132kV
  • Automasjons-, kontroll- og kommunikasjonsanlegg
  • Arbeid på dammer, luker og andre reguleringsanlegg
  • Planlagt vedlikehold og større revisjons- og rehabiliteringsarbeider. 

Noe av arbeidet foregår inne i kraftstasjoner og fjellanlegg, mens andre oppgaver foregår utendørs – året rundt og i all slags vær. Med lange avstander mellom anleggene må noe reisevirksomhet derfor påregnes.

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi forventer ikke at du kan faget når du begynner – det er derfor du skal være lærling.

Men vi ser etter deg som:

  • Har gjennomført VG2 Elenergi
  • Har interesse for elektro, mekanikk, teknologi og vannkraft
  • Er nysgjerrig og har lyst til å lære
  • Møter opp, tar ansvar og følger opp oppgavene du får
  • Samarbeider godt med andre
  • Arbeider strukturert og har fokus på helse, miljø og sikkerhet
  • Bidrar til et godt arbeidsmiljø
  • Er komfortabel med å arbeide både i fjellanlegg og utendørs
  • Har førerkort klasse B, eller planlegger å ta dette etter fylte 18 år

Vi legger stor vekt på holdninger, motivasjon og lærevillighet.

Som lærling hos oss får du:

Vi ønsker ikke at du bare skal «være med». Du skal gradvis lære faget, få ansvar og bli trygg på å løse reelle arbeidsoppgaver.

Hos oss får du:

  • Tett oppfølging fra dyktige og erfarne fagfolk
  • Opplæring i tråd med læreplanen for energioperatørfaget
  • Praktisk erfaring fra forskjellige typer vannkraftanlegg
  • Et tverrfaglig miljø med kompetanse innen elektro, mekanikk og automasjon
  • Varierte arbeidsdager og mulighet til å utvikle deg både faglig og personlig
  • Erfaring fra en bransje som blir stadig viktigere i det norske energisystemet
  • En arbeidshverdag preget av tillit, samarbeid og faglig stolthet
  • Kunnskapsrike kollegaer og et godt arbeidsmiljø
  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser

Vi er opptatt av at våre ansatte skal trives – både faglig og sosialt.
PS: Du kan se oss på "Spenningens helter" på Viaplay.

Hvorfor TrønderEnergi?
Vi har et sterkt og kompetent fagmiljø innen vannkraft og her får du:
Mulighet til å bidra til å utvikle og bygge fremtidens vannkraftverk.

Sikkerhet kommer først
Vannkraftverk er spennende arbeidsplasser, men det er også anlegg der vi arbeider med store energier, høyspenning, roterende maskiner, vann og tungt mekanisk utstyr.
Derfor forventer vi at du tar sikkerhet på alvor – både din egen og sikkerheten til dem du jobber sammen med.
Det viktigste er ikke å være raskest. Det viktigste er å gjøre jobben riktig og sikkert.

Kanskje dette er starten på karrieren din?
En læreplass skal først og fremst gjøre deg til en dyktig fagarbeider. Samtidig ønsker vi at læretiden skal gi deg et godt bilde av hvilke muligheter som finnes videre innen vannkraft og energibransjen.
Hos oss får du arbeide sammen med folk som har mange års erfaring, samtidig som du blir kjent med moderne teknologi og hvordan vannkraftverk utvikles for fremtiden.

Høres dette ut som noe for deg?
Da vil vi gjerne høre fra deg.
Fortell oss gjerne litt om hvorfor du ønsker å bli energioperatør og hvorfor vannkraft virker spennende for deg.
Legg ved CV og vitnemål/karakterutskrift.

Oppstart: august/september 2027

I tråd med våre prosedyrer vil vi gjennomføre bakgrunnssjekk i forbindelse med ansettelsen.

Framtida er fornybar. Oppdraget vårt handler om å dekke energibehovet og jobbe for en best mulig energiforvaltning til samfunnets beste. Våre selskaper og våre anlegg må derfor hensynta naturen og omgivelsene på best mulig måte. Uansett er vår viktigste oppgave å skape trygge arbeidsplasser og økonomiske verdier til våre eiere og lokalsamfunn.
Gjennom det gir vi kraft til å forme en god framtid.

Markant verdiskaper:I 75 år har vi gått på jobb for å skape verdi til samfunnets beste. For oss handler verdiskapning om å bygge og drifte lønnsom virksomhet innen fornybar energi. Fordi - gjennom det, kan vi skape verdier for eiere og samfunn.

Det betyr mye for oss å bidra til en bærekraftig samfunnsutvikling.
Det er det det hele handler om.

jobs.title: Sales Account Executive
jobs.description:
Sterling Technology, a subsidiary of TransPerfect, is the leading provider of premium virtual data room (VDR) solutions for the secure sharing of content, business process automation, and collaboration for the M&A, corporate development, real estate, capital markets, private capital, banking, and legal communities. Sterling has been supporting the M&A and capital markets for over 30 years, initially with financial printing services. Since opening our first VDR in 2010, we have helped customers from over 187 countries and 90 industries complete thousands of deals. With offices in seven major financial centres, Sterling is trusted by its users to deliver exceptional levels of service on their most critical transactions.

Summary:

The main focus of the role is to enhance clients' relationships and develop new accounts within different industries.

Your responsibilities and tasks will include:

  • Create effective approaches to drive new revenue and close new business

  • Identify, qualify, develop, and close sales opportunities

  • Develop an effective understanding of the capabilities, benefits, and competitive advantages of Sterling’s services

  • Identify prospective leads; develop new client relationships via cold calling, internet research, networking events, and direct marketing

  • Promote Sterling by educating clients on the company’s various services

  • Present Sterling via one-on-one, group, online and in-person meetings

  • Provide customer support and manage client expectations

  • Quote, manage, and bill projects daily, coordinating with clients and production teams to ensure these run smoothly and profitably

  • Communicate professionally at all levels of seniority


Essential skills and experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree or its equivalent

  • Excellent written and verbal proficiency in English

  • Minimum of 1- 3 years of experience in a sales or client-facing role

  • Ability to build and maintain long-term client relationships

  • Strong presentation skills (both in-person and online)

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities

  • Highly organised with strong attention to detail

  • Able to prioritise, manage tasks, and work effectively in a team

  • Eager to learn, embrace challenges, and driven to succeed

 

Preferred experience:

  • Experience and/or interest in Financial, Professional, Legal or Technology services

  • Experience and/or interest in the M&A space

jobs.title: Senior LNG & Natural Gas Analyst (Europe focus)
jobs.description:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors.
 
Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.
 

As a Senior LNG & Natural Gas Analyst, you will play a key role in driving Kpler’s European natural gas and global LNG market research offering. Operating at the intersection of quantitative modeling, market analysis, and client engagement, you will build and maintain forecasting models that translate complex energy flows into clear, actionable intelligence. Working as part of the LNG & Natural Gas Insight team, you will regularly publish market-defining reports and engage directly with clients, industry leaders, and media to present Kpler’s house views.


Key Responsibilities
  • Build and refine forecasting models: Develop, maintain, and enhance quantitative supply and demand models capturing European natural gas and LNG market dynamics with high predictive accuracy.
  • Analyse European energy flows: Monitor complex market datasets daily to identify emerging trade trends, structural shifts, and fundamental drivers across European gas infrastructure.
  • Generate actionable market insights: Produce high-impact research articles, reports, and expert commentary that link European natural gas developments to global LNG market implications.
  • Engage clients and present market views: Deliver Kpler's market insights directly to clients, prospective customers, and media, presenting key findings at industry events and conferences.
  • Automate data pipelines: Leverage programming tools to automate data collection, refine model inputs, and streamline analytical workflows.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally: Partner with adjacent research desks (Power, Refineries, LPG) and market data teams to expand Kpler's overall gas coverage.

    • Experience & Background
  • 5+ years of experience in natural gas or LNG market analysis, with at least 3 years specifically covering European gas markets.
  • Strong technical proficiency in dataset analysis using advanced Excel, alongside hands-on coding experience in SQL, Python, or VBA for model development and automation.
  • Proven track record of building, maintaining, and justifying quantitative market models and fundamental forecasts.
  • Excellent written communication and presentation skills, with demonstrated experience delivering data-backed views to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Bachelor's degree in Econometrics, Data Science, Economics, or a related quantitative discipline.
    •  
    Nice-to-haves:
  • Experience using data visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau to build interactive market dashboards.
  • Demonstrated interest or experience in applying AI tools to automate data collection, visualization, and analytical tasks.

jobs.title: Vil du være med og styre veien fra strategi til resultater?
jobs.description:
Forsvarsbygg har en sentral rolle i å opprettholde Norges frihet og suverenitet. Vårt oppdrag er å sørge for at alt av eiendom, bygg og anlegg som Forsvaret bruker fungerer slik det skal og er klart til bruk. Slik støtter vi Forsvarets operasjoner slik at de kan øve og operere i fred, krise, og krig.
Avdeling prosjekt og utvikling har ansvaret for fremskaffelser av eiendom, bygg og anlegg i forsvarssektoren. Her blir investeringsprosessen ledet gjennom alle faser, fra tidligfase til overlevering av ferdige bygg og anlegg. Prosjektene er geografisk fordelt over hele landet og varierer i størrelse og omfang. Prosjektporteføljen spenner bredt fra bolig- og kontorbygg til mer komplekse prosjekter som større utdanningsfasiliteter, verksted- og vedlikeholdsfasiliteter, drivstoffanlegg, veier, kaier, infrastruktur, skyte- og øvingsfelt, operative forsvarsanlegg og mye mer. Prosjektene er sentrale for å realisere forsvarsløftet og styrke Norges forsvarsevne i tråd med nasjonale prioriteringer. 

Stillingen skal styrke virksomhetsstyringen i investeringsvirksomheten gjennom å forvalte og videreutvikle fremskaffelsesprosessen for fred, krise og krig. Stillingen som rådgiver virksomhetsstyring skal bidra til at avdelingen når sine mål gjennom å legge til rette for god styring av avdelingen basert på overordnet målbilde og strategi. Du skal bidra til å sikre et helhetlig perspektiv på tvers av prosesser i vår avdeling i Forsvarsbygg, samt kontinuerlig forbedring og videreutvikling av prosedyrer, prosesser, metoder og systemer innenfor fagområdet for å understøtte god virksomhetsstyring. I stillingen vil du være en viktig bidragsyter og pådriver i utviklingsarbeid, utredningsarbeid og saksbehandling, samt ha en tett kontakt mot øvrige avdelinger og fagmiljøer i hele Forsvarsbygg. Vi søker deg som er opptatt av gode prosesser, helhet og den røde tråden gjennom virksomheten. 

Gjennom digitalisering styrker vi fremtidens forsvarsevne. Hos oss får du påvirke denne utviklingen innenfor ditt fagområde. 

Les mer om Forsvarsbygg på forsvarsbygg.no/jobb


Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Landsdekkende fag- og prosessansvar innenfor virksomhetsstyring og rapportering for investeringsvirksomheten 
  • Veilede og støtte avdelingen i virksomhetsstyring og utføre operativ og strategisk saksbehandling relatert til virksomhetsstyringen, og utarbeidelse av beslutningsgrunnlag 
  • Planlegge og tilrettelegge for gjennomføring av virksomhetsstrategi, planer, oppdragsskriv, utarbeidelse og oppfølging av handlingsplaner for investeringsvirksomheten, utvikling av måleparametre/KPI-er mv.
  • Forvalte og videreutvikle Forsvarsbyggs fremskaffelsesprosess, og være premissgiver for å sikre etterlevelse og kontinuerlig forbedring.  
  • Bidra til videreutvikling av avdelingens handlemåte og planverk for krise og krig. 
  • Lede eller bidra i tverrfaglige utviklingsprosjekter og forbedringsinitiativ i Forsvarsbygg. 
  • Virksomhetsrapportering, herunder koordinere og sammenstille rapportering fra avdelingens seksjoner, samt bidra til helhetlig porteføljeoversikt og beslutningsstøtte for ledelsen. 
Hvem ser vi etter?

Du er en strukturert og analytisk person med evner å se sammenhenger. Vi ser etter deg som tar initiativ, evner å få med deg andre og har god gjennomføringsevne. Du trives i team og bidrar til et positivt samarbeidsklima gjennom din evne til å bygge gode relasjoner. Samtidig kommuniserer du klart og presist, noe som skaper en effektiv og inkluderende dialog med kolleger og samarbeidspartnere.

Kvalifikasjoner
  • Utdanning på masternivå eller tilsvarende innen relevante fagområder.   
  • Minimum 5 års erfaring fra tilsvarende arbeidsoppgaver 
  • Erfaring med prosessledelse, endrings- og utviklingsarbeid
  • Du må kunne sikkerhetsklareres til nivå Hemmelig/NATO Secret. Les mer om sikkerhetsklarering på NSM.no. 

Ønskelige krav;

  • Erfaring fra forsvarssektoren og eller erfaring med beredskapsarbeid
  • Erfaring fra eiendom, bygg og anlegg 
Hvorfor jobbe hos oss?

I Forsvarsbygg vil du få en spennende og variert arbeidshverdag med et meningsfullt samfunnsoppdrag hvor du vil bidra til å bygge forsvarsevne hver dag. Vi satser på medarbeiderne våre, vi tilbyr kursing, etter- og videreutdanning og har etablert vår egen prosjektlederutdanning. Vi har en familievennlig og fleksibel personalpolitikk med gode arbeidstidsordninger. Du vil også få tilgang til treningsrom og bedriftsidrettslag med varierte aktiviteter. Som ansatt hos oss får du medlemskap i Statens pensjonskasse som er en av landets beste pensjonsordninger med mulighet for boliglån og gode forsikringsordninger. Forsvarsbygg ønsker at arbeidsstyrken avspeiler mangfoldet i samfunnet. Vi oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke, uavhengig av kjønn, kulturell bakgrunn, hull i CV-en eller funksjonsevne.

Andre opplysninger

  • Vi ber ikke om søknadsbrev. For oss er det mer relevant med en beskrivende CV som viser hva du har av erfaring og kompetanse. Du vil også bli bedt om å svare på et spørsmål i søknadsskjemaet, der du kan utdype relevant erfaring for stillingen.
  • Stillingen lønnes som seniorrådgiver (stillingskode 1364) fra kr. 950 000,- til kr. 1 050 000,-.
  • Vi ber om at du laster opp vitnemål og karakterutskrifter i søknaden din
  • Vi oppfordrer kvinner til å søke
  • Offentlig søkerliste utarbeides etter søknadsfristens utløp. Dersom du ønsker å reservere deg fra oppføring på offentlig søkerliste må dette begrunnes. Du vil bli varslet om reservasjon ikke tas til følge
KontaktinformasjonIvan Fjeldheim-Pettersen, Stabssjef, 97524802
ArbeidsstedGrev Wedels Plass 5
0151 Oslo
Nøkkelinformasjon:Arbeidsgiver: Forsvarsbygg

Referansenr.: 5176694639
Stillingsprosent: 100%
Fast
Søknadsfrist: 05.10.2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Forsvarsbygg er en etat underlagt Forsvarsdepartementet. Vi bygger, forvalter, drifter og vedlikeholder bygg og anlegg som er avgjørende for Norges sikkerhet. Forsvarsbygg er en beredskapsetat, og vi skal levere på vårt oppdrag for Forsvaret i fred, krise og krig. 

Vi forvalter cirka 13 000 bygg og anlegg, og gjennomfører rundt 700 investeringsprosjekter til enhver tid. Det gjør oss til Norges største offentlige eiendomsaktør. Ansvaret vårt spenner fra historiske festninger åpne for allmennheten til landets mest komplekse og samfunnskritiske forsvarsanlegg.

Hos oss vil du kunne bidra med din kompetanse til å styrke den norske forsvarsevnen, og gjøre oss mer robust, bærekraftig og framtidsrettet.

Vi mener at inkludering og mangfold er en styrke. Vi ønsker medarbeidere med ulike kompetanser, fagkombinasjoner, livserfaring og perspektiver for å bidra til enda bedre oppgaveløsning.

jobs.description:

Des déplacements entre différents chantiers peuvent être nécessaires
Permis B et véhicule personnel non obligatoires

270 à 290 NOK bruts/heure, soit environ 25,13 € à 26,99 € bruts/heure
Rémunération déterminée selon l'expérience, les compétences et les conditions de la mission
Salaire versé mensuellement, au plus tard le 10
Salaire contractuel versé en NOK ; équivalent en euros communiqué à titre indicatif et susceptible de varier selon le taux de change

Hébergement :

Chambre individuelle selon disponibilité : 7 000 NOK/mois (environ 651,47 €), électricité et Internet compris ; coût déduit du salaire
Solution alternative via Prohousing à partir de 6 000 NOK/mois (environ 558,40 €) ; coût définitif selon le logement et les disponibilités

Le recrutement est fondé exclusivement sur des critères objectifs et professionnels en lien direct avec les exigences du poste, notamment l'expérience, les compétences techniques, les références professionnelles, le niveau d'anglais requis et la disponibilité. Les candidatures sont examinées dans le respect du principe d'égalité de traitement et sans discrimination fondée sur un critère prohibé par la législation applicable.
