jobs.title: Data Engineer: Build the data foundation for the future of care
jobs.description:
Technology is changing what good care can look like.

Used well, technology can help care professionals identify risks earlier, respond faster and provide care that is better adapted to each individual. It can improve collaboration between colleagues, create greater continuity in everyday work and give care teams more time to focus on the people who need them.

Sensio is a leading European care technology company. Through our software platform Sensio 365, our nurse call solution, and our ‘hero-product’ the RoomMate AI multisensor, we help care providers deliver safer, more personalized and more efficient care. RoomMate is developed and manufactured in Norway, and it is probably the most widely deployed sensor of its kind across elderly care anywhere in the world.

With the backing of Nordic Capital, a leading European healthcare and healthtech investor, we are investing actively in product development and expanding the impact of our technology across international markets.

We’re looking for a data engineer

This role sits in our data platform team and will work across our product, engineering and AI teams. Your responsibility will be to turn data from sensors, applications, and external systems into structured, reliable datasets that can be used across Sensio’s products.

In Sensio 365, we have a large and growing range of real-time signals. For example, our RoomMate sensor can register activity patterns, movement, presence, and noise in a resident’s room. Additionally, other Sensio devices, third party devices, and system integrations all contribute alarm and event data.

When all this data is processed, structured and combined over time, they can provide much more value for our customers than they do as individual datapoints. This is what enables products such as Sensio Insight to identify patterns, present meaningful information and help care providers better understand resident activity and what enable continuous improvement of the functionality and accuracy of our AI-sensor Roommate.

As a data engineer, you will build the processors, datasets and platform services that make this possible. You may receive data through an API, a Kafka message or an existing dataset, and your job will be to determine how it should be interpreted, transformed and stored so that it becomes reliable and useful downstream.

At Sensio, you shouldn’t expect to always receive your tasks as fully defined technical specifications. You will work in collaboration with product managers, machine learning engineers and other developers to understand the problem, define the right data structure and decide which processing is required.

This is a role for someone who is more interested in understanding the problem than reaching for a predetermined solution. You will help build a platform that supports an increasing number of sensors, data formats and use cases as our ecosystem continues to grow.

We are looking for someone who understands that good data engineering is what allows teams to build better models, better products and better decisions.

This role will be placed at Sensio’s office in Oslo. You will report to the Dev Lead for Data Platform.

Your day-to-day

You will contribute to the continued development of Sensio’s data platform and the data services that support products such as RoomMate, Sensio Insight and Sensio 365 more broadly. Your daily work will include:

  • Building data pipelines, processors and services in Python, C# and .NET

  • Receiving data from APIs, Kafka and existing datasets

  • Turning sensor, alarm and activity data into reliable, structured datasets

  • Working with PostgreSQL and large data volumes

  • Collaborating closely with product managers, ML engineers and developers to define the right solutions

  • Improving platform reliability, scalability and secure data handling

This is what we’re looking for

We are looking for a skilled Data Engineer with strong technical judgement, high standards for data reliability and an understanding of how data supports modern product and ML development. If you’re the right candidate for the job, you probably have:

  • Strong experience with data engineering, backend development or data-heavy platform services

  • Strong C# and .NET skills

  • Experience with PostgreSQL and working with large data volumes

  • Strong understanding of data modelling, data structures and dataset design

  • Experience with data integrations, APIs, Kafka or other event-driven architectures

  • Familiarity with common data and machine learning tools such as Spark, MLflow and PyTorch

Your job is to make sure the data is reliable, structured, accessible, traceable and handled responsibly, so that the teams building models and products can move faster and make better decisions.

Bonus points if you have experience with one or more of the following:

  • FastAPI, dbt, Alembic or similar tools for building and maintaining data services

  • Multi-modal data, sensor data, image data, telemetry or data from edge devices

  • Kubernetes or cloud-based platform environments

  • Sensor data, IoT or real-time systems

  • Products where reliability, privacy, safety or regulatory considerations matter

What Sensio can offer

At Sensio, you will work on technology with a clear purpose and a genuine user need. RoomMate is developed for real care environments, where reliability, precision and thoughtful engineering directly affect both the people receiving care and the professionals supporting them.

As a Data Engineer at Sensio, your work will help create the foundation for smarter and more reliable care technology. Better data infrastructure can mean better models, better product decisions, better testing and more confidence in the technology used by care teams every day.

This is the kind of data engineering where good infrastructure becomes more than good infrastructure. It becomes safety, dignity and more time for care.

What we can offer:

  • A central role in building and scaling Sensio’s data platform and data services

  • The opportunity to work with multi-modal data, sensors, ML workflows and real-world products

  • The opportunity to build technology that supports healthcare professionals, residents, patients and next-of-kin

  • A Norwegian product and technology environment with an established European presence

  • A strong, cross-functional team working across hardware, software, product and design

  • Room to take ownership, influence technical direction and grow professionally

This is a role for someone who wants the complexity of data engineering, the responsibility of building trusted infrastructure and the meaning of working on technology that matters in everyday life.

If you want to build the data foundation behind smarter, safer and more useful care technology, we would like to hear from you.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

At Sensio, we’re on a mission to accelerate the digital transformation of care. With roots in the Nordic start-up scene, we’ve grown into a fast-scaling caretech company backed by Nordic Capital, with more than 230 colleagues across Norway, Sweden, Denmark, the UK – and now expanding into Germany. Our technology is already installed in thousands of care homes and hospitals, helping staff prevent falls, save lives, and free up time for what really matters: people. We build everything from advanced safety sensors and cloud platforms to apps and data tools – all developed in-house by our 80+ product and tech specialists. What makes Sensio unique? - Impact with scale – our solutions improve everyday life for tens of thousands of residents and caregivers, and we’re just getting started. - A true growth journey – from Nordic frontrunner to European scale-up, we’re building the leading caretech platform of tomorrow. - Innovation at heart – our R&D teams shape the future of care technology with cutting-edge hardware, AI, and software. - People-first culture – we believe the best products come from teams that feel at home, have freedom to experiment, and share knowledge across borders. If you want to be part of a meaningful growth story – where tech meets one of society’s biggest challenges – join us. Let’s create more time for care.

jobs.title: Are you an engineer with a passion for coffee?
jobs.description:
Are you an engineer with a passion for coffee? Help us design and build the future of roasting technology.

ROEST is revolutionizing the coffee industry with advanced roasting technology designed and built in Norway. Our team of passionate coffee experts, engineers, and designers work together to create innovative solutions that empower roasters worldwide. We're driven by a commitment to quality, consistency, and sustainability, helping coffee professionals achieve perfect roasts every time. Join us on our mission to make (even) better coffee!

The Opportunity

Are you a visionary Senior Product Development Engineer eager to lead transformative projects and shape the future of coffee technology? At ROEST we are redefining the art and science of roasting with advanced Norwegian-engineered technology. We offer an opportunity to lead significant product initiatives and thrive within a collaborative, innovative culture that values your expertise.

Your Impact at ROEST

As a Product Development Engineer at ROEST, you won't just be designing parts; you'll be shaping the experience for thousands of coffee professionals worldwide. You will be a vital part of a dedicated team where your ideas have a direct and immediate impact on the final product. We're looking for someone who is hands-on, creative, and ready to tackle complex challenges in a fast-paced, innovative environment.

What You'll Be Doing

This is a hands-on role where you'll be involved in every stage of development. Here's what you can expect to be working on:

  • Design, develop, and test a game-changing new electrical coffee roaster. Project start Q3 2026.

  • Create detailed 3D models and 2D drawings using Solidworks (or other tools) for prototyping and manufacturing.

  • Collaborate directly with the production team to implement and refine DFM/A principles.

  • Build and validate physical prototypes to rigorously test new concepts and technologies.

  • Participate in the full product lifecycle, from initial ideation and sketching to mass production and support.

Key Responsibilities

  • Leading the design, development, and validation of new hardware products.

  • Optimizing existing product lines for performance, cost, and reliability.

  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams (production, customer support, R&D).

  • Researching and integrating new technologies and engineering solutions.

Must-Have Skills & Experience

  • Master's degree in product development or 7+ years of industrial experience

  • Proven experience leading products from concept to launch.

  • Demonstrated ability to solve complex engineering problems.

  • Proven experience in product development, from concept to production.

  • High proficiency in 3D CAD software

  • Strong understanding of DFM/A (Design for Manufacturing/Assembly) principles.

  • Experience applying project management methodologies in a development context.

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field.

Nice-to-Have Skills & Experience

  • Experience with Computational fluid dynamics to solve complex tasks.

  • Experience with thermal management simulation and design.

  • Prior experience in the coffee industry or with food processing equipment.

  • Leadership experience or mentorship of junior engineers.

  • Understanding of electrical engineering principles for product integration.

  • A genuine passion for coffee and the technology that perfects it.

  • Highly motivated and comfortable working both independently and in a team.

  • A collaborative spirit, eager to work with cross-functional teams.

  • An innovative mindset, always curious and looking for better solutions.

This is a full-time, hybrid role based in Oslo, Norway.

jobs.title: ML Engineer – Computer Vision: Build smarter, safer care technology
jobs.description:
Technology is changing what good care can look like.

Used well, technology can help care professionals identify risks earlier, respond faster and provide care that is better adapted to each individual. It can improve collaboration between colleagues, create greater continuity in everyday work and give care teams more time to focus on the people who need them.

Sensio is a leading European care technology company. Through our software platform Sensio 365, our nurse call solution, and our ‘hero-product’ the RoomMate AI multisensor, we help care providers deliver safer, more personalized and more efficient care. RoomMate is developed and manufactured in Norway, and it is probably the most widely deployed sensor of its kind across elderly care anywhere in the world.

With the backing of Nordic Capital, a leading European healthcare and healthtech investor, we are investing actively in product development and expanding the impact of our technology across international markets.

We’re looking for a Machine Learning Engineer

This role sits at the core of Sensio’s sensor-driven care technology, and is placed within our new AI team. You will work with machine learning models that run on embedded devices, close to the hardware, in products that need to perform reliably in real care environments.

Sensio’s technology uses advanced sensors, algorithms and embedded systems to support digital supervision and detect potentially dangerous situations.

Sensio’s technology generates a growing range of real-time signals, such as falls, noise and activity in a resident’s room. Other products and integrations contribute alarm data, events data and data from care environments both inside and outside of Sensio’s own ecosystem.

As a Machine Learning Engineer, you will work mainly on training and evaluating Computer vision models. The models will make the best possible use of the hardware available, balancing performance, precision, robustness, memory, power consumption and deployment constraints.

We are looking for someone who understands the full journey from data and training to validation, deployment, hardware performance and continuous improvement.

You will join a strong product and engineering environment where hardware, software, data and machine learning work closely together. Your work can directly affect the safety of residents, the working day of healthcare professionals and the future of care technology.

Your day-to-day

You will be an instrumental part of the team developing, improving and deploying machine learning models for Sensio’s sensor-driven care technology. Your daily work will include:

  • Training, validating and improving computer vision models

  • Optimizing models for embedded devices and resource-constrained hardware, including performance, memory use and power consumption

  • Working with sensor data, including depth, time-of-flight or similar data sources, to improve model precision and robustness

  • Exporting, testing and preparing models for deployment

  • Building systems for continuous improvement, experiment tracking, model evaluation and feedback loops

  • Collaborating closely with embedded, software, product and data science colleagues to ensure that models work reliably in real-world care environments

This is what we’re looking for

We are looking for a machine learning engineer with strong experience in computer vision and model development for embedded or resource-constrained environments. This is a senior role that requires strong technical depth and the ability to work independently with complex machine learning problems, whether that expertise comes from industry, research or a combination of both. If you’re the right candidate for the job, you probably have:

  • A master’s degree or PhD in machine learning, computer science, robotics, signal processing or a related field

  • Solid experience with computer vision

  • Experience developing, training, validating and optimizing ML models for embedded devices or resource-constrained hardware

  • Strong Python skills and experience with ML frameworks such as PyTorch

  • Experience working close to hardware, preferrably with sensors, depth cameras, time-of-flight data, robotics, drones, automotive systems or similar

  • Understanding of inference on edge hardware

This job does not require that your background is within care or healthcare technology, but you do need to understand what it means to build models that have to work reliably outside of a controlled lab environment.

Bonus points if you have experience with one or more of the following:

  • Time-of-flight cameras, depth sensors, spectrum data or sensor fusion

  • Embedded Linux, C++ or working closely with firmware or embedded software teams

  • Model profiling, memory optimization or low-power ML deployment

  • Hardware-in-the-loop testing, automated validation or continuous model evaluation

  • MLOps, experiment tracking, dataset versioning or model lifecycle tools such as MLflow

  • Safety-critical, privacy-sensitive or regulated products where reliability matters

At Sensio, the way you work is just as important as your technical background. We are looking for someone who is independent, curious and quality-conscious. Someone who can go deep technically but also collaborates well with people across disciplines. Someone who asks good questions, takes ownership and wants to build systems that improve over time.

What Sensio can offer

At Sensio, you get to work on technology with a clear purpose and a very real user need. RoomMate is not built for a slide deck, a demo room or a theoretical future. It is built for real care environments, with real people, alarms, staff shortages and real-life consequences for those who receive care, and those who provide it.

As a Machine Learning Engineer at Sensio, your work will help make sensor-driven care technology more precise, reliable and useful. Better models can mean better detection, fewer unnecessary interruptions, faster response and more confidence for the care teams using the technology every day.

This is the kind of machine learning where good engineering becomes more than good engineering. It becomes safety, dignity and more time for care.

What we can offer:

  • A central role in building and shaping Sensio’s AI capabilities, which will have a real-life effect on the future of care technology

  • The opportunity to build technology that supports healthcare professionals, residents, patients and next-of-kin

  • A Norwegian product and technology environment with international ambitions

  • A strong, cross-functional team working across hardware, software, product and design

  • Room to take ownership, influence technical direction and grow professionally

This is a role for someone who wants the complexity of machine learning, the constraints of embedded technology and the meaning of working on products that matter in everyday life.

If you want to build models that leave the lab and help shape the future of care technology, we would like to hear from you.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

At Sensio, we’re on a mission to accelerate the digital transformation of care. With roots in the Nordic start-up scene, we’ve grown into a fast-scaling caretech company backed by Nordic Capital, with more than 230 colleagues across Norway, Sweden, Denmark, the UK – and now expanding into Germany. Our technology is already installed in thousands of care homes and hospitals, helping staff prevent falls, save lives, and free up time for what really matters: people. We build everything from advanced safety sensors and cloud platforms to apps and data tools – all developed in-house by our 80+ product and tech specialists. What makes Sensio unique? - Impact with scale – our solutions improve everyday life for tens of thousands of residents and caregivers, and we’re just getting started. - A true growth journey – from Nordic frontrunner to European scale-up, we’re building the leading caretech platform of tomorrow. - Innovation at heart – our R&D teams shape the future of care technology with cutting-edge hardware, AI, and software. - People-first culture – we believe the best products come from teams that feel at home, have freedom to experiment, and share knowledge across borders. If you want to be part of a meaningful growth story – where tech meets one of society’s biggest challenges – join us. Let’s create more time for care.

  • Setting technical direction for AI across data, model development, MLOps, validation, deployment and performance tracking

  • Driving embedded AI initiatives, including models that need to run locally on resource-constrained sensors and devices

  • Working closely with data, annotation, ML, embedded, product and engineering teams to build reliable AI workflows from data to hardware

  • Improving robustness, explainability, privacy and scalability across Sensio’s AI systems

  • Helping establish internal principles, standards and ways of working for responsible and effective use of AI

We are looking for a technically strong AI Lead with deep machine learning competence, strong academic grounding and the ability to lead both people and transformation. If you’re the right candidate for the job, you probably have:

  • Strong experience with machine learning, computer vision or embedded AI, preferably from products that operate in real-world environments

  • Advanced academic training in machine learning, computer science, robotics, signal processing, applied mathematics or a related discipline, normally at master’s or PhD level, or equivalent depth demonstrated through relevant industrial research and development

  • Experience across several parts of the ML lifecycle, such as data preparation, model development, validation, deployment, MLOps and performance monitoring

  • Understanding of edge AI, hardware constraints, model optimization, quantization or deployment to resource-constrained devices

  • The ability to lead strong technical people, create direction, handle complexity and build confidence in a fast-moving environment

You do not need to have done everything Sensio is trying to build. Very few people have. But you do need to understand the full technical landscape well enough to make good decisions, ask the right questions and lead specialists across the pipeline.

Bonus points if you have experience with one or more of the following:

  • Time-of-flight sensors, IR sensors, depth data, computer vision, sensor fusion or signal-based AI

  • Embedded Linux, C++, Pytorch or similar frameworks and tools

  • Fleet-wide deployment, model monitoring, continuous model evaluation or industrial scalability of AI systems

  • Privacy-preserving AI, anonymization, GDPR, access control, security or explainability

Few environments can offer the same combination of real-time data, meaningful use cases, hardware constraints and societal importance.

jobs.title: Sjåfør søkes deltid (Bergen)
jobs.description:
Vil du være med når vi videreutvikler Today Mobility på det norske markedet? Vi opplever sterk vekst og økende etterspørsel, og søker nå flere sjåfører som vil være med på reisen videre.

Å starte hos oss nå gir deg muligheten til å komme tidlig inn i en organisasjon i utvikling, og for deg som viser engasjement, finnes det gode muligheter for videre utvikling.
Om rollen

Som sjåfør hos oss jobber du hovedsakelig i og rundt Bergen. Du kjører biler mellom forhandlere, kunder og samarbeidspartnere, og sørger for at riktig bil er på riktig sted til riktig tid. Du blir en viktig del av en logistikkflyt som får bilbransjen til å fungere effektivt.

Stillingen er i utgangspunktet en 50 % deltidsstilling, men for den rette kandidaten vil det være gode muligheter og fleksibilitet til å øke stillingsprosenten opp mot 75 %. Arbeidstiden vil variere, men du må ha mulighet til å jobbe kveldstid frem til kl. 20.00. Stillingen passer derfor perfekt for eksempelvis studenter, eller deg som ønsker en fleksibel hverdag ved siden av andre prosjekter.

Vi ser etter deg som:

  • Har gyldig førerkort klasse B (manuell) og en trygg kjørestil

  • Kan jobbe ettermiddager og kvelder (frem til kl. 20.00)

  • Tar ansvar og jobber selvstendig

  • Trives i et miljø med tempo og varierte dager

  • Er løsningsorientert og opptatt av god kundeservice

  • Kommuniserer godt og er komfortabel med digitale verktøy

Hvorfor Today Mobility:

  • Fast deltidsstilling (50 % med mulighet for opptil 75 %)

  • Samarbeid med ledende aktører i bilbransjen

  • Struktur, rutiner og støtte i hverdagen

  • Opplæring og oppfølging for at du skal lykkes

  • Reelle muligheter for utvikling videre

Flere av våre sjåfører har gått videre til roller hos forhandlere, leasingaktører eller internt hos oss. For de som tar ansvar og viser initiativ, åpner det seg muligheter.

Praktisk informasjon

  • Stilling: Deltid (50 % – 75 %)

  • Arbeidstid: Varierende, inkluderer kveldsarbeid frem til kl. 20.00

  • Lønn: Etter avtale / timelønn basert på stillingsprosent

  • Oppstart: Snarest / etter avtale

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Today Mobility provides consumer-centric first and last mile logistics to the automotive industry. Our drivers pick up and deliver cars to and from workshops and dealerships all over Sweden whether it be for a Test Drive, New/Used car delivery or for a routine Workshop visit. So far we've delivered over 150,000 cars, and are working with Sweden's largest car manufacturers and dealers as they transition to online sales and service channels. Our vision is simple - to make car ownership simpler, more convenient and sustainable.

jobs.title: Head of Software Engineering
jobs.description:
About Monil

Monil is building world-leading technology for virtual fencing and livestock monitoring. In just four years, we've grown to over 1,000 customers and more than 50,000 collars deployed across multiple markets, and we are now entering a new phase of international growth with rapid expansion into the US.

At the heart of our solution is a collar that combines animal interaction, sensors, positioning, and wireless communication, but the value our customers experience lives in the software: the cloud platform, the data pipelines that turn raw device telemetry into insight, and the apps farmers use every day to control and understand their herds in real time.

We're looking for a Head of Software Engineering to own and scale that software, and to build the team and technical foundations that will carry us through international expansion.

About the role

This is a senior leadership role reporting directly to the CEO, with full ownership of our software engineering function across frontend, backend, and data. You will set technical direction, build and grow the team, and be accountable for the quality, reliability, and velocity of everything we ship above the device layer. The role is part of Monil’s management team and will be crucial to guide the company in a rapid growth phase.

You will collaborate closely with our product and hardware teams. Your effectiveness will depend as much on strong, trust-based collaboration with those teams as on your technical leadership. Product owns the what and the why; Hardware owns the device. You own the how and the when for all software and data products, and you are the connective tissue that turns device capability and product intent into reliable, shipped systems.

Key responsibilities

  • Own the architecture, delivery, and operational health of Monil's software platform across frontend, backend, and data.

  • Lead and grow a high-performing engineering organisation: hiring, mentoring, structuring teams, and setting the technical and cultural bar.

  • Define and drive software engineering standards, and technical best practices across the platform, including CI/CD, testing, observability, and on-call/reliability practices.

  • Build the data foundation that turns high-volume telemetry into reliable, queryable, and actionable data. Ensure that all models are productionised, platform-integrated, and maintained to the same high standards as the rest of the systems.

  • Partner closely with Product to translate roadmaps into deliverable, well-sequenced engineering plans, and to make pragmatic trade-offs on scope, timing, and technical investment.

  • Partner closely with R&D on the device-to-cloud boundary, telemetry contracts, device management, and OTA: ensuring software and firmware evolve coherently.

  • Own delivery: balance feature velocity against the architectural and operational work needed to scale internationally and reliably.

  • Be accountable for software quality, security, and the production reliability of customer-facing systems.

We believe you have

  • Significant experience leading software engineering teams, with a track record of shipping and operating production systems at scale.

  • Strong technical depth across at least one of frontend, backend, or data engineering, and the breadth and credibility to lead all three.

  • Experience with modern backend and cloud architectures, distributed systems, and the data infrastructure behind high-volume telemetry or IoT-style workloads.

  • A solid grasp of modern engineering practices; CI/CD, automated testing, observability.

  • Experience working alongside product and hardware functions, and a genuine ability to drive outcomes through influence and collaboration rather than authority alone.

  • Strong people leadership: hiring, growing, and retaining engineers, and building team structures that scale.

Experience with any of the following is a plus: connected/IoT systems and device-to-cloud data flows; edge or on-device ML; low-power or connectivity-constrained system design; OTA and device management at scale.

We believe you are

  • Passionate about building reliable products that operate in challenging real-world environments.

  • Comfortable owning outcomes end to end and driving them from idea to production.

  • Pragmatic, curious, and motivated by solving complex engineering and organisational challenges.

  • A strong collaborator who communicates effectively across technical and non-technical teams, and who builds trust with peer leaders in Product and Hardware.

  • Able to hold a high quality and reliability bar while keeping the team moving fast in an engaging way.

We offer

  • Full ownership of a software function during a period of rapid international growth.

  • Challenging engineering problems spanning connected devices, large-scale data, and customer-facing applications.

  • A collaborative environment with significant ownership and learning opportunities.

  • Meaningful impact on animal welfare and sustainable agriculture.

  • Competitive compensation and benefits.

Requirements

Candidates must have the right to work in Norway or within the EU/EEA, as we are unable to support relocation or visa sponsorship from outside this area. Some travel might be required.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Accelerate the worlds transition to sustainable agriculture by automating animal care. We design and build high-tech smart collars that benefits both farmer, animal and environment: - The farmer saves time and money on building fences and animal feed - The animals spend less time inside and more time grazing on open pastures - The smart collars enable grazing techniques that boost soil health and reduce the need for artificial fertilizer

jobs.title: Growth Engineer
jobs.description:
Building the future of architectural visualization

Our mission is to help architects bring their vision to life. We’re building a web-based application for architects that speed up their design workflows and makes high-quality visualization accessible to a wider audience.

We have experienced rapid growth in recent months and we are hiring to further scale the company. We have customers in over 120 different countries, including leading offices such as Nordic, Leo A Daly, and S+A, who collectively have generated over 6 million visualizations on our platform since the company was established in 2023.

We’ve raised over €3 million from leading Nordic investors to date, helping us build toward our mission. We’re now looking for talented individuals who want to challenge the status quo and reinvent how architects and industry professionals communicate their designs.

 

What you will do

As a product-led growth company, growth is central to helping the right users discover, adopt, and succeed with Visoid.

As one of the first members of our new Growth team, you will work closely with the Growth Manager, Product, and Commercial team. Your role is to turn growth ideas into working solutions across the full user journey from acquisition and onboarding to conversion, retention, and referral.

If you enjoy shipping quickly, working with data, and using engineering to create measurable user and business impact, we would love to hear from you.

As the Growth Engineer at Visoid, you will:

  • Build across the funnel: Improve acquisition, signup, onboarding, activation, conversion, retention, and referral.

  • Run experiments: Work with the Growth Manager to design, build, launch, and evaluate frequent growth experiments.

  • Improve the product experience: Identify friction points and build solutions that help users reach value faster.

  • Build growth infrastructure: Implement tracking, analytics, attribution, feature flags, and experimentation tools.

  • Create growth experiences: Develop landing pages, onboarding flows, referral programs, invitation flows, and in-product loops.

  • Build integrations and automations: Connect analytics, CRM, payment, marketing, and communication tools.

  • Use AI to move faster: Use AI-assisted and agentic tools to prototype, build, and test efficiently.

  • Ship with ownership: Take ideas from problem definition to production and iteration.

     

Who you are

We are seeking a creative individual with a commercial mindset who is as obsessed with our users as we are. You should be a self-motivated team player committed to delivering real value and solving genuine user problems.

We think you will thrive in Visoid if:

  • You have an ability to communicate with users and apply insights into concrete product improvements.

  • You have a startup mindset and can independently prioritize the most valuable tasks when resources are limited.

  • You are self-driven with a “doer” mentality focused on moving fast and getting the job done.

  • You are eager to learn and acquire new skills.

 

Minimum Requirements

  • A bachelor’s degree or higher in computer science, software engineering, or a related field

  • At least 3 years of professional experience working full-time in software, product, or growth engineering.

  • Experience building and shipping user-facing web applications.

  • Strong frontend skills and experience with APIs, backend services, and databases.

  • Experience with analytics, event tracking, integrations, or experimentation.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Experience using agentic development tools such as Claude, Cursor, or similar.

  • Founder mentality. You are building a function, not inheriting one.

 

Optional qualifications

  • Experience in a SaaS startup, scale-up, or product-led growth team.

  • Built onboarding, referral, invitation, monetization, or experimentation flows.

  • Worked with tools such as Mixpanel, Amplitude, or PostHog.

  • Shipped experiments that significantly improved activation, conversion, retention, or revenue.

     

We are looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The optional qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

We prioritize candidates that are either are already located in Oslo, or who have an existing right to work in Norway and are willing to relocate to Oslo.

 

Perks and benefits

We strive to offer competitive benefits for our employees. Here's what you can expect from us:

  • 4% pension contribution

  • Flexible work hours

  • Flexible home-office arrangement

  • 5 weeks vacation

  • Choice of computer equipment and mobile device

  • Gym membership

  • Cantina with subsidized lunch

  • Monthly social and educational events

     

We are located at StartupLab, the leading co-working space for startups in Norway.

 

Compensation and equity

We offer a competitive salary, adjusted for early-stage growth companies.

As an early hire you have the unique opportunity to secure a significant equity stake in the company. You will be directly invested in our success and share the rewards as we grow. Your contributions will not only shape the future of the company but also provide you with substantial financial upside if we achieve our goals.

 

About the team

As a company, we foster a team-focused culture that values ambition, collaboration and honesty. We want to assemble a team of innovative technologists and product enthusiasts who are passionate about building a great product for our users.

With the company numbering 12 employees, and already representing 10 different nationalities, we are no doubt a diverse group of people. Most of us are located in-person at the Oslo office in Norway.

 

Working at Visoid

We believe in a high-performance culture driven by speed, user impact, and continuous improvement through direct, respectful feedback. We favor rapid iteration and a "move fast and learn" approach over perfection. If you thrive in a dynamic environment, want to directly impact the product, and aren't afraid to challenge the status quo, you'll fit right in.

Beyond the work, we value a positive, inclusive atmosphere. To stay motivated, creative, and connected, we host monthly team social events where we try out new activities and simply enjoy spending time together.

 

Why Norway?

Norway combines a thriving tech industry with high living standards, and strong social benefits. Since English is widely spoken, international talent can easily settle in and feel at home.

Oslo itself is uniquely positioned: local public transport can take you to both the sea and the mountains in under 30 minutes. Whether you’re an outdoor enthusiast, an urban explorer, or a foodie looking to enjoy the city's rich restaurant and museum scene, Oslo truly has something for everyone.

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
jobs.description:
📍 Remote, based in Poland

About Us

At No Isolation, we’re a profitable, 65-person Scandinavian EdTech scale-up operating across Europe. We help educators bring learning and belonging to every child.

Our AV1 robot is deployed in 19 countries, with 5,000+ units supporting schools to improve attendance, belonging, and continuity of learning for children who cannot be physically present. Consistently described as life-changing, it bridges the gap between the student and their peers, restoring both educational continuity and the essential sense of social belonging.

We’re established enough to have a proven solution and strong financial foundations, yet still small enough for every new colleague to have a visible impact on our next stage of growth.

The Opportunity

Your purpose in this role is simple: help us grow by proactively identifying and approaching talented people who aren't actively looking, but would be a great fit if approached the right way. Our ability to hire the best people, fast, directly determines how quickly we can scale.

This role is mainly focused on proactive sourcing and candidate screening, with the possibility to also handle a few roles full-cycle (360), from brief through to offer and close. The hires will mainly be across Commercial and Operational teams, with possibility of some Tech and Product roles as well. We're looking for someone who can map our markets, build lasting candidate relationships, and give hiring managers a steady stream of great people to talk to — not a slow trickle of applicants.

What You'll Do

Proactive sourcing

  • Map our markets and proactively reach out to passive candidates using LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean search, job boards, and your network

  • Build talent pools for recurring or future hard-to-fill roles, and screen candidates for fit before progressing them

  • Keep our pipeline data in shape, track TA KPIs, and flag risks early

Full-cycle recruitment

  • Own a smaller share of roles end-to-end — from brief, through interviews, to offer and close

Alongside this, you'll partner with hiring managers to understand what they need and advise on candidate market insight, keep candidates engaged throughout the process, and craft and post job ads on relevant job boards.

What You Bring

  • 2–3 years in talent acquisition, recruitment, or proactive sourcing, with a genuine track record of engaging passive candidates

  • Experience across more than one European market

  • Fluent with LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean search, and ATS tools, and curious about using AI to work smarter

  • Confident stakeholder management

  • Excellent written and spoken English is required; working proficiency in German is an advantage

  • You are organised, persistent, and self-driven, able to juggle multiple roles and markets without dropping speed or quality, and comfortable with the healthy "chaos" of a scaling company

If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you!

Our Culture — Why You'll Love It Here

We're a Scandinavian company with a high-performance, caring culture. We set the bar high, and we back each other to get there.

  • Purpose with scale: You won't just be sourcing for any company — your work directly fuels a mission that keeps thousands of children connected, learning, and included

  • Big impact, real ownership: This is a scale-up, not a corporate machine. We start from a place of trust, so you'll have real ownership of your work from day one, with support from a highly experienced team

  • A genuine growth story: We're one of the few full-stack EdTech companies growing at our rate of profitability, and we've still only scratched the surface of the market. There is plenty of opportunity to grow alongside us, not just fill a seat

  • Highly collaborative and supportive: Regular in-person team meetings, an annual company trip, and people across departments happy to help you grow

  • Structured onboarding to get you up to speed quickly

How to Apply

Please click APPLY and upload your CV in English, and record a short video in English outlining your motivation and letting your personality shine through.

Location & Salary

📍 Remote, based in Poland.

We're unable to sponsor visas or work permits. Candidates must already have the legal right to work in Poland (e.g., EU/EEA citizenship, permanent residency, or an existing valid work permit).

jobs.title: Head of Sales (Nordics)
jobs.description:
About Us

At No Isolation, we’re a profitable, 65-person Norwegian EdTech scale-up operating across Europe. We help educators bring learning and belonging to every child.

Our AV1 robot is deployed in 19 countries, with 5,000+ units supporting schools to improve attendance, belonging, and continuity of learning for children who cannot be physically present. Consistently described as life-changing, it bridges the gap between the student and their peers, restoring both educational continuity and the essential sense of social belonging.

We’re established enough to have a proven solution and strong financial foundations, yet still small enough for every new colleague to have a visible impact on our next stage of growth.

The Opportunity - Head of Sales, Nordics

The Nordics are where it started, and it still contains some of our strongest markets. We’ve achieved good market penetration across the region so far, but there's still a huge opportunity to expand.

We're looking for a sales leader based in Oslo to take over a small existing team and drive performance further. Currently, Account Managers on your team cover Norway, Sweden and Denmark - close to the schools and municipalities they serve. Your role is to bring them together as one team, sharpen how they sell, and turn strong regional demand into predictable, growing revenue.

You will report directly to our London-based CCO, Sanjeev, who previously led Vodafone business units across Africa and Europe. Being based in our Oslo HQ, you will also work closely with the wider executive team, including our CEO, Morten, a former McKinsey Partner.

What You'll Do — Scope & Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop the team: Coach your Account Managers through deal reviews, pipeline check-ins and real-time support on live opportunities. You'll build the kind of environment where people are pushed to get better and know it's in service of their own growth, not just the number.

  • Own the regional strategy: Use market and pipeline data to decide where to focus - which segments, which territories, which accounts are worth the push. Norway, Sweden and Denmark aren't the same market; treat them that way.

  • Keep the numbers honest: Pipeline hygiene, accurate forecasting, clean data in HubSpot. Leadership makes decisions based on what you and your team report - it needs to hold up.

  • Help your team win the big deals: Multi-stakeholder sales into municipalities and education authorities take time and the right approach. You'll help AMs map the decision path and move from single-unit sales to framework agreements.

  • Connect the dots internally: Work closely with Marketing, Product and Customer Success so the whole go-to-market motion stays aligned - not just your slice of it.

  • Represent us externally: Show up at industry events and policy conversations across the region as a credible voice for what we do.

What You Bring — Experience & Capabilities

  • A track record leading B2B sales teams - ideally selling complex solutions into education or public sector, where deals take multiple stakeholders and patience.

  • You lead by coaching, not just managing. You know how to read what motivates different people and push each of them toward their own best, not a one-size-fits-all approach.

  • A structured approach to selling. You've used frameworks like MEDDPICC, SPIN or Challenger to pressure-test deals and keep timelines under control, and you expect your team to do the same.

  • Comfort with data and CRM (HubSpot experience is a plus) - you can turn numbers into coaching conversations and forecasts people can actually trust.

  • Professional fluency in Norwegian and English; Swedish or Danish is a plus but not essential.

What We Offer

  • Huge market opportunity: The Nordics are our home market and where it all started - with some of the best awareness and coverage. Yet there is still massive opportunity for account expansion and market penetration.

  • Proven product-market fit: Our solution is unique, backed by strong evidence of impact, and is highly cost effective against alternative solutions. This all shows in our very low churn - the solution works and customers love it.

  • A team and a playbook that already work: You're not starting from zero - you're taking something proven and making it better. You'll have the room to adjust the approach where it makes sense.

  • Significant financial upside. We offer an attractive uncapped commission model beyond OTE. Because the market need is high, and our solution is proven, the earning potential here is significant.

  • High-calibre commercial colleagues: You will join a commercial leadership team of experienced sales leaders from global tech companies like Vodafone and Salesforce, alongside peers steeped in EdTech experience.

  • A working environment people rate highly: our engagement metrics run above benchmark. Structured onboarding with a buddy program, an annual company trip, and a genuinely collaborative culture across departments.

  • Enhanced parental and sick leave.

  • Flexible working around core hours (10:00-15:00) and remote working option.

  • Central office space in Oslo.

  • 27 vacation days.

  • Travel insurance for employees and immediate family members.

  • Mobile phone and Internet subscription.

Location

This role is based in our Oslo HQ office, with regular travel across Norway, Sweden and Denmark to support your team in the field.

We believe in-person leadership matters, so we work a flexible hybrid model built around real collaboration.

How to Apply

Please click Apply and upload your CV in English.

If you’d like, you can also include a short video (in English) as part of your application – this is optional, but it gives us a chance to see a bit more of who you are beyond your CV. Let your personality and passion shine!

jobs.title: Fulfillment Operating Manager
jobs.description:
At Oda, we develop affordable grocery services to make the logistics of living surprisingly easy. First we built Norway’s leading online grocery store and now, partnered with Mathem in Sweden, we’re on our way to becoming the world’s most effective grocery system, delivering to thousands of Scandinavian doorsteps every week.

As part of our team, you’ll work with smart, passionate colleagues who bring their whole selves to work every day. It’s a fast-moving, collaborative environment where everyone is welcome and everyone’s opinion matters. Whether you're shaping the future of online retail, tackling complex logistical problems, or making everyday life better for our customers, your work will have a real impact. Read on to find out what part you could play in our story.

Our world-class logistics and tech solutions allow us to reduce food waste, save time and money, and ease the mental and physical load for people who want more space for life.


We’re looking for a Fulfillment Operating Manager to join Oda!

As a Fulfillment Operating Manager, you oversee the operations and performance of a specific day shift. Your primary responsibility will be to ensure that your shift operates according to our safety guidelines, meets its performance targets, and operates efficiently. You will lead a team of Team Leaders and create a structured environment that fosters effective communication, alignment, and planning.


What you’ll be doing as a Fulfillment Operating Manager

  • You have operational responsibility for your shift’s performance within areas such as safety, quality, general well-being, and efficiency.

  • You will monitor these areas through KPIs set within your department and take action when necessary to ensure these are met.

  • You will act as a role model and coach when it comes to leadership and provide guidance and support for your team leaders and other employees on your shift.

  • You will need to roll up your sleeves, helping out in operations, supporting personnel follow-up cases, and in general helping in addressing concerns, questions, and issues that may arise according to company-defined standards.

  • You are in charge of Root Cause Analyses (RCAs) on serious near-misses or injuries happening during your shift. In general, ensure that deviations are followed up and closed within deadlines.

  • You set expectations for your team leaders and ensure that the shift structure is maintained and that meetings and reports are executed properly and timely.

  • You maintain and ensure that your shift has the necessary competency, and that each team is evenly distributed both with regard to total numbers of FTEs and competency.

  • You support the testing and implementation of new initiatives.


To thrive in this role, You're an operational leader who thrives in fast-paced, multinational environments - energetic, hands-on, and comfortable balancing strategic decision-making with frontline work. You have strong interpersonal skills to navigate difficult conversations and lead teams effectively, combined with proactive planning to anticipate outcomes and meet deadlines.


What you’ll need to succeed 🌟

  • You are used to working with warehouse management systems and technologies.

What would be nice to have 💡

  • You are fluent in English, both written and spoken. Norwegian is a plus.

  • You have worked within the grocery / e -commerce industry.

What we offer 🚀

This is your chance to make a real impact as a Fulfillment Operating Manager in a fast-moving company with a product people love-while shaking up the grocery industry. You’ll experience:

  • Teammates who aim high and have each other’s backs. We care about people, and that means supporting each other every step of the way.

Practical Information

  • Application deadline: 18.09.2026

  • Working hours: 06:30 - 14:30

  • Location: Drammensveien 189, 3420 Lierskogen


A few final words

At Oda, you’ll join a passionate, ambitious team working to change the future of grocery shopping. We’re all different-just like you-and we wouldn’t have it any other way. If you need any adjustments or support during the application process, just let us know, and we’ll do our best to help. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and want everyone to have an equal shot at landing the job. 🧡

Oda is the leading online grocery retailer in Norway, but as a company, we’re first and foremost an ambitious tech and logistics company - not a classic retailer. We’re one of the fastest-growing startups in the Nordics, working with huge, complex challenges to make the lives of our customers simpler and easier. Want to join us? jobs.title: Fullstack-utvikler / AI-utvikler – arbeidstrening eller praksis i B2B/industri-startup
jobs.description:
Company: RoboConnect

Location: Molde, Norway

Work type: Full-time or part-time

Role type: Internship / student / junior developer / work training

Salary: Unpaid in the initial phase

Long-term possibility: Paid role may become possible if RoboConnect secures revenue, funding or a suitable commercial basis

Short description

RoboConnect is building an AI-supported B2B platform that helps industrial companies clarify automation needs before they invest in robotics, automation or system integration.

We are looking for a locally based fullstack developer who wants hands-on startup experience and can contribute to the development of RoboConnect’s platform, AI Advisor and internal tools. This is not a co-founder role and not an ordinary paid position at this stage, but it may become a paid role later if the collaboration works well and the company develops commercially.

About RoboConnect

Many industrial companies know they need to automate, but struggle to define what should be automated, what information is missing, whether the process is ready for investment, and which suppliers they should involve.

RoboConnect helps companies move from an unclear automation need to a structured and decision-relevant basis for internal decisions and supplier dialogue. The platform combines industrial automation insight, structured project data, AI-supported needs clarification, project preparation and matching with relevant automation partners.

The first focus area is welding automation and high-mix, low-volume manufacturing. We are currently preparing customer pilots and further development of the MVP.

Why we need a developer in-house

RoboConnect is moving from concept and market validation into product development, pilots and technical iteration. We need stronger internal technical capacity, especially around the AI Advisor, frontend, backend, API integrations, data structure and user flows.

The current platform and AI work involves several moving parts, including customer registration, project forms, dashboards, structured project data, AI-assisted needs clarification, report generation and matching logic.

We are therefore looking for a developer who can work closely with the founder and contribute practically to building, improving and testing the product.

A local candidate in Molde or nearby is strongly preferred, because close collaboration, product discussions and faster iteration will be important. Some remote work may be possible, but we would like in-person collaboration several days per week.

What you will work on

You will contribute to practical product development for RoboConnect, including:

  • frontend development and user interface improvements

  • backend development and API integrations

  • AI Advisor / chatbot functionality for needs clarification

  • structured data capture from customer conversations or forms

  • database structure and data handling

  • dashboards for customers, suppliers and admin users

  • GitHub workflow, documentation and testing

  • improving user flows from registration to project clarification

  • preparing technical demos for pilots and customer feedback

The first tasks will be scoped clearly. The goal is not to build everything at once, but to make focused improvements that can be tested with real users.

Who we are looking for

We are looking for someone with some practical development experience who wants to build real software in an early-stage startup.

You should have experience with, or strong interest in:

  • fullstack development

  • frontend and backend development

  • JavaScript / TypeScript

  • React / Next.js

  • APIs

  • databases

  • GitHub

  • AI tools, LLMs or chatbot development

  • structured problem solving

  • building usable products, not only experimenting with technology

Experience with Tailwind, Supabase, Convex, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Vercel, OpenAI, Anthropic or similar tools is an advantage, but not required if you learn quickly.

You do not need to be senior, but you should have built something before and be able to work independently on defined tasks.

You must be comfortable with

  • working in a very early-stage startup

  • incomplete systems and changing priorities

  • documenting your work clearly

  • committing code regularly to RoboConnect’s GitHub repository

  • working with agreed scope and delivery expectations

  • discussing technical choices openly

  • asking questions when something is unclear

  • receiving feedback and improving the solution iteratively

You must not commit API keys, passwords or secrets to GitHub. Production data and production credentials will not be shared during an initial trial period.

Language and location

Norwegian language skills are strongly preferred, because RoboConnect works with Norwegian industrial companies and customer needs must be understood clearly.

Candidates who speak English may also be considered if they are willing to learn Norwegian and can collaborate effectively in Norway.

The ideal candidate is located in Molde or within commuting distance. Candidates who can be physically present in Molde several days per week will be prioritized.

Practical setup

This is initially intended as an unpaid work-training, internship or experience-based role, depending on the candidate’s situation.

It may be especially relevant for someone who:

  • wants more practical experience in fullstack development

  • wants to build real startup/product experience

  • has completed studies, courses or self-learning but needs real project experience

  • is registered with NAV and may be eligible for work training or similar arrangements

  • wants to build a portfolio with meaningful product work

  • is interested in AI, automation, industrial technology or B2B platforms

RoboConnect will not present this as an ordinary paid employment relationship unless a separate paid agreement is made.

If the collaboration works well and RoboConnect secures revenue, funding or another commercial basis, a paid role may become possible later.

What you can gain

You will get hands-on experience with:

  • building a real B2B SaaS/AI platform

  • AI-supported product development

  • industrial automation use cases

  • customer needs clarification

  • startup product development

  • fullstack development in practice

  • GitHub, documentation, testing and deployment workflow

  • working close to the founder and team in an early-stage company

This is a good opportunity for someone who wants more than a theoretical project and wants to join in build something that may be used by real industrial companies.

About the founder

RoboConnect was founded by Elisabet Witsø. The company is based in Molde and connected to the industrial and automation ecosystem in Norway.

RoboConnect is still in an early phase, but has completed market validation, interviewed industrial companies and automation partners, completed MVP, and is preparing the next step toward pilots and commercial testing.

How to apply

Please apply through The Hub and answer the short application questions. Please also include your CV and GitHub profile.

The questions are intended to give us a better understanding of your motivation, availability, language skills, practical situation and how you work as a developer.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

1. Short description RoboConnect is developing an independent, AI-supported platform that helps industrial companies turn tacit and fragmented process knowledge into a clear, decision-relevant automation case — before supplier dialogue begins. 2. The problem Many industrial companies know they need to automate, but struggle to define what should be automated, what is causing the problem and whether the process is ready for investment. The people closest to production often understand the process well, but this knowledge may be spread across operators, engineers and management, poorly documented or mixed with assumptions and missing data. The customer may therefore approach the market with an unclear problem description and incomplete information. System integrators then have to reconstruct the customer’s process understanding and collect missing data before a meaningful solution dialogue can begin. This creates uncertainty, longer clarification phases, weak or difficult-to-compare proposals and projects that stall early. The core problem is not a lack of technology or suppliers. It is that the knowledge needed to make a good early automation decision is often tacit, fragmented and difficult to transfer. 3. The solution RoboConnect starts by understanding the customer’s process, challenges and actual needs. The RoboConnect AI Advisor conducts a guided professional conversation that helps the company describe how production works today, what it wants to improve, which constraints matter and what information is still missing. The AI Advisor brings together information from different parts of the organisation, separates facts from assumptions and uncertainty, identifies knowledge gaps and risks, and turns unclear issues into practical next actions. The result is a shared and structured automation basis that can be developed into a supplier-ready project brief. Relevant projects can then be connected with suitable system integrators, technology suppliers and R&D environments. This gives the customer greater decision confidence and solution providers a better starting point. RoboConnect is not building a generic chatbot. The platform combines a domain-specific workflow, structured project data and knowledge from industrial cases, expert interviews and feedback from customers and automation partners. Over time, this strengthens clarification, project maturation and matching. The first focused area is welding automation and high-mix, low-volume manufacturing. The longer-term ambition is to expand across other automation categories and build a Nordic platform for early-stage automation clarification and matching. 4. Business model and commercial opportunity RoboConnect creates value on both sides of the market. Industrial companies receive a clearer and safer starting point, while automation partners gain access to better-qualified customer opportunities. The current model is based mainly on supplier-side revenue through fees for qualified matches and successful projects. Future revenue streams may include paid AI-assisted readiness reports, supplier subscriptions, premium access and category-specific products. The model is now being validated through pilots and early customer projects. Norway is the validation market, with Sweden as the first intended scale-up market. 5. Why I started RoboConnect The motivation came from repeated conversations with industrial companies, automation experts and system integrators. I saw that many projects became uncertain long before technology was selected. Companies needed a more independent and structured way to understand their own situation before entering a supplier-led process. With a background in research, data analysis and complex problem structuring, combined with further training in programming, databases and AI, I founded RoboConnect to bridge the gap between industrial process knowledge and automation delivery.

jobs.title: Counter Staff, Oslo Gardermoen

jobs.title: Senior UX/Service Designer in Oda Systems
jobs.description:
The opportunity

You'll design the tools that get groceries onto millions of doorsteps: not what shoppers see, but the systems used by people working in logistics operations at our fulfillment centers.

Oda’s mission is to build the world’s most efficient retail system so people have space for life. A huge part of that is our sophisticated fulfillment and delivery system, designed and built entirely by us. It packs and delivers nearly a half million items every day to around 80.000 homes and businesses across Norway and Sweden. What we’ve built is second-to-none in the world when it comes to efficiency, and it’s held together by internal tools and processes that make the jobs of operators and drivers easy, fast, ergonomic, and smooth. That's where you come in.

You'll work in close collaboration with our colleagues in both Norway and at our sister company Mathem in Stockholm, and you’ll help us on the path to launching Oda Systems in new markets as we find customers who want to work with us to continue building the most efficient solution for online groceries.


The role

Service/UX designers play a major part in the design of our processes and tooling. Great processes are as much about ergonomics, workflow, physical space, team structures, and incentives as they are about screens. You’ll get the chance to not only work on software solutions but also consider how digital experiences should best interact with hardware/machinery, the physical space they’re situated in, and last but not least the operator routines around them. That combination is what makes logistics design at Oda different from most UX roles: you're never just designing a screen, you're designing a multi-dimensional workflow.

You'll join the Sourcing team within Oda's Logistics platform, designing the best possible experience for employees working with everything from receiving and restocking products to handling fruit & vegetables and our bakery tools. While we’re happy with today’s processes, we’re not satisfied: there is a ton to be done to make things more efficient, more automated, and smarter, so that we have even better control over inventory, workers have an easier workday, customers get fresher food, and we have even less product spoilage.

You'll work in a cross-functional team, closely collaborating with other disciplines – Product Management, Engineering, Data and Insight, and Logistics development. This is a hands-on, office-based role. You'll be at our Fulfillment Center in Lier regularly, and at our Tøyen office most of the week (most of the team is at Tøyen at least 3 days a week).


What you'll do in Oda

  • Lead big projects from start to finish: own them from the initial idea through concept, design, prototyping, implementation, testing, and follow-up after launch, working closely with the Sourcing team, and stakeholders in Logistics. You should feel comfortable taking on complex, large projects that require collaboration across teams.

  • Conduct UX research: observe what’s going on in operations, run workshops with your team, stakeholders, and our end-users in logistics operations.

  • Communicate and present your work to peers as well as stakeholders, showing your process, and the impact of your designs.

  • Map and model complex, systemic workflows.

  • Design user interfaces and build prototypes. You don’t have to be a pixel perfectionist, but you will draw screens. Prototype in Figma, or directly in code – whatever’s the fastest way to test an idea, with room to ship and test changes in production alongside developers.

  • Work closely with teammates and stakeholders all the way from ideation to roll-out, rather than handing off at the end of a solo-design process.

  • Raise the bar for design in your team and help shape how we approach logistics problems more broadly.


What we're looking for 🌟

  • At least 8 years of experience in UX, interaction, or service design, in-house or agency, with a portfolio showing full ownership from insight to shipped product

  • A full-stack design attitude: insight, concept, structure, and visual design, without waiting for handovers. Being open to being hands-on both on the warehouse floor and in our codebase.

  • Very solid fundamentals in product sense and design: demonstrated insight-centric process, root cause analysis, work framed in desired outcomes, ability to distill complexity.

  • Speed over perfection: You understand the importance of shipping fast, learning, and iterating over polishing a "perfect" blueprint. You leverage the advantage we have with having short feedback loops with our end-users.

  • A track record of driving process change: not just shipping a solution, but bringing the operators who'll use it along with you.

  • You already use AI as part of your own design process: you're genuinely interested in an AI-enhanced product development workflow, not just AI features bolted onto Figma.

  • Fluent English. Intermediate Norwegian or Swedish is a strong plus, since you'll be working directly with warehouse operators on-site.

  • Previous logistics experience is a plus, not a requirement.


What we offer 🚀

  • A flexible schedule built around a healthy work-life balance.

  • Modern, empowered product teams: democratized data access, good tools, a sustainable pace. We ship, and you will immediately see the impact of your work.

  • A team that's actively working AI into both design and development, not just talking about it, and genuinely open to designers who want to prototype or write code.

  • A design community across all Oda teams: UX design, Service design, Digital design, UX research, Content design, and Graphic design.

  • A culture that values kindness, transparency, and taking action over process for its own sake.

  • A modern office at Tøyen with an amazing subsidized canteen by Naked Lunch, bike parking, and a great rooftop terrace.

You'll be working with people who are ambitious about logistics in a way most designers never get to be. Come build the future with us.


Oda is committed to being an inclusive community, cultivating diversity, equity, and belonging into our everyday workplace culture. When hiring for our team, we welcome the unique contributions that people can add with different cultural backgrounds, ethnicity, race, gender, gender identity and expression, nationality, age, languages spoken, color, religion, disability, sexual orientation, education and beliefs. If you have a disability such as a hearing, visual impairment or any other neurodivergent need that requires accommodating during the hiring process, please let us know in advance. You can do this by contacting the job owner or hiring manager.

Please apply by 20th of September.

We look forward to hearing from you! 💛

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Oda is the leading online grocery retailer in Norway, but as a company, we’re first and foremost an ambitious tech and logistics company - not a classic retailer. We’re one of the fastest-growing startups in the Nordics, working with huge, complex challenges to make the lives of our customers simpler and easier. Want to join us? Our goal is to create the world's most efficient retail system. Through smart work, passionate customer focus and our own technology we make a difference in the lives of thousands of customers and change society for the better through a completely re-imagined value chain for grocery shopping. Our customers save more than 60 hours a year, time we believe can be better spent than going to the store. Our effective value chain and logistics save society tonnes of food waste each year and our distribution network replace almost 13,000 individual trips by car to the grocery store each year.

jobs.title: Senior Fullstack Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About Falkor

We build industrial intelligence software for heavy-asset sectors. As a KONGSBERG company backed by over 200 years of heritage, Falkor helps the energy, chemicals, utilities and other industrial sectors operate with absolute clarity, confidence, and control.

Our AI-enabled platform connects people, systems, and workflows—expanding human capability by turning complex data into real-time, actionable decisions. We help leading organizations improve safety, efficiency and performance while redefining how heavy assets are designed and operated.


The role

We are looking for a Senior Fullstack Software Engineer to help design, build, and continuously improve Falkor Horizon and the platform capabilities it depends on. In this role, you will contribute across frontend and backend, take ownership of features from idea to production, and help the team deliver reliable, intuitive, and scalable solutions. We are looking for a flexible, hands-on engineer who can get up to speed quickly and contribute where the team needs it most.


What You’ll Do

  • Build and improve end-to-end product features across frontend and backend.

  • Develop intuitive web experiences and scalable backend services, APIs, integrations, and data flows.

  • Own features through design, implementation, testing, release, and observability.

  • Contribute to architecture, reliability, security, scalability, and performance.

  • Work closely with Product, UX, Platform, Data, and DevOps colleagues to turn user and business needs into working software.


What we're looking for

  • 6+ years of professional software development experience, with strong hands-on experience across both frontend and backend.

  • Strong experience with TypeScript/JavaScript, Node.js, and a modern frontend framework, preferably Angular.

  • Good understanding of API design, object-oriented programming, system design, and service-oriented architecture.

  • Experience with distributed systems, databases, caching, messaging, and cloud-native architecture.

  • Hands-on experience with automated testing, debugging, observability, and CI/CD for production services and web applications.

  • Experience with one or more relevant data technologies, such as MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis, Elasticsearch, InfluxDB or TimescaleDB.


Nice to Have

  • Experience building complex web applications, design systems, data visualization, or workflow-oriented user interfaces.

  • Experience with microservices, event-driven architecture, Docker, Kubernetes, and Azure or AWS.

  • Experience with authentication, authorization, security best practices, and resilient production-grade services.

Why join Falkor?

You'll be joining a global technology company helping to redefine how complex industries operate.

Apply today with your resume.

Falkor occasionally partners with selected recruitment agencies for specific hiring requirements. We do not accept unsolicited candidate submissions and will not be responsible for associated fees unless terms have been agreed in advance through our Procurement team.
