jobs.title: PhD Candidate in Advancing Corrosion Science Through AI and High-Throughput Experimentation
jobs.description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position

Are you motivated to take a step towards a doctorate and open up exciting career opportunities? As a PhD Candidate with us, you will work to achieve your doctorate, and at the same time gain valuable experience that qualifies you for a further career in higher education and research, in and outside academia. Joining a newly formed research group will further provide you with the opportunity to become part of a growing team and contribute to an exciting new environment with plenty of new research opportunities.

Your immediate leader will be the Head of Department.


About the project

Corrosion represents a major economic burden, costing modern economies roughly 4% of their annual GDP. In Norway, this loss is estimated to be twice the total profits of the entire agricultural sector. Despite this importance, corrosion research remains dominated by case-specific studies and expert-driven intuition. This project aims to close that gap by generating, extracting and measuring corrosion data into a unified knowledge base. On the digital side, the project will employ natural language processing and AI-driven data extraction to automatically harvest corrosion data from the scientific literature. On the experimental side, it will design and refine electrochemical setups for rapid screening of corrosion rates. Given an existing interest for the university, the work will focus particularly on the electrochemical corrosion of alloys relevant to carbon capture and storage applications.


Duties of the position
  • Complete the doctoral education until obtaining a doctorate
  • Carry out research of good quality within the framework as described above
  • Academic publications and popular science dissemination
  • Participate in the newly formed research group of Corrosion and Corrosion Protection
  • Participate in international activities such as conferences, workshops and discussions

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.


Required selection criteria
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty's Doctoral Programme, see Section 6-1 of the PhD regulations for more information
  • You must have a relevant Master's degree in mechanical and industrial engineering, chemical engineering, chemistry, and materials science or equivalent. Your degree must include a major independent project (minimum 30 ECTS) equivalent to a master’s thesis
  • Master students can apply, but the master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position.
  • You must have a strong and relevant academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker academic background, you may be considered if you can document that you are exceptionally suited for a PhD education, for example through relevant work experience and/or peer-reviewed academic works.
  • Sound interest in either materials science, electrochemistry or the use of artificial intelligence in an engineering context
  • Good oral and written presentation skills in English

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.


Preferred selection criteria
  • Good analytical and computational capabilities, through course information or thesis deliverables in the application
  • Skilled in either computational modelling or experimentation, paired with the willingness to work on both

Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to: 

  • Show curiosity and a strong motivation for the subject
  • Work in a structured way, set goals and make plans to achieve them
  • Present and discuss your research with other professionals
  • Be friendly and open-minded
  • Be flexible and open to adjusting the plan for the project as needed

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.


We offer
  • An exciting job with an important mission in society
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Working capital that can be used to implement the project
  • Mentor programme as a new employee at NTNU
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.


Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality.


Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,-per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Engineering within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme through out the period of employment.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to bein conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.


About the application

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in English.

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include:

  • Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degrees
  • CV 
  • Copy of Master's thesis. If you have recently submitted your Master's thesis, you can attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed Master's degree must be presented before taking up the position.
  • Project outline containing proposals for an overall description of research questions, theoretical perspectives, methodological design for the project and progress plan (maximum 1500 words/4 pages) 
  • Short letter of motivation (400 words/1 page)
  • Possibly publications etc. other relevant research work
  • Possibly certificates
  • Names and contact information of three relevant referees


If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.


Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.

NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).


General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Professor Michael Auinger, e-mail: michael.auinger@ntnu.no. 

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact HR Senior Consultant Hedda Winnberg, e-mail: hedda.winnberg@ntnu.no.

Application deadline: 14.10.2026

-----------------

For practical information about working at NTNU, please visit this webpage. 

The city of Trondheim is a modern European city with a rich cultural scene. Trondheim is the tech capital of Norway with a population of 200,000. The Norwegian welfare state, including healthcare, schools, kindergartens and overall equality, is probably the best of its kind in the world. Professional subsidized day-care for children is easily available. Furthermore, Trondheim offers great opportunities for education (including international schools) and possibilities to enjoy nature, culture and family life and has low crime rates and clean air quality. 


Om arbeidsgiveren:

NTNU - knowledge for a better world

The Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU) creates knowledge for a better world and solutions that can change everyday life.


Department of Mechanical and Industrial Engineering

We educate graduates who can create new products, operate and maintain products, and manage projects. The Department has a variety of bachelor’s and master’s degree programmes. We conduct wide-ranging research in fields such as technology, energy, product quality and development, and productivity. The Department of Mechanical and Industrial Engineering is one of eight departments in the Faculty of Engineering.

Værøy kommune planlegger å etablere en avlastningsbolig. Når tilbudet kommer i drift, kan det – dersom begge parter ønsker det – bli aktuelt med ansettelse på vilkår fastsatt i Hovedtariffavtalen.

Vil du vite mer?
Har du spørsmål om arbeidet eller ønsker en uforpliktende samtale, er du velkommen til å ta kontakt.

Som avlaster skal du blant annet:

skape trygghet, forutsigbarhet og gode opplevelser, gi omsorg og praktisk hjelp ut fra den enkeltes behov, delta i aktiviteter hjemme og ute. Det kan være å følge opp måltider, legging og daglige rutiner, samarbeide godt med pårørende og kommunens ansatte og bidra til at pårørende får nødvendig hvile og tid til andre familiemedlemmer.

Vi søker personer som kan være avlaster i eget hjem. Arbeidet kan være på ettermiddager, kvelder, i helger eller som døgnavlastning.

Personlig egnethet vil bli tillagt stor vekt.Hvem ser vi etterVi ser etter deg som er trygg, rolig og omsorgsfull. I tillegg er du ansvarsbevisst og til å stole på. Du har tålmodighet og evne til å møte ulike behov. Du kan arbeide selvstendig og samarbeider godt med andre.
Det er en forutsetting med gode norskkunnskaper, både muntlig og skriftlig og har fylt 18 år.

Vi tilbyr

  • nødvendig opplæring og veiledning

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Værøy er den nest ytterste av Lofotkommunene med ca. 700 innbyggere, plassert sentralt midt i havet. Øya er et eldorado for deg som er glad i friluftsliv til vanns og til lands, med spektakulære fjell som er forholdsvis enkle å bestige. Her har kunstnere som Theodor Kittelsen og Karl Erik Harr latt seg inspirere, og det polare lyset inviterer til fotografering. Værøy har dessuten en svært spesiell kulturhistorie knyttet til unike fangst- og mattradisjoner. Ørn ble fanget med hendene og lundefugl med garn og hund fram til 1950-tallet. Et kreativt næringsliv med prisvinnende matprodukter er i dag med på å sette Værøy på kartet. Værøy har Nord Norges største pelagiske fiskemottak, og nær 60% av all norsk lutefisk produseres hos oss.

Værøy er et produktivt og livskraftig samfunn. Om lag 90 % av befolkningen bor på tettstedet Sørland. Her finner man butikkene, fiskeindustri, bilverksted og det meste av servicetilbud i kommunen. På nordsiden av øya ligger Lofotens eldste kirke.

Værøy har 10-årig grunnskole med ca. 70 elever og full barnehagedekning.

Kommunen har daglig ferge- og helikopterforbindelse med Bodø, og fergeforbindelse med Moskenes (fastlands Lofoten) flere dager i uka.

jobs.title: Livsglad dame i Ytre Sandviken søker fleksible assistenter som liker å være aktive
jobs.employer: MIO BPA AS AVD KONTOR BERGEN
jobs.description:
📍 Arbeidsgiver: Mio BPA
📅 Tiltredelse: Snarest
📌 Stillingstype: Tilkalling
⏰ Arbeidstid: Hovedsakelig dagtid, noe kveld ved behov

Hei!

Jeg er en sosial og livsglad kvinne på 63 år som bor i Ytre Sandviken i Bergen. Nå ser jeg etter 1–2 fleksible assistenter som kan bli en del av BPA-teamet mitt og stille opp når det oppstår behov, for eksempel ved sykdom, ferie, fravær eller andre situasjoner. Fra januar kan det i tillegg være mulighet for mer arbeid og fast dag i uken.

Jeg liker å være aktiv, men setter også pris på rolige og gode dager. En fin dag for meg kan inneholde en tur med rullestolen i nærområdet eller i Byfjellene, matlaging og gjerne tid til å strikke, lese en god bok eller stelle med blomster på terrassen. Jeg liker også kafebesøk, shopping, musikk og gode samtaler, og trives godt når jeg kan være ute i naturen eller sosial med venninner.

Jeg tøyer og trener hjemme daglig, og trener også ukentlig hos fysioterapeut og i basseng. Det er derfor en fordel om du liker fysisk aktivitet, siden du blant annet vil kunne være med på bassengtrening og må bistå meg under tøying og trening hjemme.

Jeg har en nevromuskulær sykdom som gjør at jeg bruker rullestol og trenger hjelp til praktiske og daglige gjøremål. Med din assistanse kan jeg spare krefter og bruke energien min på det som gir meg livskvalitet og glede.

Arbeidstid og behov

Jeg har et godt BPA-team rundt meg, men ønsker nå å styrke det med 1–2 tilkallingsvikarer som kan stille opp ved behov. Dette passer godt for deg som har en fleksibel hverdag og ønsker en meningsfull ekstrajobb ved siden av annen jobb, studier eller andre forpliktelser.

Behovet vil variere, og vakter kan blant annet oppstå i forbindelse med sykdom, ferie og annet fravær. Arbeidstiden er hovedsakelig på dagtid, fra ca. kl. 08.30 til kl. 16.00. Enkelte kveldsvakter kan også forekomme.

Det er fint om du har mulighet til å stille opp på litt kort varsel innimellom. Etter hvert kan det også bli muligheter for mer arbeid eller en fast stilling når behovet mitt øker.

Skriv gjerne litt om tilgjengeligheten din i søknaden og når du vanligvis har mulighet til å jobbe.

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Praktisk bistand i hverdagen, både hjemme og ute

  • Hjelp til daglig tøying og lett trening, og bassengtrening

  • Hjelp til påkledning og personlig stell etter behov

  • Husarbeid og matlaging

  • Følge meg på tur, kafébesøk, shopping og kulturelle aktiviteter

  • Kjøring av vanlig bil eller HC-bil med automatgir

  • Bidra til at jeg kan leve et aktivt og sosialt liv

Personlige egenskaper jeg ser etter

  • Du er pålitelig og tar ansvar

  • Du har godt humør og en positiv innstilling

  • Du er fleksibel og tilpasningsdyktig

  • Du liker å være ute og trives med aktivitet

  • Du er komfortabel med både aktive og roligere arbeidsdager

  • Kjemi og felles interesser betyr mye for meg

Kvalifikasjoner

  • Førerkort klasse B og trygg på å kjøre bil med automatgir

  • Erfaring fra BPA eller lignende er en fordel, men ikke et krav

  • Erfaring innenfor helse- og omsorgssektoren er en fordel

  • Gode norskkunnskaper

  • Personlig egnethet vektlegges

Hos meg får du en meningsfull og variert ekstrajobb i trivelige omgivelser. Noen dager er aktive og sosiale, mens andre er roligere. Det viktigste for meg er å finne assistenter jeg trives godt sammen med, og som jeg kan stole på når behovet oppstår.

Hvis dette høres ut som noe for deg, håper jeg du sender inn en søknad. Jeg gleder meg til å bli kjent med deg! 😊

Grunnet stillingens natur oppfordres særlig kvinner til å søke. Aktuelle kandidater kontaktes for intervju fortløpende, og vi ansetter så snart vi finner de rette kandidatene.

Ved spørsmål angående stillingen, kontakt rekrutterer Petter Skog på e-post: petter.skog@mio.no. Søknader sendes inn via eget søknadsskjema.

Vi tilbyr

  • En meningsfylt jobb

  • Erfaring fra helse- og omsorgssektoren

  • Lønn etter tariff: Timelønn 236,49 kr, kveldstillegg på 67 kr og helgetillegg på 70 kr

  • Teoretisk og praktisk opplæring, i tillegg til relevante kurs

  • Tett oppfølging med BPA-koordinator

  • Fordelsportal med rabattavtaler på blant annet hotell, hvitevarer og nettbutikker

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Mio BPA er en av Norges største BPA-leverandører. Vi har lang og bred erfaring, og leverer tjenester i over 150 norske kommuner. Vi har som mål å levere Norges beste BPA-tjenester, og tilbyr skreddersydde BPA-løsninger i henhold til den enkeltes behov. Det er viktig for oss å kunne gi våre kunder den aller beste tjenesten og at vi er den beste arbeidsplassen for våre medarbeidere. Mio BPA er en del av Mio-konsernet som er 100 prosent norskeid.

Vi jobber alltid ut ifra disse verdiene:

• Respektfull: Vi er åpne og møter andre med vennlighet og forståelse. Alle vi møter skal føle seg sett, anerkjent for den de er og verdifulle.

• Pålitelig: Vi er til å stole på og holder det vi lover. Vi opptrer på en måte som gir tillit og trygghet.

• Modig: Vi utgjør en forskjell for hvert enkelt menneske vi møter. Vi gir mennesker et bedre liv og frihet til å leve slik de vil.

jobs.title: Loopbaanadviseur
jobs.description:
Grensarbeid zoekt voor Zuyd Hogeschool een Loopbaanadviseur

Help jij medewerkers regie te nemen over hun loopbaan en draag je zo bij aan een wendbare en toekomstbestendige hogeschool?

Als loopbaanadviseur help jij medewerkers met inzicht, richting en vertrouwen om hun volgende stap te zetten. Je bent een sparringspartner en luisterend oor voor medewerkers en helpt hen om zelf regie te nemen over hun loopbaan en duurzame inzetbaarheid. Op die manier draag je bij aan een wendbare en toekomstbestendige hogeschool waar medewerkers vitaal en met plezier werken.

Over de functie

Als loopbaanadviseur help je medewerkers bij hun loopbaanontwikkeling, persoonlijke groei en vitaliteit.

  • je voert individuele adviesgesprekken met medewerkers om de vraag of behoefte te verhelderen
  • je begeleidt de medewerker middels een loopbaancheck (3 a 4 gesprekken) met als doel het verhelderen van de drie belangrijkste loopbaanvragen: Wie ben ik, wat kan ik en wat wil ik?
  • je adviseert over inzet van testen of verwijst naar (loopbaan)coaches, bedrijfsarts, arboadviseur etc.
  • je stemt af met adviseurs Mens en Organisatie en leidinggevenden bij mobiliteitsvraagstukken van medewerkers
  • je signaleert trends, behoeften en ontwikkelingen in loopbaanvragen en maakt deze bespreekbaar met collega adviseurs van het team of van de dienst Mens en Organisatie
  • je draagt zorg voor het zorgvuldig administreren van loopbaantrajecten
  • je neemt deel aan het overleggen met collega-adviseurs van de dienst Mens en Organisatie o.a. over vitaliteit en duurzame inzetbaarheid.

Waarom werken bij Zuyd?

Werken bij Zuyd is bijdragen aan een ambitieuze hogeschool met sterke regionale wortels en een duidelijke blik op de toekomst. Met ruim 14.000 studenten en 30 lectoraten bouwen we elke dag aan onderwijs en onderzoek dat ertoe doet. We geloven in ieders unieke talenten. Het begint met jou - en we doen het samen. Bij Zuyd vind je kleinschalig en persoonlijk onderwijs, een open cultuur en een gedeelde passie voor ontwikkeling. Niet voor niets zijn we in de Keuzegids 2026 uitgeroepen tot beste grote hogeschool van Nederland. Hier krijg je de ruimte om te groeien en impact te maken - voor studenten, het werkveld en de regio.

Het team en de werkomgeving

Het team Vitaliteit, Arbo en Loopbaan maakt onderdeel uit van de dienst Mens en Organisatie. Binnen dit team werk je direct samen met 4 collega’s, waarvan twee collega loopbaanadviseurs. Die samenwerking zorgt voor frisse perspectieven, inhoudelijke verdieping en een prettige dynamiek. De sfeer binnen het team is open, professioneel en collegiaal. We zoeken elkaar actief op, delen kennis en dagen elkaar uit om steeds tot de beste oplossingen te komen voor medewerkers.

Wat wij vragen

Voor deze rol zoeken wij een loopbaanadviseur die zelfstandig aan de slag kan en het team meteen kan versterken. Jij brengt het volgende mee:

-Een afgeronde de hbo-opleiding, bij voorkeur in HRM, aangevuld met kennis van duurzame inzetbaarheid

-Kennis van en ervaring met diverse gespreks- en coachingstechnieken

-Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als loopbaanadviseur, waardoor je snel zelfstandig aan de slag kunt

-Naast zelfstandigheid ook een collegiale en samenwerkingsgerichte houding

-Een goede luisteraar met sterke communicatieve en reflectieve vaardigheden

-In staat om iemands kwaliteiten te vertalen naar concrete loopbaanmogelijkheden;

-Op korte termijn beschikbaar.

Over de functie

  • Begeleiden van studenten tijdens individuele opdrachten bij de keuze en toepassing van specialistische apparatuur en/of programmatuur en bij het verzamelen, verwerken en interpreteren van gegevens.
  • Mede-evalueren van practica en aandragen van verbetersuggesties ter bevordering van de kwaliteit van het onderwijs.
  • In opdracht ontwikkelen en schrijven van instructiemateriaal ten behoeve van het onderwijs.
  • Ondersteunen van studenten, medewerkers en stagiairs bij de ontwikkeling van kennis en vaardigheden binnen het onderwijsdomein.
  • Bijdragen aan de uitvoering van onderwijs ter ondersteuning van de vraagstelling van opdrachtgevers en de verdere ontwikkeling van het vakgebied.

Waarom werken bij Zuyd?

Werken bij Zuyd is bijdragen aan een ambitieuze hogeschool met sterke regionale wortels en een duidelijke blik op de toekomst. Met ruim 14.000 studenten en 30 lectoraten bouwen we elke dag aan onderwijs en onderzoek dat ertoe doet. We geloven in ieders unieke talenten. Het begint met jou - en we doen het samen. Bij Zuyd vind je kleinschalig en persoonlijk onderwijs, een open cultuur en een gedeelde passie voor ontwikkeling. Niet voor niets zijn we in de Keuzegids 2026 uitgeroepen tot beste grote hogeschool van Nederland. Hier krijg je de ruimte om te groeien en impact te maken - voor studenten, het werkveld en de regio.

Het team en de werkomgeving

ACSAI is een relatief nieuwe academie op het gebied van wetenschap en technologie. Je maakt deel uit van een team bestaande uit docenten, onderzoekers, ondersteunend personeel en het management, dat in een professionele en vriendelijke omgeving bijdraagt aan het onderwijs. Samen zetten we ons in om jong talent en professionals van over de hele wereld te inspireren om interesse te krijgen in Data Science, AI en Technische informatica en om in Limburg te komen wonen en werken

Wat wij vragen

  • Een afgeronde bachelor- of masteropleiding in een relevant vakgebied
  • Beschikt over professionele beheersing van de Engelse taal op C1-niveau en van de Nederlandse taal op minimaal NT2-niveau
  • Beschikt over aantoonbare praktische programmeerkennis en -ervaring en heeft affiniteit met wiskunde en statistiek
  • Is in staat deze kennis te vertalen naar praktisch toepasbare oplossingen
  • Beschikt over goede mondelinge en schriftelijke communicatieve vaardigheden en kan effectief samenwerken in multidisciplinaire teams
  • Heeft affiniteit met onderwijs en begeleiden van jongeren
  • Kan goed zelfstandig werken en heeft een praktische, hands-on mentaliteit
  • Is een teamspeler die goed kan samenwerken in multidisciplinaire teams. Co- creatie is key.

jobs.title: Kreftkoordinator - 100 % fast stilling
jobs.description:
Enhet Hjemmetjenester består av; Fagutviklingssykepleier, BPA-koordinator, Demenskoordinator, Kreftkoordinator, Innsatsteam, Praktisk bistand, Dagsenteret, Granheimtunet bemannede omsorgsboliger, Hjemmetjenesten nord og Hjemmetjenesten sør.

Vil du gjøre en forskjell for kreftpasienter og deres pårørende?
Vi søker en engasjert og kompetent kreftkoordinator som ønsker å bidra til helhetlige, trygge og koordinerte tjenester for personer med kreftsykdom og deres nærmeste. Som kreftkoordinator vil du være et viktig kontaktpunkt for kreftpasienter, pårørende og samarbeidspartnere. Stillingen innebærer tett samarbeid med fastleger, spesialisthelsetjenesten, hjemmetjenesten, forvaltningen og andre relevante aktører for å sikre gode pasientforløp.
Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Gi råd, veiledning og oppfølging til kreftrammede og pårørende
  • Bidra til å tilrettelegge for at kreftrammede kan bo i egen bolig så lenge som mulig og tilrettelegge for hjemmedød om det er ønskelig
  • Bistå og tilrettelegge for lindrende behandling og omsorg ved livets slutt
  • Gi støttesamtaler
  • Koordinere og samordne tjenester og sikre helhetlige pasientforløp
  • Være bindeledd mellom kommunehelsetjenesten, fastlege, spesialisthelsetjenesten og andre samarbeidspartnere
  • Kartlegge behov og bidra til at pasienter får nødvendig informasjon og støtte
  • Delta i tverrfaglig samarbeid og fagutvikling
  • Bidra til kompetanseheving innen kreftomsorg i kommunen
  • Delta i utvikling av tjenester som styrker livskvalitet og mestring for pasienter og pårørende
  • Delta i ressurssykepleienettverket i palliasjon i Ahus sitt opptaksområde og bidra med kompetanseheving.
  • Samarbeider med frivillige i Kreftforeningen i forhold til Temakafe i Follo
  • Delta i nettverk for kreftkoordinatorer i Follo/ Romerike 
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Autorisert sykepleier
  • Førerkort klasse B
  • Videreutdanning/master innen kreftsykepleie
  • Erfaring fra kreftomsorg, palliasjon eller annen relevant helse- og omsorgstjeneste
  • Erfaring med kollegaveiledning og undervisning
  • God kjennskap til kommunale helse- og omsorgstjenester
  • Gode digitale ferdigheter og evne til å dokumentere i aktuelle fagsystemer
  • God muntlig og skriftlig fremstillingsevne på norsk
Personlige egenskaper
  • Har gode relasjonelle ferdigheter og evne til å skape tillit
  • Er positiv og bidrar til et godt arbeidsmiljø
  • Er trygg, tydelig, selvstendig og engasjert i faget og setter pasienten i fokus
  • Er strukturert og prioriterer oppgaver på en god måte, også i perioder med høyt arbeidstempo
  • Trives med en variert arbeidshverdag
  • Evner å bevare ro og oversikt i komplekse situasjoner, og sikrer fremdrift i et arbeidsfelt som krever tett koordinering mellom flere tjenester, pasienter, pårørende og samarbeidspartnere
  • Har god samarbeidskompetanse og trives i tverrfaglige team
  • Er fleksibel og løsningsorientert
  • Har evne til å møte mennesker i krevende livssituasjoner med empati og respekt

Det vil i tilsettingen bli lagt stor vekt på motivasjon for stillingen og personlig egnethet.

Vi tilbyr
  • Lønn i henhold til vår lokale lønnspolitikk, bl.a. med tillegg for utvidet kompetanse og ansvar for enkelte stillinger
  • Personlig og faglig utvikling gjennom utfordrende og interessante arbeidsoppgaver
  • Pensjons-, bank- og låneordninger i KLP. Arbeidsgiver betaler mellom 15-22 % av premie til ytelsesbasert- livslang pensjonsordning og gruppelivsforsikring
  • For tiden fritidsulykkesforsikring
KontaktinformasjonMarion Larsen, Enhetsleder Hjemmetjenester, +47 94021404
ArbeidsstedTunveien 2
1430 Ås
Nøkkelinformasjon:Arbeidsgiver: Ås kommune

Referansenr.: 5181215936
Stillingsprosent: 100%
Fast
Startdato: 01.01.2027
Søknadsfrist: 06.10.2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

En arbeidsplass i vekst - kun 19 minutter fra Oslo S
Ås kommune er i sterk vekst og søker flere dyktige og engasjerte medarbeidere. Vi tilbyr varierte og meningsfulle oppgaver i en organisasjon med høye ambisjoner for tjenestekvalitet, klima og bærekraft, digital utvikling og god forvaltning.

Ås sentrum utvikles til å bli en viktig regional by med utbygging av boliger, næringsliv og infrastruktur. Kommunen har et rikt kulturliv, aktive lokalsamfunn og attraktive arbeidsplasser – blant annet NMBU, Tusenfryd og en sterk landbruksnæring i et vakkert kulturlandskap.
 
Vi søker medarbeidere som vil bidra til å løse samfunnsoppdraget vårt på en profesjonell og framtidsrettet måte. Våre verdier er ansvarlig, tydelig og inkluderende, og vi ser etter deg som kan etterleve verdiene som kollega og i oppgaveløsning. Hos oss får du utviklingsmuligheter i en organisasjon med tydelige mål og stort engasjement.

Velkommen til Ås – en kommune i vekst i hjertet av Follo.

jobs.title: Underviser til maskinmester- og skibsingeniøruddannelsen på MARTEC
jobs.employer: Den selvejende institution MARTEC - Maritime and Polytechnic College
jobs.description:
MARTEC søger en underviser med stærke tekniske kompetencer, eksempelvis inden for energi- eller maskinteknik, og et ønske om at være med til at uddanne fremtidens maskinmestre og skibsingeniører. Stillingen omfatter både undervisning og deltagelse i forsknings- og udviklingsaktiviteter i samarbejde med erhvervet og universiteter.


Om stillingen

Som underviser på MARTEC bliver du en del af et stærkt fagligt miljø, hvor undervisere og erhverv samarbejder om at uddanne fremtidens maritime og tekniske specialister. Undervisningen er praksisnær og kobler teori, teknologi og anvendelse – med fokus på den grønne omstilling i Det Blå Danmark. Stillingen giver mulighed for at kombinere undervisning med praksisnær forskning og teknologisk udvikling.

Undervisningen tilrettelægges med udgangspunkt i dine faglige kompetencer og interesser og kan blandt andet omfatte:

  • Termiske maskiner og energisystemer

  • Konstruktion, materialer og tekniske beregninger

  • Maritime installationer, drift og vedligehold


Dine opgaver

  • Undervise og vejlede studerende på maskinmester- og skibsingeniøruddannelsen

  • Udvikle og ajourføre undervisningsforløb i samarbejde med kolleger og erhvervsliv

  • Bidrage til efter- og videreuddannelsesaktiviteter

  • Deltage i praksisnære forsknings- og udviklingsprojekter

  • Bidrage til faglig og pædagogisk udvikling

  • Indgå i tværfaglige samarbejder på tværs af MARTECs uddannelser


Undervisning er stillingens primære opgave, men du forventes også at bidrage til MARTECs forsknings- og udviklingsaktiviteter, som er en integreret del af vores uddannelsesmiljø.

Kvalifikationer

  • Relevant videregående uddannelse, fx maskinmester, energi-, maskin- eller skibsingeniør, eller dual skibsofficer.

  • Relevant erhvervserfaring fra den maritime eller tekniske sektor er en fordel.

  • Faglig indsigt i et eller flere af de nævnte undervisningsområder.

  • Interesse for undervisning, vejledning og pædagogisk udvikling.

  • Gode samarbejdsevner og lyst til at bidrage til et tværfagligt miljø.

  • Gerne erfaring med udviklings- eller forskningsprojekter i samarbejde med erhverv eller uddannelsesinstitutioner.

  • Beherskelse af dansk og engelsk på undervisningsniveau.


Hvis du ikke allerede har pædagogiske kvalifikationer, skal du forvente at gennemføre MARTEC’s adjunktforløb som en del af ansættelsen.

Vi tilbyder

  • Mulighed for at præge udviklingen af fremtidens maritime og tekniske uddannelser.

  • Høj grad af faglig frihed og mulighed for kompetenceudvikling.

  • Et stærkt fagligt fællesskab med engagerede kolleger og tæt kontakt til erhvervslivet.

  • Moderne laboratorier, simulatorer og værkstedsfaciliteter.


Ansættelsesvilkår

Stillingen er en fuldtidsstilling efter gældende overenskomst og stillingsstruktur for undervisere ved maritime og tekniske videregående uddannelsesinstitutioner.

Arbejdssted: Frederikshavn

Tiltrædelse: 1. januar 2027 eller snarest muligt derefter.

Ansøgning

Send din ansøgning med CV, eksamensbeviser og eventuel dokumentation for undervisnings- eller udviklingsaktiviteter.

Yderligere oplysninger fås hos Brian Thomsen bth@martec.dk eller 20325269.

jobs.title: Auton fiksaus ja korjaus
jobs.description:
Monipuolinen autoalan työntekijä / autopesulan työntekijä

Etsimme yritykseemme monipuolista ja motivoitunutta autoalan työntekijää. Yrityksemme tarjoaa auton pesu-, puhdistus- ja viimeistelypalveluita sekä teemme tarpeen mukaan erilaisia autojen huolto- ja korjaustöitä.

Etsimme henkilöä, jolla on käytännön kokemusta useista autoalan työtehtävistä ja joka pystyy työskentelemään itsenäisesti sekä huolellisesti.

Työtehtäviin kuuluu esimerkiksi:

Vähän ymmärrystä sähköautoista.

\* autojen ulkopesu ja perusteellinen puhdistus

\* autojen sisäpuhdistus ja detailing

\* auton maalipinnan kiillotus ja myllytys

\* maalipinnan viimeistely ja mahdolliset pienet maalaustyöt

\* auton korin ja maalipinnan käsittely

\* autojen perustason huolto- ja korjaustyöt

\* moottorin ja auton teknisen toiminnan ymmärtäminen

\* auton vianmäärityksen avustavat tehtävät

\* moottorin toimintaan ja optimointiin liittyvien asioiden ymmärtäminen

\* muut autopesulan ja autokorjaamon päivittäiset tehtävät.

Edellytämme hakijalta:

\* aikaisempaa työkokemusta autoalalta

\* käytännön osaamista auton pesusta, puhdistuksesta ja kiillotuksesta

\* ymmärrystä autojen rakenteesta ja tekniikasta

\* huolellista ja vastuullista työotetta

\* kykyä työskennellä itsenäisesti

\* hyvää motivaatiota oppia uusia työtehtäviä

\* valmiutta tehdä monipuolisia autoalan työtehtäviä.

Eduksi katsotaan erityisesti se, että hakijalla on kokemusta sekä autonhoidosta että autojen teknisistä korjaus- ja huoltotehtävistä. Arvostamme henkilöä, joka ymmärtää auton kokonaisuutena eikä ainoastaan autonpesua.

Työ on käytännönläheistä ja työtehtävät vaihtelevat asiakkaiden ja yrityksen tarpeiden mukaan. Sopiva henkilö voi osallistua myös yrityksen toiminnan kehittämiseen ja uusiin autoalan palveluihin.

Kielitaito: suomen kielen osaaminen katsotaan eduksi. Muu kielitaito ei ole este, mikäli hakijalla on tehtävään vaadittava ammatillinen osaaminen.

Työsuhde: kokoaikainen / määräaikainen tai toistaiseksi voimassa oleva työsuhde sovittavasta järjestelystä riippuen.

Haemme ennen kaikkea monipuolista autoalan ammattilaista, jolla on käytännön osaamista, työmoraalia ja halua kehittyä.

jobs.title: Apartment cleaners- Vaasa
jobs.description:

**We are now looking for apartment cleaners in Vaasa**

As an apartment cleaner, you will be responsible for maintaining the cleanliness and safety of the client's premises. You will follow detailed instructions and checklists to ensure all areas meet the required hygiene standards. Attention to detail and accuracy will be essential in your role. Don't worry – we will provide thorough training and an induction to ensure you are well-prepared to succeed.

**You will succeed in your job if you have:**

- Experience in the cleaning industry

- Good organizational and interpersonal skills

- A positive service attitude and a responsible approach to work

- Valid B-category driver's license and access to a car, as the role requires travel between locations

- Fluency in Finnish or English, other languages a plus


**Why us?**

We give you responsibility, but you won't be alone. Our work community is diverse and fair - we get things done right the first time. You'll get a comprehensive induction and the opportunity to learn more. You'll be supported by your supervisor and meet your colleagues regularly, for example in team meetings. We use high-quality cleaning equipment and environmentally friendly products.

**The job in a nutshell:**

- **Location: Vaasa**

- **Permanent employment**

- **Hourly wage:** 12.59 € / h

- **Working hours per week:** 0-37.5 hours/week, **work on an as-needed basis**. Please note that this is **not** a full-time position; the number of working hours depends on operational needs.

- **Working hours:** from Monday to Saturday between 9:00 and 16:00

- **Fair employer** – we comply with collective agreement for workers in the property services sector


**Interested?**

If you recognize yourself from the description, don't hesitate - submit your application and join us to do work that really matters. With us, you'll be part of a professional team where cleanliness isn't just about cleaning - it's about safety, well-being and a smooth everyday life. Siskon Siivous Oy is a company founded in 1994, which takes good care of its employees and offers reliable and high-quality cleaning services to its customers.

jobs.title: Keittiön vuoropäällikkö, Kulman Kuppila, Raisio, Turun Osuuskauppa
jobs.description:
Primary location:
RAISIO

Myllyn kauppakeskuksessa sijaitseva Kulman Kuppila etsii tiimiinsä KEITTIÖN VUOROPÄÄLLIKKÖÄ!
Tehtävä on määräaikainen vuoden loppuun saakka. Työtä on 90 tuntia kolmessa viikossa. Aloitus mahdollisimman pian.

Keittiön vuoropäällikkönä varmistat, että arki rullaa sujuvasti ja toimit esimerkillisesti kaikissa työtehtävissä. Työ on monipuolista ja sisältää ruoan valmistusta buffetlounaan ja kahvilatuotteiden parissa, asiakaspalvelua sekä vuoron johtamista ja keittiön toiminnan organisointia. Työpäiväsi kuluvat pääosin keittiössä ja asiakaspalvelun parissa, ja johdat vuoroa omalla esimerkilläsi osallistumalla aktiivisesti käytännön työhön tiimisi rinnalla. Työtä tehdään arkisin ja viikonloppuisin vaihtelevissa vuoroissa kello 6.00–19.00 välillä.

Kulman Kuppilan valikoimasta löytyy herkkuja asiakkaiden päivän jokaiseen hetkeen aamupuurosta iltapalaan, maukasta kotiruokabuffettia ja maittavia kahvilatuotteita unohtamatta.

Millaista vuoropäällikköä etsimme?

Vuoropäällikkönä viet rohkeasti tiimiä eteenpäin kannustavalla otteella ja pidät arjen rullaamassa hyvällä organisointikyvyllä sekä oikeudenmukaisella johtamisella. Arvostamme innokkuutta kehittyä, vahvaa tiimihenkeä ja kykyä tuoda positiivista energiaa koko meidän mahtavaan porukkaan, myös kiireen keskellä. Odotamme hakijalta aiempaa kokemusta ravintolan tai kahvilan keittiössä työskentelystä sekä voimassa olevaa hygieniapassia. Eduksi katsomme alan koulutuksen sekä aiemman työkokemuksen vastuutehtävistä.

Vuoropäällikön palkka perustuu Matkailu-, ravintola- ja vapaa-ajan palveluita koskevaan esihenkilöiden työehtosopimukseen. Tuntipalkka on kokemusvuosista riippuen 15,06-16,34 €/h. Vuorotyössä lisät tuovat mukavaa lisää peruspalkan päälle. Lisäksi sinulla on mahdollisuus kannustepalkkioon, joka voi olla jopa 1,20 € per tehty työtunti.

Liity meidän porukkaamme, niin tarjoamme sinulle:
Ihan tavallisia töitä, epätavallisen hyvillä henkilöstöeduilla! Työskennellessäsi meillä, saat rahanarvoisia ostoetuja S-etukortillasi, kuten S-ryhmän ravintoloista –25 %,Sokos ja Emotion myymälöistä -15 % tai autopesusta –50 %

Työpäiviä poikkeuksellisen rennossa porukassa yhdessä Suomen innostavimmassa työpaikassa

Mahdollisuuden kerryttää osaamista sekä lisätienestiä tekemällä lisävuoroja muissakin TOK:n toimipaikoissa koko Varsinais-Suomen alueella

Kattavan perehdytyksen työtehtävääsi ja mahdollisuuden ammatilliseen kasvuun, jota tukevat S-ryhmän monipuoliset oppimis- ja valmennusmahdollisuudet


Jos tavalliset työt houkuttaa, laita hakemusta tulemaan 22.9.2026 mennessä! Olemme sinuun yhteydessä sähköpostitse tai puhelimitse 010 764 –alkuisesta numerosta. Kannattaa seurata myös roskapostia, sillä meidän viestit voi eksyä myös sinne.

Haluaisitko kuulla lisää tehtävästä ja Turun Osuuskaupasta? Keittiöpäällikkö Sanna Puikkonen kertoo mielellään lisää. Sannan tavoitat parhaiten arkisin klo 10-17 numerosta 010 764 4483.

Turun Osuuskauppa on osa S-ryhmää ja yksi alueensa suurimmista työllistäjistä. Meillä työskentelet vakaassa organisaatiossa, jossa pääset kehittämään osaamistasi ja rakentamaan entistä parempia asiakaskokemuksia yhdessä ammattilaisten kanssa. Me Turun Osuuskaupassa työskentelemme ihan tavallisissa töissä. Tavallisuus ei tarkoita, että meillä olisi tylsää tai osaamatonta porukkaa töissä – päinvastoin! Meillä on harvinaisen hyvä työilmapiiri, epätavallisen hyvät henkilöstöedut ja poikkeuksellisen paljon monipuolisia työmahdollisuuksia. 82 % työntekijöistämme suositteleekin meitä työpaikkana. Meitä tokkilaisia on reilu 2600, ja työskentelemme neljällä eri toimialalla. Työskentelemme pilke silmäkulmassa ja tavoitteenamme on olla asiakkaiden ykkösvalinta! Lue lisää Turun Osuuskaupasta: Tietoa meistä – TOK.

jobs.title: Inbound Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
Build with us

Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe.

Today, more than 2500,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow – with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable.

With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions.

We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of.

Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together.

 
 

Your impact

You'll be the engine of our sales team the first voice new businesses hear when they discover Mollie. That's not a small thing. Every inbound lead is a real company looking for a better way to manage payments, and you'll be the one who helps them find it. You'll move fast, think on your feet, and make sure no opportunity slips through the cracks.

This role is built for someone who wants to learn sales properly, from the ground up. You won't just be passing leads along you'll own the full sales cycle for smaller businesses, closing deals yourself and building the skills that will define your career. Alongside that, you'll sharpen your instincts through outbound prospecting, giving you a complete picture of how great commercial teams operate.

If you're ambitious, curious, and ready to grow fast in a company that's scaling across Europe, this is where you start.

 
 

What you'll ship

  • Manage inbound lead flow with speed and professionalism, ensuring every business that reaches out gets a sharp, timely first response

  • Qualify leads effectively by understanding each business's needs, challenges and goals and matching them to the right Mollie solution

  • Own the full sales cycle for smaller businesses, taking deals from first contact through to close

  • Route high-potential leads to the right Account Executives with clean, well-documented handovers that set the next stage up for success

  • Build pipeline through targeted outbound prospecting, complementing inbound work with proactive engagement

  • Keep CRM records accurate and up to date, and feed insights back to Sales and Marketing to help sharpen our acquisition strategy

 
 

What you'll bring

  • Fluency in French and English you're confident communicating clearly and professionally in both, written and spoken

  • Exceptional communication skills you know how to listen, ask the right questions, and get your point across without overcomplicating it

  • Genuine curiosity about business, e-commerce and technology you like understanding how things work and you're drawn to solving problems

  • Ambition and a coachable mindset you're hungry to grow, open to feedback, and motivated to keep improving

  • Resilience and a positive attitude you don't get thrown off easily, and you bring energy to the work even when things don't go to plan

  • Some experience in a sales or customer-facing environment is a plus, but not a dealbreaker we care more about drive and potential than a polished CV

 
 

Grow your way

At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms.

You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step.

No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way.

Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy.

If you're excited by the idea of building what's next, for yourself and for thousands of businesses across Europe, we'd love to hear from you. Apply with your CV (in English) using the form below.

Want a peek behind the scenes? Check out what life at Mollie is really like.

 
 

AI at Mollie

We believe in Always Be Shipping, and AI brings that philosophy to life across every team, every role, every day.

AI is core to how we build. It helps us move faster, simplify work and make smarter decisions, creating real impact for the businesses we serve. We're looking for people who are excited to use AI to shape the future of finance with us.

With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the Role:

As a Sales Engineer it’s your mission to show the value of Camunda and guide organizations planning to automate their core business processes.

You accompany prospective customers in their product evaluation of Camunda. You are responsible for achieving the product win, getting answers to all product related technical questions, and arranging all presales interactions driving the evaluation.

In this role you will partner with our Account Executives and Solution Architects, supporting you by conducting proof of concepts or handling other deeply technical discussions. You will help qualify opportunities and then help set and execute a sales strategy to achieve a win.

The effectiveness of Camunda's Sales Engineers is gauged by their ability to convert prospects into Camunda customers both efficiently and at a high rate.

This position requires a strong interest in cutting-edge software technologies. You should take pleasure in crafting sample code or custom demonstrations and exploring new technology, even if you're not highly experienced in software development. By empathizing with prospects, you better grasp their requirements and have engaging technical conversations, and excel at clarifying how Camunda's technology can benefit their business.

What you'll be doing:

  • Position potential quantitative and qualitative business value of Camunda

  • Develop individual Camunda evaluation plans and demos for our prospects

  • Conduct product demos and product related Q&A sessions

  • Support the completion of RFI / RFP documents

  • Team with Account Executives to develop accounts

  • Organize and execute pre-sales engagements

  • Implement code snippets

jobs.title: Technology Transformation - Senior
jobs.description:
Eight Advisory est un cabinet leader sur le marché du conseil financier et opérationnel, indépendant, spécialisé en Transaction, Restructuration et Transformation d’entreprises.

Nous accompagnons les dirigeants, les actionnaires, les banques et les investisseurs potentiels dans leurs décisions.

En très forte croissance depuis notre création fin 2009, Eight Advisory compte aujourd’hui plus de 1100 collaborateurs dont 129 associés et continue de se développer. Nous sommes présents en France, Belgique, Allemagne, Royaume-Uni, Suisse, Pays-Bas, USA, Espagne, Italie ainsi que dans une trentaine d’autres villes dans le monde à travers notre réseau de cabinets indépendants "Eight International".


Dans le cadre de nos missions, nous axons notre développement sur une approche mixte IT et financière, du diagnostic jusqu’à la mise en place des recommandations et nous intervenons en collaboration étroite avec les membres de la Direction Générale.

En rejoignant notre équipe Transformation IT, vous interviendrez principalement dans les contextes suivants :

  • Accompagnement des opérations M&A :

    • Dans un contexte de transaction, vous participerez aux « IT Due Diligences » dans lesquels vous présenterez un état des lieux de l’entreprise d’un point de vue IT : organisation de la DSI, stratégie et projets, infrastructure, applications, analyses des dépenses IT.

    • Dans un contexte de détourage d’actifs

      • Vous réaliserez une « IT Due Diligence » de ou des entités concernées en insistant sur les enjeux de dépendance et d’adhérence vis-à-vis du groupe / du vendeur ;

      • Vous évaluerez les éléments IT ayant un impact sur la valeur des actifs ;

      • Vous participerez à l’élaboration de plan de séparation et à la rédaction des TSA.

    • Dans un contexte d’intégration

      • Vous définirez la stratégie d’intégration de l’entité cible, la recherche de synergies, la définition et la déclinaison opérationnelle de projets d’intégration, l’optimisation des coûts et du planning d’intégration ;

      • Vous challengerez les propositions d’intégration d’éventuels prestataires.

      • Vous participerez au suivi des différents chantiers d’intégration.

  • Conduite de la transformation IT & Digitale :

    • Vous participerez à la définition de plans de transformation IT et digitale, visant à soutenir la stratégie de développement ou de reconstruction de l’entreprise ;

    • Vous travaillerez à l’élaboration de schémas directeurs : planning, coûts, ressources, priorisation des projets, etc. ;

    • Vous pourrez suivre et piloter les différents chantiers de ce schéma directeur pour en assurer le bon déroulement.


  • Pilotage et amélioration de la performance :

    • Vous assisterez nos clients dans l’amélioration et le contrôle de leur performance IT, en particulier à l’audit de projets IT et à la revue de la performance de la DSI ;

    • Vous accompagnerez nos clients dans la rédaction de cahier des charges, en les assistant dans le choix des outils répondant à leurs besoins ;

    • Vous participerez à la définition et mise en œuvre de plan d’actions impactant l’EBITDA et/ou la trésorerie (réduction des coûts IT, réorganisation de la DSI, optimisation des projets, etc.) ;

    • Dans le cadre d’un accompagnement de nos clients en situation de perte de rentabilité, manque de visibilité ou de compréhension des flux de la part des managers (actionnaires ou société mère), vous participerez à la réalisation de diagnostics mêlant finance & IT, à l’accompagnement à la renégociation de contrats, à l’élaboration de plans d’amélioration de la rentabilité et de rationalisation de la DSI, puis à la mise en œuvre opérationnelle.


Nous recherchons pour ces missions des candidats de formation supérieure (Bac+5 –école d’ingénieur ou école de commerce de rang A), ayant acquis une expérience probante parmi les suivantes :

  • Une expérience dans le conseil durant laquelle il/elle aura développé de solides compétences IT & digitales avec une appétence pour l’analyse des impacts financiers attendus.

  • Une expérience opérationnelle dans une structure reconnue pour son excellence dans les domaines informatiques et / ou digitaux.

  • Une bonne connaissances des outils présents sur le marché.

Vous êtes dotés de qualités relationnelles et analytiques reconnues. Curieux, dynamique, vous faites preuve d'esprit d'équipe et vous pratiquez couramment l’anglais dans le cadre de vos missions (la pratique d’une seconde langue étrangère sera un plus). Vous êtes motivé par le challenge d’intervenir dans des contextes à fort enjeux stratégiques marqués par des opérations de haut de bilan et/ou de retournement et d’élargir vos compétences sur les dimensions IT, financières et opérationnelles.

jobs.title: PhD Position(s) in Bioreceptive Design and Robotic 3D Printing for Living System Integration in Architecture
jobs.description:
SDU CREATE invites highly motivated candidates who wish to contribute to a regenerative built environment to apply for one or more PhD positions in Computational Design and Fabrication for Living System Integration in Architecture. The position(s) is expected to begin in January 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. The application deadline is 15 October 2026 at 23:59 CEST.

Scope of the work

The PhD position(s) is linked to the Villum CEBE programme, Civil Engineering and the Green Transition in the Built Environment, funded by the Villum Foundation. Within Research Field 2, Design for Regeneration, Circularity and Longevity, the research will develop architectural interfaces that support the establishment and growth of living systems, particularly photosynthetic communities, as a strategy for regenerative architecture. The focus is on enveloping surfaces in the built environment.

The project will focus on designing, testing and demonstrating, at architectural scale, porous mineral interfaces combined with hydrogels. Computational design, fabrication and environmental monitoring will be combined with cultivation experiments and biological assessment, targeting mosses, algae and cyanobacteria in collaboration with partner researchers in biology.

We seek candidates with primary expertise in one of two complementary research profiles:

  • Bioreceptive Design and Robotic 3D Printing: exploring how architectural geometry, material composition and 3D printing can create bioreceptive interfaces. The work will combine computational design, printable material development, toolpath generation and robot programming to develop porous mineral interfaces informed by biological requirements.

  • Living Material Design and Biological Performance: developing hydrogels incorporating living organisms for integration into porous mineral interfaces. The work will combine formulation, cultivation, sensors, automated monitoring and data analysis to evaluate hygrothermal behaviour, biological growth, photosynthetic activity and material performance.

Both profiles require an interest in integrating biological systems and processes into architectural design and construction. The successful candidate(s) will collaborate within the team to develop and validate the resulting interfaces.

The candidate(s) will also contribute to the Centre’s activities, including teaching in the MSc CREATE programme and the BSc programme in Civil and Architectural Engineering through teaching, workshops and co-supervision of student projects.

Focus Area and Research Project

The research will investigate how material composition, porous morphologies and hygrothermal dynamics can support biological establishment and environmental performance, while addressing durability, maintenance and integration into building envelopes. Environmental measurements will help establish relationships between interface design, climatic exposure, biological development and performance.

The successful candidate(s) will contribute to selected areas according to their expertise, working within a team with complementary skills:

  • Computational design of bioreceptive mineral interfaces for enveloping surfaces in the built environment

  • Development and characterisation of printable mineral materials

  • Robotic 3D printing, toolpath generation and fabrication process development

  • Formulation of hydrogels incorporating living organisms and their integration into printed scaffolds

  • Cultivation experiments and assessment of biological growth and photosynthetic activity

  • Sensor integration, automated monitoring and data analysis to evaluate hygrothermal behaviour, ecological and microclimatic performance

  • Fabrication and evaluation of full-scale architectural demonstrators, addressing durability, maintenance and sustained biological growth

About SDU CREATE’s Research Environment

The Centre for Computational Research in Emergent Architectural Technology and Engineering, SDU CREATE, is led by Associate Professor Roberto Naboni. The Centre investigates advanced concepts and applications in architectural engineering, focusing on computational design, construction robotics, and material innovation. SDU CREATE brings together an international research team working across architectural engineering, computer science, robotics, materials science, and biology. Its research develops sustainable, regenerative approaches to designing and constructing the built environment.

Located within the Faculty of Engineering at the University of Southern Denmark, SDU CREATE provides advanced laboratory facilities for robotic fabrication, additive and subtractive manufacturing, mixed reality applications in design and construction, and structural and mechanical testing. The facilities include industrial robotic systems, computational design platforms, and equipment for the experimental testing of materials, components, and structures. This environment supports interdisciplinary collaboration and partnerships with academic and industrial institutions in Denmark and internationally. The candidate(s) will work within a research culture that combines computational development with physical experimentation and full scale construction.

SDU CREATE is a partner in CEBE, a ten-year national research initiative funded by the Villum Foundation, in which Danish technical universities collaborate to advance the sustainability of the built environment within planetary boundaries. Within this initiative, SDU CREATE leads research in Digitalisation and Automation, RF4, and contributes to research in Design for Regeneration, Circularity, and Longevity, RF2. The programme provides a long-term research framework, access to national research networks, and opportunities for collaboration with academic and industrial partners.

Responsibilities

The successful candidate(s) will contribute to the development and delivery of CREATE’s research activities and laboratory-based investigations. Responsibilities include:

  • Conducting high-quality research within the defined research project and contributing original, scientifically rigorous outcomes

  • Conducting fabrication experiments and biological and environmental performance testing, including operation of robotic systems and laboratory equipment as relevant to the candidate’s research profile

  • Participating in CREATE’s research team activities, contributing to the development of design, fabrication, and testing frameworks

  • Developing and maintaining computational tools and workflows supporting the research activities

  • Assisting in teaching bachelor’s and master’s level courses and workshops, including co-supervision of thesis students and collaboration with interns in research-related activities

  • Disseminating research results through high-impact peer-reviewed publications and recognised international conferences

  • Sharing research outcomes through curated and high-quality outputs for digital platforms, exhibitions, and competitions

  • Contributing to the further development and maintenance of CREATE’s laboratory infrastructures and experimental facilities

  • Engaging with academic and industrial collaborators at the national and international level, including participation in the Villum CEBE research network

  • Assisting senior staff in the preparation of applications for external research funding

Engagement in these activities will evolve with the experience of the candidate(s), contributing to the Centre’s excellence and supporting their academic development, ideally towards future career advancement.

Candidate Requirements

Applications are invited from highly motivated candidates holding a Master’s degree in architecture, computational design, civil or architectural engineering, materials science, environmental engineering, biology, or other relevant disciplines related to the research areas. Candidates must demonstrate primary expertise in either Bioreceptive Design and Robotic 3D Printing or Living Material Design and Biological Performance, and the ability to contribute to shared design, fabrication and validation activities. Interdisciplinary experience connecting these areas is particularly valued.

Candidates must demonstrate:

  • Documented interest and foundational knowledge in bioreceptive design, living system integration or related research areas

  • Competence in Grasshopper and Rhino, advanced for the Bioreceptive Design and Robotic 3D Printing profile and at working level for the Living Material Design and Biological Performance profile, together with relevant programming skills such as Python or C#

  • For the Bioreceptive Design and Robotic 3D Printing profile: practical experience in computational design, toolpath generation and robotic 3D printing, together with an understanding of biological requirements relevant to design; experience developing porous geometries and printable mineral materials are particularly valued

  • For the Living Material Design and Biological Performance profile: practical experience in material formulation and biological experimentation or cultivation, together with competence in experimental measurement and data analysis; experience with hydrogels, sensor integration, automated monitoring or hygrothermal characterisation are particularly valued

  • Hands-on laboratory experience, including physical prototyping or specimen preparation, and experimental testing relevant to the selected profile

  • Demonstrated capacity to conduct, document and disseminate projects and research outcomes suitable for peer-reviewed publication

  • Strong proficiency in English, both written and oral

  • Strong ability to work effectively within interdisciplinary teams and to coordinate and collaborate daily

  • Strong communication skills across graphical, written and oral formats

  • A proven track record of involvement in research or innovation projects; experience in teaching assistance, peer-reviewed publications or engagement with academic or industry stakeholders is evaluated positively

Contact information

For further information about the position(s) and SDU CREATE’s activities, please contact the Head of Centre, Associate Professor Roberto Naboni, at ron@iti.sdu.dk. For additional information on the Centre’s work, visit the website at www.create-sdu.com. 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Find full information about how to apply as well as assessment and employment terms on our website!

Restaurant NOK i Randers søger en erfaren og ansvarsbevidst kok til en fast fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer om ugen.

Som kok hos Restaurant NOK får du en central rolle i køkkenet og i restaurantens daglige drift. Vi søger en alsidig medarbejder, der ikke alene står for tilberedning af mad, men som også kan tage ansvar for de øvrige opgaver, der er nødvendige for, at restauranten fungerer godt i det daglige.

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil bl.a. være:

• Forberedelse, tilberedning og anretning af restaurantens retter

• Klargøring og forberedelse af råvarer

• Tilberedning, opfyldning og løbende vedligeholdelse af buffet

• Planlægning af køkkenets daglige arbejde og koordinering af madlavningen

• Modtagelse, kontrol og korrekt opbevaring af leverede råvarer

• Modtagelse og håndtering af kundernes bestillinger

• Betjening af kunder og kasse efter behov

• Klargøring og pakning af mad ud af huset

• Sikring af korrekt fødevarehåndtering samt overholdelse af gældende hygiejne- og egenkontrolprocedurer

Vi lægger vægt på, at du som kok er fleksibel og kan fungere i alle områder af restauranten, når der er behov for det. Stillingen kræver derfor både køkkenfaglige kompetencer, ansvarlighed, overblik og vilje til at hjælpe med de forskellige opgaver, der opstår i løbet af arbejdsdagen.

jobs.title: Postdoc Position (2 years) in Manufacturing Technology & Industrial Management
jobs.description:
The Department of Technology and Innovation (ITI) at University of Southern Denmark (SDU), section of Engineering Operations Management, invites applications for a 2-year position as Postdoc in Manufacturing Technology & Industrial Management.  The position is open from December 1, 2026, and the job location is Odense, Denmark.

 

Job description  

Successful candidates will drive internationally competitive research, collaborate in and across disciplines, work closely with industry and attract competitive external research and innovation funding in collaboration with senior researchers. The candidates will play a key role in providing outstanding education, supervise students, and develop junior research staff. 

 

We offer 

We offer a vigorous international research environment with a balance of male and female researchers, excellent facilities, including the new Robotics and Additive Manufacturing Laboratories at University of Southern Denmark, a long-term strategic initiative created to support research, teaching, and industrial collaboration and experimentation. SDU expects to increase its’ collaboration with industrial companies and associations in the coming years. 

This position will imply collaboration with industrial partners in the Renewable Energy Sector. Examples can be vendors of wind turbines, electrification solutions, electrolyzers, biogas equipment, carbon capture, utilization and storage technologies etc. It can also be major owners / operators of renewable energy plants, as offshore wind turbine park operators, green hydrogen / methanol / ammonia plants etc.

Research will be done to support DK and EU in realizing ambitions for production of green energy at off-take prices competitive with energy from fossil fuels via scaling and industrialization, whether the energy is in the form of green electricity or green fuels for industry and transport. There will be specific emphasis on research into the interplay between business strategy, product design, manufacturing systems design, manufacturing technology choices and scenarios or plans for industrial scaling. In addition to that, the position offers the opportunity to shape our educational and research and innovation programs by contributing to teaching and supervision in areas of Manufacturing technologies of the future and Industrial Management to benefit from new developments in research fields, approaches and content.   

 

We expect 

Candidates must have a relevant PhD.

Commensurate with the seniority of the position applied for, the candidates must ideally have: 

  • An excellent standing in research and innovation

  • Documented experience and good track record with education and supervision on undergraduate or graduate level

  • Extensive experience with industrial collaboration: can be from working in partnerships with or within companies, but also industrial and NGO organizations 

  • Industry outreach and work experience will be assessed positively 

  • Research & innovation project management experience will be assessed positively 

  • International work experience, organizational drive and a team-oriented mindset

  • Good written and oral communication skills

  • Fluent in English, both spoken and written                   

Candidates must have experience and competence in several, but not all, of the following fields: 

  • Business, Manufacturing and Operations Strategy

  • Product / Service design for Manufacturing, Logistics and Sustainability

  • Systems Design and Engineering

  • Materials Science, Industrial processes & Future Manufacturing Technologies

  • Design, Operations & Maintenance of Manufacturing Systems

  • Lean Manufacturing / Logistics and Industry 4.0 / 5.0 

  • Discrete Event Simulation Methods, Agent Based Simulation & Technologies

  • Machine Learning, AI, LLMs & Data Science for Manufacturing and Supply Chain Operations

  • Cost-Benefit and Return of Investment Analysis

  • Life Cycle Analysis Methods 

  • Modelling and Simulation methods

  • Case study, Design Science, Action Research Methods

  • Project Management, Agile Methods, Scrum Methods

  • EU strategies and plan for decarbonization of industry and society 

  • UN Sustainability Goals and Dimensions,

Working experience from industry, also within the renewable energy sector, will be seen as positive add-on but is not a requirement to apply for the position. 

 

Contact information
Further information about the position may be obtained from Head of Section, Niels Gorm Maly Rytter, phone: +45 29103729 or email: ngry@iti.sdu.dk 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

  • Curriculum Vitae including information on previous employment, list of programming skills mastered by the applicant, and teaching and supervision experience.

  • Letter of motivation, including details on qualifications within the subject area (max. one page).

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).  

  • Complete list of publications.

  • Publications most relevant to the position on which the applicant wishes to rely on.

  • Summary and documentation of experience in teaching. 

  • A research statement may be included.

  • At least one letter of recommendation from supervisors or previous employers. Should your referees wish to send their letters directly to us, please have them use e-mail: tek-hr@tek.sdu.dk mentioning your name and the title of the position in the subject line. Please note that these also need to reach us before deadline.

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is October 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an expert or assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as a postdoc is temporary for an initial 2-year period, and the preferred start date is from December 1, 2026. Extension may be possible depending on available funding.

Employment as a postdoc requires academic qualifications at PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for postdoc as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

-

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).
