jobs.title: Forklift Driver (trukkikuski) to Föglö, Åland Islands for the Fish Industry, Permanent Position , AX- Föglö
jobs.description:
--- *Suomeksi alla* ---

We are now looking for a forklift driver for a permanent position in the natural paradise of Föglö, Åland Islands (a temporary position is possible if desired).

The job involves operating a forklift in various stages of production and storage, such as moving products, loading and unloading cargo, and ensuring the smooth flow of materials in the production area. The forklift in use is a counterbalanced electric forklift (brand: Linde). The work requires good precision, initiative, and the ability to operate safely in a busy environment. The working conditions are cool, around +2 – +6°C, so readiness to work in cold conditions is important. You will also drive the forklift on a slightly sloped yard. If necessary, you can also participate in other production-supporting tasks. At Kalaneuvos, you will become part of a skilled and truly collaborative "work family".

Who is this job suitable for?
We are looking for a communicative person who is capable of working independently and is not afraid to take initiative. Previous experience in operating a forklift is a requirement for this job. You will receive comprehensive training on the specific forklift model and the work environment. The job is suitable for someone who enjoys being close to nature, as the workplace is located on Föglö Island, in a scenic archipelago. You should be able to communicate in English to ensure smooth communication within the team.

- Working hours: full-time: 37.5h/week
- Salary: approx. 13-14.50 EUR/h, depending on experience
- Collective agreement: Food Industry collective agreement
- Employment: through Bolt
- Start date: flexible according to agreement
- The role has possibility to advance into bigger role

Information about the workplace and practical arrangements:
Föglö does not have city services: the island has K-extra, a library, and a gym, while other city services can be found in Mariehamn, 35 minutes by ferry + 30 minutes by car. You can also manage without a car on the island, as the workplace is close to accommodation and there is a bus to Mariehamn. If desired, we can arrange accommodation for you: you will typically stay with another employee in a two- or three-room apartment, and the rent is around 300-450 EUR, which may or may not include electricity/water, depending on the apartment (you will receive exact information with the job offer).

About Kalaneuvos:
Kalaneuvos is the largest player in the Finnish fish industry and a pioneer in fish processing, fish wholesale, fish import and export, and fish farming. Kalaneuvos has been producing high-quality fish products for over 40 years, focusing not only on product quality but also on modern production methods and employee well-being. The Kalaneuvos brand offers a wide range of delicious fish products. For more information: www.kalaneuvos.fi

Please apply for the job soon: the position will be filled as soon as a suitable candidate is found.

--- SUOMEKSI ---

Haemme nyt trukkikuskia vakituiseen työsuhteeseen luonnonhelmaan Ahvenanmaan Föglön saareen (halutessasi määräaikaisuus on mahdollinen).

Työtehtäviin kuuluu trukin käyttö tuotannon ja varaston eri työvaiheissa, kuten tuotteiden siirtäminen, kuormien lastaus ja purku, sekä materiaalivirran sujuvuuden varmistaminen tuotantoalueella. Käytössä oleva trukki on vastapainoinen sähkötrukki (merkki: Linde). Työ vaatii hyvää tarkkuutta, oma-aloitteisuutta sekä kykyä toimia turvallisesti kiireisessä ympäristössä. Työskentelytilat ovat viileät, noin +2 – +6°C, joten valmius työskennellä kylmässä on tärkeää. Ajat trukkia myös hieman kaltevalla pihalla. Tarpeen mukaan voit osallistua myös muihin tuotantoa tukeviin työtehtäviin. Kalaneuvoksella pääset osaksi ammattitaitoista ja todellakin yhteen hiileen puhaltavaa "työperhettä".

Kenelle työ sopii?
Etsimme kommunikaatiotaitoista ja itsenäiseen työskentelyyn kykenevää henkilöä, joka ei pelkää tarttua toimeen. Aiempi kokemus trukin käytöstä on vaatimuksena tälle työlle. Saat toki kattavan perehdytyksen kyseiseen trukkimalliin sekä työympäristöön. Työ sopii luonnon läheiselle henkilölle, sillä työpaikka sijaitsee Föglön saarella, saaristomaisemissa. Puhuthan englantia, jotta kommunikaatio työporukassa sujuu ongelmitta.

- Työtunnit: täydet tunnit: 37,5h/vko
- Palkkaus: n. 13-14,50eur/h, kokemuksen mukaan
- Työehtosopimus: Elintarvikealan TES
- Työsuhde: Boltin kautta
- Aloitus joustavasti sopimuksen mukaan
- Roolissa on hyvä mahdollisuus edetä

Tietoa työskentelypaikkakunnasta ja käytännön järjestelyissä:
Föglössä ei ole kaupungin palveluita: saarella on K-extra, kirjasto ja kuntosali, ja muutoin kaupungin palvelut löytyvät esim. Maarianhaminasta, 35min lauttamatkan ja 30min ajomatkan päästä. Saarella pärjää myös ilman autoa, sillä työpaikka on lähellä majoitusta ja Maarianhaminaan pääsee bussilla. Halutessasi järjestämme sinulle majoituksen: majoitut tyypillisesti toisen työntekijän kanssa rivitalokaksiossa tai -kolmiossa, ja vuokra on n. 300-450eur, ja sisältää, tai ei sisällä sähköä / vettä, riippuen asunnosta (saat tarkan tiedon työtarjouksen yhteydessä).

Tietoa Kalaneuvoksesta:
Kalaneuvos on Suomen kalateollisuuden suurin toimija ja alan edelläkävijä kalanjalostuksessa, kalatukkukaupassa, kalan tuonnissa ja viennissä sekä kalankasvatuksessa. Kalaneuvos on valmistanut korkealaatuisia kalatuotteita jo yli 40 vuoden ajan panostaen tuotteiden laadun lisäksi nykyaikaisiin tuotantomenetelmiin sekä henkilöstön hyvinvointiin. Kalaneuvos-brändin alta löytyy laaja valikoima herkullisia kalatuotteita. Lisätietoja: www.kalaneuvos.fi

Haethan työpaikkaa pian: paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

jobs.title: Senior People & Culture Partner
jobs.employer: Impact Fund Denmark (tidl. Investeringsfonden for Udviklingslande)
jobs.description:
Impact Fund Denmark has changed a lot in a short time. We have grown quickly, welcomed many new colleagues and are becoming a larger, more international investment organisation. The same goes for People & Culture and we need and experienced People & Culture professional to strengthen our deliveries in the next phase.

The next phase is about making that growth work well: helping teams come together, strengthening leadership and building and implementing people practices that are robust enough for a more complex organisation without becoming unnecessarily heavy.

We are looking for a senior People & Culture professional with a proven track record across the full HR agenda, including culture and organisational development. You will bring experience and judgement that strengthen the whole function, with the ambition and potential to be considered for the Head of People & Culture role within three to four years. We also welcome experienced former Heads of People & Culture who want to contribute at this level as an individual contributor.

You will serve the whole organisation, where you will partner closely with senior leaders on organisational, leadership, performance and people questions. You will also take responsibility for selected People & Culture priorities and projects across Impact Fund Denmark.

You will be a senior sparring partner to the Head of People & Culture and Executive Management, bringing the confidence and experience to challenge established thinking, shape our people strategy and lead its implementation. We expect you to contribute expertise that colleagues across People & Culture, including its leadership, can learn from.

You will report to our Head of People & Culture.

What you’ll be working on

A part of your role will be spent working directly with leaders across our investment organisation. The questions will vary: how a team should be structured, what capabilities we need next, how to address and build performance, how we strengthen succession, or what senior management needs to know before making a people decision.

You will:

  • lead culture and organisational development initiatives, translating our values and strategic priorities into everyday leadership behaviours, stronger collaboration and clear accountability for performance

  • advise senior leaders and Executive Management on organisational, capability, performance and complex people matters across headquarters and regional offices

  • prepare analysis, recommendations and decision material for Executive Management and, when relevant, the Board

  • support organisational and job design as teams, mandates and responsibilities evolve

  • advise on employee relations matters within local employment law and our agreements across headquarters and regional offices

  • use people data to identify patterns, challenge assumptions and support better decisions

  • take ownership of selected People & Culture projects that cut across the organisation

  • work with People Operations, Finance and Legal to ensure that people processes have clear approvals, appropriate controls and traceable documentation, supporting compliance and auditability under the Danish standards on public-sector auditing (SOR)

  • work closely with colleagues in Recruitment, People Operations and People Development, and coach and mentor People & Culture colleagues to strengthen their business partnering skills and prepare them for broader responsibilities

We are currently a relatively lean People & Culture function. That means there is not a specialist team to hand work over to. If a recommendation requires analysis, a presentation, a new process or careful implementation, you should be comfortable taking ownership and doing that work yourself.

What a good first year looks like

After your first year, we would expect that:

  • Change has moved beyond discussion and design. You have taken ownership of important organisational or capability priorities and helped turn them into practical improvements.

  • Core processes work well. Performance, talent and compensation processes in your area are consistent, useful and delivered on time. Leaders can explain and document their decisions, and demonstrate that people resources are used responsibly and effectively in a state-owned organisation.

  • Leaders trust your advice and judgement. Senior investment leaders involve you early as a trusted advisor and challenger when important organisational or people questions arise.

  • Decisions are better supported. Executive Management receives clear, well-argued recommendations and useful People material from you.

What we’re looking for

There is no single background that will make someone successful in this role, but you will need substantial experience dealing with the full People & Culture agenda, strategy and policy work, senior stakeholders and an organisation that has really great people and leaders with massive potential.

We would expect you to bring:

  • substantial experience in a broad senior HR Business Partner, People Partner or People leadership role in international organisations

  • experience advising senior executives directly on organisational and people decisions

  • demonstrated experience across the full HR agenda, including people strategy, culture and organisational development, recruitment, leadership development, performance, talent and succession, reward, employee relations and HR governance

  • practical experience with organisational design and complex employee matters

  • strong analytical skills and an ability to turn complicated information into a clear point of view and useful recommendations

  • evidence that you can take work from diagnosis through to implementation rather than relying on large specialist teams

  • solid knowledge of Danish employment law and HR practice; knowledge of local employment law across our regional offices is considered an advantage

  • professional fluency in Danish and English

It would be useful, but is not essential, if you also have experience with one or more of the following:

  • financial services, investment or another complex, knowledge-intensive organisation.

  • working with Executive teams and Boards or preparing material for Executives and Board discussions

  • international HR

  • a lean or smaller organisation where senior People professionals remain in delivery

  • compensation, People Analytics, talent or succession

Where the role sits

This is a senior individual-contributor role with no direct reports.

You will be the main People & Culture partner for our investment organisation, working directly with senior investment leaders. At the same time, you will own selected priorities that matter across Impact Fund Denmark and work closely with the Head of People & Culture.

The role will suit someone who likes that combination: being in the room for senior discussions, then staying close enough to the work to make sure something actually happens afterwards.

You should be comfortable moving between an Executive Management discussion, detailed analysis and the practical conversations needed to implement a decision.

Why join Impact Fund Denmark?

You will have close access to the Head of People & Culture and senior leaders across our organisation. You will have considerable scope to influence how we organise, lead and develop our people as Impact Fund Denmark grows and consolidates.

You will also be joining at a point where the organisation is evolving. We are building the people foundation for a larger and more professional international investor, which means some things are already well established while others still need to be shaped.

And the organisation's purpose is tangible. Our investments support green energy and infrastructure, financial services, sustainable food systems and healthcare in developing countries.

Practical details

  • Location: Østbanegade 135, 2100 Copenhagen Ø

  • Position: Permanent, full-time, 39 hours per week including lunch

jobs.title: Senior Talent Acquisition Partner
jobs.employer: Impact Fund Denmark (tidl. Investeringsfonden for Udviklingslande)
jobs.description:
Impact Fund Denmark has grown over the past few years, and many of our colleagues are still relatively new to the organisation. In 2027, our focus is on making that growth work well: strengthening the systems, processes and ways of working a larger organisation needs, while continuing to hire for our ambitions toward our 2027-2030 strategy.

Recruitment is an important part of that next phase.

We are creating a dedicated Senior Talent Acquisition Partner role to take ownership of how recruitment works across Impact Fund Denmark from attraction and sourcing to assessment, candidate experience and offer.

Hiring managers make the final hiring decision. Your role is to make sure they reach it through a strong, well-run and well-informed process.

You will report to our Head of People & Culture.

What you’ll be working on

You will own end-to-end recruitment across the organisation, covering both investment roles and corporate and support functions.

For each hire, you will take the process from the first conversation with the hiring manager through to offer. You will be responsible for keeping the process moving, maintaining a high standard and making sure both candidates and hiring managers know what to expect.

At the same time, you are responsible for anchoring the recruitment process in the organisation, training hiring manager or appointed recruitment panel, and meticulous documentation of the hiring process and decisions to ensure compliance.

That includes:

  • advising hiring managers on role definition, the candidate market and the right recruitment approach

  • delivering a professional and engaging candidate journey from start to finish, including a welcoming, seamless and positive on-site experience for arriving candidates

  • coordinating, overseeing and driving end-to-end recruitment processes in close collaboration with hiring managers

  • sourcing directly, mapping relevant markets and reaching out to candidates who may not be actively looking

  • Identifying, sourcing and vetting talents on different channels to find top-tier active and passive candidates, and conduct initial screening interviews to assess technical and interpersonal-skills as well as cultural alignment

  • screening and interviewing candidates and helping managers design structured, relevant assessments

  • managing timelines, expectations and communication from intake through to offer

  • briefing and managing external search or recruitment partners when we use them

  • setting and ensuring a consistent standard for job ads, interviews, candidate communication and hiring documentation

  • building talent pipelines and market knowledge for recurring or difficult-to-fill profiles

  • using recruitment data to improve hiring quality, timeliness and cost-effectiveness, and demonstrate responsible use of recruitment resources in a state-owned organisation

  • improving our recruitment tools, templates and ways of working over time

  • ensuring that selection criteria, candidate assessments, approvals and hiring decisions are clearly documented and traceable, supporting public-sector governance, compliance with applicable rules and internal policies, and auditability under the Danish standards on public-sector auditing (SOR)

  • contributing to selected People & Culture projects alongside recruitment where it makes sense

  • training and guiding hiring managers on recruitment processes and guidelines to drive fair, consistent hiring decisions

We use Talentech as our applicant tracking system and CatalystOne as our HR system.

What a good first year looks like

After your first year, we would expect that:

  • Recruitment has a clear owner. Hiring managers know where to go for advice and support, and there is a consistent professional standard across the organisation.

  • Processes are stronger and more consistent. Roles are well defined, assessments are structured, and recruitment decisions are properly documented.

  • Hiring processes keeps moving. Managers receive relevant, well-screened candidate fields, and processes keep momentum on the factors within your control.

  • We rely less on who happens to apply. Direct sourcing is used actively where needed, and external search partners are brought in selectively and managed closely.

What we’re looking for

This role needs someone who is comfortable owning recruitment rather than simply coordinating it.

You will need to bring:

  • Solid experience independently managing end-to-end recruitment

  • strong direct-sourcing experience, including outreach to passive candidates

  • experience recruiting into a professional, knowledge-intensive environment

  • confidence advising senior and demanding hiring managers

  • the ability to keep recruitment processes moving and hold people to agreed timelines

  • experience screening and interviewing candidates, with good judgement about assessment quality

  • strong structure, follow-through and attention to the documentation behind hiring decisions

  • professional fluency in Danish and English

It would be useful, but is not essential, if you also have experience with one or more of the following:

  • recruiting investment or financial-services professionals

  • executive search or other senior professional recruitment

  • briefing and managing external search or recruitment partners

  • market mapping, talent intelligence or proactive pipeline building

  • using recruitment data and metrics to improve processes

  • international recruitment

Where the role sits

This is a Lead role with no direct reports. You will have full ownership of the recruitment lifecycle, meaning you should be comfortable balancing high-level strategy and manager coaching with hands-on execution, including the day-to-day administrative and coordination tasks, candidate care and operational execution.

You will be the main point of contact for recruitment across Impact Fund Denmark and the person responsible for how recruitment is run and for its quality.

Hiring managers remain accountable for who they hire. You bring the candidate market knowledge, recruitment expertise and process that help them make those decisions well.

That means being willing to challenge a brief when necessary, being realistic about the market, keeping a process moving when other priorities compete for attention, and making sure candidate experience does not become an afterthought.

For specialist searches, or during periods of particularly high hiring activity, you will also work with HRBP colleagues and external search partners. For periods of low activity you will build adjacent HR capabilities and part take in leadership development,....

Why join Impact Fund Denmark?

You will have the opportunity to shape how recruitment is done across the organisation rather than inherit a narrowly defined part of the process.

You will work closely with the Head of People & Culture and with senior leaders across the organisation, including our investment teams.

The role is unusually broad for an internal recruitment position. One search may be for an investment professional with a highly specialised background; the next may be for a corporate or functional expert.

And the work connects directly to Impact Fund Denmark's purpose. Every person you help bring into the organisation contributes, in some way, to investments in green energy and infrastructure, financial services, sustainable food systems and healthcare in developing countries.

jobs.title: Seasonal Worker Wanted – Pumpkin Season 2026
jobs.description:
About Thorsbjerggaard

Thorsbjerggaard is a Danish farm specializing in the cultivation of edible pumpkins. Our products are supplied to many major Danish supermarkets and specialty stores. We also grow peas, squash, and watermelons.

All work is carried out on the farm, including cultivation, harvesting, washing, and packing.

A valid forklift certificate is an advantage and will be preferred.

The certificate must be valid for use in Europe.

Working Period

As soon as possible – end of March 2027

Working Hours

During warm periods, work usually starts at 5:00 a.m. and continues until around 12:00 noon. During busy periods, additional work in the afternoon may be required.

Working hours may vary depending on the weather and workload. Part-time work may occur. You will have at least one day off per week.

Language Requirements

You must be able to speak and understand English.

Wages

Monthly salary

Registered with the Danish tax authorities (SKAT)

Salary paid directly into your bank account, with a pay slip

Requirements

  • You must be at least 18 years old.

  • EU citizenship (a valid passport or national ID card is required).

  • Good physical condition, motivation, and a positive attitude.

  • Farm or harvesting experience is an advantage but not required.

  • A clean criminal record certificate from your home country.

We Expect You To

  • Be reliable and arrive on time.

  • Be flexible and willing to help wherever needed.

  • Work well as part of a team with people from different cultures.

  • Be able to communicate in English.

Accommodation

We have a campsite located on the farm, where you can rent a space in a caravan. Each caravan can accommodate up to four people.

Beds with mattresses are provided, but you must bring your own sleeping bag and bed linen.

The campsite offers access to toilets, showers, laundry facilities, shared cooking facilities (you prepare your own meals), and internet access.

The accommodation fee is all-inclusive.

The cost of accommodation in a caravan is DKK 70 per person per day. A refundable deposit of DKK 1,500 is required and will be returned if everything is left in the same condition as when you arrived.

Holiday Allowance

Holiday allowance will be transferred to FerieKonto and paid according to Danish holiday regulations.

Hygiene Rules

All hygiene regulations relating to the handling and harvesting of food products must be strictly followed. You will receive detailed instructions before starting work.

Failure to follow the hygiene rules may result in immediate dismissal without further warning.

What to Bring

  • Please remember to bring:

  • Sleeping bag

  • Warm clothing

  • Practical work clothes

  • Boots and waterproof clothing

  • Even in good weather, the plants can be very wet in the morning.

Important Documents

You must bring:

  • A valid national ID card (and passport, if possible)

  • A valid IBAN bank account in your own name

  • Documentation proving that you have health insurance in your home country

  • Tax Information 2026

  • You must bring documentation showing that you have a permanent address in your home country.

  • If you worked for us last year and have had other jobs since then, please bring documentation from your most recent employer.

  • If you are married, documentation of your marital status is required.

  • Please bring copies of all original documents, as well as English translations.

How to Apply

Please send your application and relevant documents to:

job@thorsbjerggaard.dk

If you do not hear from us within two weeks, please assume that your application was unsuccessful and that we are unable to offer you a position for 2026.

jobs.title: Animal Science Manager
jobs.description:
Alimetrics Research Oy is an established Finnish contract research organisation with 23 years of experience. We provide research and analysis services for international companies engaged in feed additive development. Since 2022, Alimetrics Research has been part of Associated British Foods. We employ 16 specialists, and our core scientific expertise is in the investigation and monitoring of gastrointestinal health indicators in production animals. Our administrative office and research laboratory are in Espoo. Additionally, we operate poultry and swine research farms in the Somero region.

Currently, our most important clients are companies developing health-promoting feed ingredients for production animals. In our typical assignments, we evaluate novel products using both proprietary laboratory models and controlled feeding trials in poultry and swine, study their modes of action, explore microbiological and immunological parameters related to health, and help our clients apply scientific information to their product development and marketing.

We are now seeking a highly capable Animal Science Manager to lead our feeding trial research activities and contribute to the continued growth of our business.

Education:

· An academic degree (preferably a PhD) in veterinary medicine, production animal science, animal nutrition, animal physiology, or a related field.

Key responsibilities:

· Leads the planning of poultry and swine feeding trials for clients.

· Schedules trials in accordance with agreed project plans.

· Designs experimental feed formulations for the trials.

· Leads scientific discussions with clients and drives sales of feeding trials.

· Takes responsibility for trial reporting to clients.

· Communicates with relevant authorities and applies for trial permits when required.

· Works closely with the Farm Manager.

· Collaborates with research institutes, universities, laboratories, industry partners, and internal technical teams.

Essential qualifications and characteristics:

· At least five years of relevant work experience and a strong understanding of production animals and diet formulation.

· Authorship of peer-reviewed scientific publications.

· Practical experience in handling live production animals.

· Good understanding of Finnish and EU regulations governing animal trials.

· Good organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities.

· Ability to work effectively in a matrix organisation with multiple stakeholders and under time pressure.

· Ability to work professionally and collaboratively with colleagues, customers, and research partners.

· A valid driving licence.

· Fluent written and spoken English.

Desirable qualifications and characteristics:

· Hands-on experience in statistical analysis and interpretation of animal performance data.

· Experience in feed additive product development and the animal nutrition industry.

· Finnish language skills.

The position is permanent and full-time and is based at Alimetrics Research in Espoo, Finland. The role requires frequent visits to our poultry and swine research farms in the Somero region and occasional travel to customer sites, scientific meetings, conferences, and research partners. Practical work associated with animal trials may occasionally require extended working hours.

The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading and developing a specialized engineering team within EEDC, supporting delivery of industrial automation and functional safety projects. The role combines people leadership, resource and capacity management, technical leadership, and direct project contribution when required, including acting as Lead Engineer on selected safety-related projects.

Main Responsibilities
Team Leadership & People Development
•    Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers and technical specialists.
•    Conduct performance, development, and career discussions in line with company processes.
•    Support employee engagement, team collaboration, retention, and succession planning.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and high-quality engineering delivery.
Resource, Capacity & Delivery Management
•    Manage team utilization, workload visibility, resource allocation, and project staffing priorities.
•    Support recruitment, onboarding, competency planning, and capability development for the team.
•    Coordinate with project managers, delivery leaders, and other engineering teams to secure adequate resource coverage.
•    Monitor team objectives and contribute to operational performance, productivity, and delivery reliability.
Technical Leadership – Functional Safety & SIS
•    Provide technical guidance and mentoring on Functional Safety Management (FSM), Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS), and related industrial automation topics.
•    Support functional safety lifecycle activities, including review of safety requirements, engineering deliverables, verification approach, and project execution practices.
•    Act as Lead Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Engineer on selected customer projects when business needs require direct technical contribution.
•    Support technical estimation, proposal reviews, project risk identification, and solution alignment for SIS, safety PLC, DCS, SCADA, and critical control applications.
•    Ensure that engineering outputs are aligned with applicable standards, customer requirements, internal quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and safety practices.
Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Support implementation of EEDC strategic initiatives, standard operating practices, and competency roadmaps.
•    Contribute to continuous improvement activities, quality management system adherence, and audit readiness where applicable.
•    Promote safe, compliant, and customer-focused execution across assigned engineering activities.
•    Collaborate with cross-border stakeholders and support regional or global delivery needs as required.

jobs.title: Špecialisti v oblasti databáz a počítačových sietí inde neuvedení
jobs.description:
Your responsibilities
Respond to customer support requests and technical incidents through the ticketing system.
Troubleshoot issues involving Linux servers, dedicated infrastructure, cloud environments, storage platforms, and network connectivity.
Analyze system logs, performance metrics, and monitoring events to identify the root cause of incidents.
Resolve problems related to server functionality, operating system configuration, performance, and service availability.
Coordinate with data centre technicians to perform hardware diagnostics and component replacements when required.
Escalate complex technical issues to engineering teams, providing complete troubleshooting details.
Keep customers informed about incident progress and communicate technical information in a clear and professional manner.
Maintain accurate case documentation, contribute to the knowledge base, and collaborate with internal infrastructure teams.

Required skills and experience
At least two years of experience in technical support, Linux administration, hosting operations, NOC, or a similar infrastructure-focused role.
Practical experience administering Linux distributions such as Ubuntu, Debian, CentOS, or equivalent.
Strong command-line skills, including process management, system services, user administration, permissions, package management, log analysis, and file systems.
Good understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, IP addressing, routing, SSH, HTTP/HTTPS, ports, and firewall concepts.
Basic knowledge of server hardware, storage technologies, RAID configurations, and infrastructure monitoring.
Experience working with ticketing systems, monitoring platforms, log management, or remote administration tools.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple issues simultaneously.
English proficiency at Upper-Intermediate (B2) level or above.

jobs.title: Dizajnéri a správcovia databáz
jobs.description:
Design, develop, and maintain Power BI reports and dashboards translating complex operational data into actionable insights for business operations stakeholders; ensure models are performant, scalable, and governed.

Build and maintain automated workflows and business applications using Power Automate and Power Apps, reducing manual effort across core operations processes (approvals, data collection, escalation routing).

Own the data layer: write and optimize DAX measures and Power Query transformations; connect to sources including SharePoint, Dataverse, SQL, and Snowflake where applicable.

Collaborate with business operations teams to gather, challenge, and translate requirements into technical solutions — including scope control and managing change requests.

Administer production and distribution of internal financial reports, compile various cross functional reports. Drive the reporting simplification and efficiency.

Prepare, clean, and analyze large datasets from various sources (ERP, operational, and financial systems).

Maintain solution documentation, workspace governance, and RLS (row-level security) configurations in line with organizational data access policies.

Troubleshoot and resolve incidents across the Power Platform environment; support end-user adoption through training and hands-on guidance.

Contribute to the Centre of Excellence (CoE) standards for naming conventions, deployment pipelines, version control, and template reuse across the team.

Work within a GBS or shared-services operating model, balancing multiple stakeholder demands with clear SLA management and transparent prioritization.

Collaborate with senior management and provide update on financial reports, progress and modifications. Explain the variances to senior leadership team.

Support data governance and documentation of data sources, logic, and model results.

Communicate findings and analytical results in a clear and actionable way to non-technical stakeholders.

Keep up to date with emerging trends in AI, machine learning, and Power Platform technologies.

jobs.title: Správcovia objektov
jobs.description:
Pravidelná údržba elektrotechnických zariadení a zabezpečenie ich plnej funkčnosti. Vykonávanie pravidelnej kontroly jednotlivých zariadení. Operatívne riešenie vzniknutých problémov na rozvádzačoch a iných elektr. zariadeniach. Zodpovednosť za pravidelnú údržbu prevádzky a opravy (voda, elektrika, výmena žiaroviek, opravy svietidiel, klimatizácia, vzduchotechnika). Hlavná činnosť je zameraná na fyzický výkon práce. Všetky údržbárske práce v areáli prevádzky. Bezodkladné riešenie vzniknutých problémov a nedostatkov a ich následné hlásenie kompetentným osobám. Znalosť technických parametrov a špecifikácie používaných prístrojov a zariadení. Zapisovanie hodnôt z plynomerov, vodomerov. Výpomoc pri kosení areálu, vysádzaní kvetináčov a udržiavaní poriadku v areáli prevádzky, odpratávanie snehu, výkopové práce. V rámci dosiahnutého vzdelania a kvalifikácie (získané osvedčenia) prevádza všetky pridelené údržbárske práce.
Výhody:Stravovanie zabezpečené zamestnávateľom za symbolickú úhradu. Po uplynutí skúšobnej doby nárok na: - možnosť výmenných rekreácii v našich zariadeniach, - príspevok na III.pilier DDS, - multisport karta, - nepravidelné odmeny. Jedná sa o prácu na 12-hodinové zmeny podľa harmonogramu od pondelka do nedele.

jobs.title: Správcovia systémov
jobs.description:
Poskytovanie technickej podpory používateľom pri riešení bežných problémov s hardvérom, softvérom a podnikovými aplikáciami. Evidencia, klasifikácia a riešenie používateľských požiadaviek a incidentov prostredníctvom tiketovacieho systému HALO. Inštalácia, konfigurácia a príprava pracovných staníc, notebookov, tlačiarní, mobilných telefónov a ďalších koncových zariadení. Podpora používateľov pri práci s Microsoft 365 a štandardnými kancelárskymi aplikáciami. Správa používateľských účtov, hesiel a prístupových oprávnení podľa interných postupov. Evidencia a aktualizácia inventára IT hardvéru a softvéru. Spolupráca pri nákupe, príprave a vydávaní IT techniky novým zamestnancom. Základná správa tlačového prostredia vrátane riešenia bežných problémov s tlačiarňami a skenermi. Podpora výrobných pracovísk pri riešení základných IT problémov ovplyvňujúcich výrobnú prevádzku. Spolupráca pri aktualizáciách operačných systémov, aplikácií a bezpečnostných nástrojov. Vykonávanie pravidelných kontrol pridelených IT systémov podľa definovaných postupov. Spolupráca pri vedení a aktualizácii IT dokumentácie, interných postupov a prevádzkových záznamov. Eskalácia zložitejších technických problémov na IT špecialistu alebo IT administrátora senior. Dodržiavanie pravidiel informačnej bezpečnosti a podieľanie sa na ochrane firemných dát a IT prostriedkov. Plnenie ďalších úloh v oblasti IT podpory podľa pokynov nadriadeného alebo potrieb spoločnosti.

jobs.title: Čalúnnici a podobní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Náplň práce Pracovná náplň nie je obmedzená len na nižšie uvedené činnosti a zamestnanec môže byť podľa prevádzkových potrieb zamestnávateľa poverený aj ďalšími súvisiacimi pracovnými úlohami. Výroba, čalúnenie, oprava a renovácia čalúneného nábytku (stoličky, kreslá, pohovky, postele a iný nábytok). Výroba a montáž čalúnenia pre motorové vozidlá vrátane kompletného čalúnenia interiéru, obkladov, dekoratívnych prvkov a zákazkových úprav. Meranie, strihanie, príprava a spracovanie poťahových materiálov (textil, koža, ekokoža a iné materiály). Montáž výplňových materiálov (pena, vatelín, pružiny, popruhy a ďalšie čalúnnické komponenty). Šitie poťahov na priemyselných šijacích strojoch podľa potreby výroby. Poťahovanie výrobkov a upevňovanie poťahových materiálov pomocou ručného a elektrického náradia. Oprava alebo výmena poškodených častí čalúneného nábytku a interiérov vozidiel. Kontrola kvality hotových výrobkov a dodržiavanie technologických postupov. Udržiavanie čistoty pracoviska, pracovných nástrojov a výrobných priestorov. Pomoc pri nakládke, vykládke a doručovaní hotových výrobkov zákazníkom. Riadenie služobného motorového vozidla pri zabezpečovaní rozvozu alebo prepravy materiálu, ak je držiteľom platného vodičského oprávnenia. Vykonávanie pomocných a upratovacích prác podľa potrieb prevádzky. Plnenie ďalších pracovných úloh súvisiacich s výrobou, montážou, servisom a prevádzkou spoločnosti podľa pokynov zamestnávateľa. Dodržiavanie predpisov bezpečnosti a ochrany zdravia pri práci (BOZP), protipožiarnych predpisov a interných smerníc zamestnávateľa. Požiadavky na uchádzača Minimálne 3 roky preukázateľnej odbornej praxe na pozícii čalúnnik alebo v obdobnej profesii. Skúsenosti s čalúnením nábytku a výhodou sú skúsenosti s čalúnením interiérov motorových vozidiel. Manuálna zručnosť, presnosť a zodpovedný prístup k práci. Schopnosť pracovať samostatne aj v tíme. Dobrý zdravotný stav a fyzická zdatnosť. Vodičské oprávnenie skupiny B je výhodou.
Výhody:Hradené, vlastná doprava zamestnávateľa

jobs.title: Opatrovatelia a asistenti v zariadeniach pre staršie osoby a osoby so zdravotným postihnutím
jobs.description:
Ak Ti nie je ľahostajný život ľudí ohrozených stratou bývania a s nepriaznivým zdravotným stavom, príď do Útulku a zariadenia opatrovateľskej služby sv. Lujzy de Marillac a pridaj sa k nám do tímu opatrovateľov! Ako opatrovateľ, opatrovateľka budeš mať možnosť: ​ • prispievať k zlepšeniu zdravotného stavu klienta formou starostlivosti o osobnú hygienu klienta, či pomoci pri presune na lôžko či invalidný vozík • zabezpečovať výdaj stravy, ako aj nevyhnutného ošatenia a obuvi • asistovať pri sprevádzaní klienta k lekárovi a bežných denných aktivitách • podporovať klienta pri každodenných činnostiach • vykonávať administratívne činnosti spojené s poskytovaním služieb klientom • podieľať sa na tímových poradách a skupinových supervíziach Láka Ťa práca opatrovateľa, ale máš obavu, či to zvládneš? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude sprevádzať šikovný kolega a neskôr budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať certifikovaný opatrovateľský kurz hradený organizáciou. Okrem toho Ťa počas roka čakajú vzdelávacie programy, ktoré Ti pomôžu pri práci s klientom Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce, ktorí by radi počas štúdia pretavili svoje doterajšie vedomosti pri priamej práci s klientom v praxi Týždenný pracovný čas je 37,5h (za mesiac to je 13-14 pracovných zmien). Práca je rozložená na denné a nočné zmeny (v priemere 5-6 nočných zmien mesačne). Denná služba v čase 7:45 - 20:15h a nočná služba v čase 19:45 - 8:15h. ☝️Čo je Útulok a ZOS sv. Lujzy de Marillac a aký Ťa čaká pracovný tím? V zariadení sociálnych služieb sa už 15 rokov venujeme pomoci ľuďom ohrozeným stratou bývania alebo skúsenosťou so životom na ulici, ktorí majú zdravotné ťažkosti a častokrát nemajú dostupné možnosti k doliečeniu svojho stavu. Práve u nás im poskytujeme celodennú starostlivosť s víziou zlepšenia či stabilizovania ich zdravia. V zariadení máme kapacitu 35 klientov, väčšinou v staršom veku. Aj napriek ťažkým životným skúsenostiam našich klientov neopúšťa radosť a snaha o riešenie svojho stavu. Počas týždňa sa klienti zapájajú do rôznych aktivít, ako ranné rozcvičky, prechádzky, návšteva galérie, trhov, spoločné varenie, výroba bezodpadových podpaľovačov a iné. Náš tím opatrovateľov aktuálne tvorí osem kolegov a kolegýň spolu s vedúcou opatrovateľkou, počas dňa sa stretneš aj s vedúcim a zástupkyňou zariadenia, ako aj so sociálnymi pracovníkmi, zdravotnou sestrou a koordinátorkou aktivít. Ak chceš vidieť ako to vyzerá za dverami útulku, pozri si videjko: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PWIuYGiNTqE

jobs.title: Terénni sociálni a zdravotní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá má zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Depaul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! ​Len v Bratislave žije odhadom viac ako 5 000 ľudí bez domova. Mnohí z nich navštevujú naše zariadenia, no ešte väčšia skupina sa ukrýva priamo v uliciach, vlastnoručne postavených príbytkoch či opustených chatrčiach. Ako najväčší terénny tím v Bratislave navštevujeme Karlovu Ves, Dúbravku, Lamač a Devínsku Novú Ves, aby sme pomáhali i tým, ktorí za nami prísť nedokážu. Našim cieľom je vyhľadávať a oslovovať ľudí bez domova v ich prirodzenom prostredí, poskytovať im sociálne a psychologické poradenstvo, základné zdravotné ošetrenie, materiálnu pomoc, sprevádzanie v kríze a prepájať ich na dostupné služby a bývanie. Veríme, že solidarita a spoločná práca môže ľuďom v núdzi darovať nádej a silu na nový začiatok. Ako terénny sociálny pracovník/sociálna pracovníčka budeš: - aktívne vyhľadávať a kontaktovať osoby a rodiny so sociálnymi problémami v rámci lokality a cieľovej skupiny (osoby z marginalizovaných rómskych komunít, ľudia bez domova), - posudzovať životné situácie človeka v spoločenskom, ekonomickom, politickom kontexte lokality/regiónu/spoločnosti, - identifikovať zdroje možností a schopností klienta a jeho sociálneho prostredia potrebných pre dosiahnutie stanovených cieľov klientom, - posky­tovať podporu v krízových situáciách osobám z cieľovej skupiny a sprístupnenie ostatných foriem pomoci, - poskytovať sociálne poradenstvo na úrovni základného a špecializovaného sociálneho poradenstva v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, - poskytovať pomoc pri uplatňovaní práv a právom chránených záujmov jednotlivca v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, príp. znevýhodnených skupín obyvateľov na lokálnej/regionálnej úrovni, - vykonávať preventívne aktivity v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách s cieľom predchádzať sociálnemu vylúčeniu alebo jeho prehlbovaniu, zmierňovanie negatívnych dopadov a zvyšovanie kvality života ľudí žijúci v podmienkach sociálneho vylúčenia a generačnej chudoby, - vykonávať aktivity, ktoré prispievajú k zmierňovaniu napätia a latentných konfliktov v lokalite, - spolupracovať s inštitúciami a organizáciami pôsobiacimi v lokalite/regióne a koordinovať ich v záujme klienta/skupiny/komunity, - sprostredkovávať kontakt, prípadne distribuovať a sprevádzať klienta k odborníkovi, do nadväzných služieb (napr. sociálne, psychologické, pedagogické, zdravotné služby a pod.) s ohľadom na potrebu klienta, - vykonávať technicko-administratívne úkony v rámci evidencie terénnej sociálnej práce, - priebežný rozvoj odborných a sociálnych kompetencií, účasť na vzdelávaní a supervíziách, - vykonávať činností prevažne v prirodzenom prostredí klienta (v domácnosti, komunite, vo voľnom priestranstve), - dodržiavať Štandardy terénnej sociálnej práce a terénnej práce vo vylúčení a Etického kódexu sociálneho pracovníka a asistenta sociálne práce Slovenskej republiky.

Mesačný priemer je spravidla 9 nočných služieb a 4 denné služby. Rozvrhnutie zmien môže byť aj individuálne podľa dohody so zamestnancom​ Kto sme? Nocľaháreň sv. Vincenta de Paul je najväčšou nízkoprahovou nocľahárňou v strednej Európe. Funguje nepretržite už 20 rokov, bez prestávky každý deň v roku. Denne poskytne nocľah, teplé jedlo, sociálne poradenstvo a ďalšie služby pre 200 ľudí v núdzi. Nocľaháreň je jedným z 10 zariadení a projektov neziskovej organizácie Depaul Slovensko, ktorá poskytuje komplexné služby ľuďom bez domova. Pre činnosť našej organizácie sú najdôležitejší naši zamestnanci – Depaul ľudia – profesionáli s veľkým srdcom, trpezlivosťou a empatiou. Pracujeme v priateľskom kolektíve, podporujme vzdelávanie, supervízie a teambulidingové aktivity. Láka ťa práca v nocľahárni, ale premýšľaš, či máš dostatok skúseností? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude v práci sprevádzať skúsený tím kolegov. Postupne budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať školenia a supervízie, ktoré ti pomôžu pri práci s klientmi. Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce alebo príbuzných humanitárnych odborov, ktorí by radi svoje doterajšie vedomosti preniesli do praxe. Náš tím tvorí viacero pomáhajúcich pracovníkov a počas dňa stretneš aj skvelých sociálnych pracovníkov, koordinátorky dobrovoľníkov a komunitné organizátorky či vedúcu nocľahárne s jej zástupkyňami. Viac informácií o nocľahárni a útulku nájdeš na našej webovej stránke https://depaul.sk/, v časti Naše služby, alebo vo video vizitke: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9IufpprxiqU Tešíme sa na teba :) !

Hands-on experience configuring and troubleshooting enterprise or service-provider network equipment.
Experience managing network changes in business-critical production environments.
Ability to diagnose complex connectivity, routing, performance, and packet-loss issues.
Experience with network monitoring, configuration management, IPAM, and incident-management tools.
Understanding of capacity planning, network resilience, and failure-domain design.
Ability to review technical solutions and make sound architectural decisions.
Strong leadership, prioritization, and incident-coordination skills.
English and Russian at Upper-Intermediate level or higher.

jobs.title: Senior Behandelcoördinator Tandheelkunde
jobs.description:
De functie vereist ruime ervaring met het coördineren van complexe implantologische en restauratieve behandeltrajecten binnen een tandheelkundige omgeving. De kandidaat dient aantoonbare ervaring te hebben met het begeleiden van patiënten gedurende het volledige behandelproces, het afstemmen van behandelplannen met behandelaars, tandtechnische laboratoria en externe leveranciers, en het bewaken van de voortgang van complexe behandeltrajecten.

Daarnaast wordt ervaring verwacht met digitale behandelplanning, digitale tandheelkundige workflows, tandheelkundige apparatuur en instrumentarium. Praktische ervaring met het Rhein83-ecosysteem en de bijbehorende prothetische oplossingen, alsmede ervaring met het Navident Dynamic Navigation System en de toepassing daarvan binnen implantologische behandeltrajecten, is van groot belang voor het succesvol kunnen vervullen van de functie.

Gezien de internationale patiëntenpopulatie van de praktijk dient de kandidaat tevens aantoonbare ervaring te hebben met het communiceren met patiënten uit diverse culturele en taalkundige achtergronden. Goede beheersing van de Engelse taal is vereist. Daarnaast is ervaring met het begeleiden van Arabisch-, Russisch- en Oekraïenstalige patiënten gewenst, zodat complexe behandelopties en behandeltrajecten op een begrijpelijke wijze kunnen worden toegelicht en patiënten goed geïnformeerde keuzes kunnen maken.

Vanwege het specialistische karakter van de functie wordt gezocht naar een ervaren kandidaat die vanaf de start zelfstandig kan functioneren en slechts beperkte inwerkbegeleiding nodig heeft

Tandartspraktijk Grinberg is een moderne en groeiende tandartspraktijk met een sterke focus op implantologie, prothetische rehabilitatie en restauratieve tandheelkunde. Wij bedienen een diverse en internationale patiëntenpopulatie en streven ernaar hoogwaardige, innovatieve en toegankelijke mondzorg te bieden, ongeacht taal, culturele achtergrond of bekendheid met het Nederlandse zorgsysteem.

Voor onze praktijk zijn wij op zoek naar een ervaren Senior Behandelcoördinator Tandheelkunde. In deze functie vervul je een centrale rol binnen complexe behandeltrajecten en fungeer je als schakel tussen patiënten, behandelaars, tandtechnische laboratoria en leveranciers. Je bent betrokken bij de voorbereiding, coördinatie en opvolging van geavanceerde implantologische en restauratieve behandelingen en draagt bij aan een efficiënte en hoogwaardige uitvoering van zorg.

De functie combineert patiëntcommunicatie, behandelcoördinatie, technische ondersteuning en digitale werkprocessen. Je werkt nauw samen met behandelaars en externe partners en krijgt de mogelijkheid om een directe bijdrage te leveren aan de kwaliteit van zorg en de patiëntervaring.

Vanwege het specialistische karakter van de functie zoeken wij een ervaren kandidaat die vanaf de start zelfstandig kan functioneren en een actieve bijdrage kan leveren aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze praktijk.

jobs.title: Packaging Operator
jobs.description:
The purpose of this position is to operate packaging or labeling machines and perform manual packaging operations according to procedures and guidelines, so that orders are packaged according to the standard and on time are available for shipping. Works with moderate work direction and is skilled and knowledgeable to the position.

Main responsibilities:
Visually inspect vaccines.
Assist colleagues/teams when necessary.
Work according to filling instructions and Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) guidelines.
Prioritize safety by actively contributing to a safe working environment.
Participate in improvement projects and activities, both independently and as part of a team.

Requirements:
Completed education at a minimum MBO level 2.
Technical knowledge and/or an interest in technical work.
Experience with and knowledge of GMP and GDP.
A professional attitude, combined with enthusiasm and a willingness to learn.
Ability to communicate effectively with colleagues.
Someone eager and motivated to help improve our department.

Our client is a global leader in medicines, dedicated to creating a healthy world. Through their vaccines, biologics, and medicines, they provide innovative treatments to improve the health of people and animals in more than 140 countries. They focus on conditions that severely impair daily functioning or are life-threatening, and for which new medicines are needed. Our client is also a pioneer in biologics research and development for animal health.

At our client, they believe in the power of diversity within teams of talented employees at all levels. Diverse skills, experiences, backgrounds, and cultural perspectives help them better understand the needs of their diverse customers, healthcare providers, and patients. Our client employs approximately 4,500 people across three locations in the Netherlands.

jobs.title: Verzorgende IG met hart voor de zorg!
jobs.description:
Bij Medicalhunt zoeken wij een Verzorgende IG'er die op zoek is naar een veelzijdige, afwisselende baan in de ouderenzorg.

Werkervaring in de functie is mooi meegenomen, maar geen vereiste. Wel is het belangrijk dat je beschikt over een zorgdiploma van minimaal helpende niveau.

Ben jij een Verzorgende IG die houdt van afwisseling, nieuwe uitdagingen en vrijheid in je werk? Dan hebben wij de baan voor jou!


Als Verzorgende IG via detachering spring jij in bij verschillende zorginstellingen: van verpleeghuizen en thuiszorg tot revalidatiecentra. Geen dag is hetzelfde! Je ondersteunt cliënten met hun dagelijkse zorg, voert verpleegtechnische handelingen uit en zorgt voor een warme en veilige omgeving.

Het is natuurlijk belangrijk om een vertrouwd gezicht te zijn voor de bewoners. Daarom duurt een detachering minimaal 2 tot 3 maanden, maar het kan ook een half jaar of zelfs een jaar zijn. In die tijd draai je volledig mee in het team. Na deze periode ga je door naar een nieuwe, uitdagende opdracht. Je kan kiezen voor afwisseling tussen verschillende doelgroepen, hebt de mogelijkheid om een opdracht te verlengen wanneer deze goed bevalt of je kiest voor een doelgroep die jou het meeste aanspreekt.


Bij Medicalhunt sta je er niet alleen voor: je krijgt een vaste contactpersoon en we bieden je persoonlijke begeleiding en ondersteuning, zodat jij je kunt focussen op wat je het beste doet: zorgen voor anderen!


Wat maakt detacheren nou zo leuk?

Afwisseling: Jij bepaalt waar en wanneer je werkt. Dit geeft je vrijheid in je werk, maar zorgt er ook voor dat je een goede werk-privé balans kan behouden;

Zekerheid: Een arbeidscontract bij ons voor een x aantal uren in de week, mét de flexibiliteit van detachering;

Ontwikkeling: Wij investeren in jouw groei met trainingen en opleidingen;

Teamspirit: Ook al werk je op verschillende locaties, je maak echt deel uit van team Medicalhunt. We staan altijd voor je klaar en zetten jouw werkgeluk op nummer 1!

Offer Description
Understanding how patterns of neural activity give rise to behavior is a central challenge in neuroscience. Most of what we know about this relationship comes from rodent experiments performed under tightly controlled laboratory conditions. While these approaches are essential for identifying neural mechanisms, they capture only a fraction of the behavioral repertoire animals display in more complex environments.
What are you going to do?
In this project, you will investigate how neural population activity relates to behavior across environments ranging from standardized laboratory assays to large outdoor enclosures. Using miniaturized calcium imaging, you will record the activity of large populations of neurons in freely behaving mice and determine how neural activity relates to moment-to-moment behavioral changes.
A major component of the project will make use of large outdoor mouse enclosures at the University of Groningen. Welcome to Maastricht University!
Would you like to help detect health risks in herbal food supplements earlier, using data-driven approaches? Herbal supplements are often considered safe because they are natural. But how well do we actually understand their potential health effects? In this PhD project, you will develop a testing strategy to identify possible hazards earlier and contribute to safer use of herbal supplements.
PhD Candidate: Towards a tiered risk assessment strategy to evaluate the safety of herbal supplements
Herbal food supplements are widely used and often perceived as inherently safe because they are 'natural'. Yet these products can contain complex mixtures of bioactive compounds, and their composition may vary depending on the plant material, extraction method and production process. Contamination, adulteration and differences between batches add further uncertainty. Because these products are generally not tested before entering the market, potential adverse effects may only become apparent once they are already widely used.
That is why a robust and structured strategy is needed to better evaluate the safety of herbal supplements and reduce potential risks to human health. In this collaborative project, you will investigate the hepatotoxicity, nephrotoxicity, genotoxicity and endocrine-disrupting potential of diverse herbal extracts using human-relevant in vitro models and complementary bioassays. You will also examine how liver metabolism influences their toxicity. For selected extracts, you will use chemical analyses such as LC-MS/MS and GC-MS to help identify the compounds responsible for the observed effects.   • Générateur de tests local : isoler une séquence, reconstruire l'arbre d'états, et en sortir des tests de non-régression automatisés
  • Replayer : une API et un back-office minimaliste pour visualiser graphiquement les états et les interactions inter-services
    • Les points d'attention : la volumétrie, la fidélité de la reconstruction chronologique, la corrélation d'événements en environnement distribué, et l'industrialisation de l'outil (CI/CD, tests, documentation).

Join the Central Data Office (CDO), the team responsible for implementing the Firm's Data Strategy, supporting users, fostering the adoption of Data Management best practices, and enabling data that is Trusted, Ready to use and Protected. In this role, you will be part of the Data Governance Operations team, working closely with the Data Governance Unit Leader, Data Owners, Data Stewards, and other stakeholders across the firm.
What your role will look like
As a Data Governance Analyst Associate, you will contribute to the firm's data transformation by helping strengthen Data Governance practices across the organisation. You will support the effective use, protection, quality, and management of data while ensuring Data Governance processes and activities are followed consistently.
• Support the Data Governance Unit Leader and the Data Governance Operations team with Data Governance analysis.
• Ensure the efficient follow-up of requests related to data use across the firm and contribute to the evolution of this activity.
• Oversee data issue management activities and data requirements, including Data Subject requests in collaboration with the Data Protection Office.
• Contribute to the analysis of Data Procedures and assess their impact on Data Governance rules and processes.
• Support the management of the community of Data Owners and Data Stewards and help maintain engagement across stakeholders.
• Perform Data Retention implementation campaigns, including database storage analysis to identify areas with the greatest impact.
• Maintain Data Governance documentation, guidelines and templates, while coordinating meetings, organising logistics, and maintaining accurate records as part of the audit trail.
Your growth and opportunities
You will build practical experience in Data Governance, Data Management practices, and data regulations while contributing to the implementation of the Firm's Data Strategy. The role provides exposure to multiple business domains and stakeholder groups across the firm, helping you broaden your understanding of how data supports decision-making and governance.
The skills you bring
• Master's degree in IT, Data Management, Business Management or Sciences.
• Working knowledge of business analysis and the ability to structure large amounts of information within a process framework.
• Keen to acquire knowledge of Data Management practices (DMBOK), Data Regulation rules (GDPR, RoPA and EU data regulations), and business domains.
• Basic knowledge of Data Architecture, data modelling and database design is considered valuable for the role.
• Fluent in French and English
Ways of working
• Analyse information in a structured way and use data and facts to support informed decisions.
• Collaborate effectively with colleagues and stakeholders to achieve shared objectives and build trust.
• You act with integrity, handle confidential information with care, and uphold high ethical standards in every situation.
Additional skills that would support your success
• Knowledge of Project Management methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, Prince2).
• Knowledge of Product Management practices (ITIL).
The skills listed reflect what matters most to succeed in this role. If your experience aligns with them, even if your path looks different, we encourage you to apply and start the conversation with us.
Take your next step
Make a difference by contributing to the way data is governed, protected and used across the firm. Work with colleagues from different teams, build expertise in a growing field, and help shape trusted and reliable data practices. Grow your impact, expand your knowledge, and contribute to meaningful transformation across the organisation. Grow here. Go further.

Title:  Head of ICT and Security Risk Management Department – CDI

Department:  ICT AND SECURITY RISK DEPARTMENT

Description:

The Risk Management Department is responsible for the risk control function of the Bank, encompassing both Financial Risk and Operational Risk matters.
The Risk Management Department monitors existing and emerging risks, assess them and report them to the Senior Management of the Bank. It supports the business in managing their risks, providing guidance to promote risk awareness continuously.

We are seeking an experienced Head of ICT & Security Risk Management on a permanent role to lead our digital operational resilience strategy and ensure full compliance with the EU Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA) and relevant regulatory requirements.

Your main tasks will be to:

• Be responsible for establishing and maintaining and governing a comprehensive ICT risk management framework
• Protect the Bank against cyber threats, operational disruptions, and third-party risks while enabling business growth and innovation.
• Manage and enhance the Bank's ICT risk management strategy and digital operational resilience framework in compliance with DORA regulations;

Job Description

Join a global financial services firm where your work helps strengthen trust in the financial system and supports how we serve clients worldwide. You will collaborate with partners across operations, technology, and compliance to deliver clear, well-evidenced outcomes in a fast-moving regulatory environment. You will build relationships, shape governance routines, and help ensure critical deliverables are tracked and closed with discipline.

As an AML Governance & Oversight Associate, 1st Line of Defense within our Outsourcing, Operations, and Technology organization, you will help coordinate the governance cadence that keeps anti-money laundering actions, regulatory and audit deliverables, and escalation items controlled, evidenced, and closed on time—working closely with first and second line partners across the firm.

Job responsibilities

• Support the AML 1LoD Lead as the business/operations interface to 2LoD/GFCC by coordinating inputs, aligning expectations, and surfacing key decisions, risks, and dependencies for action/escalation.
• Maintain the single source of truth for AML matters, including the JPMSE AML Areas of Concern and the Issue/Action Register, ensuring clear ownership, target dates, dependencies, and documented closure evidence/status.
• Identify, triage, and track emerging AML risks/issues (1LoD lens), prepare concise escalation summaries, and monitor escalations through to closure in line with agreed governance.
• Support the coordination and quality-check regulatory RFIs end-to-end (intake, scoping, stakeholder outreach, drafting coordination, and evidence collation) and produce final response packs for AML 1LoD Lead review and sign-off.
• Support AML audit activity (internal and external) as the 1LoD engagement support point of contact, including the PwC AML AFS Audit (JPMSE): manage auditor communications, RFI trackers, and walkthrough logistics; coordinate evidence requests/compilation; and drive action tracking to closure to ensure consistent messaging, evidence discipline, and timely stakeholder follow-up.
• Coordinate the AMLA data questionnaire by managing inputs, challenge/validation, tracking, evidence collation, and final pack preparation for sign-off.
• Support AML New Product Assessment activities by coordinating required inputs, tracking actions, and preparing evidence/assessment materials for AML 1LoD Lead review.
• Support regulatory strategy and change monitoring by tracking regulatory change and industry developments impacting JPMSE; maintaining a regulatory change/watch-items tracker (aligned with 2LoD) with actions, owners, and dates; and reporting progress on a regular cadence.
• Provide programme/project governance support (plans, RAID logs, milestones, governance updates), with particular focus on the EU AML Reform Program for Outsourcing.
• Run the quarterly BAU cycle for AML Outsourcing Framework maintenance (including the Outsourcing Register) and coordinate regulatory notifications for new outsourcing.

Required qualifications, capabilities and skills

• Demonstrable experience operating within a 1LoD control environment, issue management, governance forums, escalation, evidence discipline, and sustainable remediation.
• Experience in AML and/or wider Financial Crime topics (e.g., AML governance, KYC/CDD, transaction monitoring, sanctions, fraud) and how these translate into business/operations requirements.
• Experience coordinating responses to regulatory requests and/or audits (RFIs, evidence packs, walkthrough coordination), with strong attention to defensibility and consistency of messaging.
• Ability to manage data quality in a controlled way (data sourcing understanding, reconciliations/checks, exception tracking, root cause themes, and prevention), ideally for regulatory submissions/questionnaires.
• Able to influence and drive outcomes across Business, Operations, Technology and 2LoD partners (including GFCC), including confident follow-up and escalation where required.
• Proven ability to run multiple workstreams concurrently, maintain trackers and governance cadence, and drive actions to closure under tight timelines and competing priorities.
• Strong written and verbal skills, produces concise, senior-ready updates and materials that are audit/regulator appropriate.
• Excellent Microsoft office skills, Excel ,Power Point and Word.
• Practical knowledge of Automation Tools such as Alteryx and Tableau

• German language proficiency (written and spoken) preferred

jobs.title: Data & AI Senior Associate (m/f)
jobs.description:
Data & AI Senior Associate

Luxembourg
Line of Service Advisory
Industry/Sector Not Applicable
Specialism Data, Analytics & AI
Management Level Senior Associate
Job ID: 753737WD

Job Description & Summary

Meet your future team

Join our Data & AI team within Advisory, part of the Financial Services Transformation area. We work closely with colleagues across Advisory to help banks, asset managers and fund industry clients design and deliver data, analytics, AI and organizational transformation initiatives, bridging business and technology from strategy through adoption.  

What your role will look like

As a Data & AI Senior Associate, you will help clients turn data into a business asset and support the design and delivery of transformation programs across data management, analytics, AI and operating model topics. This role sits at the intersection of business and technology, with a strong focus on consulting, transformation and stakeholder engagement rather than pure software development. The role exists to help clients define where they are going, structure how they get there, and support implementation and adoption along the way.

• Analyze how data is captured, structured, transformed and consumed across business processes and systems; build, document and challenge data models, data dictionaries and source-to-target data mappings;
• Design and document data architectures on the Microsoft stack – Azure Data Factory, OneLake, Microsoft Fabric – from ingestion and transformation through to consumption;
• Contribute to data governance initiatives: ownership, lineage, data quality and cataloguing (experience with Microsoft Purview is a strong asset);
• Prepare detailed functional and technical implementation specifications that client IT teams can build from, with enough technical awareness of the broader landscape (integration patterns, APIs, streaming, databases) to contribute meaningfully to solution design discussions.
• Translate complex data-related information into clear, business-friendly outputs – Power BI dashboards, visual summaries and management reporting that people actually use;
• Build and deploy solutions on the Power Platform – Power Automate, Dataverse, Power Apps – and on Azure AI Foundry, automating business processes and embedding AI where it creates real value;
• Contribute to commercial proposals, client demonstrations and alliance initiatives with our technology partners – Microsoft in particular.

Your growth and opportunities

Develop expertise across the full data lifecycle, from data management and governance through analytics, AI and organizational transformation. Gain exposure to large-scale transformation programs within the financial services industry and progressively take ownership of client discussions, solution design and workstreams. Grow towards a management consulting profile by helping clients shape initiatives, demonstrate value and drive adoption.  

The skills you bring

• Hold a Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Management, Data Science or a related field;
• Have 3 to 6 years of professional experience in data management, business intelligence, data analysis or data-driven transformation projects – in consulting or within an in-house data team;
• Have a strong data-oriented mindset: you are comfortable with data models, data mapping and data flows, and ideally have exposure to data governance;
• Have hands-on experience with the Microsoft data stack – Azure Data Factory, Microsoft Fabric and OneLake, Power BI – and with the Power Platform (Power Automate, Dataverse); Microsoft Purview, Azure AI Foundry and Microsoft Dynamics 365 are considered strong assets;
• Understand system integration concepts, and how business applications interact with each other and with their data sources and databases;
• Are genuinely curious about AI and Generative AI – you like testing new tools rather than only reading about them;
• Can bridge business and technical stakeholders: turning business needs into detailed requirements, and keeping the conversation with IT teams flowing in both directions;
• Are able to work autonomously, learn quickly and bring a positive, constructive attitude to discussions with business and IT alike;
• English: C1 – full professional proficiency;
• French: C1 – full professional proficiency
  
Ways of working

• You apply structured thinking to business and transformation challenges, interpret information critically and connect data to business outcomes;
• You collaborate effectively across teams and disciplines, build trust with stakeholders and contribute to shared client outcomes;
• You continuously learn, explore emerging technologies and actively apply new knowledge to improve delivery and create value;
• You act with integrity, handle confidential information with care, and uphold high ethical standards in every situation.

Additional skills that would support your success

• Experience with Microsoft Purview;
• Experience with Azure AI Foundry;
• Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365.
• Luxembourgish: C1 – full professional proficiency
• German: C1 – full professional proficiency

The skills listed reflect what matters most to succeed in this role. If your experience aligns with them, even if your path looks different, we encourage you to apply and start the conversation with us.

Take your next step

Shape how organizations use data, analytics and AI to make better decisions and deliver meaningful transformation. Work alongside experienced consultants and technology specialists while helping clients bridge strategy, business and technology. Build expertise that goes beyond tools and creates lasting impact for clients and teams alike.

Grow here. Go further.

Travel Requirements

Available for Work Visa Sponsorship?
Government Clearance Required?

jobs.title: IMMOBILIENVERWALTER / PROPERTY MANAGER (W/M/D) (Immobilienmakler/in)
jobs.description:
Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:
Immobilienverwalter

Stellenbeschreibung:
Die BRINVESTOR GmbH ist seit 2006 ein etabliertes und solides Immobilienunternehmen mit Sitz in Korntal-Münchingen.

Unser Kerngeschäft ist der Erwerb, der Besitz und das aktive Management unseres vielfältigen Immobilienportfolios sowie die Entwicklung von Projekten für namhafte Großunternehmen und öffentliche Träger, die wir mit hoher Dienstleistungsmentalität umsetzen.

Für unser Team suchen wir Verstärkung in Teil- oder Vollzeit.

IMMOBILIENVERWALTER / PROPERTY MANAGER (W/M/D)

SCHWERPUNKT GEWERBEIMMOBILIEN

DEINE AUFGABEN

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir einen Immobilienverwalter mit Schwerpunkt Gewerbeimmobilien, der die ganzheitliche Betreuung eines vielseitigen Immobilienbestands übernimmt und aktiv zur Weiterentwicklung unserer internen Strukturen und Abläufe beiträgt.

Zu deinen Aufgaben gehören unter anderem:

- Ganzheitliche kaufmännische und organisatorische Betreuung von Gewerbeimmobilien mit unterschiedlichen Nutzungsarten
- Selbstständige Mieterbetreuung sowie Bearbeitung aller mieter- und objektspezifischen Themen
- Kaufmännische Steuerung der Objekte inklusive Budgetüberwachung, Kostencontrolling, Rechnungsprüfung und Betriebskostenabrechnungen in Zusammenarbeit mit der Buchhaltung
- Planung, Beauftragung und Überwachung von Instandhaltungs- und Reparaturmaßnahmen in Zusammenarbeit mit dem technischen Projektmanagement
- Durchführung von Objektbegehungen sowie Unterstützung bei der Neuvermietung von Flächen
- Einholung von Angeboten, Vergabe von Aufträgen und Steuerung externer Dienstleister
- Bearbeitung von Schadens- und Versicherungsfällen
- Optimierung organisatorischer Abläufe und Prozesse

DEIN PROFIL

- Berufserfahrung: Du hast bereits Erfahrung als Immobilienverwalter, kaufmännischer Objektverwalter, Property Manager oder WEG‑Verwalter gesammelt. Dein Hintergrund kann zum Beispiel aus einer Hausverwaltung, dem Property Management, einer Immobiliengesellschaft, einem Bestandshalter, Vermögensverwalter, Family Office, Bauträger oder Projektentwickler stammen.
- Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest strukturiert und eigenverantwortlich und übernimmst zuverlässig sowie lösungsorientiert mit hoher Einsatzbereitschaft die Betreuung und Verantwortung für deine Immobilien.
- Arbeitszeit: Du suchst eine verantwortungsvolle Teil- oder Vollzeitstelle mit 25 bis 40 Stunden pro Woche. Deine Arbeitszeit kannst Du in Abstimmung flexibel gestalten. Nach der Einarbeitung ist bei Bedarf teilweise Homeoffice möglich.
- Teamverständnis: Du fühlst Dich in kleinen Teams wohl, schätzt ein partnerschaftliches Miteinander und packst mit an, wenn im Team Unterstützung gebraucht wird.
- Sprachkenntnisse: Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und idealerweise auch über gute Englischkenntnisse.

DARAUF KANNST DU DICH FREUEN

- Familienfreundliches Unternehmen: Wir ermöglichen dir flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit, bei Bedarf nach der Einarbeitung auch teilweise mobil zu arbeiten.
- Vielfältiges Immobilienportfolio: Du betreust ein breit aufgestelltes Immobilienportfolio mit Schwerpunkt Gewerbe und unterschiedlichen individuellen Nutzungsarten, das für Abwechslung sorgt und dir ermöglicht, fachlich dazuzulernen und deine Erfahrung praxisnah zu vertiefen.
- Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Wir arbeiten dich gründlich ein und geben dir den Raum, dich Schritt für Schritt weiterzuentwickeln.
- Gestaltungsspielraum: Du hast die Möglichkeit, bestehende Prozesse aktiv weiterzuentwickeln, Abläufe effizienter zu gestalten und eigene Ideen in der Immobilienverwaltung einzubringen.
- Teamkultur: Wir legen großen Wert auf ein respektvolles Miteinander, in dem man sich gegenseitig unterstützt.
- Unsere Projekte: Unsere Aufgaben sind vielseitig und abwechslungsreich. Dadurch lernen wir ständig dazu und stellen uns immer wieder neuen Herausforderungen.
- Dein Arbeitsplatz: Dich erwartet ein schönes Büro mit moderner Ausstattung, zwischen der B10 und der Natur gelegen, inklusive eigenem Parkplatz.
- Attraktives Vergütungspaket: Wir bieten ein wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt, eine unbefristete und sichere Anstellung sowie 30 Urlaubstage. Zusätzlich hast du die Möglichkeit, ein JobRad zu nutzen.

DU WILLST TEIL UNSERER ERFOLGSGESCHICHTE WERDEN?

Dann bewirb dich unkompliziert über unser Bewerbungsformular.
