jobs.title: Sanitør til løsøre | Hjælp os med at passe på det, der betyder noget
jobs.description:
Det er ikke bare ting

Når en kunde bliver ramt af brand, vand eller en anden skade, kan hjemmets eller virksomhedens indbo også blive berørt.

Møbler, billeder, bøger, tøj og personlige ejendele kan ved første øjekast ligne almindelige ting – men for kunden kan de have stor både praktisk og personlig værdi.

Derfor kræver arbejdet med løsøre noget særligt.

Hos Ocab søger vi nu en sanitør, som har lyst til at arbejde med håndtering, rengøring og behandling af kundernes indbo og løsøre – både ude hos kunderne og på vores vaskelinje.

Om jobbet

Som sanitør til løsøre følger du kundens ejendele gennem forskellige dele af processen.

Det kan begynde ude på et skadested, hvor indbo skal sorteres, registreres, pakkes og transporteres. Andre dage arbejder du på vores vaskelinje med rengøring og behandling af løsøre, så mest muligt kan reddes og leveres tilbage til kunden.

Det kræver ikke bare praktisk sans. Det kræver også, at du arbejder systematisk, omhyggeligt og respektfuldt med de ting, du får mellem hænderne.

Dine arbejdsopgaver kan blandt andet være

  • Håndtering af indbo og løsøre efter brand-, vand- og andre skader

  • Sortering og registrering af kundernes ejendele

  • Pakning, mærkning og klargøring til transport og opbevaring

  • Rengøring og behandling af løsøre

  • Arbejde på vores vaskelinje

  • Flytning og håndtering af møbler og øvrigt indbo

  • Arbejde ude hos kunder i forbindelse med skadesager

  • Dokumentation af det udførte arbejde

  • Samarbejde med kolleger og projektledere gennem hele forløbet

Vi forestiller os, at du

Til denne stilling leder vi først og fremmest efter en person, der kan lide at gøre tingene grundigt og ordentligt.

Du forstår, at du arbejder med andre menneskers ejendele, og du behandler dem med den samme omhu, som du selv ville ønske.

Vi ser gerne, at du:

  • Er omhyggelig og detaljeorienteret

  • Arbejder struktureret og har styr på de ting, du håndterer

  • Har lyst til både praktisk arbejde og mere systematiske opgaver

  • Trives med at arbejde på vores vaskelinje såvel som ude hos kunderne

  • Er i god fysisk form, da flytning og håndtering af indbo kan være en del af arbejdsdagen

  • Arbejder selvstændigt og tager ansvar for dine opgaver

  • Trives med samarbejde og bidrager positivt til teamet

  • Møder kunderne ordentligt og med forståelse for den situation, de står i

  • Taler og forstår dansk

  • Har kørekort (kategori B)

Erfaring fra skadeservice, rengøring, flyttebranchen, lager eller lignende praktisk arbejde kan være en fordel, men det vigtigste er din tilgang til arbejdet og din lyst til at lære.

Det er en forudsætning, at du kan fremvise en straffeattest.

Hvem er Ocab?

Ocab er en af Nordens førende virksomheder inden for skadeservice og industriservice. Vi hjælper hvert år tusindvis af kunder efter blandt andet brand-, vand- og klimaskader. Hos Ocab bliver du en del af en virksomhed med høj faglighed og engagerede kolleger. Vi tror på, at de bedste resultater skabes gennem samarbejde, ordentlighed og en stærk holdånd.

Vi tilbyder

  • En varieret hverdag med både arbejde på vores vaskelinje og ude hos kunderne

  • Grundig oplæring og gode muligheder for faglig udvikling

  • Et arbejde, hvor omhu og kvalitet gør en reel forskel

  • Dygtige og hjælpsomme kolleger

  • Løn efter overenskomst

  • Pension og sundhedsordning

  • 37 timers arbejdsuge

  • Ingen obligatorisk deltagelse i vagtordningen

Arbejdssted: Ocab Farum, Rugmarken 36, 3520 Farum

Tiltrædelse: Snarest muligt

jobs.title: Sanitør til skadeservice | Bliv en del af Ocab Holbæk
jobs.description:
En hverdag, hvor der er brug for dig

Når en kunde bliver ramt af en vand-, brand- eller skimmelskade, er en hurtig og professionel indsats vigtig. Hos Ocab rykker vi ud, begrænser skaden og hjælper kunden videre – og som sanitør bliver du en vigtig del af den indsats.

Til vores afdeling i Holbæk søger vi nu en sanitør, som trives med en aktiv og varieret arbejdsdag, tager ansvar og har lyst til at blive en del af et hold med dygtige kolleger.

Nogle dage følger planen. Andre dage gør den ikke. Det er en del af jobbet – og derfor skal du kunne bevare overblikket og være klar til at træde til, når der er brug for dig.


Om jobbet

Som sanitør hos Ocab arbejder du med mange forskellige typer skadeserviceopgaver hos både private, virksomheder og professionelle kunder.

Det er et praktisk og fysisk job. Du kan blandt andet komme til at flytte og håndtere kundernes indbo og løsøre, arbejde med nedrivning og sanering samt løse industriopgaver og opgaver i højden.

Du arbejder både selvstændigt og sammen med kolleger og projektledere. Uanset opgaven er målet det samme: at levere et professionelt stykke arbejde og møde kunden ordentligt i en situation, der ofte er både uventet og vanskelig.

Dine arbejdsopgaver kan blandt andet være

  • Blotlægning og nedrivning i forbindelse med vandskader

  • Skimmelsanering

  • Rengøring og sanering efter brandskader

  • Opsætning og tilsyn med affugtningsudstyr

  • Håndtering og flytning af indbo og løsøre

  • Asbestsanering

  • Sanering efter skadedyr

  • Oprydning og rengøring i forbindelse med socialsager

  • Industriopgaver

  • Dokumentation af opgaver fra start til slut

  • Tæt samarbejde med kolleger og projektledere

  • Deltagelse i vagtordning

Vi forestiller os, at du

Du behøver ikke komme med præcis den samme baggrund som dine kommende kolleger. Erfaring betyder noget, men vi lægger også stor vægt på din indstilling, ansvarlighed og måde at samarbejde med andre på.

Vi ser gerne, at du:

  • Har erfaring fra skadeservice eller en lignende branche – erfaring med skadeservice er en klar fordel

  • Har asbestbevis eller erfaring med asbestsanering – en fordel, men ikke et krav

  • Er i god fysisk form og trives med et aktivt arbejde, hvor løft og flytning kan være en del af arbejdsdagen

  • Er tryg ved at arbejde i højden, da nogle opgaver kan foregå på stiger, lifte eller arbejdsplatforme

  • Arbejder selvstændigt og tager ansvar for dine opgaver

  • Er omhyggelig og kvalitetsbevidst

  • Trives med samarbejde og bidrager positivt til holdet

  • Er fleksibel og kan bevare overblikket, når dagens planer ændrer sig

  • Bor i rimelig afstand til vores afdeling i Holbæk

  • Taler og forstår dansk

  • Har kørekort (kategori B)

Deltagelse i vagtordningen er en obligatorisk del af stillingen. Du skal derfor være indstillet på efter en fastlagt vagtplan at kunne træde til uden for normal arbejdstid, når en akut skade kræver vores hjælp.

Det er en forudsætning, at du kan fremvise en straffeattest.

Hvem er Ocab?

Ocab er en af Nordens førende virksomheder inden for skadeservice og industriservice. Vi hjælper hvert år tusindvis af kunder efter blandt andet brand-, vand- og klimaskader.

Hos Ocab bliver du en del af en virksomhed med høj faglighed og engagerede kolleger. Vi tror på, at de bedste resultater skabes gennem samarbejde, ordentlighed og en stærk holdånd.

Vi tilbyder

  • En spændende og varieret arbejdsdag

  • Grundig oplæring og gode muligheder for faglig udvikling

  • Dygtige og hjælpsomme kolleger

  • Et job med ansvar og stor variation i opgaverne

jobs.title: Junior Payroll Assistant
jobs.description:
Through proprietary software and AI, along with a focus on customer delight, Sleek makes the back-office easy for micro SMEs.

We give Entrepreneurs time back to focus on what they love doing - growing their business and being with customers. With a surging number of Entrepreneurs globally, we are innovating in a highly lucrative space.

We operate across 3 business segments:

Corporate Secretary: Automating the company incorporation, secretarial, filing, Nominee Director, mailroom and immigration processes via custom online robots and SleekSign. We are the market leaders in Singapore with ~5% market share of all new business incorporations

Accounting & Bookkeeping: Redefining what it means to do Accounting, Bookkeeping, Tax and Payroll thanks to our proprietary SleekBooks ledger, AI tools and exceptional customer service

FinTech payments: Overcoming a key challenge for Entrepreneurs by offering digital banking services to new businesses

Sleek launched in 2017 and now has around 17,500 customers across our offices in Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia and the UK. We have around 600 staff with an intact startup mindset. We have recently raised Series B financing off the back of >70% compound annual growth in Revenue over the last 5 years. Sleek has been recognised by The Financial Times, The Straits Times, Forbes and LinkedIn as one of the fastest growing companies in Asia. Backed by world-class investors, we are on track to be one of the few cash flow positive, tech-enabled unicorns based out of Asia Pacific.

Mission of the role

To ensure the accurate, timely, and compliant processing of payroll for multiple UK clients. The UK Payroll Executive will be responsible for managing payroll data, processing payroll transactions, supporting workplace pension auto-enrolment, responding to client queries, and ensuring all payroll activities are completed in line with UK labour laws, HMRC requirements, tax regulations, and agreed client timelines.

The role requires strong attention to detail, client service, ownership, and the ability to manage multiple payrolls and deadlines efficiently while continuously looking for ways to improve workflows through technology, AI, and automation.

Key outcomes In the first 6â12 monthsOutcome 1: UK Payroll Knowledge & Process Proficiency

Develop a strong foundational understanding of UK payroll regulations and processes and confidently apply the appropriate rules when preparing and processing client payrolls.

Become fully familiar with Sleek's internal payroll platforms and processes, including HMRC submissions such as RTI, FPS and EPS, workplace pension submissions, and year-end reporting requirements including P60s and P11Ds by the third month.

Outcome 2: Accurate & Compliant Payroll Processing

Process assigned client payrolls accurately and within agreed timelines, ensuring all payroll data is complete and correctly validated before submission.

Ensure 100% compliance with agreed payroll and statutory deadlines, including payroll runs, pension auto-enrolment submissions, and applicable HMRC requirements.

Identify discrepancies or potential issues early, take ownership of resolving them, and maintain high standards of confidentiality and data accuracy.

Outcome 3: Client Service & Responsiveness

Maintain a high level of client satisfaction by providing prompt, accurate, and professional responses to payroll-related queries.

Consistently achieve a CSAT target of at least 97% month-on-month while ensuring that client queries and emails are responded to within the agreed communication SLA, with no non-reply tickets or emails left unresolved at the end of the working day.

Build trusted relationships with clients by providing clear updates, proactively following up on outstanding information, and handling difficult conversations positively when required.

Outcome 4: Team Collaboration & Process Improvement

Work effectively with the UK Payroll team and other internal departments to ensure smooth payroll operations and timely resolution of client or processing issues.

Contribute to improving payroll processes and operational efficiency by identifying opportunities to use AI, automation, payroll technology, and improved workflows to reduce manual work, improve accuracy, and increase turnaround times.

Must-have experience

  • Minimum 1â2 years of hands-on UK payroll processing experience.
  • Experience working in a bureau, outsourced payroll environment, or shared services centre is preferred.
  • Experience managing multiple client payroll accounts is an advantage.
  • Working knowledge of UK payroll processes, HMRC requirements, tax regulations, and workplace pension processes.
  • Experience with payroll software such as BrightPay, Xero Payroll, or similar is an advantage.
  • Strong attention to detail and experience working with sensitive and confidential financial information.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and meet strict deadlines.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Comfortable working with data and payroll-related reporting and metrics.
  • Practical experience or strong interest in using AI tools, automation, and IT applications to improve daily workflows.

Must-have attributes

Ownership & Accountability: Takes full responsibility for assigned payrolls and client accounts, follows through on tasks without constant supervision, and proactively resolves issues or roadblocks.

Humility: Open to feedback, willing to learn, and comfortable acknowledging knowledge gaps and seeking support when required.

Structured Thinking: Able to organise multiple client payrolls, deadlines, queries, and tasks in a clear and logical manner, while using sound judgement to prioritise competing requirements.

Data Driven & Attention to Detail: Comfortable working with numbers and payroll data, with a strong focus on accuracy. Able to identify discrepancies, missing information, or inconsistencies before they impact payroll processing or clients.

Can Have Tough Conversations in a Positive Way: Able to communicate clearly and professionally when dealing with sensitive payroll issues, missing information, delays, or difficult client situations while maintaining a constructive client relationship.

AI & Tech Savvy: Energetic about adopting new software, AI tools, automation, and technology to make payroll processes more efficient and effective.

Behavioural fit is also important at Sleek, and we will be looking for candidates that have a proven track record of embodying the below attributes in their recent roles:

We will be looking for candidates who have a proven track record of embodying the below attributes in their recent roles:

Ownership: This shows reliability and helps build trust within the team. We move fast and need to know that everyone will see things through to completion and proactively help to get things back on track when challenges arise. Accountability is really important to us.

Humility: There is so much we don't know. Humility allows for open-mindedness to feedback and a willingness to learn from others. It paves the way for collaboration and creates a positive work environment. It is a key ingredient of self-awareness and emotional intelligence.

Structured Thinking: Our business is complex with many layers (many services, many countries, many cultures). Regardless of whether you're more analytical or creative in nature, being able to show sound judgement is important to us. It ensures solutions are pragmatic and balance the needs of the organisation, team and customers.

Attention to detail: You'll be managing multiple client payrolls, deadlines, queries, and workstreams. It will be important for you to keep track of everything and notice when information is missing, inconsistent, or likely to cause an issue.

Excellent listener and clear communicator: We have a variety of nationalities and for many people, English isn't their first language. For you to excel, you'll need to be present in your calls and make sure you properly receive and thoughtfully send messages to others in the business.

The interview process

The successful candidate will participate in the following interview stages. We anticipate the process to last no more than 3 weeks from start to finish.

TA Screen / One-way Video Interview: Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a one-way video interview to assess spoken and written communication, relevant UK payroll experience, motivation, and initial background.

Technical Round: A 30-minute interview and practical assessment with the Hiring Team to assess UK payroll knowledge, payroll processing experience, attention to detail, ability to work with payroll data, and understanding of UK payroll processes and deadlines.

Soft Skills Round: A 30-minute chat with a member of the leadership team to evaluate real-world work scenarios against our core behavioural values, including ownership, humility, structured thinking, communication, and ability to handle challenging situations.

Reference Verification: Prior to final offer confirmation, we will conduct one professional reference check with your recent direct manager or supervisor. To keep the process moving smoothly, this step may be initiated during the final interview stages.

Requirement for background screening

Please be aware that Sleek is a regulated entity and as such is required to perform different levels of background checks on staff depending on their role. This may include using external vendors to verify:

  • Your education
  • Any criminal history
  • Any political exposure
  • Any bankruptcy or adverse credit history

We will ask for your consent before conducting these checks. Depending on your role at Sleek, an adverse result on one of these checks may prohibit you from passing probation.

By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Data Privacy Statement for Candidates, found at Sleek.com.

Some other great things about working at Sleekâ¦

Humility and kindness: Humility is a core attribute we hire for, which means we have a culture of not taking ourselves too seriously and being able to laugh. Kindness is also incredibly important. We are committed to creating and nurturing a diverse and inclusive environment.Â 

Flexibility: Youâll be able to work remotely. If you need to start early or start late to cater to your family or other needs, we donât mind, so long as you get your work done and proactively communicate. You can also work fully remote from anywhere in the world for 1 month each year

Financial benefits: We pay competitive market salaries and provide staff with generous paid time off and holiday schedules. Certain staff at Sleek are also eligible for our employee share ownership plan and can share in the upside of our stellar growth trajectory as we work toward listing on a prominent stock exchange in the Asia Pacific region.

Personal growth: Youâll get a lot of responsibility and autonomy at Sleek - we move at a fast pace so youâll be making decisions, making mistakes and learning. Thereâs also a range of internal and external facing training programmes we run. Weâre also at the forefront of utilising AI in our space and are developing a regional centre of AI excellence. It is our intention that if you leave Sleek, you leave as a more well-rounded person and professional.

Sleek is also a proudly certified B Corp. Â Since we started our journey in 2017, weâve been committed to building Sleek as a force for good. In just over 5 years, weâve joined a community of industry leaders like Patagonia, Ben & Jerry's, and P&G who are building an inclusive, equitable, and a regenerative economy.

jobs.description:
About PFM
Prop Firm Match Global FZCO is a leading platform for discovering, comparing, and selecting top proprietary trading firms. We provide traders with tools and features to easily compare challenge details, read verified reviews, see accurate payout data, and much more. We're a fast-moving, fully remote team with members from all around the world caring deeply about the quality of what we build. Our culture values ownership, clear communication, and practical impact over fluff.

About the department
Customer Experience is the front line of PFM. We're the team traders turn to when something isn't working, when they need clarity on a firm, a promotion, or their loyalty rewards, or when a payout question needs a real answer. We work across Intercom, Discord, and email to keep response times fast without losing quality and every ticket we close well is a small deposit in the trust traders place in PFM and in the firms we work with.

About the role
Deliver timely, accurate, and empathetic support that enables traders to confidently use Prop Firm Match while maintaining trust with both customers and partner firms. This role ensures every customer interaction contributes to a positive experience and protects the reputation of PFM.

Performance objectives

  • Respond to customer inquiries across Intercom tickets, Discord, and email.
  • Review and resolve customer issues end to end.
  • Tailor tone and approach to each customer's situation without sacrificing accuracy.

Success looks like
Customers receive accurate, professional, and empathetic support with high satisfaction.


Objective 2 -Â  Maintain operational excellence
Own this outcome end to end, translating it into clear priorities, coordinated execution, and measurable results.

  • Prioritize incoming tickets and follow established workflows.
  • Document cases and keep customer records up to date.
  • Escalate issues to the right team when they fall outside scope.

SLAs are consistently met while maintaining quality and minimizing escalations.

Objective 3 -Â  Ensure information accuracy

  • Verify offers, promo codes, and loyalty program submissions before responding.
  • Stay current on firm rules, payout information, and policies.

Objective 4 -Â  Support continuous improvement

  • Report bugs and flag recurring issues to Product and Development.
  • Suggest workflow improvements based on patterns you notice.

Customer feedback drives product and process improvements.


What we look for

Must have

  • Minimum 2 years of customer support or other client-facing experience, ideally in a remote, high-volume environment.
  • Strong written communication: able to explain things clearly and empathetically to non-technical customers.
  • Hands-on experience with Intercom or a similar helpdesk/ticketing platform.
  • High attention to detail: comfortable verifying specifics (promo codes, payout terms, policy language) before responding.
  • Strong time management, with the discipline to hit response-time and handling-time targets without cutting corners on quality.
  • Comfortable investigating and troubleshooting an issue independently before escalating it.
  • Professional, accountable, and collaborative: works well across teams without needing heavy oversight.

Legal Counsel - FTC (f/m/d)

Location: Luxembourg, LU

Your area of work:

We are looking for a Senior Legal Counsel to join our Corporate & Commercial Legal team on a fixed-term contract from 1 January 2027 to 31 December 2027.
Clearstream is a leading provider of post-trade services for the global securities and investment funds industry. As part of the Group Legal department, which operates across six jurisdictions, you will provide legal support to Clearstream Group entities in Luxembourg and abroad, with a particular focus on corporate law and corporate governance matters. Acting as a trusted business partner, you will advise senior stakeholders and contribute to strategic projects in a dynamic and highly regulated financial services environment.

Your responsibilities:

• Provide legal advice on corporate law and corporate governance matters to Clearstream Group entities in Luxembourg and internationally.
• Support boards of directors and senior management on legal and governance-related topics.
• Advise on regulatory matters and interactions with financial market authorities.
• Contribute to business initiatives, strategic projects and M&A transactions.
• Support the implementation of new legal and regulatory requirements.
• Draft, review and negotiate legal documentation and corporate resolutions.
• Collaborate closely with business, compliance, risk and other internal stakeholders.
• Select, instruct and oversee external legal counsel where required.

Your profile:

• Master's degree in Law (or equivalent) and qualification to practise law in a European jurisdiction.
• Minimum 8 years of professional experience in a law firm and/or in-house legal department.
• Strong expertise in Luxembourg corporate law and corporate governance.
• Good understanding of Luxembourg regulatory requirements applicable to financial institutions.
• Knowledge of civil, commercial, banking and securities law would be an advantage.
• Experience in securities services, capital markets or investment services is considered an asset.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to interact confidently with senior decision-makers.
• Fluent in English; French and/or German would be an advantage.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant - CDI - Full-Time - (M/F/X)
jobs.description:
Executive Assistant – Corporate Governance & Board Support (M/F/X)

About Luxinnovation

Luxinnovation is Luxembourg's national innovation agency. As a semi-public institution set up as an Economic Interest Group (GIE), we empower companies to innovate today to be ready for tomorrow. We also contribute to the development of the economy as a whole by identifying innovation opportunities and fostering collaborative innovation projects that stimulate the development of a sustainable, competitive and digital economy.
Luxinnovation is supported by three ministries — the Ministry of the Economy, the Ministry for Research and Higher Education, and the Ministry of Foreign and European Affairs — as well as three semi-public institutions: the Luxembourg Chamber of Commerce, the Luxembourg Chamber of Skilled Crafts, and FEDIL – The Voice of Luxembourg's Industry.

Job mission

As an Executive Assistant reporting to the General Secretary, you will serve as the primary point of coordination for the CEO's office, managing the executive diary, organising leadership meetings and ensuring seamless communication between the CEO, internal teams and external stakeholders. You will also play a central role in corporate governance by coordinating Board of Managers meetings and General Assemblies and maintaining compliance with Luxembourg's legal obligations.
You will combine high-level administrative expertise with strong organisational skills to support the agency's leadership team in delivering on Luxinnovation's mission.

Main tasks and responsibilities

Your responsibilities are structured around Luxinnovation's four core pillars of activity:

Inspire: Representing the leadership and enhancing institutional visibility
• Welcome and accompany VIP visitors, ensuring a professional and seamless experience
• Coordinate internal and external events organised by the CEO's office and the broader leadership team
• Prepare briefing documents, background notes and speaking points for the CEO's external engagements
• Support the CEO's institutional representation at high-level meetings and conferences

Assess & Accelerate: Driving operational excellence across the executive office
• Manage the CEO's diary: schedule appointments, meetings and professional travel (transport, accommodation, programmes, visa formalities where required)
• Process and validate travel-related expense reports
• Collect, consolidate and track information for the CEO on ongoing projects, events and pending requests
• Organise semi-annual and annual performance review meetings between the CEO and direct reports
• Manage and validate leave and telework requests from the CEO's direct reports
• Ensure administrative follow-up: filing, archiving and document management

Connect: Facilitating seamless communication and cross-departmental coordination
• Plan and coordinate leadership meetings: Management Committee (MCM), Staff Meetings, Managers Meetings
• Coordinate across Luxinnovation's departments to ensure fluid communication between the leadership team, staff and external partners
• Manage incoming communications: handle phone calls, emails and relay critical information to the appropriate stakeholders
• Provide ad hoc administrative support to members of the leadership team as needed

Fund: Supporting corporate governance and institutional compliance
• Plan and organise Board of Managers meetings (Conseils de gérance) and General Assemblies
• Prepare corporate governance documents: agendas, attendance lists, proxy forms, General Assembly minutes, official convocations and draft presentations
• Prepare documentation packs and dispatch official convocations and correspondence within statutory deadlines
• Coordinate logistics and room reservations for governance meetings
• Maintain and monitor legal obligations with the Luxembourg Trade and Companies Register (RCS) and the Register of Beneficial Owners (RBE)
• Handle confidential and sensitive information with the highest level of discretion

This list is not exhaustive. Additional tasks may be assigned to the holder of the job.

Required competencies

Education level and professional experience required:
• No specific diploma is required; relevant professional experience is the primary criterion
• Minimum 5 years of proven experience in a similar executive assistant, office management or corporate governance coordination role, ideally within a C-suite environment

Specific competencies:
• Demonstrated experience in C-suite diary management and complex travel coordination
• Solid knowledge of corporate governance processes: board meetings, General Assemblies, minute-taking and statutory filings
• Excellent organisational and time-management skills with the ability to handle multiple priorities simultaneously
• Strong written and verbal communication skills across multiple stakeholder levels
• High degree of discretion and ability to handle confidential information
• Proactive, solution-oriented mindset with a keen eye for detail

Amazon opened its virtual doors in 1995 and strives to be the world's most customer-centric company, where customers can find and discover anything they might want to buy online. jobs.title: Advanced Materials Engineer, Global Materials Science (m/f)
jobs.description:
Description:

Key job responsibilities
Materials Development & Innovation:
• Lead laboratory research and development of paper-based packaging materials for manual and automatic packaging, with deep understanding of pulp and paper manufacturing processes and converting operations.
• Design and execute experiments to optimize material formulations and processing parameters, applying the materials science triangle framework (processing-structure-properties) across the full range of paper-based packaging materials and converting processes.
• Develop next-generation materials solutions that unlock step-change improvements in performance, cost, sustainability, and automation compatibility—with specific focus on EU supplier capabilities and regional material availability.
• Advance materials innovations from concept, pilot, and deployment phases, ensuring solutions are compatible with EU packaging automation hardware and converting equipment.
• Evaluate and develop paper-based material systems that meet the unique performance demands of automated packaging lines, considering substrate interactions, machine speed requirements, and environmental conditions.
EU Materials Strategy & Global Alignment
• Serve as the primary conduit between EU and NA materials science teams, driving global alignment on materials specifications while identifying opportunities to harmonize and simplify across regions.
• Develop and maintain a comprehensive understanding of the EU supplier base—including paper mills, converters, and coating suppliers—and how it differs from the North American supply landscape.
• Identify region-specific materials requirements dictated by EU regulations (e.g., REACH, EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation, CEFLEX), regional material supply constraints, and operational differences in EU fulfillment networks.
• Balance global standardization with regional customization—driving simplification where materials can be harmonized and developing tailored solutions where regional requirements demand differentiation.
• Build and maintain a materials roadmap for EU that aligns with global GSP strategy and EU automation hardware development timelines.
Automation Hardware Integration
• Work closely with EU-based automation hardware development teams to ensure paper-based packaging materials are co-developed with automation equipment, optimizing for machine runnability, reliability, and throughput.
• Provide materials expertise during automation system design, commissioning, and optimization—translating materials properties into actionable equipment parameters.
• Develop deep understanding of packaging converting equipment (folders, gluers, sealers, labelers) and how paper-based materials properties influence machine performance at production speeds.
• Support troubleshooting of materials-related automation failures, conducting root cause analysis that spans materials properties, converting conditions, and equipment settings.
Materials Characterization & Testing
• Perform and direct lab engineers to conduct comprehensive materials characterization of physical, structural, strength, resistance, surface, optical, barrier, and recyclability properties while utilizing standards and non-standard methodologies.
• Establish correlations between fundamental materials properties and operational performance in fulfillment environments, with emphasis on how EU-specific substrates and converting conditions affect outcomes.
• Design and execute test plans that validate materials performance against specifications and requirements for both manual and automated packaging operations.
• Analyze test data using statistical methods to drive data-driven materials selection decisions across the EU supplier base.
Specifications & Quality
• Define materials specifications based on critical performance thresholds required for packaging to protect products and survive the fulfillment network, accounting for EU-specific substrate variability and supplier capabilities.
• Translate operational requirements and automation equipment constraints into measurable materials properties and acceptable ranges.
• Develop quality control protocols and testing methodologies to ensure EU supplier compliance with specifications, accounting for differences in regional testing standards.
• Drive specification harmonization between NA and EU where feasible, clearly documenting where and why regional deviations are necessary.
Supplier & Manufacturing Collaboration
• Work directly with EU-based paper mills, converters, and other suppliers to develop and scale new paper-based packaging materials.
• Conduct technical evaluations of EU supplier capabilities, pulp and paper manufacturing processes, converting operations, and quality control systems.
• Guide suppliers on process optimization—from pulp preparation and paper machine settings through converting and finishing operations—to achieve target material properties and consistency.
• Build strong technical relationships across the EU supplier base to enable rapid development cycles and ensure supply resilience.
Cross-Functional Partnership
• Collaborate with Packaging Design and automation hardware teams on materials-design-equipment integration, ensuring all three dimensions are optimized together.
• Partner with EU and Global Procurement (GPO) on strategic sourcing, supplier selection, and commercial negotiations within the EU supply base.
• Support sustainability initiatives including carbon footprint modeling, recyclability assessment, and compliance with EU-specific sustainability regulations and reporting requirements (REACH, EU PPWR, CEFLEX).
• Provide technical expertise to program managers, product teams, and deployment teams across both EU and NA organizations.
• Communicate complex materials science and manufacturing concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences across multiple geographies and cultures.
Documentation & Knowledge Sharing
• Author technical reports, test protocols, specifications documents, and research summaries that serve both EU and global audiences.
• Document experimental procedures, results, and learnings to build institutional knowledge, with particular emphasis on EU-NA materials differences and lessons learned.
• Present findings at design reviews, technical workshops, and leadership reviews across regions.
• Contribute to intellectual property generation through public disclosures and patent applications.
• Mentor junior engineers and technicians on materials science principles, pulp and paper manufacturing fundamentals, converting operations, and testing methodologies.
This role sits at the intersection of materials science, manufacturing processes, automation engineering, and global supply chain strategy. Your holistic understanding of how pulp becomes paper, how paper becomes packaging, and how packaging runs through automated systems makes you uniquely positioned to solve problems that span traditional disciplinary boundaries, all while keeping EU and NA aligned on a simplified, high-performing materials portfolio.
Our Mission: We build deep expertise in packaging materials through rigorous research and testing, develop innovative packaging solutions that unlock automation potential and sustainability improvements, and establish robust supply chains that deliver superior solutions at lower cost.
Our Vision: To be the global leader in e-commerce packaging materials science and innovation, enabling the best customer packaging experience at the lowest cost to serve.
What Makes Us Unique: We're not just specifying materials—we're fundamentally understanding them through the materials science triangle framework (processing, structure, properties). Our integrated capabilities span from molecular-level materials characterization, to full packaging system testing, to automation compatibility testing. This end-to-end ownership enables us to innovate faster [...]

jobs.title: Fund Legal Senior Officer – CDI (m/f)
jobs.description:
Title:  Fund Legal Senior Officer – CDI

Dept:  FUND LEGAL DEPARTMENT

Description:

The Fund Legal Department is in charge of company secretarial tasks, internal control and corporate governance for the Cayman Islands domiciled subsidiaries of NBL as well as monitoring of the legislation and regulations applicable to our business activities. The Fund Legal Department is also responsible for the legal work in relation to the set-up, restructuring and liquidation of the Cayman investment funds administered by NBL.

In order to support the department, we are looking for a legal officer on a permanent contract.

Your main tasks will be:

• Organize the board meetings for our two Cayman subsidiaries (GFTC/MTC),  Ensure the related documentation is collected, drafted, shared, signed and registered appropriately
• Coordinate and liaise with the team and lawyers for the execution and delivery of legal documents
• Draft and review GFTC/MTC's corporate governance policies and procedures. Control NBL polices applicable to GFTC/MTC.  
• Draft various regulatory reporting to Cayman authorities.
• Conduct the risk assessment of the third-party service providers (e.g. external law firms)
• Assess various invoices from the third parties.
• Assist the team to perform certain fund projects (setting up, restructuring and termination of funds).
• Safekeeping of original documents and database maintenance

Job requirements:

• Successful candidates must possess either: (a) an academic background in Studies in Law, with a preference for Luxembourg, European, and/or UK common law jurisdictions. Experience in a legal environment would be a plus; or (b) a minimum of three years of professional experience within a law firm or a legal department of financial institutions or equivalent entities
• Familiar with laws and regulations applicable for global financial institutions
• General knowledge of company secretary functions for companies and internal control
• A collaborative mindset and willingness to share administrative tasks and operational responsibilities with team members to ensure smooth departmental operations.
• A keen interest in offshore jurisdictions, with a specific focus on Cayman Islands fund structures.
• Very good level of English. In particular, advanced English writing skill is essential
• Good legal drafting and analytical skills; attention to details,
• Strong organizational and time-management skills, with a track record of meeting strict deadlines
• Sound judgment in compliance with laws and regulations as well as common sense and commercial reasonability
• Proactive with stress resilience and hands-on approach
• Good communication skills in English (French is a plus), open-mindedness, and flexibility to adapt to an international and multicultural office environment

Please be aware that in accordance with the law of July 23, 2016, the selected candidate will be requested to provide a criminal record (section 3)

If you are interested in this position and meet the job requirements, please apply by clicking on our Nomura Recruitment Gateway.

jobs.title: POMOĆNIK/POMOĆNICA U NASTAVI
jobs.description:
Na temelju članka 99. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnim i srednjim školama (Narodne novine, broj 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10, 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 126/12, 94/13, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22 i 156/23), članka 21. i 22. Zakona o osobnoj asistenciji (Narodne novine, broj 71/23), te članka 3. Pravilnika o pomoćnicima u nastavi i stručnim komunikacijskim posrednicima (Narodne novine, broj 85/24) Osnovna škola „Drago Gervais“ Brešca, Brešca 6, 51213 Jurdani, tel. 051 279 229 dana 14.09.2026. objavljuje:

NATJEČAJ

za zasnivanje radnog odnosa

1. Pomoćnik u nastavi u Osnovnoj školi „Drago Gervais“ Brešca

- 1 (jedan) izvršitelj/ica na određeno nepuno radno vrijeme, 27 sati ukupnog tjednog radnog vremena.

Ugovor o radu na određeno vrijeme za školsku godinu 2026./2027. do 31.8.2027. godine.

Mjesto rada : Brešca

Uvjeti:

  • najmanje završena četvrta srednja škola
  • završen program obrazovanja odraslih (osposobljavanja) za pomoćnika u nastavi ili edukacije za pomoćnika u trajanju od najmanje 20 sati ako je stečena do 1. srpnja 2024. godine.
  • protiv osobe nije pokrenut kazneni postupak ili koja je pravomoćno osuđena za neko od kaznenih djela iz članka 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnim i srednjim školama (Narodne novine, broj 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10, 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 126/12, 94/13, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22 i 156/23) i članka 23. Zakona o asistenciji (Narodne novine, broj 71/23).

Pomoćnik u nastavi ne može pružati potporu tijekom odgojno-obrazovnog procesa svom članu obitelji, osim kada na području osnivača odgojno-obrazovne ustanove nije moguće zaposliti pomoćnika u nastavi, a to nije u suprotnosti s interesima učenika s teškoćama u razvoju.

U prijavi na natječaj navode se osobni podaci podnositelja prijave (osobno ime i prezime, adresa stanovanja, broj telefona, odnosno mobitela, e-mail adresa) i naziv radnog mjesta na koje se prijavljuje.

Prijavu je potrebno vlastoručno potpisati.

Uz prijavu na natječaj potrebno je priložiti:

  1. životopis (vlastoručno potpisan, navedeni podatci o iskustvu u radu s djecom s teškoćama – naziv institucije/udruge/tvrtke te trajanje),
  2. dokaz o odgovarajućem stupnju obrazovanja (preslika diplome ili potvrda o stečenoj stručnoj spremi),
  3. dokaz o državljanstvu,
  4. potvrda o završenom programu edukacije odraslih odnosno edukacije za pomoćnika u nastavi,
  5. uvjerenje da nije pod istragom i da se protiv kandidata/kinje ne vodi kazneni postupak glede zapreka za zasnivanje radnog odnosa (ne starije od dana objave natječaja),

  1. dokaz da kandidatu nije pravomoćno izrečena prekršajno pravna sankcija za nasilje u obitelji (ne starije od dana objave natječaja),
  2. elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje (ne starije od dana objave natječaja).

Način dostave prijava: Prijave s potrebnom dokumentacijom o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja dostavljaju se osobno ili putem pošte na adresu Škole: Osnovna škola „Drago Gervais“ Brešca, Brešca 6, 51213 Jurdani s naznakom: „NATJEČAJ ZA POMOĆNIKA U NASTAVI – 27 SATI“.

Rok za podnošenje prijava je 8 dana od dana objave natječaja na mrežnim stranicama i oglasnoj ploči Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje, te mrežnim stranicama https://os-dgervais-jurdani.skole.hr/ i oglasnoj ploči školske ustanove.

Osoba koja ne podnese pravovremenu i potpunu prijavu ili ne ispunjava propisane uvjete iz natječaja ne smatra se kandidatom prijavljenim na natječaj i ne obavještava se o razlozima zašto se ne smatra kandidatom natječaja.

Nepravodobne i nepotpune prijave neće se razmatrati.

Sukladno članku 13. stavku 3. Zakona o ravnopravnosti spolova (Narodne novine, broj 82/08. i 69/17.) na natječaj se mogu javiti osobe oba spola.

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnom zakonu, dužan je u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti sve propisane dokaze o ostvarivanju prava prednosti prema posebnom zakonu, a ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate pod jednakim uvjetima.

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom

102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine br. 121/17., 98/19) uz prijavu na natječaj u kojoj se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju dužan je, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i dokaze propisane člankom 103. stavkom 1. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rada i članovima njihovih obitelji, a koji su navedeni na mrežnim stranicama Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za% 20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapošljavanju-

%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 49. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (NN 84/2021) uz prijavu na natječaj u kojoj se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju dužan je, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i dokaze propisane člankom 49. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata, a koji su navedeni na mrežnim stranicama Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja:

https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za% 20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapošljavanju-

%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf

Kandidat koji ostvaruje pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine, broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20) dužan je u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, kao i dokaz o invaliditetu.

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s

člankom 48.f Zakona o zaštiti civilnih i vojnih invalida rata (NN br.33/92, 57/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13, 98/19) dužan je uz

prijavu priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta i potvrdu o statusu vojnog/civilnog invalida rata i dokaz o tome na koji je način prestao radni odnos.

Kandidat koji je stekao obrazovnu kvalifikaciju izvan Republike Hrvatske, a zapošljava se u reguliranoj profesiji u sustavu odgoja i obrazovanja u Republici Hrvatskoj (nastavnik, strukovni učitelj, suradnik u nastavi, stručni suradnik u školskoj ustanovi) dužan je u prijavi na natječaj priložiti rješenje o priznavanju inozemne stručne kvalifikacije koje izdaje Ministarstvo znanosti i obrazovanja sukladno Zakonu o reguliranim profesijama i priznavanju inozemnih stručnih kvalifikacija (NN 82/15, 70/19, 47/20).

Kandidati koji su svoju obrazovnu kvalifikaciju stekli izvan Republike Hrvatske, a zapošljavaju se u sustavu odgoja i obrazovanja na radnom mjestu koje nije na popisu reguliranih profesija, dužni su dostaviti dokumentaciju sukladno Zakonu o priznavanju i vrednovanju inozemnih obrazovnih kvalifikacija (NN 69/22).

Vrednovanje kandidata: Za kandidate prijavljene na natječaj koji ispunjavaju uvjete natječaja, te čije su prijave pravodobne i potpune provest će se vrednovanje kandidata kroz usmeni razgovor (intervju).

Popis kandidata koji se pozivaju na intervju te mjesto i točan termin objavit će se u roku sedam dana od dana isteka roka za podnošenje prijava na natječaj na mrežnoj stranici škole https://os-dgervais-jurdani.skole.hr/ u izborniku pod nazivom „Natječaji i ponude“, podizbornik „Natječaji za zapošljavanje“. Poziv će se dostaviti i na elektroničku poštu kandidata.

Povjerenstvo za vrednovanje kandidata prijavljenih na natječaj koje imenuje ravnatelj, provest će usmeni razgovor (intervju) s kandidatima.

Kandidati su obvezni pristupiti postupku vrednovanja. Ako kandidat ne pristupi razgovoru, smatra se da je povukao prijavu na natječaj.

Obavijest o rezultatu ovog natječaja s imenom i prezimenom odabranog kandidata, škola će objaviti na svojim mrežnim stranicama https://os-dgervais-jurdani.skole.hr/ u izborniku pod nazivom „Natječaji i ponude“, podizbornik „Natječaji za zapošljavanje“., u roku 15 dana od dana donošenja odluke o izboru kandidata, te će se objavom rezultata natječaja smatrati da su svi kandidati obaviješteni i neće biti pojedinačno pisano obavještavani.

Iznimno od navedenog, ako se na natječaj prijavi jedan ili više kandidata za koje se utvrdi da se osnovano pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima, sve se kandidate izvješćuje istim tekstom obavijesti o rezultatima natječaja pisanom poštanskom pošiljkom, pri čemu se kandidate koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima izvješćuje pisanom preporučenom poštanskom pošiljkom s povratnicom.

Prijavom na natječaj kandidati su suglasni s javnom objavom osobnih podataka (imena i prezimena) na mrežnim stranicama škole u svrhu poziva na razgovor. Suglasni su javnom objavom osobnih podataka (ime, prezime, titula) na mrežnoj stranici škole, u svrhu obavještavanja o rezultatima natječaja. Podnošenjem prijave na natječaj kandidat daje izričitu privolu Školi da može prikupljati i obrađivati ​​osobne podatke kandidata iz natječajne dokumentacije u svrhu provedbe natječajnog postupka sukladno odredbama Opće uredbe (EU) 2016/679 o zaštiti osobnih podataka i Zakona o provedbi Opće uredbe o zaštiti podataka (Narodne novine, broj 42/18.). Kandidati su upoznati da prijave na natječaj Škola čuva i nakon isteka natječaja sukladno Posebnom popisu arhivskog i registraturnog gradiva s rokovima čuvanja i njegovim kasnijim izmjenama i dopunama.

Izrazi koji se koriste u natječaju, a imaju rodno značenje koriste se neutralno i odnose se jednako na muške i na ženske osobe.

Natječaj je objavljen na mrežnim stranicama i oglasnoj ploči Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje na mrežnim stanicama i oglasnoj ploči škole 14.9.2026.

jobs.description:

Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (NN 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10, 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 126/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 156/23 dalje: ZOOOSŠ) i članka 3. Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u Srednjoj školi Jelkovec, raspisuje se N A T J E Č A J za radno mjesto ČISTAČ/ICA - SPREMAČ/ICA – 1 izvršitelj (m/ž), na određeno nepuno radno vrijeme (20 sati ukupnog tjednog radnog vremena), zamjena, do povratka privremeno nenazočne radnice na rad na puno radno vrijeme Mjesto rada: Srednja škola Jelkovec, Vladimira Stahuljaka 1, Sesvete, a po potrebi temeljem pisane odluke ravnatelja i izvan sjedišta škole. Uz opće uvjete za zasnivanje radnog odnosa sukladno Zakonu o radu (NN 93/14, 127/17, 98/19, 151/22, 46/23 i 64/23) i poseban uvjet prema članku 10. Pravilnika o radu Srednje škole Jelkovec: završena osnovna škola.
  • životopis (obavezno navesti adresu elektroničke pošte radi dostave poziva na provedbu postupka vrednovanja kandidata)
  • dokaz o stručnoj spremi
  • dokaz o državljanstvu
  • potvrdu nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupka za neko od kaznenih djela iz članka 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi, ne starije od dana objave natječaja
  • potvrda o evidentiranom radnom stažu (elektronički zapis o radno-pravnom statusu, ne starije od dana objave natječaja)
  • privolu za obradu osobnih podataka dostupnu na mrežnim stranicama škole Isprave mogu biti priložene u neovjerenoj preslici, s potrebom dostave izvornih dokumenata na zahtjev Škole. Na natječaj se mogu javiti osobe oba spola. Kandidat/kinja koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (NN 127/17., 98/19., 84/21 i 156/23), uz prijavu na natječaj dužan/dužna je, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i dokaze propisane člankom 103. stavkom 1. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji, a koji su objavljeni na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: (https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/POPIS%20DOKAZA%20ZA%20OSTVARIVANJE%20PRAVA%20PRI%20ZAPO%C5%A0LJAVANJU.pdf) Kandidat/kinja koji se poziva na pravo prednost pod jednakim uvjetima prema članku 48. stavcima 1.-3. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (NN 84/21) obvezan je dostaviti dokaze iz stavka 1. članka 49. ovoga Zakona u svrhu ostvarivanja prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju. U nastavku se nalazi poveznica na kojoj su navedeni dokazi potrebni za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju i popunjavanju radnog mjesta: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf?fbclid=IwAR2AM0Jor0DeHCVwC6YREDtWRM318h46qCdt0-v8an8Uz4JLG9eZQ1w_SU4 Kandidatom prijavljenim na javni natječaj smatrat će se samo osoba koja podnese pravodobnu i potpunu prijavu te ispunjava uvjete iz javnog natječaja. Nepotpune i nepravodobne prijave neće biti razmatrane. Kandidati prijavljeni na natječaj prolaze vrednovanje, sukladno Pravilniku o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja KLASA: 602-03/19-10/01, URBROJ: 251-519-19-05, od 29. siječnja 2019. kroz selekcijski postupak – razgovor članova Povjerenstva sa kandidatima. Na temelju provedene procjene kandidata povjerenstvo donosi svoje pisano obrazloženo mišljenje i predaje ga ravnatelju. Na mrežnoj stranici škole bit će pravovremeno objavljeno područje provjere, pravni i drugi izvori za pripremu kandidata za testiranje, vrijeme i mjesto održavanja testiranja. Rok prijave je 8 dana od dana objave. Prijave se šalju isključivo: na e-mail ured@ss-jelkovec.skole.hr ili se predaju osobno u tajništvu škole (od 08,00-12,00). Za svaku prijavu poslanu na e-mail, odnosno predanu osobno, kandidat će dobiti potvrdu o urudžbiranju prijave. Prijava poslana na mail ne mora biti vlastoručno potpisana. Natječaj je objavljen na mrežnoj stranici Srednje škole Jelkovec i mrežnoj stranici Hrvatskog Zavoda za zapošljavanje te traje od 14.09.2026. do 22.09.2026. O rezultatima natječaja kandidati će biti obavješteni putem stranice Škole.
Ravnatelj Ivica Sambol, mag.ing.el.

jobs.title: ODGOJITELJ/ ODGOJITELJICA U  PODRUČNOM ODJELU BRDOVEC
jobs.description:
Na temelju članka 26. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju ( NN 10/97,107/07,94/13,98/19,57/22,101/23 i 22/26 ) i članka 49. Statuta Dječjeg vrtića Mali kaj (KLASA: 601-02/23-01,URBROJ: 2140-49- 601-02/23-01),Upravno vijeće Dječjeg vrtića Mali kaj na svojoj 08. Sjednici održanoj dana 10.09.2026.godine, raspisuje

NATJEČAJ za zasnivanje radnog odnosa za radno mjesto ODGOJITELJ/ ODGOJITELJICA u Područnom odjelu Brdovec

1. ODGOJITELJ

· 3 izvršitelja M/Ž - rad na nedređeno puno radno vrijeme

2. UVJETI:

· sukladno Zakonu o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (Narodne novine, br.NN 10/97,107/07,94/13,98/19,57/22,101/23 i 22/26 ) i Pravilniku o vrsti stručne spreme stručnih djelatnika te vrsti i stupnju stručne spreme ostalih djelatnika u dječjem vrtiću (Narodne novine, br. 133/97)

Posebni uvjeti:

- da osoba nije pravomoćno osuđena ili da se protiv nje ne vodi postupak sukladno članku 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju

Prednost:

- položen stručni ispit,

- 1 godina radnog iskustva,

Pored navedenih uvjeta kandidati moraju ispunjavati i opće uvjete za prijem u radni odnos:

- punoljetnost,

- zdravstvenu sposobnost za obavljanje poslova radnog mjesta.

Dokaz o zdravstvenoj sposobnosti za obavljanje poslova radnog mjesta dostavit će izabrani kandidat po dostavljenoj obavijesti o izboru ukoliko se prvi put zapošljava.

Uz vlastoručno potpisanu zamolbu - prijavu na natječaj, kandidati/kinje su obvezni priložiti sljedeću dokumentaciju:

· životopis (s posebnim osvrtom na dosadašnji rad u struci);

· dokaz o državljanstvu (preslika domovnice ili osobne iskaznice);

· dokaz o stečenoj stručnoj spremi (preslika diplome);

· dokaz o položenom stručnom ispitu (preslika svjedožbe);

· potvrdu Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje o podacima o radnom stažu evidentiranim u bazi podataka HZMO, ne stariju od dana objave ovog natječaja;

· potvrda predškolske ustanove ili drugog poslodavca odnosno preslika ugovora o radu (koja mora sadržavati vrstu poslova koju je obavljao i vremensko razdoblje u kojem je kandidat obavljao navedene poslove) ukoliko do sada nije bio zaposlenik DV Mali kaj;

· uvjerenje da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak za neko djelo iz članka 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (NN NN 10/97,107/07,94/13,98/19,57/22,101/23 i 22/26) izdanu u svrhu zapošljavanja u dječjem vrtiću koja ne smije biti starija od datuma objave natječaja;

· uvjerenje da se protiv kandidata ne vodi prekršajni postupak za neko djelo iz članka 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (NN NN 10/97,107/07,94/13,98/19,57/22,101/23 i 22/26 ) u istu svrhu i s istim rokovima;

· potvrdu Centra za socijalnu skrb (prema mjestu stanovanja) da kandidatu nisu izrečene zaštitne mjere iz članka 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (NN NN 10/97,107/07,94/13,98/19,57/22,101/23 i 22/26 ) u istu svrhu i s istim rokovima;

· izjava kandidata o nepostojanju zapreka iz članka 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (vlastoručno potpisana).

· potvrdu prethodnog poslodavca o razlogu prestanka Ugovora o radu (ukoliko je kandidat trenutno bez zaposlenja).

Sukladno članku 13. stavak 3. Zakona o ravnopravnosti spolova (NN 82/08 i 69/17) na natječaj se mogu prijaviti kandidati oba spola.

Kandidat/kinja koji/a ostvaruje pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima dužan je u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Da bi ostvario pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju, kandidat/kinja koji/a ispunjava uvjete za ostvarivanje tog prava, dužan/a je uz prijavu na natječaj priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, kao i rješenje/potvrdu o priznatom statusu iz koje je vidljivo spomenuto pravo, dokaz iz kojeg je vidljivo na koji način je prestao radni odnos kod posljednjeg poslodavca (ugovor, rješenje, odluka) te dokaz da je nezaposlen/a (uvjerenje ili evidencijski list Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje).

Kandidat/kinja koji/a se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju temeljem Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (NN 121/17 i 98/19), dužan/a je pored dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, dostaviti sve potrebne dokaze iz članka 103. navedenog Zakona. Dokazi potrebni za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju dostupni su na Internet stranici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja, na poveznici https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju.pdf

Urednom prijavom na natječaj smatra se prijava koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge navedene u natječaju. Osoba koja nije podnijela pravodobnu i urednu prijavu ili ne ispunjava formalne uvjete iz natječaja ne smatra se kandidatom prijavljenim na natječaj.

Prijave za natječaj s obveznom dokumentacijom dostavljaju se na adresu:

Dječji vrtić Mali kaj

Ivana Gorana Kovačića 13

49000 Krapina

(Za natječaj – odgajatelj, NE OTVARAJ) ili osobno u tajništvu u PO Laduč.

Rok za podnošenje prijava na natječaj je osam (8) dana od dana objave natječaja.

Nepotpune i nepravodobne prijave neće se razmatrati.

Kandidati koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete natječaja će biti pozvani na razgovor (intervju).

O terminima razgovora kandidati će biti obaviješteni najmanje tri dana prije održavanja.

Odluka o odabiru kandidata temeljem natječaja objaviti će se na mrežnim stranicama Dječjeg vrtića Mali kaj i oglasnim pločama Vrtića osam (8) dana od dana donošenja .

Nakon izvršenog natječaja ne mora se izvršiti izbor te se u tom slučaju donosi odluka o poništenju natječaja.

Natječaj je objavljen na mrežnoj stranici i oglasnim pločama Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje te mrežnim stranicama i oglasnim pločama Vrtića dana 14.09.2026. godine i traje do 22.09.2026. godine.

Prijavom na natječaj kandidat daje privolu da se njegovi osobni podaci sadržani u natječajnoj dokumentaciji koriste isključivo u svrhu provedbe javnog natječaja sukladno odredbama Zakona o provedbi Opće uredbe o zaštiti osobnih podataka i Uredbe (EU) 2016/679.

jobs.title: DOSTAVLJAČ M/Ž
jobs.description: Dostava hrane i pića biciklom putem digitalnih platformi (Glovo i Wolt). Dodatne informacije: Radnik će raditi puno radno vrijeme. 40 sati tjedno u dvije smjene - prva smjena od 8 do 16 sati, druga od 16 do 00 sati. jobs.title: Project Researcher (PhD. Student) or Postdoctoral Researcher, Electricity Markets and Flexibility (Electrical Engineering) - 2 positions
jobs.description:
The University of Vaasa is an inspiring and international community where we work together for a sustainable and responsible future. We combine expertise in business and technology in a unique way, tackling current challenges with determination and collaboration. As part of the Nordic regions largest energy technology hub, we promote sustainable business, energy, and society. We educate future professionals who will create a fairer and more sustainable world.

The University of Vaasa is seeking two motivated and talented Project Researchers or Postdoctoral Researcher to join the Research Council of Finland-funded Electricity Markets and Flexibility project.

The positions are full-time and fixed-term for three (3) years. The preferred starting date is flexible but agreed together as soon as possible. The positions are located in the School of Technology and Innovations and under electrical engineering discipline. The positions are located in Vaasa.

Background

The Electricity Markets and Flexibility project investigates how electricity markets must be designed, and how demand-side flexibility must be mobilised, for a power system dominated by variable renewable generation to remain reliable and affordable.

The project combines quantitative modelling of markets and the wider energy system with empirical analysis of how flexibility is created, priced, and traded by market participants. A central objective is to understand the interaction between market design choices and the total cost of the energy system, and to quantify the value of flexible demand, including the rapidly growing load from data centres, to system operation, investment, and consumers.

The project will produce new knowledge on electricity market design, system-level cost assessment, and demand-side flexibility, as well as new datasets, modelling methods, and blueprints. The results can be directly utilised in the scientific community, but also to improve decision-making in the public and private sectors.

The two positions are divided between two closely connected research themes. Decided theme is chosen depending on the profiles of the selected candidates.

Theme A: Electricity market design and the cost of the whole energy system

Research on this theme addresses the design of wholesale, balancing, reserve, and capacity markets under high shares of variable renewable generation; price formation, scarcity pricing, and locational signals; network charging and cost allocation; and sector coupling with heat and transport. The work involves system-level modelling of investment and operation to assess how alternative market designs affect the total cost of the energy system, security of supply, and the distribution of costs and benefits among market participants.

Theme B: Power system flexibility in data centres

Research on this theme addresses large data centres as controllable electricity loads. Topics include temporal and spatial shifting of computing workloads, the use of on-site energy storage and backup capacity, thermal flexibility and waste heat recovery, participation in wholesale, balancing, and reserve markets, grid connection and connection agreements, and the techno-economic and business case assessment of flexible operation. The work spans the modelling of data centre flexibility potential and its valuation from the perspectives of the operator, the system operator, and society.

https://www.univaasa.fi/en/about/organisation/schools/technology-and-innovations/

Your role

You will play a key role in the project team and actively participate in the implementation of different activities within the research project. The role emphasises the ability to conduct high-quality research and interact with different national and international stakeholders. Your work will contribute directly to project deliverables and high-quality academic publications.

Key responsibilities in the position:

- Contribute to the projects activities.
- Conduct independent and collaborative research within one of the projects research themes.
- Develop, apply, and document quantitative models and analyses of electricity markets, energy systems, or flexible demand.
- Collaborate with an interdisciplinary group of universities, research organisations, system operators, energy companies, technology providers, and data centre operators.
- Participate in data collection, analysis, and validation activities with industry stakeholders and policy makers.
- Lead and co-author high-quality scientific publications in international peer-reviewed journals.
- Support teaching or supervision tasks when applicable (according to university guidelines).
- Present research at academic conferences and project meetings.
- Produce a doctoral dissertation based on the research carried out within the project.

The position may also include other tasks to be agreed upon separately. All tasks are agreed in more detail in the Annual Work Plan. The annual working time is 1612 hours.

Requirements

We expect the selected person to have the ability and motivation for doctoral studies and to complete a doctoral degree.

To be eligible for a full PhD student position, the candidate is required to participate in a separate application process which is arranged at least twice a year in order to be admitted and enrolled as a doctoral student at the University of Vaasa. For more information about eligibility and the application process, please visit the Graduate School's website: [Doctoral education | University of Vaasa (uwasa.fi)](https://www.uwasa.fi/en/education/doctoral-education)

Required:

- You have a masters degree or a PhD in a relevant field.
- Strong proven interest in the research area of the project.
- Demonstrated quantitative and analytical skills, including programming or modelling experience.
- Ability to work both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.
- Motivation to produce high-quality research outputs.
- Excellent communication skills in English.

Desirable:

- Experience with energy system, power system, or electricity market modelling, and with the associated software and programming environments.
- Experience with optimisation, simulation, econometrics, or data analysis applied to energy or market data.
- Knowledge of data centre operations, computing infrastructure, or ICT energy use (Theme B).

Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (Narodne novine 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10 - ispravak, 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 126/12 - pročišćeni tekst, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20 – Uredba 151/22, 155/23 i 156/23), odredbi Zakona o osobnoj asistenciji (NN 71/2023) i Pravilnika o pomoćnicima u nastavi i stručnim komunikacijskim posrednicima (NN broj 85/2024) ravnateljica Osnovne škole Dr. Vinka Žganca Vratišinec objavljuje

JAVNI POZIV ZA

Stručno komunikacijskog posrednika u nastavi

  • 1 izvršitelj, na određeno nepuno radno vrijeme, 32 sati ukupnog radnog vremena tjedno: do završetka školske godine 2026./2027. odnosno do 31.08.2026. godine

Minimalni uvjeti za zasnivanje radnog odnosa: kandidati za stručno komunikacijskog posrednika trebaju ispunjavati uvjete utvrđene člankom 21. Zakona o osobnoj asistenciji (NN 71/2023):

(1) Stručno komunikacijski posrednik mora biti punoljetna zdravstveno sposobna osoba koja ima završen program obrazovanja odraslih (osposobljavanja) za stručno komunikacijskog posrednika i najmanje razinu obrazovanja 4.2 HKO-a.

(2) Iznimno od stavka 1. ovoga članka, Stručno komunikacijski posrednik može biti osoba koja ne ispunjava uvjet završenog programa obrazovanja odraslih (osposobljavanja) za stručno komunikacijskog posrednika iz stavka 1. ovoga članka ako je do dana stupanja na snagu ovoga Zakona završila edukaciju stručno komunikacijskog posrednika u trajanju od najmanje 20 sati i ispunjava ostale uvjete za stručno komunikacijskog posrednika propisane ovim Zakonom.

(3) Iznimno od stavka 1. ovoga članka, stručno komunikacijski posrednik može biti osoba koja ne ispunjava uvjet završene najmanje razine obrazovanja 4.2 HKO-a iz stavka 1. ovoga članka, ali ispunjava uvjet završenu najmanje razinu obrazovanja 4.1 HKO-a i ima završen program obrazovanja odraslih (osposobljavanja) za stručno komunikacijskog posrednika, ako na području osnivača odgojno-obrazovne ustanove nije moguće zaposliti stručno komunikacijskog posrednika, a to nije u suprotnosti s interesima učenika s teškoćama u razvoju.

(4) Stručno komunikacijski posrednik ne može pružati potporu tijekom odgojno-obrazovnog procesa svom članu obitelji, osim kada na području osnivača odgojno-obrazovne ustanove nije moguće zaposliti stručno komunikacijskog posrednika, a to nije u suprotnosti s interesima učenika s teškoćama u razvoju

- da protiv kandidata nije pokrenut kazneni postupak (potvrda ne starija od 6 mjeseci).

U skladu s čl. 13. st. 2. Zakona o ravnopravnosti spolova (NN 82/08 i 69/17) na natječaj se mogu javiti osobe oba spola.

Osoba koja se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine broj 121/17, 98/19 i 84/21), članku 48. stavku 1.-3. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21), članku 48. f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine broj 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03,148/13 i 98/19), članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18 i 32/20) dužna je u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu, a ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima.

Osoba koja se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji uz prijavu na natječaj dužna je priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja i ovisno o kategoriji u koju ulazi sve potrebne dokaze (članak 103.st.1.Zakona) dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja:

https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf

Osoba koja se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata uz prijavu na natječaj dužna je priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja te priložiti dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju (članak 49.st.1.Zakona) dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja:

https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf

Kandidati će o rezultatima natječaja biti obaviješteni putem web stranice škole na poveznici http://www.os-vzganca-vratisinec.skole.hr/ . Iznimno ako se na natječaj prijavi kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju, sve se kandidate izvješćuje istim tekstom pisanom poštanskom pošiljkom.

Nepravodobne i nepotpune prijave neće se razmatrati.

Javni poziv je objavljen 08. rujna 2026. godine na mrežnim stranicama i oglasnoj ploči Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje, te mrežnoj stranici i oglasnoj ploči Škole, a rok za podnošenje prijava je 8 (osam) dana od dana objave natječaja.

Zakona o pravima hrvatskih branitelja iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine broj 121/2017, 98/19 i 84/21), uz prijavu na javni natječaj dužan je, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i sve potrebne dokaze o ostvarivanju prava prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja iz članka 103. navedenog Zakona, a koji su navedeni na mrežnim stranicama Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja Republike Hrvatske: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju.pdf Kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti temeljem Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rada (Narodne novine: 84/21) dužni su dostaviti sve dokaze iz članka 49. citiranog Zakona. Dokazi potrebni za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju objavljeni su na internetskoj stranici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Urednom prijavom smatra se prijava koja sadržava sve podatke i priloge navedene u natječaju. Kandidati koji uđu u uži izbor mogu biti pozvani na razgovor. Prijavom na natječaj kandidati su izričito suglasni da Zagrebačko gradsko kazalište Komedija kao voditelj obrade može prikupljati, koristiti i dalje obrađivati podatke u svrhu provođenja natječajnog postupka, sukladno odredbama Uredbe (EU) 2016/679 Europskog parlamenta i Vijeća od 27. travnja 2016. godine o zaštiti pojedinaca u vezi s obradom osobnih podataka i o slobodnom kretanju takvih podataka te o stavljanju izvan snage Direktive 94/45/EZ (Opća uredba o zaštiti podataka) SL EU L119, i Zakona o provedbi Opće uredbe o zaštiti podataka (Narodne novine broj 42/18). Prijave s dokumentacijom (životopise s kontakt podacima, dokaz o stručnoj spremi i dokaz o ukupnom radnom iskustvu) dostaviti na mail adresu: petra.topolovsek@komedija.hr u roku od 14 dana. Nepravovremeno podnesene i nepotpune prijave neće se razmatrati. Osoba koja nije podnijela pravodobnu i urednu prijavu ili ne ispunjava formalne uvjete iz natječaja, ne smatra se kandidatom prijavljenim na natječaj. O rezultatima izbora kandidati/kandidatkinje će biti obaviješteni u zakonskom roku. Odluka o rezultatima izbora bit će objavljena na mrežnim stranicama Zagrebačkog gradskog kazališta „Komedija“. Poslodavac ima pravo ne odabrati niti jednog kandidata i poništiti natječaj, kao i organizirati provjeru znanja.
