jobs.title: Service Technician and Installation Supervisor
jobs.description:
About the position

Ferrum is looking for an experienced and hands-on Service Technician and Installation Supervisor who can take responsibility for the installation, start-up and servicing of individual machines and complete filling lines at our customers' sites. We supply solutions for the production and filling of beer and soft drinks, including process equipment, filling machines, conveyors and associated utility systems.

You will have a key role at customer sites, combining hands-on work with the coordination of installation, connection, testing and commissioning activities. The position requires solid industry experience and extensive travel. Assignments will mainly be in Denmark and elsewhere in Europe, and you must be prepared for overnight stays, changing working hours and work carried out during production shutdowns.

Your main responsibilities
  • Plan and carry out the installation, mechanical assembly and run-in of new machines and complete filling lines.
  • Act as Installation Supervisor and coordinate Ferrum technicians, customer personnel, subcontractors and other equipment suppliers on site.
  • Ensure correct positioning, levelling and mechanical integration of machines, conveyors, piping, platforms and associated equipment.
  • Carry out and verify pneumatic connections and assist with the connection of process media and utilities such as compressed air, water, CO2, nitrogen, steam, cooling and CIP.
  • Participate in testing, FAT/SAT, commissioning, production start-up and performance runs in close cooperation with project management, automation specialists and the customer.
  • Systematically troubleshoot mechanical and pneumatic faults and carry out basic fault-finding on electrical signals, sensors, drives and PLC-related issues.
  • Perform service, inspections, preventive maintenance, repairs, modifications and format changeovers on existing systems.
  • Identify the root causes of downtime and quality issues and recommend spare parts, maintenance activities and technical improvements.
  • Train customer operators and maintenance personnel in safe operation, cleaning, changeovers and routine maintenance
  • Document progress, working hours, deviations, outstanding items and completed work in daily site and service reports.
  • Ensure that all work is performed safely and in accordance with applicable safety requirements, customer site rules and relevant hygiene and food-production requirements.
  • Provide practical feedback to the project, engineering and service teams to support the continuous improvement of future solutions and installations.

Your professional background
  • You have a relevant technical qualification, for example as an industrial mechanic, marine engineer, metal fabricator, automation technician or similar. Extensive relevant industry experience may compensate for a different educational background.
  • You have several years of hands-on experience with the installation, servicing and commissioning of machinery or complete lines for the beverage, brewery, food or packaging industry.
  • You have in-depth knowledge of filling lines and preferably experience with fillers, cappers, can seamers, conveyors, mixers/carbonators, pasteurisation, CIP and utility equipment.
  • Experience from a manufacturer or service organisation such as Krones, KHS, Sidel, GEA or another supplier of process and filling lines would be a clear advantage.
  • You are able to read and work from mechanical drawings, layouts, P&IDs, pneumatic diagrams, manuals and technical documentation.
  • You have strong mechanical expertise and can perform precise alignment, installation, adjustment and systematic troubleshooting.
  • Knowledge of electrical systems, instrumentation, variable frequency drives, sensors and Siemens PLC/HMI systems is an advantage, but this is not a dedicated PLC programming role.
  • You can communicate professionally in written and spoken English. Danish or another European language would be an advantage.
  • You hold a valid driving licence and a valid EU/EEA passport, and are able to travel and work throughout Denmark and Europe without significant restrictions.

Personal qualities
  • You take ownership of your assignments and maintain an overview, even when schedules are tight or several disciplines are working simultaneously.
  • You are hands-on, solution-oriented and comfortable working independently away from the office.
  • You communicate clearly and respectfully with customers, colleagues and subcontractors and can lead site meetings in a professional manner.
  • You work in a structured manner and follow up on agreements, open items, safety, quality and documentation.
  • You are flexible regarding travel, working hours and changing priorities and understand that start-ups and production-critical service assignments may require additional effort.

We offer
  • A permanent position with significant influence on the successful delivery of international customer projects.
  • A varied working day involving new installations, commissioning, service and technical problem-solving.
  • The opportunity to work with complete solutions - from process systems and utilities to the finished filling line.
  • Close cooperation with project managers, engineers, automation specialists, suppliers and customers' technical organisations.
  • An informal company with short decision-making paths, a high level of responsibility and a strong focus on quality and professional integrity.
  • Salary and employment terms based on qualifications, together with relevant travel conditions and work equipment.


Practical information

Work location: Ferrum's base in Fredericia, combined with assignments at customer sites in Denmark and elsewhere in Europe.

jobs.title: Full Professor, Associate Professor, or Assistant Professor in Defense-related Technologies for Unmanned Aerial Systems Engineering for Defense
jobs.description:
SDU Drone Center at the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute (MMMI), University of Southern Denmark in Odense invites applications for positions in defense-related technologies for Drones (Unmanned Aerial Systems, UAS) at the levels of Full Professor, Associate Professor, or Assistant Professor. The positions are available from January 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

 

What we offer
The successful candidate(s) will join the SDU Drone Center, located at SDU Campus and at HCA Airport, where we operate state-of-the-art indoor and outdoor drone laboratories. You will become part of an interdisciplinary and agile research environment with strong ties to the internationally recognized robotics ecosystem in Odense.

 

What We expect
We expect candidates to have documented expertise in systems engineering for unmanned aerial systems with demonstrated real-world applications. The successful candidate will conduct research in aerial robotics, focusing on the design and implementation of drones operating in dynamic and complex outdoor environments. Relevant research areas include, but are not limited to, autonomous systems, swarming, navigation in GNSS-denied environments, communication and coordination, airspace situational awareness and management, safety and security, and counter-drone technologies.

Experience in defense-related research and/or applications is considered an advantage.

 

Commensurate with the seniority of the position applied for, the candidates must have:

  • Strong research and publication record;

  • Experience with defense, industrial, public sector and/or emergency services collaboration (this is a requirement for Full Professor);

  • Proven track record of attracting research funding (this is a requirement for Full Professor and Associate Professor);

  • Experience with teaching and education development (this is a requirement for Full Professor and Associate Professor).

The successful candidate(s) are expected to play a proactive role in contributing to and expanding the Center’s research portfolio. This includes active participation in ongoing projects as well as the development, leadership, and coordination of new externally funded research initiatives. The candidate(s) are further expected to secure competitive national and international research funding, establish strategic collaborations with academic, industrial, and defense stakeholders, and strengthen the Center’s position in civil and defense-related drone technologies.

The candidate(s) will contribute to teaching and supervision within the Master of Science education in Drones and Autonomous Systems, which is part of the Robotics MSc programme at the University of Southern Denmark.

Research environment
SDU Drone Center conducts research in drone technologies and future drone applications within areas such as defense, infrastructure inspection, healthcare logistics, precision agriculture, nature conservation, and environmental monitoring. We are an interdisciplinary team of researchers with specializations within robotics, computer vision, software, embedded systems, and the design and construction of drone systems. Together we create drone solutions for a flourishing European society. Learn more about the center at https://www.sdu.dk/uasFor further information please contact Head of SDU Drone Center, Professor Ulrik Pagh Schultz, ups@mmmi.sdu.dk,  phone: +45 6550 3570.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

  • Motivated application.

  • Curriculum Vitae. 

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation). 

  • Complete list of publications.

  • Publications most relevant to the position.

  • Teaching Portfolio documenting teaching, learning, and supervision qualifications and approach. Any format is acceptable; see the Faculty's teaching portfolio page for inspiration (mandatory for full professor and associate professor applicants).

  • Summary and documentation of teaching experience (for assistant professor applicants).

  • Research plan.

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is November 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as an assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 3-year period, and appointment as an associate professor and full professor is permanent. 

Employment as an assistant professor requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment. During employment, the assistant professor will complete the Lecturer Training Programme. 

Employment as an associate professor and full professor requires academic qualifications at PhD level as well as scientific and teaching qualifications commensurate with the position as an associate professor or a full professor. A completed lecturer training programme or equivalent pedagogical/didactical competence development is a prerequisite. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state included the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for assistant professor, associate professor or full professor as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

jobs.title: Collo: Data Analyst / Engineer
jobs.description:
**Employment type:** full-time, fixed-term

**Location:** Visiokatu 1, 33720 Tampere, Hybridi

**Application deadline:** 23.9.2026

Join Collo in building the intelligence layer for liquid processes.

Collo, a Finnish deep-tech company, is looking for a **Data Analyst or an Engineer** to produce insightful analytics for well-known customers. This is a fixed-term parental leave cover, with the possibility to discuss continuing in the role after the fixed-term contract ends.

**About Collo:**

Collo builds liquid process intelligence for the global food and beverage industry. The companys ambition is simple: help manufacturers understand what is happening inside their liquid processes in real time and turn that intelligence into better decisions and automated action.

Collos technology combines a unique RF-based measurement technology with science-led AI and analytics. A single inline analyzer reads the liquids unique fingerprint as it flows through the process, revealing changes that conventional factory systems often cannot see.

That intelligence helps some of the worlds leading food and beverage manufacturers reduce product losses, optimise cleaning, improve process control and ultimately make every drop matter.

Born from research at Tampere University and already deployed in 16 countries, Collo is now scaling internationally. This is your chance to join a small, highly skilled team working at the intersection of deep tech, data, industrial AI and real-world manufacturing.

**What will you be doing?**

In this role, you will join Collos Service team in a role that combines customer-facing analytics with hands-on development of the tools, pipelines, and automated workflows that make analytics more scalable and efficient.

Your responsibilities will include direct customer data analysis, visualisation, and reporting, as well as improving existing analysis pipelines, developing automated data processing, and designing scalable analysis workflows. You will work with industrial measurement and time-series data, turning it into actionable insights for Collos customers.

Your work will include participating in customer meetings, identifying analytics needs and problems in customers processes as well as developing solutions to these problems. You will conduct hands-on data analysis and communicate your findings to the customers. jobs.title: Musiikki-, kulttuuri- ja tapahtumakoordinaattori
jobs.description:
**PRM Finland Oy** hakee monipuolista työntekijää kansainvälisen musiikki-, kulttuuri-, tapahtuma- ja majoitustoiminnan kehittämiseen Kotkassa.

Tehtävässä painottuvat erityisesti musiikki-, kulttuuri- ja tapahtumatoimintaan liittyvät vastuut, mutta työnkuva sisältää myös hotellin ja majoituspalveluiden käytännön tehtäviä.

Työtehtävät

- Musiikkiesitysten toteuttaminen hotellissa, tapahtumissa, konferensseissa ja erilaisissa yleisötilaisuuksissa

- Esiintyminen Jumalanpalveluksissa ja muissa hengellisissä tilaisuuksissa

- Musiikki- ja kulttuuriohjelmien suunnittelu, koordinointi ja toteutus

- Harjoittelu ja valmistautuminen esiintymisiin

- Kulttuuritapahtumien sekä kansainvälisten tapahtumakonseptien kehittäminen

- Osallistuminen markkinointi- ja viestintäsisältöjen tuottamiseen

- Yrityksen edustaminen erilaisissa tapahtumissa ja yhteistyötilaisuuksissa


Tapahtuma- ja konferenssitoiminta

- Konferenssien, kokousten ja tapahtumien suunnittelu sekä käytännön järjestäminen

- Kansainvälisten yhteistyöverkostojen ylläpitäminen ja kehittäminen

- Vieraiden vastaanottaminen sekä tapahtumien sujuvuuden varmistaminen

- Asiakaspalvelu tapahtumien yhteydessä


Hotelli- ja majoitustoiminta

- Hotellivieraiden vastaanotto ja opastaminen

- Asiakaspalvelu- ja vieraspalvelutehtävät

- Hotellin päivittäisiin toimintoihin osallistuminen

- Tilojen yleisen viihtyvyyden ja järjestyksen ylläpitäminen

- Muut majoitus- ja hotellitoimintaan liittyvät tehtävät


Odotamme sinulta

- Kokemusta musiikki-, kulttuuri-, tapahtuma- tai asiakaspalvelualalta

- Esiintymiskokemusta ja valmiutta toimia yleisön edessä

- Hyviä viestintä- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja

- Kykyä toimia kansainvälisessä toimintaympäristössä

- Kokemusta tapahtumien suunnittelusta tai koordinoinnista

- Kokemusta markkinoinnista, viestinnästä tai sosiaalisen median sisällöntuotannosta katsotaan eduksi

- Joustavaa, oma-aloitteista ja vastuullista työotetta


Kielitaito

- Suomi: välttävä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito

Tarjoamme

- Monipuolisen ja luovan työnkuvan

- Vaihtelevan työympäristön, jossa yhdistyvät esiintyminen, tapahtumat, kulttuuri ja vieraspalvelu

- Mahdollisuuden hyödyntää omaa osaamista useilla liiketoiminnan osa-alueilla

- Kansainvälisen ja kasvavan toimintaympäristön


**Työpaikan sijainti:** Kotka **Työsuhde:** Kokoaikainen, toistaiseksi voimassa oleva **Työnantaja:** PRM Finland Oy

jobs.title: Office Manager
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Location: Dublin, Ireland Salary: €55,000 plus Sodexo benefits Contract: Full-time, Permanent About the Role We are looking for an organised and proactive Office Manager to support the delivery of hard and soft facilities services across multiple client sites. This is a varied, hands-on coordination role where you’ll help ensure services are delivered safely, consistently and to a high standard. You’ll work closely with clients, contractors and internal teams while coordinating a team of up to 20 employees and managing day-to-day facilities requirements. Travel between sites will be required Key Responsibilities: Coordinate day-to-day hard FM services, including planned and reactive maintenance, statutory inspections, utilities and contractors. Coordinate soft services including cleaning, reception, waste, pest control, workplace support and events. Lead, schedule, coach and performance-manage a multi-site team. Act as the main point of contact for facilities queries, work orders and escalations. Build strong relationships with clients and stakeholders and resolve issues professionally. Coordinate contractor access, permits, inductions, risk assessments and method statements. Maintain accurate operational, compliance and service records. Support audits, inspections and corrective actions. Monitor SLAs, KPIs, maintenance schedules, staffing, supplies and expenditure. Support purchasing, purchase orders, deliveries, invoices and inventory control. Coordinate site meetings, moves, events and business continuity activities. Promote strong Health & Safety, environmental and service standards. Identify opportunities to improve quality, efficiency and customer experience. What We Ae Looking For We are looking for someone with strong facilities coordination, people management and customer service skills. You will ideally have: Fluency in Mandarin Experience coordinating facilities operations across one or more sites. Experience across both technical and workplace/soft services. Proven experience leading, scheduling or managing teams. Good understanding of Health & Safety, compliance, audits and contractor management. Excellent organisation, communication and problem-solving skills. Experience using Microsoft Office and CAFM/helpdesk systems. Confidence working with KPIs, service data and operational reporting. The flexibility to travel between sites and respond calmly to changing priorities. A proactive, customer-focused approach with strong attention to detail. Sodexo reserves the right to close this advert early if we are in receipt of a high number of applications

jobs.title: Directeur Adjoint de Village (H/F)
jobs.description:
Villages clubs du soleil acteur majeur du tourisme social et familial, certifié ISO 9001, expert dans l'accueil de familles en formule " tout compris " en France et entreprise à taille humaine avec des valeurs solides, recherchent pour la prochaine saison d'hiver 2027, un directeur Adjoint de village F/H pour ses Villages Clubs de Montagne. Véritable relais du directeur F/H et en interaction permanente avec les chefs de service, il/elle doit :

Manager, animer et coordonner l'ensemble des services, et plus particulièrement la restauration
Participer au recrutement et gérer les ressources humaines du village dans le respect des engagements de l'entreprise
Assurer une relation client de qualité et anticiper leurs attentes
Veiller à la réalisation du produit et à la bonne application de la démarche qualité

En qualité de manager, vous êtes un véritable vecteur de la culture d'entreprise dans un esprit basé sur des valeurs de Respect,  Solidarité et Excellence qui favorisent l'engagement et le développement humain de tous nos collaborateurs.

Vous avez :

Issu(e) d'une formation supérieure en hôtellerie ou en management, vous parlez couramment le langage de la gestion et du service. Le terrain est votre seconde nature : Fort(e) d'une expérience de 3 ans minimum, vous excellez dans le management d'équipe et le pilotage d'un centre de profit. Le petit plus qui fera la différence ? Une expertise éprouvée dans l'univers du tourisme ou de la restauration.

Statut Cadre en forfait jours.
Logement et repas fournis en avantage en nature.

jobs.title: Tiimipäällikkö
jobs.description:
**Toimintamme kasvaessa etsimme nyt neljättä tiimipäällikköä Huolenpitotiimiin. Meillä pääset oppimaan jatkuvasti uutta asuntosijoittamisesta ja vuokrasuhteiden hallinnoinnista.**

Asuntopehtoori on täyden palvelun asuntovarallisuuden hoitaja, joka tarjoaa asiakkailleen vuokravälitystä, asuntovälitystä, vuokra-asuntojen Huolenpitopalvelua sekä isännöintiä. Olemme ketterä ja nykyaikainen toimija, joka tunnetaan loistavasta asiakaspalvelustaan sekä kilpailukykyisestä hinnoittelustaan. Toimimme 14 eri kaupungissa palvellen asiakkaita ympäri Suomen!

Meillä Asuntopehtoorin Huolenpitopalvelussa teet tiivistä yhteistyötä Huolenpitopalvelun muiden tiimipäällikön, sihteeriemme ja välittäjiemme sekä liiketoimintajohtajan kanssa. Tiimissämme on yhdessä tekemisen meininki ja hyvä yhteishenki!

Tiimipäällikön tehtävänä on varmistaa, että tiimin päivittäinen työ sujuu tehokkaasti, ja asiakkaamme saavat laadukasta ja asiantuntevaa palvelua. Tiimipäällikkönä vaikutat suoraan siihen, miten tiimi toimii, millaista palvelua asiakkaamme saavat ja miten pystymme vastaamaan kasvun tuomiin tarpeisiin. Etsimme henkilöä, jolla on kyky itsenäiseen työskentelyyn, kyky kantaa vastuuta omasta ja tiimin työskentelystä sekä halua kehittää toimintaa ja auttaa tiimiä onnistumaan yhdessä.

**Työnkuva:**

- Tiimin päivittäisen työn johtaminen ja resursointi huomioiden mm. lomat ja poissaolot

- Työntekijöiden tukeminen ja esihenkilötyö

- Uusien työntekijöiden rekrytointi ja perehdytys

- Raportointi ja palkkojen koostaminen

- Sihteereiden tukeminen erilaisissa vuokrasuhteisiin liittyvissä haastavissa tilanteissa

- Haastavien asiakastilanteiden ratkaiseminen

- Palvelun laadun seuranta ja kehittäminen

- Asiakastyytyväisyyden parantamiseen tähtäävien toimintatapojen kehittäminen

- Yhteistyö muiden tiimien ja sidosryhmien kanssa


**Odotamme rooliin valitulta henkilöltä:**

- Osaamista tiimin johtamisesta ja esihenkilötyöstä

- Kykyä kantaa vastuuta sekä omasta että tiimin tekemisestä ja toimia esimerkkinä muille

- Kykyä seurata, arvioida ja kehittää työn laatua sekä puuttua tarvittaessa havaittuihin puutteisiin

- Aiempaa kokemusta sijoitusasunnoista ja vuokrasuhteiden hallinnoinnista

- Hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja ongelmanratkaisutaitoja

- Itsenäistä, järjestelmällistä ja vastuullista työotetta

- Rohkeutta tehdä päätöksiä, viedä asioita määrätietoisesti eteenpäin ja ottaa myös haastavia asioita rakentavasti puheeksi

- Rakentavaa ja ratkaisukeskeistä asennetta, kykyä toimia joustavasti muuttuvissa tilanteissa sekä valmiutta sitoutua yhteisiin tavoitteisiin ja viedä niitä eteenpäin myös haastavissa tilanteissa


Lisäksi arvostamme asunto-osakeyhtiölain ja huoneenvuokralain perusteiden osaamista sekä kokemusta kiinteistönvälitysalalta tai asuntosijoittamisesta. Aiempi kokemus vuokravälityksestä, vuokravalvonnasta, vuokrasuhteiden hoitamisesta, LKV/LVV-tutkinto tai muu työtehtävää tukeva koulutus katsotaan eduksi.

Luottamus ja vastuullisuus ovat toimintamme perusta, minkä vuoksi tehtävään valittavalta henkilöltä tarkistetaan luottotiedot.

**Työaika ja työskentelypaikka**

Työaika arkisin klo 8.00-16.00. Työ pitää sisällään satunnaisia viikonloppuvuoroja muutaman kerran vuodessa. Työskentelypaikka on Asuntopehtoorin toimisto. Saat kuitenkin itse valita, että millä toimistostamme tulisit työskentelemään, joten kerrothan hakemuksessa mikä toimistomme olisi sinulle mieluisin.

  • Vedligeholde en ren og organiseret arbejdsplads

  • Bidrage til en god og venlig kundeoplevelse

  • Trives i et travlt miljø og kan bevare overblikket

  • Har sans for detaljer og brænder for god mad

  • Har en positiv indstilling og fungerer godt i et team

jobs.title: Autovuokraamotyöntekijä Turku
jobs.description:
Olemme Hertz, maailmanlaajuinen johtava autovuokraamo. Toimimme n. 150 maassa ja 8300 toimipisteessä. Vuokraamme erikokoisia autoja henkilö- ja pakettiautoista minibusseihin. Toiminnassamme pyrimme minimoimaan ympäristöhaitat ja olemme siinä edelläkävijä myös Suomessa. Kalustoomme kuuluukin hybridejä, plug-in hybridejä sekä täyssähköautoja. Meillä pääset työskentelemään yhteisöllisessä ja kehittyvässä työympäristössä osana kansainvälisesti tunnettua yhtiötä.

Etsimme nyt Turun alueelle autovuokraamotyöntekijää. Työtehtävät ovat monipuolisia ja koostuvat asiakaspalvelusta sekä operatiivisista toiminnoista, kuten mm. autojen pesuista, siirroista, vauriotarkastuksista ja luovuttamisesta asiakkaille.
Työtä tehdään aamu- ja iltavuorossa, arkisin 7:00–19:00 välisenä aikana. Työtehtäviin kuuluu myös ajoittaisia päivystys- ja viikonloppuvuoroja.
Toivomme sinun olevan nopea omaksumaan uusia asioita ja työmenetelmiä, oma-aloitteinen, joustava ja yhteistyökykyinen. Tulet hyvin toimeen ihmisten kanssa, etkä hätkähdä nopeatempoista työtä tai uusia ja välillä haastaviakin tilanteita. Olet asiakaspalveluhenkinen ja tulet sujuvasti toimeen kotimaisen kielen lisäksi ainakin englannin kielellä. Muu kielitaito on hyödyksi. Olethan vähintään 18-vuotias ja omistat voimassa olevan ajokortin. Jos kuvaus osui sinuun, saatat hyvinkin olla kohta yksi meistä.

Tarjoamme sinulle:
- Kansainvälisen työilmapiirin
- Kattavan perehdytyksen työtehtävien laadukkaaseen hoitamiseen
- Tuntipalkan kokemuksen mukaan, alkaen 13,07 €/h
- Loistavan lisäansainta mahdollisuuden tiimitavoitteiden ja henkilökohtaisten suoritepalkkioiden muodossa
- Lounas- ja liikuntaedun
- Mukavat työkaverit sekä loistavan mahdollisuuden kehittää itseään asiakaspalvelutehtävissä


Haluaisitko sinä olla osa huikeaa tiimiämme?

Haethan tehtävää viimeistään 27.9.2026 mennessä. Ota kuitenkin huomioon, että haastattelut aloitetaan jo hakuaikana ja avoimet työpaikat täytetään mahdollisimman pian. Käytämme rekrytointiprosessin osana videohaastatteluja. Lähetä liitteenä hakemuskirjeesi, CV ja mahdolliset muut liitteet, joissa on kuvattu osaamistasi. Kuulemme mielellämme myös osaamista tukevista harrastuksistasi ja mielenkiinnon kohteistasi.

Työskentely on nopeatempoista ja vaatii kykyä hypätä työtehtävästä toiseen. Työhön sisältyy myös hetkiä, jolloin työskentelet vuorossa yksin, joten edellytämmekin sinulta täysi-ikäisyyttä. Olet saletisti etsimämme myyjä, mikäli viihdyt sosiaalisessa ja itsenäisessä työssä, sekä toivotat tervehtimällä ja olemuksellasi asiakkaat tervetulleeksi myymälään. Pidät tiimin kanssa myymälän hyvässä kunnossa ja tartut oma-aloitteisesti kaikkiin työtehtäviin. Eduksi katsomme aiemman työkokemuksen myyjän tehtävistä ja yksintyöskentelystä. Jos ihan tavalliset työt houkuttaa, laita hakemusta tulemaan 16.9 mennessä! Me ollaan sinuun yhteydessä sähköpostitse tai puhelimitse 010 764 –alkuisesta numerosta. Kannattaa seurata myös roskapostia, sillä meidän viestit voivat eksyä myös sinne.

Turun Osuuskauppa on osa S-ryhmää ja yksi alueensa suurimmista työllistäjistä. Meillä työskentelet vakaassa organisaatiossa, jossa pääset kehittämään osaamistasi ja rakentamaan entistä parempia asiakaskokemuksia yhdessä ammattilaisten kanssa. Me Turun Osuuskaupassa työskentelemme ihan tavallisissa töissä. Tavallisuus ei tarkoita, että meillä olisi tylsää tai osaamatonta porukkaa töissä – päinvastoin! Meillä on harvinaisen hyvä työilmapiiri, epätavallisen hyvät henkilöstöedut ja poikkeuksellisen paljon monipuolisia työmahdollisuuksia. 82 % työntekijöistämme suositteleekin meitä työpaikkana. jobs.description: À propos de la mission Nous recherchons un(e) Freelance Social Media Manager expérimenté(e) pour développer et piloter la présence de nos clients, principalement des TPE et PME, sur les réseaux sociaux. La mission couvre l'ensemble du cycle Social Media : de la définition de la stratégie éditoriale à la création et publication des contenus, en passant par l'animation des communautés et l'analyse des performances. Identifier les plateformes les plus pertinentes : LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, etc. Définir les lignes éditoriales, piliers de contenu, formats et fréquences de publication. Construire et gérer les calendriers éditoriaux. Réaliser une veille régulier/ière sur les tendances, formats et évolutions des différentes plateformes. Création & Rédaction de Contenu Concevoir les sujets et angles éditoriaux adaptés à chaque marque. Rédiger les publications en respectant le ton et l'identité de chaque client. Créer des contenus engageants adaptés aux spécificités de chaque plateforme. Rédiger des accroches, captions et appels à l'action efficaces. Préparer des briefs clairs pour les graphistes, vidéastes ou motion designers lorsque des créations plus avancées sont nécessaires. Garantir la cohérence entre les contenus publiés et l'identité visuelle de chaque marque. Publication & Community Management Planifier et publier les contenus sur les différentes plateformes. Assurer la cohérence et la régularité des publications. Suivre les commentaires, messages et interactions. Animer les communautés et favoriser l'engagement. Identifier les opportunités permettant de développer organiquement les audiences. Création : bonne maîtrise de Canva ou d'outils similaires pour la production de contenus simples et capacité à travailler avec des créatifs sur des productions plus avancées. Stratégie : capacité à construire une véritable stratégie éditoriale au-delà de la simple publication de contenus. Analytics : capacité à analyser les performances Social Media et à transformer les résultats en recommandations concrètes. IA : bonne maîtrise des outils d'IA appliqués à la recherche, l'idéation et la création de contenu. TPE/PME : bonne compréhension des enjeux et contraintes des petites et moyennes entreprises. Organisation : excellente capacité à gérer plusieurs clients et calendriers éditoriaux simultanément. Qualités : autonomie, créativité, rigueur, proactivité et capacité à proposer régulier/ièrement de nouvelles idées. Portfolio : la capacité à présenter des comptes gérés, exemples de contenus réalisés et résultats obtenus sera particulier/ièrement appréciée. jobs.description: Afin de renforcer les équipes de DEEP au sein de Business Line Cloud, nous recherchons actuellement un(e) DEEP - Cloud Systems Architect - Cloud Souverain (m/f/n) à temps plein.Vos missions Concevoir et spécifier des architectures cloud complexes sur OVH Public Cloud, Clever Cloud et, selon les besoins, OPCP, en garantissant leur performance, leur sécurité, leur résilience et leur conformité. Analyser les besoins métiers et techniques des clients, définir les trajectoires de transformation et élaborer les architectures et services cibles adaptées aux contraintes d'exploitation, de sécurité, de souveraineté et de time-to-market. Accompagner les projets de migration et de modernisation d'infrastructures et de plateformes applicatives vers OVH Public Cloud, Clever Cloud et des approches cloud native basées sur Kubernetes et services managés. Diriger ou encadrer l'intégration des composants techniques nécessaires aux solutions retenues : réseau, sécurité, IAM, observabilité, sauvegarde, CI/CD, registry, plateformes Kubernetes, services de données et composants d'automatisation. Garantir l'intégration de la sécurité dès la conception (security by design), ainsi que l'application des bonnes pratiques de résilience, de continuité, de sauvegarde, de conformité et de gouvernance. Piloter la standardisation et l'industrialisation des plateformes via l'Infrastructure as Code, l'automatisation, les pratiques DevOps/GitOps et les pipelines de déploiement. Définir et faire appliquer les architectures de référence pour les environnements cloud native, incluant les aspects de déploiement, d'observabilité, de logging, de gestion des secrets, de sécurité et de cycle de vie des plateformes. Apporter une expertise d'architecture sur les sujets PaaS, plateformes conteneurisées, intégration applicative, services managés et écosystèmes open source liés au cloud native. Jouer un rôle de référent technique auprès des équipes d'ingénierie, d'exploitation, de delivery, d'avant-vente et des clients, afin de sécuriser les choix techniques et de favoriser l'adoption des solutions définies. Assurer une veille technologique active et proposer des évolutions pertinentes sur les services OVH, Clever Cloud, les technologies cloud native et les approches d'automatisation afin d'enrichir les offres et les plateformes de DEEP. Réaliser des missions de consultance en architecture auprès des clients, afin de les accompagner dans la définition de leurs trajectoires cloud, l'évaluation des choix techniques et la conception de solutions adaptées à leurs enjeux métier et techniques. Supporter, concevoir et faire émerger de nouveaux services autour de ses domaines de compétence (cloud public, cloud native, architecture, automatisation, plateforme), en participant à la définition des standards, des briques techniques, de la documentation et du positionnement de ces services dans le catalogue de l'entreprise. Votre profil Disposer d'une formation de niveau Master spécialisée en informatique, systèmes, réseaux et cloud, et/ou d'une expérience professionnelle équivalente. Disposer d'une expérience significative dans la conception, l'intégration ou l'évolution d'architectures cloud pour des clients, avec une capacité démontrée à cadrer des solutions complexes. Maîtriser les concepts et architectures IaaS, PaaS, KaaS, cloud public, cloud souverain et services managés. Avoir une connaissance d'OVH Public Cloud et/ou de Clever Cloud. Maîtriser les principes d'architecture cloud native et les plateformes conteneurisées, en particulier Kubernetes et l'écosystème associé. Connaître plusieurs technologies cloud native et DevOps parmi les suivant/antes : GitLab, Keycloak, Nexus, SonarQube, FluxCD, Crossplane, Velero, Kasten, RabbitMQ, Kafka, OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Elasticsearch, Prometheus, AKS, EKS ou équivalents. Avoir une bonne connaissance dans les pratiques d'automatisation et d'Infrastructure as Code telles que Terraform, Ansible ou équivalents, ainsi que les approches CI/CD et GitOps. Être capable d'intégrer les exigences de sécurité, de conformité, de gouvernance et d'exploitabilité dans les choix d'architecture. jobs.title: Engineering Manager TLM Platform
jobs.description:
The Problem

36 million businesses in America need insuranceâit's not optional. 77% are underinsured. 40% have no coverage at all. The distribution system failed them: too slow, too opaque, too confusing.

Over 90% of commercial insurance is still human-led. We're building the inverse: 90%+ AI-led, pushing toward the higher 90s. Not by patching legacy workflowsâby building AI that makes humans more effective, improves the customer experience, and eliminates friction at every step.

We're adding ~1,000 customers per month. We've grown 100x since last year. We're looking to do even more this yearâand that's why we're hiring.

You'll build the team and the systems the rest of engineering depends on. When they compound, everyone gets faster.

The Thesis

Harper runs 200+ services across Railway and AWS. We orchestrate N parallel agentic workloads. Our AI systems make thousands of decisions a day, and every decision needs to be traceable, evaluated, and cheaper to run tomorrow than it is today. The infrastructure underneath all of that is the difference between a company that scales and one that stalls.

Great platform engineering here isn't invisibleâit's the reason product ships fast. When observability catches a silent failure before a customer does. When a pooling layer makes connection exhaustion a non-issue. When developer velocity doubles because someone built the tool nobody knew they needed. That leverage compounds across every other engineer on the team.

The Role

This role is open both to an experienced EM and to someone on the path to becoming an EM who doesn't yet have significant management experienceâwe're happy to bring that person on and support the transition.

This is a team that still needs to be built. We have 2 people in it today, and we believe this area needs significant investment at Harper. The role owns three things: infrastructure (cloud, third-party vendors, and everything surrounding it), developer productivity (making sure we're genuinely an AI-first shop, with the right AI tooling and harnesses in place for every other engineering team to be successful), and SRE and production support (production discipline is top of mind as we head into a high-growth, high-scale phaseâwe need someone who has run an SRE function before). Each of these three areas can grow into a larger team of its own over time.

The team is 2 people today, growing to five to six over the next three months. Because the team is small, whoever takes this roleâEM or TLMâwill need to be hands-on at the start, working directly with the team and doing the work themselves.

What You'll Do

  • Own infrastructure â cloud, third-party vendors, and everything surrounding it

  • Build developer productivity â the AI tooling and harnesses that make every other engineering team genuinely AI-first

  • Own SRE and production support â bring production discipline as we head into a high-growth, high-scale phase

  • Build out the team â grow from 2 people to five to six over the next three months

  • Stay hands-on â with a team this small, work directly alongside your engineers and do the work yourself, not just direct it

  • Grow each function over time â infrastructure, developer productivity, and SRE/production support can each become a larger team of its own

You Might Be a Fit If...

  • Have at least 2 years as a line manager directly managing teams of six to ten peopleâor clear readiness to grow into that role

  • You've been a line manager for at least two years, directly managing teams of six to ten peopleâor you're on a clear path there and want to grow into it

  • You have hands-on experience with AWS or GCP and strong database troubleshooting skills

  • You've seen real scaleâon the order of at least a million requests per minute

  • You can troubleshoot across databases, networking, compute, Docker, Kubernetes, and other aspects of infrastructure

  • You care as much about developer productivity and AI tooling as you do about raw infrastructure

  • You know on-call practices, SLAs, SLOs, and SRE practices generally

  • You want to stay hands-on and grow into a fuller managerial role over time

  • You move fast, with the same appetite as the rest of Harper

Nice to Have

  • Your own network to draw on for hiringâotherwise, comfort working closely with recruiters

  • Experience building developer productivity tooling and AI harnesses for other engineering teams

  • Experience building a team from a very small base

  • Prior startup experienceâespecially at a company scaling through hypergrowth

Compensation & Logistics

  • Salary: $225,000â$275,000

  • Location: San Francisco, in-office. Based in SF or willing to relocate.

  • Schedule: MondayâFriday, in-office five days a week.

  • Benefits: Uber commuter benefits; breakfast, lunch, and dinner provided; snacks, drinks, and coffee daily; free gym membership; health, dental, and vision insurance.

The Process

  1. Hiring Manager screen - 30 min video chat.

  2. Technical screen â 60 min remote: project deep dive + system design

  3. Super Day on-site â meet the team, sit in on the operation, do real work alongside us.

jobs.title: Senior People & Talent Operations Partner
jobs.description:
â¡ This one's going to move fast. We're expecting a lot of interest, so we're running this as a focused hiring sprint. Applications and assessments close September 20, with interviews happening over the two weeks after that.Â 

ð Where do we hire from? Almost everywhere. Check that your country appears on this page. For this role, you'll have at least 4 hours daily overlap with your UK-based manager.

Hi there, I'm Olive Turon, Head of People & Culture at TestGorilla. I'm excited to share more about the Senior People & Talent Operations Partner role and our team.

About TestGorilla

At TestGorilla, we're on a mission to place 1 billion people in their dream jobs. To democratize opportunity, we're building the world's leading skills-based talent discovery platform - one that replaces reliance on resumes with scientific validation of what people can truly do.

Founded as a 100% remote company in 2020, our global team is united by high standards, a lot of heart, and a relentless drive to conquer new technological frontiers. We're all AI-fluent builders who care deeply about replacing bias with fairness.

After empowering thousands of companies to hire smarter and faster, we're now unlocking the next phase of our scale-up journey - where you'll play an instrumental role in creating a world where skills matter most!

About the role

As our Senior People & Talent Operations Partner, you'll own People Ops as a product: the systems, compliance, and self-serve workflows that let most of People & Culture run itself day to day, plus the tooling behind how we hire. You'll join a lean, two-person team, working directly with me, with proper and lasting ownership from day one.Â 

Payroll, compliance, and HR systems across every (35, currently!) country we operate in are foundational elements of this role. Just as critically, you'll build and own the AI/automation and self-serve layer that keeps our People function lean, bringing a product mindset to everything you touch.Â  Letâs face it: weâre a scale-up, so youâll also need to be happy wearing other People hats when the moment requires.

We're looking for someone autonomous, opinionated and candid, who'll tell me when I've got it wrong. You'll be dealing with real people and real problems, so you'll need to stay empathic but boundaried, structured and organized even when the pace picks up.

Iâm biased, but I think itâs a dream job: this is an HR role in an HRTech company changing the world of work for the better, weâll have immense amounts of fun, thereâs plenty of uncharted territory for you to make your own, and Iâm committed to helping you to do the best work of your life.

A quick check: if you've never built objectively clever automations (not just used one someone else built), this probably isn't the role for you. Automation is just that central to the job.

Responsibilities

In this role, your responsibilities will include:

  • Upholding TestGorilla's behaviors and fostering an inclusive, supportive culture.

  • Designing, building and maintaining a smart, automated and AI-enabled people journey - from pre-boarding to off-boarding - that frees up capacity for bespoke, white-glove treatment where it matters

  • Being the technical owner and orchestrator of our HR tech stack: evaluating and enhancing it, ensuring these tools are not siloed but unified and integrated.

  • Owning the non-Finance side of payroll, invoicing, contract administration, and compliance end to end, across every country we operate in.

  • Owning data privacy and recordkeeping, and the day-to-day relationship with our EOR vendor.

  • Owning configuration and troubleshooting of our hiring tooling, so hiring managers can run their own searches independently.

  • Owning the documentation that makes self-serve actually work in practice, ensuring that itâs structured in a way that is easily accessible to both humans and P&C AI agents.Â 

  • Working with me to maintain a clean line between what's self-serve and what needs a person. We do not aspire to automate our entire People journey here.Â 

What you'll bring

We're looking for someone who:

  • Is passionate about TestGorilla's mission to help one billion people find their dream jobs.

  • Has excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

  • Has built and owned sophisticated automations (Zapier, n8n, Make.com, and the like) as a core part of an integrated HR tech stack, not just used AI tools day to day. Arguably the most important thing on this list.

  • Has managed payroll, compliance, or HR operations across multiple countries, ideally through an Employer of Record or a mix of EOR and direct entities.

  • Has deep, hands-on HRIS experience. HiBob experience is a big plus, and so is experience assessing or migrating HR systems.

  • Brings a product mindset: builds for the people who use them (employees and managers), listens to their feedback, and iterates rather than building in isolation.

  • Thrives in a high-autonomy, async-first, remote-only environment, and has worked in these kinds of teams and working cultures before.

  • Marries operational rigor with genuine empathy and a real interest in people. You'll be dealing directly with team members, sometimes on sensitive matters.

  • Is opinionated and candid, with excellent feedback and stakeholder management skills.

Most people in this role will have acquired these skills over five years of relevant experience. That being said, we care far more about what you've owned, your impact and how you've progressed, than the exact number of years.

We seek diversity and encourage applications from everyone, even if your experience doesn't exactly match the description. Studies show that women and underrepresented groups can be hesitant to apply unless they meet every requirement - let's buck that trend!

Bonus skills

While these skills aren't a requirement, we'd be very interested to hear from you if you have any of the following:

  • Experience with an ATS or hiring platform such as Ashby, Greenhouse, or Lever.

  • Experience with an EOR provider such as Remote, Deel, or Oyster.

  • HRIS implementation or migration project experience.

  • Experience supporting a team through organizational change.

What's in it for you?

Please note: In this role, you'll be hired as an Individual Contractor.

  • Global Team: Join a fully remote, mission-driven team from around the world.

  • Competitive compensation: â¬56,520 - â¬70,650 base pay + Share Appreciation Rights (SARs). This role doesn't carry a bonus component.

  • Remote & flexible work: Work from almost anywhere*. Enjoy flexible hours and asynchronous work to balance work and life.
    *Check out the countries we currently hire from here.

  • Remote work budget: â¬1,000 available each year, or up to â¬2,000 from day 1 if you're buying a laptop!

  • Growth & development: Invest in yourself and your career with a 3.5% L&D budget per year and clear growth opportunities.

  • Parent/Caregiver support: We provide a caregiver-friendly work environment with paid 8-16 week parental leave and tailored return-to-work approaches.

  • Work-life balance: Our unlimited and flexible time off policy empowers you to take the time you need to recharge and maintain your well-being.

Interested?

At TestGorilla, we believe your skills speak louder than your resume. That's why we champion a skills-first approach, using cutting-edge, AI-powered assessments to uncover your true skills and experience match.

When you apply, you'll get to experience our platform firsthand by taking an assessment â it's your invitation to shine and show us what you can do! While our platform is powered by AI, every hiring decision is made by humans. Check out our Applicant Privacy document to see how we protect your data.

Given the hiring sprint timeline above, we'd love to see your application land before September 20.

Concerned about test anxiety or need help with the assessment? We've got you covered. Please check out our candidate support page for any questions. Accommodations are readily available as part of the assessment setup, and requesting support will never impact your application.

jobs.description:

Na temelju članka 107.   1. Prema čl. 105. i 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (NN 87/08., 86/09., 92/10.,105/10.-ispr., 90/11., 5/12., 16/12. 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 i 156/23) i Pravilniku o stručnoj spremi i pedagoško-psihološkom obrazovanju učitelja i stručnih suradnika u osnovnom školstvu (NN 6/19);
  2. Prema Zakonu o odgoju i obrazovanju na jeziku i pismu nacionalnih manjina (NN 51/00.,56/00-ispr.).
Za radna mjesta potrebno je poznavanje talijanskog jezika na razini materinjeg jezika (osim radnog mjesta br.5). Uz potpisanu prijavu kandidati su dužni priložiti životopis, diplomu, dokaz o državljanstvu, elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji HZMO-a i uvjerenje da se protiv kandidata ne vodi istražni ili kazneni postupak ne stariji od šest (6) mjeseci. Kandidati koji su stekli inozemnu obrazovnu kvalifikaciju dužni su također dostaviti: rješenje određenog visokog učilišta o priznavanju potpune istovrijednosti u skladu sa Zakonom o priznavanju istovrijednosti stranih školskih svjedodžbi i diploma ili rješenje Agencije za znanost i visoko obrazovanje o stručnom priznavanju inozemne visokoškolske kvalifikacije u skladu sa Zakonom o priznavanju inozemnih obrazovnih kvalifikacija te u skladu sa Zakonom o reguliranim profesijama i priznavanju inozemnih stručnih kvalifikacija, rješenje Ministarstva znanosti i obrazovanja o priznavanju inozemne stručne kvalifikacije radi pristupa reguliranoj profesiji. Kandidati koji ističu posjedovanje dodatnih kvalifikacija, znanja i edukacija dokumentaciji prilažu i dokaze za iste i to: uvjerenje ili certifikat, ili potvrda, ili svjedodžba ili druga javna isprava, ili osobna izjava kandidata ovjerena od javnog bilježnika. Sva dokumentacija dostavlja se u neovjerenoj preslici, odabrani kandidat prije zaključenja ugovora o radu dužan je dostaviti na uvid izvornike dokumenata. Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima, dužni su u prijavi za natječaj pozvati se na to pravo, priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta i priložiti sve dokaze o priznatom statusu. Navedeni kandidati imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate pod jednakim uvjetima. Poveznica Ministarstva branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/POPIS%20DOKAZA%20ZA%20OSTVARIVANJE%20PRAVA%20PRI%20ZAPO%C5%A0LJAVANJU.pdf i https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Pozivi za pojedine faze natječajnog postupka s mjestom i vremenom održavanja te rezultati istih, kao i obavijest o odabiru kandidata biti će objavljeni na stranicama Škole na poveznici: https://os-belvedere-ri.skole.hr/oglasi-za-posao Kandidat koji se ne odazove pozivu za bilo koju fazu selekcijskog postupka, smatrati će se da je povukao prijavu. Kandidat prijavom na natječaj daje privolu za prikupljanje i obradu osobnih podataka iz natječajne dokumentacije u svrhu provedbe natječajnog postupka. Prijave je potrebno dostaviti na adresu: Osnovna škola-Scuola elementare Belvedere, Kozala 41, 51000 Rijeka. Rok za podnošenje prijave je 8 dana od dana objave natječaja. Natječaj se objavljuje na mrežnim stranicama škole i HZZ-a dana 08.09.2026.godine. Nepotpune, nepotpisane i nepravovremene prijave neće se razmatrati. Condizioni previste dagli articoli 105 e 106 della Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione elementare e media superiore (GU 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10-corr., 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 e 156/23) e dal Regolamento sulla qualifica e preparazione psico-pedagogica dei docenti e collaboratori nell'istruzione elementare (GU 6/19 e 74/20); 2. Condizioni specifiche in base alla Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione nella lingua e scrittura delle minoranze nazionali (GU 51/00, 56/00-corr.). I candidati i quali hanno conseguito una qualifica estera devono inoltre presentare: il decreto d’un ente di educazione superiore con il quale si riconosce una completa equipollenza del titolo di studio secondo la Legge sul riconoscimento dell’equipollenza dei titoli di studio esteri o il decreto dell’Agenzia per la scienza ed educazione superiore di riconoscimento del titolo di studio estero ai fini lavorativi secondo la Legge sul riconoscimento dei titoli di studio esteri e nei sensi della Legge sule professioni regolamentate e sul riconoscimento dei titoli di studio esteri ai fini lavorativi, il decreto del Ministero della scienze ed educazione sul riconoscimento del titolo di studio estero per i fini di lavoro nelle professioni regolamentate. I candidati i quali dichiarano di possedere delle qualifiche aggiuntive, conoscenze ed educazioni devono presentare dei documenti probatori delle stesse, ovvero: attestati o certificati, conferme, pagelle, documenti pubblici equivalenti o una dichiarazione privata certificata da parte di un notaio pubblico. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (NN 87/08., 86/09., 92/10.,105/10.-ispr., 90/11., 5/12., 16/12. 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 i 156/23) i sukladno Pravilniku o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja radnika u OŠ-SE Belvedere iz Rijeke, Kozala 41, raspisuje N A T J E Č A J za popunjene sljedećih radnih mjesta 2) 1 učitelj/ica geografije – 14 sati ukupnog tjednog radnog vremena, na neodređeno radno vrijeme TRAŽENI UVJETI:
  1. Prema čl. 105. i 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (NN 87/08., 86/09., 92/10.,105/10.-ispr., 90/11., 5/12., 16/12. 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 i 156/23) i Pravilniku o stručnoj spremi i pedagoško-psihološkom obrazovanju učitelja i stručnih suradnika u osnovnom školstvu (NN 6/19);
  2. Prema Zakonu o odgoju i obrazovanju na jeziku i pismu nacionalnih manjina (NN 51/00.,56/00-ispr.).
Za radna mjesta potrebno je poznavanje talijanskog jezika na razini materinjeg jezika (osim radnog mjesta br.5). Za radna mjesta mjesta provesti će se psihologijsko testiranje, poznavanje talijanskog jezika te intervju. Povrh navedenih provjera vršiti će se i vrednovanje dodatnih kvalifikacija, znanja i edukacija od strane Povjerenstva za vrednovanje kandidata sukladno odredbama Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u OŠ-SE Belvedere u odnosu na sve kandidate, koji udovoljavaju propisanim uvjetima, a podnijeli su potpune i pravovremene prijave. Uz potpisanu prijavu kandidati su dužni priložiti životopis, diplomu, dokaz o državljanstvu, elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji HZMO-a i uvjerenje da se protiv kandidata ne vodi istražni ili kazneni postupak ne stariji od šest (6) mjeseci. Kandidati koji su stekli inozemnu obrazovnu kvalifikaciju dužni su također dostaviti: rješenje određenog visokog učilišta o priznavanju potpune istovrijednosti u skladu sa Zakonom o priznavanju istovrijednosti stranih školskih svjedodžbi i diploma ili rješenje Agencije za znanost i visoko obrazovanje o stručnom priznavanju inozemne visokoškolske kvalifikacije u skladu sa Zakonom o priznavanju inozemnih obrazovnih kvalifikacija te u skladu sa Zakonom o reguliranim profesijama i priznavanju inozemnih stručnih kvalifikacija, rješenje Ministarstva znanosti i obrazovanja o priznavanju inozemne stručne kvalifikacije radi pristupa reguliranoj profesiji. Kandidati koji ističu posjedovanje dodatnih kvalifikacija, znanja i edukacija dokumentaciji prilažu i dokaze za iste i to: uvjerenje ili certifikat, ili potvrda, ili svjedodžba ili druga javna isprava, ili osobna izjava kandidata ovjerena od javnog bilježnika. Sva dokumentacija dostavlja se u neovjerenoj preslici, odabrani kandidat prije zaključenja ugovora o radu dužan je dostaviti na uvid izvornike dokumenata. Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima, dužni su u prijavi za natječaj pozvati se na to pravo, priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta i priložiti sve dokaze o priznatom statusu. Navedeni kandidati imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate pod jednakim uvjetima. Poveznica Ministarstva branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/POPIS%20DOKAZA%20ZA%20OSTVARIVANJE%20PRAVA%20PRI%20ZAPO%C5%A0LJAVANJU.pdf i https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Pozivi za pojedine faze natječajnog postupka s mjestom i vremenom održavanja te rezultati istih, kao i obavijest o odabiru kandidata biti će objavljeni na stranicama Škole na poveznici: https://os-belvedere-ri.skole.hr/oglasi-za-posao Kandidat koji se ne odazove pozivu za bilo koju fazu selekcijskog postupka, smatrati će se da je povukao prijavu. Kandidat prijavom na natječaj daje privolu za prikupljanje i obradu osobnih podataka iz natječajne dokumentacije u svrhu provedbe natječajnog postupka. Prijave je potrebno dostaviti na adresu: Osnovna škola-Scuola elementare Belvedere, Kozala 41, 51000 Rijeka. Rok za podnošenje prijave je 8 dana od dana objave natječaja. Natječaj se objavljuje na mrežnim stranicama škole i HZZ-a dana 08.09.2026.godine. Nepotpune, nepotpisane i nepravovremene prijave neće se razmatrati. Ai sensi dell'articolo 107 della Legge sull'educazione e l’istruzione elementare e media superiore (GU 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10-corr., 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 e 156/23) e in conformità al Regolamento sulle modalità e procedure di assunzione la OŠ-SE Belvedere di Fiume, via Kozala 41, bandisce il C O N C O R S O per i seguenti posti di lavoro 2) 1 insegnante di geografia – 14 ore settimanali, a tempo indeterminato CONDIZIONI RICHIESTE: 1. Condizioni previste dagli articoli 105 e 106 della Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione elementare e media superiore (GU 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10-corr., 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 e 156/23) e dal Regolamento sulla qualifica e preparazione psico-pedagogica dei docenti e collaboratori nell'istruzione elementare (GU 6/19 e 74/20); 2. Condizioni specifiche in base alla Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione nella lingua e scrittura delle minoranze nazionali (GU 51/00, 56/00-corr.). Per tutti i posti di lavoro in questione è necessario conoscere la lingua italiana a livello di madre lingua (escluso il numero 5) e possono accedere persone di ambedue i sessi. Per i posti di lavoro in questione saranno effettuati test psicologici, verifiche della conoscenza della lingua italiana e colloqui. Oltre ai suddetti controlli saranno valutate delle qualifiche aggiuntive dalla Commissione che svolge le prove (test) per le assunzioni rispettando le regole stabilite dal Regolamento sulle modalità e procedure di assunzione dell'OŠ-SE Belvedere con tutti i candidati che soddisferanno le condizioni formali richieste e che presenteranno domande complete, entro il termine previsto. Le domande firmate devono essere corredate da dati biografici (CV), da certificato di studio richiesto del Regolamento sulla qualificha e preparazione psico-pedagogica dei docenti e collaboratori nell'istruzione elementare, da certificato di cittadinanza, da estratto elettronico o certificato sui dati iscritti nelle evidenze matricolari dell’Ufficio di pensionamento croato e da attestato comprovante l’assenza di condanne penali la cui data di rilascio non deve risultare superiore ai sei (6) mesi. I candidati i quali hanno conseguito una qualifica estera devono inoltre presentare: il decreto d’un ente di educazione superiore con il quale si riconosce una completa equipollenza del titolo di studio secondo la Legge sul riconoscimento dell’equipollenza dei titoli di studio esteri o il decreto dell’Agenzia per la scienza ed educazione superiore di riconoscimento del titolo di studio estero ai fini lavorativi secondo la Legge sul riconoscimento dei titoli di studio esteri e nei sensi della Legge sule professioni regolamentate e sul riconoscimento dei titoli di studio esteri ai fini lavorativi, il decreto del Ministero della scienze ed educazione sul riconoscimento del titolo di studio estero per i fini di lavoro nelle professioni regolamentate. I candidati i quali dichiarano di possedere delle qualifiche aggiuntive, conoscenze ed educazioni devono presentare dei documenti probatori delle stesse, ovvero: attestati o certificati, conferme, pagelle, documenti pubblici equivalenti o una dichiarazione privata certificata da parte di un notaio pubblico. Tutta la documentazione deve essere presentata sotto forma di fotocopia semplice, mentre il candidato scelto deve presentare i documenti originali prima della firma del contrato di lavoro. I candidati i quali hanno diritto di precedenza secondo regolamenti speciali, devono dichiarare questo diritto e fornire prove che confermino il loro diritto e stato. I suddetti candidati avranno la precedenza di fronte agli altri candidati che hanno le stesse condizioni e qualifiche, ma non usufruiscono di codesto diritto. Il link del Ministero degli veterani: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/POPIS%20DOKAZA%20ZA%20OSTVARIVANJE%20PRAVA%20PRI%20ZAPO%C5%A0LJAVANJU.pdf e https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Gli inviti per ogni fase della selezione, con il tempo e il posto dove si terranno, come anche i risultati di esse e anche i risultati finali saranno pubblicati sulle pagine web della scuola sul sito: https://os-belvedere-ri.skole.hr/oglasi-za-posao Se un candidato non si presenta a una delle fasi di selezione verrà considerato come se avesse ritirato la propria domanda. Secondo il GDPR i candidati con la presentazione della domanda acconsentono alla scuola di conservare e trattare i loro dati personali contenuti nella loro documentazione ai fini di codesto bando di concorso. Le domande devono pervenire al seguente indirizzo: OŠ-SE Belvedere, Kozala 41, 51000 Fiume, entro 8 giorni dalla pubblicazione del presente Bando di Concorso. Il presente Bando sarà pubblicato sulle pagine web della Scuola e dell’Ufficio di collocamento Croato il giorno 8 settembre 2026. Le domande incomplete, non firmate e non pervenute entro il termine stabilito, non saranno prese in considerazione

jobs.title: Afløser til receptionen søges
jobs.description:
Vi søger en afløser/ studerende til receptionen.

Milling Hotel Ansgar er et charmerende byhotel beliggende i hjertet af Odense, tæt på byens centrum og banegården. Du kan se mere om Milling Hotels, vores hoteller og værdier på www.millinghotels.dk

Vi søger en studerende/ afløser til vores reception. Er du passioneret omkring service og vil du være med til at skabe en nærværende og god oplevelse for vores gæster, så er du måske den, vi leder efter.

Dine vagter vil primært ligge eftermiddag og aften, lige som der vil være faste weekendvagter, hver anden weekend. Du vil indgå i en fast vagtplan. Timetal kan variere fra uge til uge, men gennemsnitligt skal du regne med 10-15 timer per uge. Derudover kan du påregne at skulle hjælpe med ekstra vagter i ferieperioder og ved andet fravær.

Vi tænker, at du har nogen af de rette kvalifikationer, hvis du er:

  • Ansvarsbevidst

  • Fleksibel

  • God service falder naturligt for dig

  • Har godt humør

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt

  • Er samtidig teamplayer

  • Du taler og skriver som minimum dansk (ufravigeligt) og engelsk

Vi tilbyder en spændende stilling i et stabilt team, der er præget af høj service og godt samarbejde. 

Vi tilbyder:

  • Et lille team med skønne kolleger, god vagtplan (som udgangspunkt fri hver anden weekend)

jobs.title: REMONTSTRĀDNIEKS
jobs.description:
Pievienojies mūsu komandai!
Valmieras pirmsskolas izglītības iestāde “Ābelīte” (turpmāk – Iestāde) aicina darbā remontstrādnieku (0,5 darba likmi (20 stundas nedēļā)) uz nenoteiktu laiku. Darba vietas adrese: Palejas iela 5, Valmiera, Valmieras novads.

Ja Tev ir vēlme:
•    veikt slēdzeņu nomaiņu, iekārtu un mēbeļu remontu, krāsošanu, kosmētiskos remontdarbus;
•    veikt aukstā un karstā ūdensvada, kanalizācijas sistēmas ekspluatāciju un remontu;
•    informēt darba devēju par konstatētajiem bojājumiem;

un ja Tev ir:
•    profesionālā vidējā izglītība inženierzinātnēs vai būvniecības jomā;
•    valsts valodas prasmes atbilstoši Valsts valodas likuma prasībām;
•    kompetences: prasme analizēt situāciju un rīcības sekas, atrast piemērotāko risinājumu; komunikācijas un sadarbības prasmes; prasme plānot, organizēt un kvalitatīvi veikt savu darbu; atbildības sajūta, disciplinētība, precizitāte;

mēs piedāvājam:
•    atalgojumu 390 EUR mēnesī pirms nodokļu nomaksas;
•    iespēju saņemt atvaļinājuma pabalstu par labu darba sniegumu;
•    darba devēja līdzfinansētu veselības apdrošināšanu pēc pārbaudes laika beigām, kā arī citas sociālās garantijas/labumus atbilstoši darba rezultātam un normatīvajos aktos noteiktajam.

Pieteikuma vēstuli, profesionālās darbības aprakstu (CV), lūdzam iesniegt elektroniski, nosūtot uz e-pastu abelite@valmiera.edu.lv ar norādi “Remontstrādnieka vakancei” līdz 2026.gada 25.septembrim.

Informējam, ka pieteikuma dokumentā norādītie personas dati tiks apstrādāti, lai nodrošinātu šī atlases konkursa norisi atbilstoši fizisko personu datu aizsardzības regulējuma prasībām.

jobs.title: Product Support Specialist, Europe
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

Over the past years, Linear has experienced incredible organic growth and has become an instrumental tool for many of the world’s best product teams. We believe customer support should always feel like an extension of that experience. As a Product Support Specialist at Linear, you’ll contribute to the future of our product by surfacing customer feedback and insights, contributing to our technical documentation, and engaging a technical customer community via social channels.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based in Europe. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you’ll do

 - Support customers in end-to-end engagement, including onboarding, account setup, debugging issues, feature and integration discovery

 - Investigate and resolve inbound customer issues reported through all communication channels, including email, Slack, Twitter, and Reddit

 - Partner with our engineering team to document and reproduce bugs

 - Surface trends and insights from customer feedback to the team at large to inform product choices

 - Lead select strategic projects to improve the support experience, internal knowledge sharing, and product operations

Requirements

 - Currently based in Europe.

 - Passion about technology, quality, and Linear’s mission

 - Excellent communication and customer service skills and experience working with a technical or engineering user base. Ability to adapt your communication approach to non-technical users.

 - Experience troubleshooting technical issues, including APIs and integration setups. Ability to reproduce bugs with Linear and our integrations in various environments (different browsers, Windows, Mac, Mobile).

 - Familiarity with SQL, Javascript, APIs, and GitHub is a plus. If you don’t have direct experience in these areas, curiosity to learn more is desirable as well. Please note that this is not a product engineering role.

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms including extended exercise windows

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

 - Remote-first with no required commute

jobs.title: Flytta till Barcelona i vinter!
jobs.description:
Hemsida: https://www.konnect.se/ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/konnectse/ Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@konnectse

Är du kvicktänkt, utåtriktad och vill jobba utomlands på ett nytt fräscht kontor med härliga kollegor? Då är du rätt person för oss.

Vi söker nya motiverade säljare av mobila bredbandsabonnemang till vårt kontor i Barcelona. Fast grundlön & provision utan tak!

Har du ingen tidigare erfarenhet? Det är inget krav! Hos oss får du lära dig försäljning från grunden samt hur du använder dig av dina färdigheter för att nå din fulla potential.

Vilka är vi?

Vi jobbar med de största varumärkena inom försäljning och har gjort det i över 10 år. Därför kan vi erbjuda branschens mest attraktiva provisionsmodeller som dem flesta säljare går igång på, utöver en grundlön.

Konnect är Sveriges största säljbolag med kontor i Stockholm och Barcelona. Vi ger våra medarbetare det absolut bästa och vad kan vara bättre än att vara omgiven av likasinnade människor i en stad som Barcelona? Inget, tycker vi!

Vi är störst och vi är bäst på det vi gör men vilka är vi på riktigt? Vi är 300 säljare som alla jobbar för samma sak - att ha kul och njuta av livet. Vi är kollegor men vi är också vänner. Vi jobbar ihop, kämpar och har riktigt kul! Oavsett om vi jobbar eller hänger på stranden så har vi ett gemensamt mål - att vara vårt bästa jag och sälja bra produkter och avtal för de bästa varumärkena inom branschen.

Om tjänsten:

Vi söker dig som är sugen på att arbeta i en stor och snabbväxande koncern och är redo att kavla upp ärmarna när det behövs. I rollen som säljare hos oss vill vi se vilja, driv, kreativitet och ett ”outside-of-the-box” tänk. Vi jobbar på ett ett strukturerat och noggrant tillvägagångssätt för att sälja in en produkt eller ett avtal till företagare och privatpersoner. Du kommer utöver det delta i utbildningar och feedbacksamtal från din teamleader, detta för att ständigt utvecklas och växa i rollen som säljare hos oss.

Vi söker dig som:

Drivs mot uppsatta mål, resultatinriktad och utöver det är en social person som har lätt att ta kontakt med nya människor. Viktigt att du vågar utmana dig själv!

Vad erbjuder vi?

    Hög provision för varje avtal du säljer och spanskt kollektivavtal.
    Daglig coaching och löpande utbildningar för att du ska få de bästa förutsättningarna att lyckas i ditt arbete.
    Fantastiska teamleaders som leder gruppen mot ständig utveckling, motiverar och anordnar tävlingar med otroliga priser varje månad.
    Vi ser till att kombinera arbete med roliga aktiviteter så att gruppen stärks i positiv anda.

Vid flytt till Barcelona:

    Ersättning av flygbiljett.
    Stöd vid letande utav boende.
    Allmänna tips för en utomlandsflytt.
    Stora utvecklingsmöjligheter.
    Ett fantastiskt kontor med ljusa och öppna ytor, 10 minuters lugn promenad från en av Barcelonas vackraste stränder.

Har du fler frågor? Du är varmt välkommen att kontakta oss.

Ansök idag. Vi rekryterar löpande.

Hemsida: https://www.konnect.se/ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/konnectse/ Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@konnectse

Vi hjälper många av Sveriges vassaste varumärken i deras försäljning. Under tio års tid har vi byggt upp vår verksamhet och breddat vårt tjänsteutbud för att alltid ligga i framkant. Vårt team består idag av över trehundra drivna och talangfulla medarbetare på våra kontor i Stockholm och Barcelona.
