jobs.title: Head of Internal Audit
jobs.description:
Head of Internal Audit  
Key Accountabilities  
Risk ManagementDevelop, implement and coordinate the organization's risk management strategy, and maintain Business Continuity plans for the organization. Introduce a culture of Risk Management supported by policies and guidance. Develop and maintain a Risk Register and ensure it is reviewed regularly by the Management Team. Responsible for the development, auditing, testing and implementation of Business Continuity Plans. Create action plans which show how these policies and plans will be implemented and undertake regular audits to demonstrate that they are effective. Ensure that relevant staff understand the policies and are given assistance and advice when needed. May oversee Group Risk Inspections.  
Quality Assurance  
Implement, support and audit relevant quality assurance systems across the organization. Assess the organization and recommend, priorities and implement relevant organizational and service specific quality policies. Make recommendations and implement an organizational wide quality assurance program based on set objectives ensuring systems and process are in place and working to meet any standards set for achievement. Ensure that all systems (IT and paper) for holding and processing customers' data are compliant with prevailing legislation. Ensure all work is carried out in accordance with any quality assurance system or service quality standards. Monitor and evaluate performance against standards or agreed targets. Use audits, feedback loops and corrective action to ensure continuous improvement. Prioritize and escalate issues resulting in non\-complianceReport and take actions on the findings of monitoring and evaluation processes and make recommendations as and SafetyPlan, review, recommend and implement health and safety management procedures and practices across the organization in line with prevailing legislation and operational working practices and instill health and safety culture. Work with external H\&S advisors to ensure Omya remain compliant as a company and utilize as much resources as possible in terms of policies, procedures, audits and advice. Lead and service the H\&S Working Group, and advise and support the Group as appropriate in relation to reviewing, improving and monitoring the H\&S policies, procedures and working practices across the organization. Write and implement a health and safety plan based on external and internal audits with defined responsibilities and delivery dates. Plan, review, recommend, implement and monitor H\&S management systems and practices across the organization including, fire safety, first aid provision and safe working practices etc. Advise and support designated persons with legal compliance and the maintenance of Health and Safety manuals including carrying out risk assessments, H\&S inspections and the management of fire safety, emergency evacuation and first aid provision as required. Keep up to date with H\&S legislation affecting Omya and advise the Management on legal compliance. Ensure that all incidents and details are recorded, including corrective actions taken. Ensure that staff are suitably trained, supported and monitored by senior and local management and that appropriate corrective action is taken when staff fails to comply with policy and procedure. Participate in IMA \- Occupational Health \& Safety Working Group.  
General Duties  
Attend and contribute to regular management meetings and other appropriate meetings. Ensure that all work is delivered within the budgetary and resource constraints of the organization.

Sr. Supervisor QA Complaint Approval  
At Johnson \& Johnson, we believe health is everything. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson \& Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.  
Cilag AG in Schaffhausen belongs to the group of Johnson \& Johnson Innovative Medicine and manufactures high quality pharmaceutical products, active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and medical devices. Today Cilag AG is one of the largest pharmaceutical manufacturers in Switzerland supplying all the major global markets. The Schaffhausen facility is a strategic launch and growth site for parenteral products, and we have an impressive pipeline of new and innovative products.  
The Senior Supervisor, Complaint Quality Approver Team is accountable for leading a team of Complaint Quality Approvers responsible for independent, objective review and approval of complaint records. The role provides people leadership, operational oversight, and quality decision support to ensure complaint investigations are complete, scientifically justified, risk\-based, and compliant with applicable procedures and regulations. The Senior Supervisor ensures consistent approval practices, timely record progression, appropriate escalation of quality risks, and continuous capability development across the team.  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES  
The Senior Supervisor leads the Complaint Quality Approver team and is responsible for assigning, prioritizing, and monitoring work to ensure compliant and timely approval of complaint records. The role provides guidance to approvers on investigation strategy, risk assessment, escalation, evidence requirements, Root Cause Analysis, NC considerations, and alignment of investigation conclusions across products or affiliates when applicable. The Senior Supervisor ensures that approval decisions are made consistently and are supported by objective evidence, applicable procedures, and current regulatory expectations. In addition, the role reviews complex or high\-risk complaint records, supports escalation to Quality leadership, and drives alignment with cross\-functional partners when investigation direction, closure readiness, or quality risk requires leadership input.  
The Senior Supervisor is accountable for developing team capability through coaching, feedback, training, and performance management. The role establishes clear expectations for documentation quality, approval rationale, system usage, and stakeholder communication, and ensures the team applies best practices consistently. The Senior Supervisor monitors workload, cycle time, quality metrics, backlog, and recurring investigation trends to identify improvement opportunities, remove barriers, and support sustainable business continuity. The role also contributes to process improvement initiatives, inspection readiness, audit support, and the implementation of global or site quality system changes impacting complaint record approval.  
KEY INTERFACES  
Complaint Quality Approvers to provide leadership, coaching, work prioritization, and performance feedback.  
Complaint investigation owners and cross\-functional contributors, including Manufacturing, QC, Engineering, Supply Chain, Packaging, MSAT, Regulatory, and Medical Safety as applicable.  
Quality leadership for escalation, risk communication, resource planning, operational performance, and decision alignment.  
Other sites and affiliates to align investigation strategy, closure expectations, evidence requirements, and consistent complaint outcomes for site\-manufactured products.  
Audit, inspection readiness, quality systems, and process improvement stakeholders to support compliant execution and continuous improvement.  
REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE \& SKILLS  
Strong knowledge of quality investigations, complaint handling, CAPA and nonconformance concepts in a regulated pharmaceutical or medical product environment.  
Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, and develop a team in a quality organization, including setting priorities and managing performance.  
Strong understanding of cGMP, Good Documentation Practices, data integrity expectations, and applicable U.S. and international regulatory requirements.  
Proven ability to assess complex technical data, investigation conclusions, risk assessments, and escalation needs.  
Ability to make sound quality decisions, communicate clear rationale, and ensure consistency in approval standards.  
Strong stakeholder management skills and ability to operate effectively in a matrixed, cross\-functional, and global environment.  
Ability to drive sustainable process improvements.  
Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to provide actionable feedback and represent the team in leadership discussions.  
Strong organization, prioritization, and decision\-making skills to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and escalations.  
EDUCATION \& EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS  
Master’s degree or PhD in Life Science or related discipline, or equivalent experience, is required.  
Minimum of 3\-4 years of experience in quality investigations, complaint handling, quality systems, or a related regulated quality environment is required.  
Prior people leadership, team lead, supervisory, or demonstrated coaching experience is strongly preferred.  
Experience performing, reviewing, approving, or providing oversight for complex quality investigations, complaints, deviations, nonconformances, or similar quality events.  
Experience working with cross\-functional stakeholders and quality leadership to manage risk, escalation, and decision alignment.  
Demonstrated ability to drive process improvement, inspection readiness, and consistent execution of quality system requirements.  
Proven critical thinking, problem\-solving, communication, and people leadership skills.

jobs.title: Recovery Counsellors 100%
jobs.description:
Recovery Counsellors 100%  
About us  
We are a Private Recovery Clinic, experts in addiction and affective disorders, providing exceptional treatment and care to an international clientele. Situated on the spectacular shores of Lake Lucerne, we are an English\-speaking boutique clinic treating those suffering from addiction and affective disorders such as depression and anxiety. Our team is dedicated to helping people achieve long\-term recovery through compassionate care.  
The role  
We are currently recruiting dedicated and experienced Recovery Counsellors (100%) to join our multidisciplinary team. The ideal candidate combines personal recovery experience, professional competence, and a strong commitment to supporting others on their recovery journey. In this role, you will work closely with medical and mental health professionals to provide comprehensive care, guidance, and encouragement to our clients.  
Start date: immediately or by agreement.  
Skills and qualifications  
A minimum of 10 years of continuous abstinence from all psychoactive substances  
Excellent written and spoken English (C2 professional proficiency); other languages are an advantage  
Active and ongoing participation in personal recovery work or mutual aid groups, such as Narcotics Anonymous, Alcoholics Anonymous, Gamblers Anonymous, etc.  
A clear understanding of your recovery process and the ability to express it in a differentiated manner  
Good IT skills and the ability to write reports and clinical notes  
A high degree of professional \& personal competence as an "expert from experience"  
The ability to work as part of a multi\-disciplinary team with medical leadership  
A relevant form of training or work experience  
The ability to work with a culturally diverse clientele  
A current driver’s license and willingness to drive  
Ability to commute or relocate close to Lucerne, Switzerland  
Ability to work in shifts (combination of day, overnight, weekends, holidays)  
Must be eligible for a work permit in Switzerland (CH/EU\-/EFTA nationals). An EU passport is ideal for obtaining a work permit if you are applying outside Switzerland.  
Key responsibilities:  
Working as a valued member of the clinical team, our Recovery Counsellors offer essential motivation, support, and guidance to our clients as they embark on their recovery journey with the utmost care and consideration for confidentiality. You will collaborate with medical staff and other team members to ensure integrated care and actively contribute to implementing client treatment plans. You will have the opportunity to use your own recovery experience to inspire and guide clients through their recovery process, moderate and deliver group sessions, escort the clients to mutual aid groups in Zurich and Lucerne, accompany them to various off\-site activities, organising and supervising overnight, on\-call, and weekend plans. You will also be responsible for digitallyreporting and recording the clients' sessions with recovery counsellors and other programme\-related activities and contributing to a comprehensive and organised summary of their progress.  
Our offer  
Join a dynamic, driven, and culturally diverse team where you can make a meaningful impact on the lives of others while enhancing your skills in a supportive and creative environment. You can work across various fascinating and challenging tasks at this young and forward\-thinking company. You will belong to a modern, progressive company in a spectacularly beautiful location. We offer opportunities for professional growth and a competitive salary with contributions towards retirement.  
Please send your electronic CV with a photo, a letter of motivation, and relevant certifications, diplomas, or degrees. For more information, call . jpid20c34d8jm jit0729jm jiy26jm

jobs.title: Sport Facilities Manager & Activity Coordinator
jobs.description:
Aiglon College seeks to appoint a suitably qualified
Sport Facilities Manager & Activity Coordinator
to join the school from: 01.11.2026

Your profile
The role and candidate profile for this role is detailed in the attached job description and person specification.

Successful Aiglon staff are enthusiastic, experienced, committed, reflective, dynamic and willing to try new ideas. If you share these values and have an appetite for challenge and an ambition to make a positive impact on our world, we welcome your application.  

About us
Located in Chesières (Vaud, Switzerland), Aiglon College is a not-for-profit, international boarding school offering a distinctive, world-class education in a stunning alpine setting.
The school was founded on a distinctive ethos: the balanced development of mind, body and spirit. This philosophy underpins everything we do at Aiglon, both inside and outside the classroom.
There are over 480 students, representing more than 70 nationalities, following the International GCSE (IGCSE) and International Baccalaureate Diploma (IB Diploma) programmes.

What we offer
Aiglon is dedicated to the well-being and professional development of all staff, within a vibrant, friendly, and modern workplace. Beyond competitive salaries and comprehensive social security benefits, we provide free accident and loss of salary insurances, generous pension and leave entitlements, as well as a range of special perks and advantages.

How to apply
Deadline for applications: 28.09.2026
Early applications are encouraged.  We reserve the right to appoint before the application deadline should we find the right candidate.  Please apply through our School platform (eteach) following the instructions; applications sent by standard email will not be considered.

Aiglon is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children.
Applicants will therefore need to undergo child protection screening appropriate to the post.

You can find information on how the School processes your personal data within the School’s Privacy Notice.

JOB PURPOSE
Lead, safeguard and develop Aiglon’s sports and activities provision so that every pupil, staff member and guest enjoys an inclusive, high-quality and safe programme.

KEY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Safety & Compliance
Conduct daily facility walk-throughs, logging hazards and initiating corrective action, which includes taking action to fix equipment where possible
Enforce best practice in child safeguarding and health & safety, fully aligned with Swiss regulations and Aiglon policies
Maintain inspection and servicing schedules for all sports equipment; liaise with the Director of Operations for repairs or replacement
Help to manage the bookings of the minibus fleet for the expeditions and sports departments
Ensure that the minibuses are in good order after use
Secure the Sports Centre at the end of the day or open hours (equipment check, lights, alarms, locks)
Programming & User Experience
Produce and publish the weekly Sports Centre and facilities timetable, balancing curriculum lessons, house practices, team training and community bookings. This includes the Padel Court, Alpina Pitch, Ski Lockers along with other sports spaces and facilities
Encourage a broad, lifelong engagement in physical activity by promoting a wide range of sports and wellbeing initiatives
Liaise proactively with the Health Centre, Deputy School Director (Pastoral) and Houseparents regarding students with medical or additional-needs profiles
Communicate clearly and courteously with all users, modelling professional conduct that earns trust from pupils and colleagues
Fitness Suite & Strength-and-Conditioning
Oversee presentation, cleanliness and day-to-day supervision of the Fitness Suite
Assist in the planning and coaching of age-appropriate S&C sessions
Monitor student progress (eg movement screens, jump tests, wellness surveys) and maintain records to inform individualised programmes
Educate students on safe lifting technique, recovery, nutrition and injury prevention; coordinate return-to-play plans with medical/physio staff
Foster a culture of respect for equipment and peers, ensuring correct footwear, clothing and hygiene standards at all times
Activities Co-ordination
Design, oversee and support a high quality and successful activities programme across the school through planning and programming the activity schedule, timings, staffing and resources
Quality assure the activities programme through observations, student, staff and parent surveys and liaison with outside external staff providers
Ensure effective and timely communication of information to students, staff and the wider community
Provide leadership, guidance and support to staff for effective programme planning, scheduling and execution
In collaboration with the Director of Character and the Head of Junior Activities, have a clear overall strategy in line with the schools mission for both the development and participation of our students in activities for enjoyment and lifelong engagement
Create energy and dynamism within activities and manage the day-to-day operation of the programme
Ensure that an effective activities programme exists to develop the leadership of our students
Work with the Director of Character and Educational Systems to ensure that there is an effective schedule of events and activities that fit within the school master calendar
Ensure that all students and parents are aware that activities are a school requirement and to provide the necessary support and guidance on how to use SOCs to make it possible for all students to engage and sign up to activities they are interested in
Work with the Director of Character and Educational Systems to continue to develop the processes and systems of SOCs to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the services delivered
Monitor student involvement and attendance at all activities and contact students and staff regarding student absence
Ensuring ongoing innovation, engagement and development so the students have access to a broad, balanced and constantly evolving programme of activities
Continuously evaluate and improve the programme to ensure it meets and aligns with the interests of the students
Provide opportunities, such as prize giving to showcase excellence or celebrate development and achievements in the wide range of activities and events across the school community
Oversee the purchasing and maintenance of resources, equipment and materials for the programme
Prepare detailed reports on the programme for the School Director in the reports to the Board of Directors
Working with the Director of Character, develop and implement risk management strategies for the programme and ensure all risk assessments are in place and regularly reviewed
Working with the HR department and Director of Character, to ensure that the central register of staff safeguarding checks is up to date and that there is due diligence with checks on external staff providers
Contribute to internal and external written and other communication of news and information about Activities across the school
Working with the Communications and Marketing team, evolve the activities section for the school website and school handbook
Administration
Produce termly participation reports of student engagement and ensure equipment compliance
Contribute to staff CPD by running short workshops on fitness, wellbeing or safe practice
OTHER TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES
To be available for School sporting events such as inter-house and inter-school competitions, Sports day and other major events
Understand and implement all School policies and procedures, particularly those relating to safeguarding children and young people
Undertake any other task which may be reasonably requested by the Director of Character Education to assist in the smooth running of the team
Understand the School’s Guiding Principles and uphold the ethos of the School at all times

The qualifications, experiences and attributes of the post-holder must match the detailed specification below:
A. Education, Qualifications and Languages
Essential
Bachelor’s degree in Sports Science, Exercise Physiology, Sport Facilities Management or related discipline, or equivalent qualifications
Desirable
Accredited Strength & Conditioning certification (eg NSCA‑CSCS, UKSCA, ASCA Level 2 or Swiss equivalent)
Valid First Aid & CPR qualification
Working proficiency in French

B. Experience and Knowledge
Desirable
Minimum 5 years’ professional experience managing multi‑sport facilities, including student and staff supervision
Proven record of coaching S&C programmes for student athletes and teams
Experience working in an international school, university or elite sports academy

jobs.title: Senior Packaging Technician, Operations (m/f/d) - [R408196]
jobs.description:
The Senior Packaging Technician is responsible for independently executing clinical packaging activities in compliance with internal specifications, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), batch records and applicable Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP)/ Good Documentation Practice (GDP) and Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) requirements. This role performs primary and secondary packaging, operates packaging and labelling systems, supports documentation and SAP transactions, coordinates routine technical tasks within assigned studies and serves as an experienced technical point of contact for day-to-day packaging activities.  

Key Responsibilities:

1. Clinical Packaging Operations
•    Performs primary packaging of clinical studies according to internal specifications, SOPs and batch records.
•    Performs secondary packaging of clinical studies according to internal specifications, SOPs and batch records.
•    Supplies ordered study material to the corresponding packaging rooms and prepares materials in accordance with the relevant SOPs.
•    Operates packaging and labelling systems in support of clinical packaging activities.

2. Technical Coordination
•    Trains and supports new technicians during onboarding and routine operations.
•    Performs administrative work related to packaging orders and clinical packaging activities.
•    Escalates problems directly to the supervisor or manager as required.
•    Coordinates the execution of bottle filling, labelling and packaging activities for clinical studies.
•    Oversees compliance-related aspects of packaging orders and serves as a technical point of contact for technicians assigned to individual studies.
•    Performs cleaning verification for equipment and rooms and completes final cleaning verification at study closeout.
•    Executes SAP transactions related to packaging activities.
•    Prepares GMP documentation, including required photographs, and creates batch notes or comments as applicable.
•    Reviews and coordinates Packaging Technicians’ activities within the assigned area.
•    Supports the transfer of cold materials as required during daily operations.  
•    Ensures study completion and hands over completed studies to the supervisor.

3. Routine Operational Tasks
•    Performs or coordinates routine tasks such as scale adjustments, deionized water flushes, and replenishment of consumables to support operational readiness.  
•    Provides day-to-day operational support to ensure readiness of packaging rooms, equipment and materials.
•    Supports the Packaging Compliance Support team with batch pre- and post-execution reviews.  

4. Documentation & Systems
•    Assists in document preparation, control and process improvement for packaging activities.
•    Uses SAP, Word and Excel for documentation and operational support, including the accurate completion of electronic logs.
•    Ensures accurate and compliant use of SAP for clinical packaging processes.

5. Compliance & EHS
•    Performs all activities in compliance with applicable SOPs, company policies, and GMP/GDP/EHS requirements.
•    Documents activities in accordance with internal GDP requirements.
•    Conducts blinding checks in accordance with SOP requirements.  

Your Profile:

•    Completed apprenticeship, preferably in a life sciences-related field.
•    At least 3 years of experience in pharmaceutical manufacturing, clinical packaging, or a comparable GMP-regulated environment.  
•    Good understanding of GMP, GDP and EHS requirements relevant to packaging operations.
•    English language proficiency at B1/ B2 level or above.
•    Hands-on experience with packaging and labelling equipment and routine operational support activities.
•    Experience with documentation practices, batch records and accurate recording of operational activities.
•    Proficiency in SAP and Microsoft Office applications such as Word and Excel.
•    Ability to train and support other technicians and to serve as a technical point of contact for assigned studies.  
•    Reliable, detail-oriented and able to work independently while following procedures and compliance requirements.
•    Demonstrates strong ethics, compliance and quality mindset.
•    Strong team player with a collaborative mindset.  
•    Demonstrates a continuous improvement mindset in day-to-day operations and supports the implementation of procedural changes.

THE COMPANY

Our Company is a leading biopharmaceutical company employing over 1,000 people in Switzerland at three sites. The company’s headquarters are in Lucerne. At the site in Zurich, the company operates a global innovation and development hub. In addition, we manufacture medicines for global clinical trials and operate a forensic laboratory in Schachen (Canton Lucerne). We conduct around 40 clinical trials annually in Switzerland. The main therapeutic areas include oncology, infectious diseases, cardiovascular and cardiometabolic diseases. We also have a broad portfolio of vaccines for the prevention of diseases in children, adolescents, and adults and we are one of the leading companies in veterinary medicine. Furthermore, we take our responsibility to the local community seriously and have been involved for many years in initiatives such as the «Trendtage Gesundheit Luzern» and the «Alliance Health Competence».  

We are proud to be certified as a “Top Employer Switzerland” and “Top Employer Europe” showing the company’s commitment to our employees and the community around us.

Our Werthenstein BioPharma site in Schachen is where we conduct cutting-edge research, develop and analyze new biological agents and supply clinical trial products for global clinical studies. The site is also home to one of our global forensic laboratories where we carefully monitor our products through the supply chain to ensure security and safety for our patients.

Diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen HF/FH tragen die fachliche Verantwortung im gesamten Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

Meist hören Sie schon innerhalb von 24 Stunden von uns, denn Ihre Zeit ist uns wichtig. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen HF/FH tragen die fachliche Verantwortung im gesamten Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Somit entsteht Pflegequalität, die ankommt.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Die Region Hombrechtikon im Kanton Zürich verzeichnet eine anhaltend hohe Nachfrage nach diplomierten Pflegefachfrauen und Pflegefachmännern in der Langzeitpflege, da der demografische Wandel den Fachkräftebedarf kontinuierlich steigert. Sie profitieren als ausgebildete Fachperson von ausgezeichneten Karrierechancen, attraktiven Löhnen und stabilen Anstellungsverhältnissen in renommierten Altersheimen und Pflegeeinrichtungen. iPersonal als spezialisierter Personalvermittler erleichtert Ihnen den Einstieg erheblich, indem das Unternehmen Sie gezielt mit passenden Arbeitgebern zusammenbringt, Ihre beruflichen Wünsche berücksichtigt und den gesamten Bewerbungsprozess professionell begleitet.

### Ihre Vorteile mit MediPersonal in der Region Hombrechtikon

- Kostenlose Weiterbildungen über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – somit bekommt Ihre Karriere Rückenwind
- Persönliche Begleitung von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Arbeitstag
- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden
- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein
- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen
- Und vor allem: Diskretion garantiert – Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Langzeitpflege in Hombrechtikon

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

**Wie schnell erhalte ich eine Rückmeldung auf meine Bewerbung?**
In der Regel melden wir uns bereits innerhalb von 24 Stunden bei Ihnen, denn Ihre Zeit ist wertvoll. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

jobs.title: Data Scientist (m/f/d)
jobs.employer: Syngenta Crop Protection AG Forschung & Entwicklung
jobs.description:
Company Description

At Syngenta Crop Protection, we're pioneering solutions that safeguard global food security while championing sustainable agriculture. As a world market leader headquartered in Switzerland, we empower farmers with innovative crop protection technologies that defend against nature's toughest challenges. We unite advanced science with digital solutions to develop intelligent crop protection that maximizes yields while minimizing environmental impact. Join our mission of revolutionizing plant protection from seed to harvest.

Syngenta has been ranked as a top employer by Science Magazine, and it has been awarded with the "Friendly Work Space" label to all its Swiss sites.


Job Description

We are seeking a highly skilled Data Scientist (m/f/d) with deep expertise in developing multi-omics data integration and machine learnings methods, to join our Digital & Data Science Group in Biologicals Research. Biologicals research discovers, characterizes, optimizes and produces novel biologicals. Biologicals are derived from nature. They can be naturally occurring microbes, extracts or molecules protecting plants from pests and diseases or improving plant and soil health.
Within this role you will work on Syngenta ‘omics data to identify patterns in product performance and make predictions. You will be asked to develop methods to analyze and interpret the outcome of ‘omics experiments with your analytical skills as well as machine learning approaches. Your work will result in new tools to guide selection, optimization and development of novel Biologicals solutions.

Key responsibilities will include:

Develop and implement new multi-omics integration strategies (e.g., data harmonization, feature engineering, network-based methods) to strengthen biological interpretation and hypothesis generation
Apply and advance machine learning, statistical modeling, and AI approaches to extract insights from complex, high‑dimensional, multi‑omics datasets
Curate, quality control, and integrate large scale ’omics datasets, ensuring data integrity, reproducibility, and downstream analytical readiness
Evaluate and develop new data analysis tools, validate findings using a trial and iterative approach, and effectively communicate findings to technical and non-technical audiences
Identify data needs and provide recommendations to scientists to ensure the quantity and verify the integrity of data used for analyses
Work collaboratively to deliver new approaches, share learnings, and drive innovation in digital and data science including technology foresight
Work with R&D IT and software developers to deploy predictive model applications tailored to stakeholder needs
Support business users with change management initiatives to manage data more effectively

Qualifications:

MSc or PhD in Data Science, Statistics, Machine Learning, Computational Biology, Bioinformatics, or related field with some experience in natural sciences (e.g. chemical biology, microbiology, ecology, environmental sciences)
3+ years developing multi-omics integration methods for complex biological, biochemical, environmental, or agricultural datasets
Strong proficiency in Python and/or R, UNIX/Linux environments, ML frameworks, SQL
Experience with proteomics and metabolomics data analysis would be an asset
Dynamic personality with passion for innovation and problem-solving

Additional information:

We offer a variety of financial and non-financial benefits including:

A position which contributes to valuable and impactful work in a stimulating and international environment
A superb working environment with an open culture and diverse workforce where new ideas are always welcome
The opportunity to work with and learn from highly qualified and experienced employees and gain scientific and technical excellence
Learning culture (Together we Grow) and wide range of training options
You will profit from a competitive pension fund plan, flexible working, attractive bonus system, onsite doctor, fitness room, canteen, and other benefits such as Family friendly initiatives, Child and Family allowance
Please send your complete application with CV, a motivation letter that highlights your motivation and relevant experience for this position, diploma and work certificates (if applicable) in English. Additionally, we welcome access to git repositories showcasing relevant past projects. We will only consider applications that contain CV and motivation letters.

Syngenta is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion or any other employment practices for reasons of race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Trade Compliance Manager Process Industries Switzerland (80-100%)
jobs.description:
Bei ABB unterstützen wir Industrien dabei, effizienter und sauberer zu arbeiten – und jede einzelne Person trägt hier dazu bei. Wir bieten allen Mitarbeitenden die Möglichkeit, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und die eigene Entwicklung aktiv voranzutreiben. Gemeinsam entstehen Lösungen, auf die alle stolz sein können. __

In this role, you own the Trade Compliance framework for the Local Business Line (LBL) and are accountable for establishing, implementing, and continuously improving the policies, processes, controls, and governance required to ensure compliant execution of our global business activities. You ensure that all international business transactions, project deliveries, imports, exports, cross-border shipments, and related trade activities are conducted in accordance with ABB's Global Trade Program and applicable customs, export control, sanctions, and origin regulations. As the LBL's Trade Compliance authority, you define and maintain the operational trade compliance framework. You establish clear processes, responsibilities, controls, and escalation mechanisms and ensure effective implementation across all relevant functions. You drive the integration of trade compliance requirements into daily operations and act as the main point for complex compliance matters, regulatory changes, and risk mitigation. You are further responsible for developing, documenting, and maintaining procedures and training programs related to export controls, sanctions, customs, and origin management.


Working model is: #LI-Hybrid


You will be mainly accountable for:

Develop, improve and implement processes of LBL’s customs procedures, origin management, sanction lists screening, dual-use classification and export controls.

Functionally lead trade compliance resources in the LBL.

Lead and oversee Trade Compliance within the Local Business Line (LBL), including the implementation and continuous improvement of ABB’s Trade Compliance Program, internal directives, internal control system, local trade reviews, self-audits, and corrective actions.

Provide expert guidance and training on customs, origin, export control, and sanctions compliance, supporting the LBL, coordinating trade compliance resources and support functions, and maintaining strong alignment with key stakeholders such as CTCO, TCS, PCE, declarants, and logistics teams.

Drive Trade Compliance in day-to-day operations and complex projects, including risk assessments, internal checks, master data and supplier-related compliance requirements, and regular updates to stakeholders on implementation progress and relevant regulatory changes.

Advise and drive all trade compliance matters in LBL’s complex projects to different countries


What we are looking for:

Degree as a Foreign Trade Specialist / Manager or Export Control / Customs Compliance Officer with at least 8 years of experience in a relevant field (Senior Trade Compliance or Legal/Compliance background)

Excellent experience in free trade and preferential origins as well as in trade compliance matters

Solid knowledge in Swiss (GKV), EU and US (EAR) dual-use and sanctions regulations

Experience in an industry with large project businesses in various countries and ability as a people leader and solution-oriented team player

SAP and SAP GTS E4H experiences

jobs.title: Natural Hazards Mission Lead
jobs.description:
ETH Zurich is establishing the ETH Swiss GeoLab, a new interdisciplinary unit of ETH Zürich I Space. ETH Space will soon become one of few strategic centres of ETH Zurich, and encompasses overall five units.

The GeoLab is focused on Earth observation and its applications. The GeoLab uses satellite, airborne, ground-based and in-situ observations. To these diverse data sets it applies AI-driven analysis methods and high-performance computing to develop solutions for specific societal and economic challenges.

Located at the D4 Business Village in Root, close to Lucerne, ETH Swiss GeoLab works at the interface of research, technology development and practical application. In its first phase, the GeoLab is focusing on few selected high-impact application areas where Earth observation, geodata and AI-based analytics can create tangible value for Switzerland. The Natural Hazards Mission focuses initially on mass movements, including landslides and rockfalls, with the aim of improving early detection, monitoring, preparedness and decision support for Swiss practitioners, authorities and infrastructure stakeholders. It builds on stakeholder engagement, solution scoping and community-building activities already underway within GeoLab, including contributions from senior domain experts and partners in the Swiss natural hazards community.

The ETH Swiss GeoLab is led by Prof. Dr Verena Griess and Prof. Dr Thomas Zurbuchen, with Dr Felix Seidel as Managing Director, responsible for the day-to-day operations of this exciting activity. The Space Research and Planetary Sciences Division (WP) at the University of Bern has been at the forefront of space research for over 50 years. The Space Research and Planetary Sciences Division at the University of Bern is seeking a skilled and motivated Test or Electrical Engineer to support ongoing work with the ground reference model of NIM (Neutral and Ion Mass spectrometer), part of ESA's JUICE (JUpiter ICy moons Explorer) mission. jobs.title: Principal Process Chemist Specialist

jobs.description:
At Syngenta Group, we're a global community of 56,000 innovators across 90 countries, united by a 250-year legacy of agricultural excellence. As the world's most local agricultural technology partner, we create tailor-made solutions that transform farming while protecting our planet, driven by our commitment to innovation, ethics, and integrity. Through our inclusive environment and diverse perspectives, we pioneer breakthrough solutions for farmers, society, and future generations. Join our worldwide teams of agricultural pioneers in creating a more resilient and equitable food system for all.

Job Description

Purpose
•    Provide technical leadership for a particular product or capability within the Process Technology (PT) environment, holding the chemistry and process know-how for assigned chemical steps.
•    Lead the local technical team in the development, introduction, and support of chemical processes for new and mature intermediates and/or active substances, in close collaboration with WMU and Global Process Technology.
•    Drive improvement plans for chemical processes to increase capacity, improve quality, and reduce costs, while troubleshooting process issues (leading cost and process learning curves).
•    Support process relocation projects to external suppliers or other manufacturing sites, and coach junior chemists.

Accountabilities

General & HSE:
•    Ensure that the manufacturing process is safe and compliant with legal and internal HSE rules at all times.
•    Ensure process design meets the requirements of company and national HSEQ and regulatory standards (e.g., Chemical Reaction Hazards, PRA, Management of Change).
•    Define, plan, and control laboratory work, semi-technical, and full-scale plant trials to develop and test new or improved manufacturing processes.
•    Lead programs of scientific work, defining individual tasks and technical designs within complex, challenging projects.

•    Actively participate in local and global technical networks to share knowledge and stay connected with other Syngenta sites (CHMU, GBJH, etc.).
Production Support:
•    Define key process parameters and design control strategies to ensure they remain within safe and optimal limits.
•    Provide proactive technical support and troubleshooting to manufacturing plants to restore or improve production performance.

Supply Chain & Project Support:
•    Understand supply chain requirements and take a leading role in delivering objectives (acting as the Technology Lead for specific Active Ingredients (AIs) when required).
•    Lead the technical transfer of manufacturing processes to third parties (outsourcing) or other Syngenta facilities in coordination with the Technology & Sourcing Manager.

•    Process Safety: Solid understanding of process safety, reaction hazards, electrostatics, and environmental issues.
•    Change Management: Detailed knowledge of systems for process change and their potential implications on product quality (formulation, regulatory, etc.).
•    Business Acumen: Awareness of costing systems and the financial impact of PT development work on Supply Chain performance.

jobs.description:
Main purpose
Responsible for execution of Gasoline Blending operations and trader support. The role co-ordinates all aspects of post-deal trading activity to ensure contract execution runs efficiently, provides commercial and market information to the trader as necessary, and reviews and comments on contracts and tenders to ensure consistency with the trade ticket and recap.

Key responsibilities
For all Gasoline blended cargoes, be the key point of contact between the commercial desk and external stakeholders.
Liaise with terminals and vessels to ensure commercial blending plans are followed in line with the traders’ expectations.
Ensure with inspection companies that quality is as per blend plans and in line with contractual provisions.
Investigate Quantity losses and explore remedial action.
Trouble shoot when plans change and provide solutions.
Actively manage the terminals line up to mitigate demurrage.
Review stowage plans and monitor vessel progress during voyages.
Appoint third-party providers in line with group policy; oversee clean acceptance of vessels on subjects and chartering progress.
Liaise and co-ordinate with Finance, providing accurate and timely data needed for the issuance of L/Cs and P/Us.
Issue documentary instructions to suppliers and handle all aspects of customs exportation/importation where applicable.
Maintain good contract and shipping files electronically; keep Pluto updated regularly and minimise exceptions.
Complete voyage and storage reconciliations to identify and investigate loss/gain differences for each operation.
Monitor and advise the deals desk of all costs related to each transaction, maintaining P&L awareness.
Ensure operations are optimised to best commercial advantage, meeting all contractual obligations (e.g. minimising demurrage exposure).
Maximise recoveries; document, present and secure payment of all claims to third parties.
Maintain strong working relationships with trade support divisions — claims, deals desk, trade finance and chartering — and with counterparts and third-party service providers.
Train and develop less experienced members of the operations team to increase knowledge and commercial awareness.
Follow internal procedures and company policies; adhere to Trafigura's Code of Conduct, HSEC Policy and Business Principles.
Identify operational issues and escalate to the Regional Manager as appropriate.

Required qualifications
At least 5 years' experience in cargo operations in a global oil trading company.
Experience working on Gasoline cargo operations with a preference for experience with blending operations.
Ability to interpret the operational requirements of contracts and comment on operational aspects; understanding of the basic legal framework supporting oil contracts.
Ability to interpret charter party terms against the interacting oil contract; good understanding of common ship operations and terminology.
Good understanding of relevant petroleum product specifications, analytical methods, laboratory precision and inspection procedures.
Good understanding of different types of financial instruments, their uses, and the importance of LOIs and shipping documents within the trading process.

Preferred qualifications
Experience across multiple product desks (Gasoline, Distillates and Fuel Oil).
Familiarity with Pluto or similar trade operations management systems.
Exposure to storage logistics and reconciliation processes.

Attributes for success
Strong decision-making ability — comfortable navigating ambiguity and complexity in a fast-moving trading environment.
Effective networker who builds and maintains relationships with counterparts, service providers and internal stakeholders.
Organised and detail-oriented, with strong planning and prioritisation skills.
Resourceful and commercially aware, with a proactive approach to problem-solving.

Department overview
The Oil Cargo Operations department is responsible for the efficient and effective management of the physical movement of oil and petroleum products. The team ensures commodities are transported from origin to destination, meeting all contractual obligations and regulatory requirements. The department works closely with Traders, Finance, Deals Desk (Risk and P&L) and Chartering to support the full trade lifecycle.

Role Summary

Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.

As a Disputes and Chargeback Program Manager at Replit, you’ll be part of our Trust and Safety Operations team, who owns customer-facing workflows that handle sensitive and policy-driven interactions across the Support organization. This includes areas such as privacy requests, DMCA and intellectual property claims, law enforcement requests, and abuse appeals.

You'll own Replit's disputes and chargeback function end-to-end: from the individual case in front of you to the policies, playbooks, and automation that let it hold up as we scale to millions of users. This role combines strategic ownership with hands-on execution: you'll determine dispute and chargeback strategy, and build the systems that make those decisions repeatable at scale, working closely with Engineering, Legal and Finance.

 

In this role you will…

 - Own the full dispute lifecycle: investigate incoming chargebacks and disputes, decide whether and how to represent, gather evidence, and respond within network deadlines.

 - Design and maintain the policies, decision trees, and SOPs that govern how disputes and chargebacks are handled.

 - Define the key metrics, health targets, and goals for the disputes program and track performance against them, reporting to leadership.

 - Monitor chargeback rates and dispute trends to identify the underlying drivers of volume, and partner with Engineering and Finance to address root causes.

 - Partner with Engineering and Support Operations to automate manual parts of the workflow (evidence gathering, decisioning logic, etc).

 - Build training, documentation, and escalation paths that enable frontline support teams to handle dispute-related inquiries confidently and consistently as the program scales.



Required Skills and Experience:

 - 6+ years of hands-on experience owning disputes/chargebacks operations, ideally where you built or significantly leveled up the function rather than just running an existing one.

 - Deep familiarity with major card network dispute rules and reason codes (e.g., Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover), including compelling-evidence frameworks and network monitoring/excessive-dispute programs (e.g., Visa's VDMP/VFMP, Mastercard's ECP)

 - Experience building or improving SOPs, playbooks, or workflows in a support or operations environment.

 - Experience partnering with Engineering to scope and prioritize automation, even if you're not writing the code yourself.

 - Comfort operating as both a hands-on operator and systems builder in a scaling environment.

 - Strong judgment and decision-making skills when handling sensitive or ambiguous customer situations.

 - Experience translating policy or legal requirements into clear, repeatable processes or customer-facing guidance.

 - Strong written communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly, empathetically, and precisely in high-stakes situations.

 - Proven track record working cross-functionally to deliver impactful results.

 

Nice to Have:

 - Hands-on experience with Stripe's dispute tooling specifically, including submitting evidence and managing dispute workflows through Stripe.

 - Experience in customer support, trust & safety, support operations, or similar roles within a technology company.

 - Experience in a high-growth or usage-based SaaS environment, where dispute patterns and volume can shift quickly with product changes.

 - Familiarity with fraud detection tooling and how it intersects with the disputes function.

 - Experience managing outsourced or contract support as programs scale, in case this function grows beyond a single person down the line.

jobs.title: Senior/Media Manager
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



ABOUT THE ROLE

Replit is investing seriously in paid media — TV, CTV, online video, out-of-home, audio, social, and search — and we need the person who makes that investment work. This role is the internal owner of our media program: you'll direct our external media agencies, pressure-test their plans, steward the budget, and hold every dollar accountable for reaching the right audiences on the right channels at the right time.

You'll report to the VP of Marketing and act as the connective tissue between our brand and growth teams and our agency partners. This is not a hands-on-keyboard activation role. You won't be living in Ads Manager — you'll be the person who briefs the agency, challenges the channel mix, catches the pacing problem before it becomes a budget problem, and translates campaign performance into decisions leadership can act on.

This is the right role if you've sat on the brand side (or want to move there from a media agency), you know what a great media plan looks like and what a lazy one looks like, and you get energy from being the sharpest media mind in the room without needing to touch the platforms yourself.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Agency leadership: Serve as the primary day-to-day partner to our media agencies. Set strategy direction, write clear briefs, run planning cycles and QBRs, and hold partners accountable for performance, optimization, quality, and business results.

 - Plan interrogation: Review and challenge agency recommendations across every channel — TV, CTV, OLV, OOH, audio, social, search, programmatic. Catch weak rationale, frequency saturation risks, and budget misallocations before plans get approved.

 - Budget stewardship: Own media budget pacing, forecasting, authorizations, and reconciliation in partnership with Finance. Monitor spend and delivery mid-flight, flag risks early, and drive reallocations when the data says to.

 - Media strategy & planning: Lead annual, quarterly, and campaign-level planning with the agency. Make sure plans reflect our audiences, product moments, competitive pressure, and business goals — not just what's easy to buy.

 - Measurement & accountability: Define campaign KPIs and measurement frameworks with the agency and our analytics team. Own wrap reports, drive a test-and-learn agenda (incrementality, brand lift, MMM as we scale), and go beyond CPMs and impressions to reach efficiency and cost-per-outcome.

 - Executive reporting: Distill campaign and channel performance into clear recommendations for marketing leadership. Tell us what worked, what didn't, and what we should do differently — with numbers behind it.

 - Cross-functional alignment: Partner with Brand, Growth, Creative, Product Marketing, Social, and Comms so media plans amplify what the rest of marketing is building, and so creative assets fit the placements we're buying.



REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

 - 5+ years of media planning and strategy experience, either brand-side managing external agencies or at a media agency serving major consumer brands

 - Demonstrated experience independently reviewing and challenging agency media plans, not just executing against them

 - Experience managing multi-million dollar media budgets across concurrent campaigns, including pacing, forecasting, and mid-flight reallocation

 - Fluency across the full channel landscape: TV/CTV, online video, OOH, audio/podcasts, paid social, search, and programmatic — you can evaluate rates, rationale, and audience fit in any of them

 - Strong command of media measurement: reach and frequency, brand lift, incrementality testing, and marketing mix modeling

 - Sharp analytical skills; you can work from raw campaign data to find performance trends and budget inefficiencies, and you're at home in Excel

 - Strong stakeholder management across Finance, Analytics, Creative, and agency teams; you write briefs people can actually work from

 - AI-native: actively using AI tools to speed up analysis, reporting, and planning work — you're not just aware of them, you're using them daily

 - Comfort operating in ambiguity and at speed; you don't need committee consensus to make smart decisions



BONUS QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience at a high-growth consumer tech, B2C, or AI company

jobs.title: Influencer Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
At Aftershoot, we're building a global community of photographers who spend less time behind their screens and more time behind the lens. Every feature we create, every update we ship, is designed to make post-processing easier, faster, and smarter for photographers around the world.

From culling to editing to retouching. Our AI tools do all the heavy lifting, so photographers can focus on what they do best: capturing moments, telling stories, and creating magic.

We're a fast-growing, passionate team backed by 100K+ active users globally. Double-digit ARR in less than 4 years, amazing investors and a team who truly believe in our mission.

Our mission is clear: Become the default companion for every photographer in the world. If you care deeply about building meaningful products, working with curious and driven teammates, and being part of a team that genuinely loves what they do, we'd love to meet you.

Let's create the future of AI in photography, together.

About the Role

This is a function-owner role, not an execution role.

Aftershoot already invests seven figures a year into creators, and creator-led content is one of the biggest drivers of how photographers discover us. What we don't yet have is someone who owns it end to end: who decides where the money goes, which creators earn a renewal, what the content should actually say, and how we prove any of it worked.

That's you. You'll set the strategy, own the budget, build the partner roster, and lead a small team of executives who handle day-to-day outreach and campaign management. Most of our creators are based in the US, so you'll be working across US time zones on a regular basis.

You'll come in with a clear mandate: make the same spend go three times further, or deliver the same results for meaningfully less. Both are good answers.

What You'll Do

â¢ Own Aftershoot's global influencer and creator marketing strategy end to end, with the US as the primary market.

â¢ Own the annual creator budget: allocate it, defend it, sunset what isn't working, and double down on what is.

â¢ Build and maintain the partner roster across YouTube, Instagram, and TikTok, spanning photography, creative-tools, and tech audiences.â¢ Move the program from one-off sponsored posts toward recurring partnerships, ambassador structures, and long-term creator relationships.

â¢ Build the measurement layer: attribution, incrementality, cost per trial and per paid conversion by creator, so renewal decisions are made on evidence rather than instinct.

â¢ Negotiate rates, deliverables, exclusivity, and usage rights, including whitelisting so strong creator content can be repurposed into paid media.

â¢ Get content actually shipped: briefing creators, holding them to timelines, and getting the work over the line when it slips.

â¢ Hire, manage, and coach a team of 2â3 Influencer Marketing Executives.

â¢ Work closely with Growth, Content, Product Marketing, and Design so creator content plugs into the wider marketing engine rather than running beside it.

â¢ Plan and run creator activity around peak moments like Black Friday and major product launches.

â¢ Explore adjacent channels where they make sense: affiliate, community, events, and podcast partnerships.

What You'll Bring

â¢ 5â8 years in influencer, creator, or partnerships marketing, at an agency or in-house, with at least 2 of those years setting strategy rather than only executing campaigns.

â¢ Direct experience managing a meaningful creator budget, and the ability to walk us through how you spent it and what you got back.

â¢ Experience working with US or international creators, and comfort operating across time zones.

â¢ Excellent spoken and written English. Much of this job is video calls and negotiation with US-based creators, so you need to be clear, natural, and persuasive live.

â¢ Real negotiation instincts. Paying a creator is the beginning of the relationship, not the end of it, and getting good work out of a partner takes persistence and charm in equal measure.

â¢ Comfort with numbers: you can look at a campaign and form a point of view on whether it earned its keep.

â¢ Working knowledge of creator tooling and affiliate platforms (GRIN, CreatorIQ, Modash, Upfluence, Aspire, Impact.com, PartnerStack, or similar).

â¢ A bias toward action. We move fast, we test in the market rather than in slide decks, and we'd rather fix a live campaign than perfect a plan.

Nice to have, genuinely not required

â¢ A background in photography, creative tools, or prosumer software.

â¢ Experience in a consumer AI or global SaaS company.

â¢ Experience building a creator program from zero.

We are not filtering for photography experience. If you've built creator programs in D2C, gaming, fintech, or anywhere else that scales, the playbook travels.

What You'll Gain

â¢ Full ownership of a function from day one, with a seven-figure budget and no legacy playbook to inherit.

â¢ Direct line to leadership and real influence over how Aftershoot grows.

â¢ A global creator community in a category people are genuinely passionate about.

â¢ The chance to build a team around you as the program scales.

What Happens After You Apply?

  1. Phone Screen â If your profile looks like a fit, our People team will reach out for an intro call.

  2. Team Interview â A deeper conversation on your experience and how you've run creator programs before.

  3. Case Discussion â We'll share real context on our program a day ahead, then talk through how you'd approach it. No 20-slide deck required.

  4. Bar-Raiser Interview â Meet our leadership team for a final evaluation.

  5. Offer! â If it goes well, we'll extend a formal offer and welcome you on board.

jobs.title: Lead Product Designer
jobs.description:
About us

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our People

With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our Impact

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. Weâre proud to be a part of that.Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

About the Role

We are seeking a Lead Product Designer who can elevate HighLevel's product experiences through exceptional craft, product vision, systems thinking and influence. You have spent 7+ years designing complex digital products, ideally including SaaS, B2B, platform, workflow-heavy or similarly sophisticated product experiences, and are ready to shape product direction, design standards and team culture across one or more product pillars.

As a lead individual contributor, you will partner deeply with product and engineering leaders, mentor other designers and help teams define and improve strategically important product experiences across the HighLevel platform. You will connect customer needs, business goals, technical constraints and long-term product strategy to clear, useful and highly polished product design.

We expect candidates at this level to demonstrate an extraordinarily high bar for design craft and visual sophistication, and to raise that bar for the teams around them. You should care deeply about hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, interaction quality, usability, accessibility and the standards that make product experiences feel refined, trustworthy and coherent at scale. We want candidates who can ship truly world-class product design.

Experience using AI-powered tools for exploration, prototyping, critique, synthesis or workflow acceleration is mandatory. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

What You Can Expect

  • Autonomy to shape design direction across one or more strategically important product pillars.

  • Meaningful influence with product, engineering and senior leadership on product quality, customer outcomes and roadmap direction.

  • The opportunity to raise the design bar across multiple teams through critique, standards, mentorship and systems thinking.

  • Partnership with ambitious product, engineering, data and design peers who value clarity, speed, craft and customer outcomes.

  • A craft-forward design culture where lead designers help strengthen design practice, improve team rituals and grow other designers.

  • A 100% remote environment where distributed collaboration is normal. Employees in all geographies are expected to be flexible and thoughtful about working hours so US- and India-based colleagues can collaborate effectively.

What We Are Looking For

  • 7+ years of relevant product design experience, with 2+ years in a leadership, mentorship or design direction capacity; experience in SaaS, B2B, platform, workflow-heavy or other complex digital product environments is highly valuable.

  • An exceptionally strong portfolio that demonstrates systematic thinking, customer empathy, exceptional craft, measurable product impact and leadership beyond individual execution.

  • Proven experience leading data-informed product design across the full lifecycle, including research, information architecture, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, content strategy and usability testing.

  • Exceptional visual and interaction design craft, with deep care for hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, motion, usability, accessibility and product quality.

  • Experience designing for AI-driven or intelligent interfaces, including collaboration with machine learning, data, automation or platform teams.

  • Deep fluency in design systems, accessibility standards, reusable patterns and scalable product experience decisions.

  • Experience influencing design direction for high-impact product areas, systems, platforms or pillars, not only individual features or flows.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills and the ability to work fluently with product managers, engineers, data partners, customer-facing teams, senior stakeholders and other designers.

  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to simplify complex ideas, lead critiques and workshops and persuade through rationale, evidence and craft.

  • Passion for improving team operations, design standards, processes, tools, documentation and better ways for teams to work.

In This Role, You Will

  • Lead design strategy and execution for one or more product pillars from discovery through delivery.

  • Translate customer needs, business goals, product strategy and technical constraints into clear experience direction and design roadmaps.

  • Partner with product and engineering leaders to define product vision, prioritize opportunities and align teams around high-quality outcomes.

  • Influence leadership decisions through customer empathy, data synthesis, product judgment, storytelling and strong design rationale.

  • Drive design quality reviews and set standards for usability, accessibility, interaction quality, visual consistency and design system alignment.

  • Raise the quality of multiple teams by mentoring designers, improving critique, strengthening shared patterns and making standards easier to adopt.

  • Define and socialize metrics for design quality and impact, such as usability signals, accessibility compliance, task success, adoption, retention or customer satisfaction.

  • Lead complex discovery and design efforts through ambiguity by synthesizing inputs, framing decisions and helping teams move with clarity.

How You Work

  • You raise the bar for craft, visual sophistication and product quality across the teams around you.

  • You move comfortably between product strategy, customer insight, systems thinking and hands-on design execution.

  • You balance speed, detail, scalability and quality without losing sight of the customer.

  • You build trust through warmth, candor, accountability and genuine respect for your teammates as people.

  • You enjoy leading collaboration across time zones and cultural contexts, including with US- and India-based teammates.

  • You communicate in ways that help distributed teams work with clarity, care, trust and momentum.

  • You advocate for accessibility, inclusion and ethical design.

jobs.title: Senior Independent AI Engineer / Architect
jobs.description:
Senior Independent AI Engineer / Architect

Remote | Americas, Europe, or Israel

 

Most AI engineers can find work.

 

Finding work worth doing is harder.

 

A.Team is an invite-only network of senior AI engineers, ML engineers, and AI architects building production AI systems for startups, enterprises, and global companies.

 

Since 2020, builders in the network have earned more than $200M working with companies including Lyft, Google X, HCA, Unilever, Sightful, D-ID, and others.

 

The Work

You'll join small teams solving real problems.

 

Not demos.

Not proof-of-concepts that never ship.

Not another thin wrapper around an API.


Recent work has included:

 

  •  AI-native products built from 0→1
  • Agent architectures and orchestration systems
  • Enterprise AI deployments
  • Retrieval, evaluation, and reliability infrastructure
  • LLM-powered workflows and products
  • Machine learning platforms operating at scale

 

You'll work directly with founders, CTOs, and product leaders, helping shape both technical direction and execution.

 

Why Builders Join

The best opportunities rarely make it to the open market.

 

A.Team exists to solve that.

 

No bidding.

 

No prospecting.

 

No race to the bottom.

 

Just ambitious companies, difficult problems, and experienced peers.

 

Who Thrives Here 

People who have already shipped.

 

Engineers who have deployed AI systems into production, understand the tradeoffs behind the hype, and know how to turn technical complexity into business value.

 

What matters is a track record of building and shipping.

 

The Details

 

  • Typical rates: $120-$170/hr
  • Remote
  • You keep 100% of your rate

 

Not a Fit

  • Early-career engineers
  • People without production AI experience
  • Small gig seekers
  • Developers focused primarily on simple AI wrappers or templated implementations

 

Apply

Tell us what you've built.

👉 build.a.team/apply-ai.

We'll take it from there.

jobs.title: Senior Independent Software Developer
jobs.description:
You must be located in the Americas, Europe, or Israel to apply.


A·Team is a VC-backed, stealth, application-only home on the internet for senior independent software builders to team up with hand-picked, high-growth companies on their next big thing. 

After talking with hundreds of independent engineers, designers, and product folks, we heard over and over that finding vetted, high-quality, consistent clients is hard, and projects are often too small to be rewarding. A·Team matches small teams of the most talented builders in the world with companies backed by a16z, YC, Softbank, General Catalyst, etc. on a contract basis for many of their most important initiatives. We quietly launched in May 2020, and have helped A·Teamers earn $85+ million since.

As part of A·Team, you can expect:

  • High-paying, meaningful missions with the most audacious companies sent your way; generally $90-$150+/hr, with vetted, fascinating clients doing work that matters. We're picky about who we partner with; new clients only come in via trusted referral. We've worked with Lyft, McGraw Hill, ClearCo, Pepsi, Walmart, the former CEO of Waze, the leading vaccine production software, several new unicorns we can't say here, and dozens of startups backed by a16z/YC/Softbank/Insight/Tiger/etc.
  • Work alongside friends old & new: our niche is small/diverse product teams, since clients with larger budgets and higher-impact work tell us they want teams, not individuals. Of course, we keep friends together whenever we can.
  • Full autonomy: say "no" to things that don't excite you. The most talented builders often juggle a few things at once, so there's never pressure to join an A·Team mission if you don't have the bandwidth. If we're no longer a fit, it's easy to leave or pause too. 
  • Small, curated, off-the-record gatherings: for conversations hard to have elsewhere. Long-term, we're creating micro-communities for the world's top builders to become friends around the things they care about.
  • Keep 100% of what you earn: if you charge $120/hr, you get $120/hr. A·Team makes money by charging a small, flat, transparent platform fee on top of your rate.

 

 

How to apply:

Go here: https://build.a.team/remotivereferral + mention Remotive. We respect your time so the application is short. We're also much more interested in seeing what you've made, and excited to chat more if there’s a fit.

What you’ll do:

  • Once part of A.Team, you’ll regularly be invited to impactful missions that match your interests. Find the right pick from early-stage incubations with world-class founders, to fast-growing super-funded companies, to old school non-tech incumbents looking to build as a tech giant would

  • Missions usually involve building an ambitious piece of software from 0 to 1 as part of a small 3-4 person team. 

  • You’ll be paid to scope it out, give the client options, guide strategy, and execute on the selected solution. Sometimes the client has a clear vision, sometimes not; which is why A.Team builders tend to be senior folks who can work together to find the right direction. 

Who A·Team is for:

  • Senior software developers who left large companies and high-growth startups to pursue their craft with autonomy.

  • Those who prefer consistent contract work over a full-time role, who want to create a variety of new products alongside other top-tier builders.

  • The majority of A.Teamers spend most of their time doing independent work, but a sizeable percentage are either employed full-time (but testing out client work), bootstrapping a side project, or looking for their next big thing

Who A·Team is not for:

  • People looking for small gigs

  • Folks looking to build simple wordpress/wix/squarespace-style websites

  • Those still early in their careers (<4 years) and recent university/bootcamp grads (at least not yet)

Our long-term vision:

A·Team is a new type of company for a new kind of independent software builder. We call them "unhirables": people who traditional companies couldn’t hire full-time even if they wanted to, but who want to do their most meaningful work with their favorite people in small, autonomous, distributed expert teams. 

To help us secure amazing missions, we raised $60 million+  from Insight Partenrs, Tiger Global, NFX, RocNation, along with the former CEO of Upwork, the founders of Fiverr and Lemonade, Apple's Global Head of Recruiting, YC Partner Aaron Harris, Wharton's Adam Grant, and Duke's Dan Ariely.
